text_en: The former treatise I made , O Theophilus, of all things which Jesus began to do and to teach,
text_la: Primum quidem sermonem feci de omnibus, o Theophile, quæ cœpit Jesus facere et docere
text_pt: Fiz o primeiro tratado, ó Teófilo, acerca de tudo que Jesus começou, não só a fazer, mas a ensinar,
text_el: Τὸν μὲν πρῶτον λόγον ἐποιησάμην περὶ πάντων, ὦ Θεόφιλε, ὧν ἤρξατο Ἰησοῦς ποιεῖν τε καὶ διδάσκειν

text_en: until the day on which, giving commandments by the Holy Ghost to the apostles whom he had chosen, he was taken up —
text_la: usque in diem qua præcipiens Apostolis per Spiritum Sanctum, quos elegit, assumptus est:
text_pt: Até ao dia em que foi recebido em cima, depois de ter dado mandamentos, pelo Espírito Santo, aos apóstolos que escolhera;
text_el: ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας ἐντειλάμενος τοῖς ἀποστόλοις διὰ πνεύματος ἁγίου οὓς ἐξελέξατο ἀνελήμφθη:

text_en: to whom also he showed himself alive after his passion , by many proofs , for forty days appearing to them, and speaking of the kingdom of God .
text_la: quibus et præbuit seipsum vivum post passionem suam in multis argumentis, per dies quadraginta apparens eis, et loquens de regno Dei.
text_pt: Aos quais também, depois de ter padecido, se apresentou vivo, com muitas e infalíveis provas, sendo visto por eles por espaço de quarenta dias, e falando das coisas concernentes ao reino de Deus.
text_el: οἷς καὶ παρέστησεν ἑαυτὸν ζῶντα μετὰ τὸ παθεῖν αὐτὸν ἐν πολλοῖς τεκμηρίοις, δι' ἡμερῶν τεσσεράκοντα ὀπτανόμενος αὐτοῖς καὶ λέγων τὰ περὶ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And eating together with them, he commanded them, that they should not depart from Jerusalem , but should wait for the promise of the Father , which you have heard (says he) by my mouth.
text_la: Et convescens, præcepit eis ab Jerosolymis ne discederent, sed exspectarent promissionem Patris, quam audistis (inquit) per os meum:
text_pt: E, estando com eles, determinou-lhes que não se ausentassem de Jerusalém, mas que esperassem a promessa do Pai, que, disse ele, de mim ouvistes.
text_el: καὶ συναλιζόμενος παρήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων μὴ χωρίζεσθαι, ἀλλὰ περιμένειν τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ πατρὸς ἣν ἠκούσατέ μου:

text_en: For John indeed baptized with water: but you shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost , not many days hence.
text_la: quia Joannes quidem baptizavit aqua, vos autem baptizabimini Spiritu Sancto non post multos hos dies.
text_pt: Porque, na verdade, João batizou com água, mas vós sereis batizados com o Espírito Santo, não muito depois destes dias.
text_el: ὅτι Ἰωάννης μὲν ἐβάπτισεν ὕδατι, ὑμεῖς δὲ ἐν πνεύματι βαπτισθήσεσθε ἁγίῳ οὐ μετὰ πολλὰς ταύτας ἡμέρας.

text_en: They therefore who had come together, asked him, saying: Lord, will you at this time restore again the kingdom of Israel ?
text_la: Igitur qui convenerant, interrogabant eum, dicentes : Domine, si in tempore hoc restitues regnum Israël?
text_pt: Aqueles, pois, que se haviam reunido perguntaram-lhe, dizendo: Senhor, restaurarás tu neste tempo o reino a Israel?
text_el: οἱ μὲν οὖν συνελθόντες ἠρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες: κύριε, εἰ ἐν τῷ χρόνῳ τούτῳ ἀποκαθιστάνεις τὴν βασιλείαν τῷ Ἰσραήλ;

text_en: But he said to them: It is not for you to know the time or moments, which the Father has put in his own power:
text_la: Dixit autem eis: Non est vestrum nosse tempora vel momenta quæ Pater posuit in sua potestate:
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Não vos pertence saber os tempos ou as estações que o Pai estabeleceu pelo seu próprio poder.
text_el: εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς, οὐχ ὑμῶν ἐστιν γνῶναι χρόνους ἢ καιροὺς οὓς ὁ πατὴρ ἔθετο ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ,

text_en: But you shall receive the power of the Holy Ghost coming upon you, and you shall be witnesses unto me in Jerusalem , and in all Judea , and Samaria , and even to the uttermost part of the earth.
text_la: sed accipietis virtutem supervenientis Spiritus Sancti in vos, et eritis mihi testes in Jerusalem, et in omni Judæa, et Samaria, et usque ad ultimum terræ.
text_pt: Mas recebereis a virtude do Espírito Santo, que há de vir sobre vós; e ser-me-eis testemunhas, tanto em Jerusalém como em toda a Judéia e Samaria, e até aos confins da terra.
text_el: ἀλλὰ λήμψεσθε δύναμιν ἐπελθόντος τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος ἐφ' ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἔσεσθέ μου μάρτυρες ἔν τε Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ Σαμαρείᾳ καὶ ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς.

text_en: And when he had said these things, while they looked on, he was raised up : and a cloud received him out of their sight.
text_la: Et cum hæc dixisset, videntibus illis, elevatus est : et nubes suscepit eum ab oculis eorum.
text_pt: E, quando dizia isto, vendo-o eles, foi elevado às alturas, e uma nuvem o recebeu, ocultando-o a seus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα εἰπὼν βλεπόντων αὐτῶν ἐπήρθη, καὶ νεφέλη ὑπέλαβεν αὐτὸν ἀπὸ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν.

text_en: And while they were beholding him going up to heaven , behold two men stood by them in white garments.
text_la: Cumque intuerentur in cælum euntem illum, ecce duo viri astiterunt juxta illos in vestibus albis,
text_pt: E, estando com os olhos fitos no céu, enquanto ele subia, eis que junto deles se puseram dois homens vestidos de branco.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἀτενίζοντες ἦσαν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν πορευομένου αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες δύο παρειστήκεισαν αὐτοῖς ἐν ἐσθήσεσι λευκαῖς,

text_en: Who also said: You men of Galilee , why stand you looking up to heaven ? This Jesus who is taken up from you into heaven , shall so come as you have seen him going into heaven .
text_la: qui et dixerunt : Viri Galilæi, quid statis aspicientes in cælum? Hic Jesus, qui assumptus est a vobis in cælum, sic veniet quemadmodum vidistis eum euntem in cælum.
text_pt: Os quais lhes disseram: Homens galileus, por que estais olhando para o céu? Esse Jesus, que dentre vós foi recebido em cima no céu, há de vir assim como para o céu o vistes ir.
text_el: οἳ καὶ εἶπαν: ἄνδρες Γαλιλαῖοι, τί ἑστήκατε βλέποντες εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν; οὗτος ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὁ ἀναλημφθεὶς ἀφ' ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν οὕτως ἐλεύσεται ὃν τρόπον ἐθεάσασθε αὐτὸν πορευόμενον εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν.

text_en: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mount that is called Olivet , which is near Jerusalem , within a sabbath day's journey.
text_la: Tunc reversi sunt Jerosolymam a monte qui vocatur Oliveti, qui est juxta Jerusalem, sabbati habens iter.
text_pt: Então voltaram para Jerusalém, do monte chamado das Oliveiras, o qual está perto de Jerusalém, à distância do caminho de um sábado.
text_el: Τότε ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἀπὸ ὄρους τοῦ καλουμένου ἐλαιῶνος, ὅ ἐστιν ἐγγὺς Ἰερουσαλὴμ σαββάτου ἔχον ὁδόν.

text_en: And when they had come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode Peter and John , James and Andrew , Philip and Thomas , Bartholomew and Matthew , James of Alpheus and Simon Zelotes and Jude the brother of James .
text_la: Et cum introissent in cœnaculum, ascenderunt ubi manebant Petrus, et Joannes, Jacobus, et Andreas, Philippus, et Thomas, Bartholomæus, et Matthæus, Jacobus Alphæi, et Simon Zelotes, et Judas Jacobi.
text_pt: E, entrando, subiram ao cenáculo, onde habitavam Pedro e Tiago, João e André, Filipe e Tomé, Bartolomeu e Mateus, Tiago, filho de Alfeu, Simão, o Zelote, e Judas, irmào de Tiago.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε εἰσῆλθον, εἰς τὸ ὑπερῷον ἀνέβησαν οὗ ἦσαν καταμένοντες, ὅ τε Πέτρος καὶ Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἀνδρέας, Φίλιππος καὶ Θωμᾶς, Βαρθολομαῖος καὶ Μαθθαῖος, Ἰάκωβος Ἁλφαίου καὶ Σίμων ὁ ζηλωτὴς καὶ Ἰούδας Ἰακώβου.

text_en: All these were persevering with one mind in prayer with the women , and Mary the mother of Jesus , and with his brethren .
text_la: Hi omnes erant perseverantes unanimiter in oratione cum mulieribus, et Maria matre Jesu, et fratribus ejus.
text_pt: Todos estes perseveravam unanimemente em oração e súplicas, com as mulheres, e Maria mãe de Jesus, e com seus irmãos.
text_el: οὗτοι πάντες ἦσαν προσκαρτεροῦντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν τῇ προσευχῇ σὺν γυναιξὶν καὶ Μαριὰμ τῇ μητρὶ [τοῦ] Ἰησοῦ καὶ σὺν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ.

text_en: In those days Peter rising up in the midst of the brethren, said (now the number of persons together was about an hundred and twenty):
text_la: In diebus illis, exsurgens Petrus in medio fratrum, dixit (erat autem turba hominum simul, fere centum viginti):
text_pt: E naqueles dias, levantando-se Pedro no meio dos discípulos (ora a multidão junta era de quase cento e vinte pessoas) disse:
text_el: Καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις ἀναστὰς Πέτρος ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν εἶπεν ἦν τε ὄχλος ὀνομάτων ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ὡς ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι,

text_en: Men, brethren, the scripture must needs be fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas , who was the leader of them that apprehended Jesus :
text_la: Viri fratres, oportet impleri Scripturam quam prædixit Spiritus Sanctus per os David de Juda, qui fuit dux eorum qui comprehenderunt Jesum:
text_pt: Homens irmãos, convinha que se cumprisse a Escritura que o Espírito Santo predisse pela boca de Davi, acerca de Judas, que foi o guia daqueles que prenderam a Jesus;
text_el: ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, ἔδει πληρωθῆναι τὴν γραφὴν ἣν προεῖπεν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον διὰ στόματος Δαυὶδ περὶ Ἰούδα τοῦ γενομένου ὁδηγοῦ τοῖς συλλαβοῦσιν Ἰησοῦν,

text_en: Who was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry .
text_la: qui connumeratus erat in nobis, et sortitus est sortem ministerii hujus.
text_pt: Porque foi contado conosco e alcançou sorte neste ministério.
text_el: ὅτι κατηριθμημένος ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν καὶ ἔλαχεν τὸν κλῆρον τῆς διακονίας ταύτης.

text_en: And he indeed has possessed a field of the reward of iniquity , and being hanged, burst asunder in the midst: and all his bowels gushed out.
text_la: Et hic quidem possedit agrum de mercede iniquitatis, et suspensus crepuit medius : et diffusa sunt omnia viscera ejus.
text_pt: Ora, este adquiriu um campo com o galardão da iniqüidade; e, precipitando-se, rebentou pelo meio, e todas as suas entranhas se derramaram.
text_el: οὗτος μὲν οὖν ἐκτήσατο χωρίον ἐκ μισθοῦ τῆς ἀδικίας, καὶ πρηνὴς γενόμενος ἐλάκησεν μέσος, καὶ ἐξεχύθη πάντα τὰ σπλάγχνα αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And it became known to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem : so that the same field was called in their tongue, Haceldama , that is to say, The field of blood .
text_la: Et notum factum est omnibus habitantibus Jerusalem, ita ut appellaretur ager ille, lingua eorum, Haceldama, hoc est, ager sanguinis.
text_pt: E foi notório a todos os que habitam em Jerusalém; de maneira que na sua própria língua esse campo se chama Aceldama, isto é, Campo de Sangue.
text_el: καὶ γνωστὸν ἐγένετο πᾶσι τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ, ὥστε κληθῆναι τὸ χωρίον ἐκεῖνο τῇ διαλέκτῳ αὐτῶν Ἁκελδαμάχ, τοῦτ' ἔστιν, χωρίον αἵματος.

text_en: For it is written in the book of Psalms : Let their habitation become desolate, and let there be none to dwell therein. And his bishopric let another take.
text_la: Scriptum est enim in libro Psalmorum : Fiat commoratio eorum deserta, et non sit qui inhabitet in ea : et episcopatum ejus accipiat alter.
text_pt: Porque no livro dos Salmos está escrito: Fique deserta a sua habitação, E não haja quem nela habite, e: Tome outro o seu bispado.
text_el: γέγραπται γὰρ ἐν βίβλῳ ψαλμῶν, γενηθήτω ἡ ἔπαυλις αὐτοῦ ἔρημος καὶ μὴ ἔστω ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν αὐτῇ, καί, τὴν ἐπισκοπὴν αὐτοῦ λαβέτω ἕτερος.

text_en: Wherefore of these men who have companied with us, all the time that the Lord Jesus came in and went out among us,
text_la: Oportet ergo ex his viris qui nobiscum sunt congregati in omni tempore quo intravit et exivit inter nos Dominus Jesus,
text_pt: É necessário, pois, que, dos homens que conviveram conosco todo o tempo em que o Senhor Jesus entrou e saiu dentre nós,
text_el: δεῖ οὖν τῶν συνελθόντων ἡμῖν ἀνδρῶν ἐν παντὶ χρόνῳ ᾧ εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ὁ κύριος Ἰησοῦς,

text_en: beginning from the baptism of John , until the day wherein he was taken up from us, one of these must be made a witness with us of his resurrection .
text_la: incipiens a baptismate Joannis usque in diem qua assumptus est a nobis, testem resurrectionis ejus nobiscum fieri unum ex istis.
text_pt: Começando desde o batismo de João até ao dia em que de entre nós foi recebido em cima, um deles se faça conosco testemunha da sua ressurreição.
text_el: ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τοῦ βαπτίσματος Ἰωάννου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἀνελήμφθη ἀφ' ἡμῶν, μάρτυρα τῆς ἀναστάσεως αὐτοῦ σὺν ἡμῖν γενέσθαι ἕνα τούτων.

text_en: And they appointed two, Joseph, called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias .
text_la: Et statuerunt duos, Joseph, qui vocabatur Barsabas, qui cognominatus est Justus, et Mathiam.
text_pt: E apresentaram dois: José, chamado Barsabás, que tinha por sobrenome o Justo, e Matias.
text_el: Καὶ ἔστησαν δύο, Ἰωσὴφ τὸν καλούμενον Βαρσαββᾶν, ὃς ἐπεκλήθη Ἰοῦστος, καὶ Μαθθίαν.

text_en: And praying , they said: You, Lord, who know the heart of all men , show whether of these two you have chosen,
text_la: Et orantes dixerunt : Tu Domine, qui corda nosti omnium, ostende quem elegeris ex his duobus unum,
text_pt: E, orando, disseram: Tu, Senhor, conhecedor dos corações de todos, mostra qual destes dois tens escolhido,
text_el: καὶ προσευξάμενοι εἶπαν, σὺ κύριε, καρδιογνῶστα πάντων, ἀνάδειξον ὃν ἐξελέξω ἐκ τούτων τῶν δύο ἕνα

text_en: to take the place of this ministry and apostleship , from which Judas has by transgression fallen, that he might go to his own place.
text_la: accipere locum ministerii hujus et apostolatus, de quo prævaricatus est Judas ut abiret in locum suum.
text_pt: Para que tome parte neste ministério e apostolado, de que Judas se desviou, para ir para o seu próprio lugar.
text_el: λαβεῖν τὸν τόπον τῆς διακονίας ταύτης καὶ ἀποστολῆς, ἀφ' ἧς παρέβη Ἰούδας πορευθῆναι εἰς τὸν τόπον τὸν ἴδιον.

text_en: And they gave them lot , and the lot fell upon Matthias , and he was numbered with the eleven apostles .
text_la: Et dederunt sortes eis, et cecidit sors super Mathiam : et annumeratus est cum undecim Apostolis.
text_pt: E, lançando-lhes sortes, caiu a sorte sobre Matias. E por voto comum foi contado com os onze apóstolos.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν κλήρους αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἔπεσεν ὁ κλῆρος ἐπὶ Μαθθίαν, καὶ συγκατεψηφίσθη μετὰ τῶν ἕνδεκα ἀποστόλων.

text_en: And when the days of the Pentecost were accomplished, they were all together in one place;
text_la: Et cum complerentur dies Pentecostes, erant omnes pariter in eodem loco:
text_pt: E, cumprindo-se o dia de Pentecostes, estavam todos concordemente no mesmo lugar;
text_el: Καὶ ἐν τῷ συμπληροῦσθαι τὴν ἡμέραν τῆς πεντηκοστῆς ἦσαν πάντες ὁμοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό.

text_en: and suddenly there came a sound from heaven , as of a mighty wind coming, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting.
text_la: et factus est repente de cælo sonus, tamquam advenientis spiritus vehementis, et replevit totam domum ubi erant sedentes.
text_pt: E de repente veio do céu um som, como de um vento veemente e impetuoso, e encheu toda a casa em que estavam assentados.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἄφνω ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἦχος ὥσπερ φερομένης πνοῆς βιαίας καὶ ἐπλήρωσεν ὅλον τὸν οἶκον οὗ ἦσαν καθήμενοι:

text_en: And there appeared to them parted tongues, as it were of fire, and it sat upon every one of them.
text_la: Et apparuerunt illis dispertitæ linguæ tamquam ignis, seditque supra singulos eorum:
text_pt: E foram vistas por eles línguas repartidas, como que de fogo, as quais pousaram sobre cada um deles.
text_el: καὶ ὤφθησαν αὐτοῖς διαμεριζόμεναι γλῶσσαι ὡσεὶ πυρός, καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐφ' ἕνα ἕκαστον αὐτῶν,

text_en: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and they began to speak with divers tongues , according as the Holy Ghost gave them to speak.
text_la: et repleti sunt omnes Spiritu Sancto, et cœperunt loqui variis linguis, prout Spiritus Sanctus dabat eloqui illis.
text_pt: E todos foram cheios do Espírito Santo, e começaram a falar noutras línguas, conforme o Espírito Santo lhes concedia que falassem.
text_el: καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν πάντες πνεύματος ἁγίου, καὶ ἤρξαντο λαλεῖν ἑτέραις γλώσσαις καθὼς τὸ πνεῦμα ἐδίδου ἀποφθέγγεσθαι αὐτοῖς.

text_en: Now there were, dwelling at Jerusalem , Jews — devout men , out of every nation under heaven .
text_la: Erant autem in Jerusalem habitantes Judæi, viri religiosi ex omni natione quæ sub cælo est.
text_pt: E em Jerusalém estavam habitando judeus, homens religiosos, de todas as nações que estão debaixo do céu.
text_el: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ κατοικοῦντες Ἰουδαῖοι, ἄνδρες εὐλαβεῖς ἀπὸ παντὸς ἔθνους τῶν ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν:

text_en: And when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded in mind , because every man heard them speak in his own tongue .
text_la: Facta autem hac voce, convenit multitudo, et mente confusa est, quoniam audiebat unusquisque lingua sua illos loquentes.
text_pt: E, quando aquele som ocorreu, ajuntou-se uma multidão, e estava confusa, porque cada um os ouvia falar na sua própria língua.
text_el: γενομένης δὲ τῆς φωνῆς ταύτης συνῆλθεν τὸ πλῆθος καὶ συνεχύθη, ὅτι ἤκουσεν εἷς ἕκαστος τῇ ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ λαλούντων αὐτῶν.

text_en: And they were all amazed, and wondered, saying: "Behold, are not all these that speak Galilean ?
text_la: Stupebant autem omnes, et mirabantur, dicentes : Nonne ecce omnes isti qui loquuntur, Galilæi sunt?
text_pt: E todos pasmavam e se maravilhavam, dizendo uns aos outros: Pois quê! não são galileus todos esses homens que estão falando?
text_el: ἐξίσταντο δὲ καὶ ἐθαύμαζον λέγοντες, οὐχὶ ἰδοὺ πάντες οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ λαλοῦντες Γαλιλαῖοι;

text_en: And how have we heard, every man our own tongue wherein we were born?
text_la: et quomodo nos audivimus unusquisque linguam nostram in qua nati sumus?
text_pt: Como, pois, os ouvimos, cada um, na nossa própria língua em que somos nascidos?
text_el: καὶ πῶς ἡμεῖς ἀκούομεν ἕκαστος τῇ ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ ἡμῶν ἐν ᾗ ἐγεννήθημεν;

text_en: Parthians and Medes and Elamites and inhabitants of Mesopotamia, Judea , and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia ,
text_la: Parthi, et Medi, et Ælamitæ, et qui habitant Mespotamiam, Judæam, et Cappadociam, Pontum, et Asiam,
text_pt: Partos e medos, elamitas e os que habitam na Mesopotâmia, Judéia, Capadócia, Ponto e Asia,
text_el: Πάρθοι καὶ Μῆδοι καὶ Ἐλαμῖται, καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν, Ἰουδαίαν τε καὶ Καππαδοκίαν, Πόντον καὶ τὴν Ἀσίαν,

text_en: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya about Cyrene , and strangers of Rome ,
text_la: Phrygiam, et Pamphyliam, Ægyptum, et partes Libyæ quæ est circa Cyrenen : et advenæ Romani,
text_pt: E Frígia e Panfília, Egito e partes da Líbia, junto a Cirene, e forasteiros romanos, tanto judeus como prosélitos,
text_el: Φρυγίαν τε καὶ Παμφυλίαν, Αἴγυπτον καὶ τὰ μέρη τῆς Λιβύης τῆς κατὰ Κυρήνην, καὶ οἱ ἐπιδημοῦντες Ῥωμαῖοι,

text_en: Jews also, and proselytes , Cretes, and Arabians : we have heard them speak in our own tongues the wonderful works of God ."
text_la: Judæi quoque, et Proselyti, Cretes, et Arabes : audivimus eos loquentes nostris linguis magnalia Dei.
text_pt: Cretenses e árabes, todos nós temos ouvido em nossas próprias línguas falar das grandezas de Deus.
text_el: Ἰουδαῖοί τε καὶ προσήλυτοι, Κρῆτες καὶ Ἄραβες, ἀκούομεν λαλούντων αὐτῶν ταῖς ἡμετέραις γλώσσαις τὰ μεγαλεῖα τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And they were all astonished, and wondered, saying one to another: "What does this mean?"
text_la: Stupebant autem omnes, et mirabantur ad invicem, dicentes : Quidnam vult hoc esse?
text_pt: E todos se maravilhavam e estavam suspensos, dizendo uns para os outros: Que quer isto dizer?
text_el: ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες καὶ διηποροῦντο, ἄλλος πρὸς ἄλλον λέγοντες, τί θέλει τοῦτο εἶναι;

text_en: But others, mocking, said: "These men are full of new wine."
text_la: Alii autem irridentes dicebant: Quia musto pleni sunt isti.
text_pt: E outros, zombando, diziam: Estão cheios de mosto.
text_el: ἕτεροι δὲ διαχλευάζοντες ἔλεγον ὅτι γλεύκους μεμεστωμένοι εἰσίν.

text_en: But Peter standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and spoke to them: You men of Judea , and all you that dwell in Jerusalem , be this known to you and with your ears receive my words.
text_la: Stans autem Petrus cum undecim, levavit vocem suam, et locutus est eis : Viri Judæi, et qui habitatis Jerusalem universi, hoc vobis notum sit, et auribus percipite verba mea.
text_pt: Pedro, porém, pondo-se em pé com os onze, levantou a sua voz, e disse-lhes: Homens judeus, e todos os que habitais em Jerusalém, seja-vos isto notório, e escutai as minhas palavras.
text_el: Σταθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος σὺν τοῖς ἕνδεκα ἐπῆρεν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπεφθέγξατο αὐτοῖς, ἄνδρες Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Ἰερουσαλὴμ πάντες, τοῦτο ὑμῖν γνωστὸν ἔστω καὶ ἐνωτίσασθε τὰ ῥήματά μου.

text_en: For these are not drunk , as you suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day:
text_la: Non enim, sicut vos æstimatis, hi ebrii sunt, cum sit hora diei tertia:
text_pt: Estes homens não estão embriagados, como vós pensais, sendo a terceira hora do dia.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ὡς ὑμεῖς ὑπολαμβάνετε οὗτοι μεθύουσιν, ἔστιν γὰρ ὥρα τρίτη τῆς ἡμέρας,

text_en: But this is that which was spoken of by the prophet Joel :
text_la: sed hoc est quod dictum est per prophetam Joël:
text_pt: Mas isto é o que foi dito pelo profeta Joel:
text_el: ἀλλὰ τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ εἰρημένον διὰ τοῦ προφήτου Ἰωήλ,

text_en: And it shall come to pass, in the last days, (says the Lord ), I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy : and your young men shall see visions , and your old men shall dream dreams .
text_la: Et erit in novissimis diebus, dicit Dominus, effundam de Spiritu meo super omnem carnem : et prophetabunt filii vestri et filiæ vestræ, et juvenes vestri visiones videbunt, et seniores vestri somnia somniabunt.
text_pt: E nos últimos dias acontecerá, diz Deus, Que do meu Espírito derramarei sobre toda a carne; E os vossos filhos e as vossas filhas profetizarão, Os vossos jovens terão visões, E os vossos velhos sonharão sonhos;
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν ταῖς ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις, λέγει ὁ θεός, ἐκχεῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματός μου ἐπὶ πᾶσαν σάρκα, καὶ προφητεύσουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες ὑμῶν, καὶ οἱ νεανίσκοι ὑμῶν ὁράσεις ὄψονται, καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ὑμῶν ἐνυπνίοις ἐνυπνιασθήσονται:

text_en: And upon my servants indeed and upon my handmaids will I pour out in those days of my spirit : and they shall prophesy .
text_la: Et quidem super servos meos, et super ancillas meas, in diebus illis effundam de Spiritu meo, et prophetabunt :
text_pt: E também do meu Espírito derramarei sobre os meus servos e as minhas servas naqueles dias, e profetizarão;
text_el: καί γε ἐπὶ τοὺς δούλους μου καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς δούλας μου ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐκχεῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματός μου, καὶ προφητεύσουσιν.

text_en: And I will show wonders in the heaven above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood and fire, and vapour of smoke.
text_la: et dabo prodigia in cælo sursum, et signa in terra deorsum, sanguinem, et ignem, et vaporem fumi :
text_pt: E farei aparecer prodígios em cima, no céu; E sinais em baixo na terra, Sangue, fogo e vapor de fumo.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τέρατα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἄνω καὶ σημεῖα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κάτω, αἷμα καὶ πῦρ καὶ ἀτμίδα καπνοῦ:

text_en: The sun shall be turned into darkness and the moon into blood, before the great and manifest day of the Lord to come.
text_la: sol convertetur in tenebras, et luna in sanguinem, antequam veniat dies Domini magnus et manifestus.
text_pt: O sol se converterá em trevas, E a lua em sangue, Antes de chegar o grande e glorioso dia do Senhor;
text_el: ὁ ἥλιος μεταστραφήσεται εἰς σκότος καὶ ἡ σελήνη εἰς αἷμα, πρὶν ἐλθεῖν ἡμέραν κυρίου τὴν μεγάλην καὶ ἐπιφανῆ.

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved .
text_la: Et erit : omnis quicumque invocaverit nomen Domini, salvus erit.
text_pt: E acontecerá que todo aquele que invocar o nome do Senhor será salvo.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται πᾶς ὃς ἐὰν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου σωθήσεται.

text_en: You men of Israel , hear these words: Jesus of Nazareth , a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him, in the midst of you, as you also know :
text_la: Viri Israëlitæ, audite verba hæc : Jesum Nazarenum, virum approbatum a Deo in vobis, virtutibus, et prodigiis, et signis, quæ fecit Deus per illum in medio vestri, sicut et vos scitis:
text_pt: Homens israelitas, escutai estas palavras: A Jesus Nazareno, homem aprovado por Deus entre vós com maravilhas, prodígios e sinais, que Deus por ele fez no meio de vós, como vós mesmos bem sabeis;
text_el: Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται, ἀκούσατε τοὺς λόγους τούτους: Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον, ἄνδρα ἀποδεδειγμένον ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς δυνάμεσι καὶ τέρασι καὶ σημείοις οἷς ἐποίησεν δι' αὐτοῦ ὁ θεὸς ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν, καθὼς αὐτοὶ οἴδατε,

text_en: This same being delivered up, by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God , you by the hands of wicked men have crucified and slain .
text_la: hunc, definito consilio et præscientia Dei traditum, per manus iniquorum affligentes interemistis:
text_pt: A este que vos foi entregue pelo determinado conselho e presciência de Deus, prendestes, crucificastes e matastes pelas mãos de injustos;
text_el: τοῦτον τῇ ὡρισμένῃ βουλῇ καὶ προγνώσει τοῦ θεοῦ ἔκδοτον διὰ χειρὸς ἀνόμων προσπήξαντες ἀνείλατε,

text_en: Whom God has raised up , having loosed the sorrows of hell , as it was impossible that he should be holden by it.
text_la: quem Deus suscitavit, solutis doloribus inferni, juxta quod impossibile erat teneri illum ab eo.
text_pt: Ao qual Deus ressuscitou, soltas as ânsias da morte, pois não era possível que fosse retido por ela;
text_el: ὃν ὁ θεὸς ἀνέστησεν λύσας τὰς ὠδῖνας τοῦ θανάτου, καθότι οὐκ ἦν δυνατὸν κρατεῖσθαι αὐτὸν ὑπ' αὐτοῦ:

text_en: For David says concerning him: I foresaw the Lord before my face: because he is at my right hand, that I may not be moved.
text_la: David enim dicit in eum : Providebam Dominum in conspectu meo semper : quoniam a dextris est mihi, ne commovear :
text_pt: Porque dele disse Davi: Sempre via diante de mim o Senhor, Porque está à minha direita, para que eu não seja comovido;
text_el: Δαυὶδ γὰρ λέγει εἰς αὐτόν, προορώμην τὸν κύριον ἐνώπιόν μου διὰ παντός, ὅτι ἐκ δεξιῶν μού ἐστιν ἵνα μὴ σαλευθῶ.

text_en: For this my heart has been glad, and my tongue has rejoiced: moreover my flesh also shall rest in hope .
text_la: propter hoc lætatum est cor meum, et exsultavit lingua mea, insuper et caro mea requiescet in spe :
text_pt: Por isso se alegrou o meu coração, e a minha língua exultou; E ainda a minha carne há de repousar em esperança;
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ηὐφράνθη μου ἡ καρδία καὶ ἠγαλλιάσατο ἡ γλῶσσά μου, ἔτι δὲ καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου κατασκηνώσει ἐπ' ἐλπίδι:

text_en: Because you will not leave my soul in hell : nor suffer your Holy One to see corruption.
text_la: quoniam non derelinques animam meam in inferno, nec dabis sanctum tuum videre corruptionem.
text_pt: Pois não deixarás a minha alma no inferno, Nem permitirás que o teu Santo veja a corrupção;
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψεις τὴν ψυχήν μου εἰς ᾅδην, οὐδὲ δώσεις τὸν ὅσιόν σου ἰδεῖν διαφθοράν.

text_en: You have made known to me the ways of life: you shall make me full of joy with your countenance.
text_la: Notas mihi fecisti vias vitæ : et replebis me jucunditate cum facie tua.
text_pt: Fizeste-me conhecidos os caminhos da vida; Com a tua face me encherás de júbilo.
text_el: ἐγνώρισάς μοι ὁδοὺς ζωῆς, πληρώσεις με εὐφροσύνης μετὰ τοῦ προσώπου σου.

text_en: You men , brethren, let me freely speak to you of the patriarch David : that he died and was buried; and his sepulchre is with us to this present say.
text_la: Viri fratres, liceat audenter dicere ad vos de patriarcha David, quoniam defunctus est, et sepultus : et sepulchrum ejus est apud nos usque in hodiernum diem.
text_pt: Homens irmãos, seja-me lícito dizer-vos livremente acerca do patriarca Davi, que ele morreu e foi sepultado, e entre nós está até hoje a sua sepultura.
text_el: Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, ἐξὸν εἰπεῖν μετὰ παρρησίας πρὸς ὑμᾶς περὶ τοῦ πατριάρχου Δαυίδ, ὅτι καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν καὶ ἐτάφη καὶ τὸ μνῆμα αὐτοῦ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν ἄχρι τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης:

text_en: Whereas therefore he was a prophet and knew that God has sworn to him with an oath , that of the fruit of his loins one should sit upon his throne.
text_la: Propheta igitur cum esset, et sciret quia jurejurando jurasset illi Deus de fructu lumbi ejus sedere super sedem ejus:
text_pt: Sendo, pois, ele profeta, e sabendo que Deus lhe havia prometido com juramento que do fruto de seus lombos, segundo a carne, levantaria o Cristo, para o assentar sobre o seu trono,
text_el: προφήτης οὖν ὑπάρχων, καὶ εἰδὼς ὅτι ὅρκῳ ὤμοσεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς ἐκ καρποῦ τῆς ὀσφύος αὐτοῦ καθίσαι ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ,

text_en: Foreseeing this, he spoke of the resurrection of Christ . For neither was he left in hell : neither did his flesh see corruption.
text_la: providens locutus est de resurrectione Christi, quia neque derelictus est in inferno, neque caro ejus vidit corruptionem.
text_pt: Nesta previsão, disse da ressurreição de Cristo, que a sua alma não foi deixada no inferno, nem a sua carne viu a corrupção.
text_el: προϊδὼν ἐλάλησεν περὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως τοῦ Χριστοῦ ὅτι οὔτε ἐγκατελείφθη εἰς ᾅδην οὔτε ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ εἶδεν διαφθοράν.

text_en: This Jesus has God raised again , whereof all we are witnesses .
text_la: Hunc Jesum resuscitavit Deus, cujus omnes nos testes sumus.
text_pt: Deus ressuscitou a este Jesus, do que todos nós somos testemunhas.
text_el: τοῦτον τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀνέστησεν ὁ θεός, οὗ πάντες ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν μάρτυρες.

text_en: Being exalted therefore by the right hand of God and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost , he has poured forth this which you see and hear.
text_la: Dextera igitur Dei exaltatus, et promissione Spiritus Sancti accepta a Patre, effudit hunc, quem vos videtis et auditis.
text_pt: De sorte que, exaltado pela destra de Deus, e tendo recebido do Pai a promessa do Espírito Santo, derramou isto que vós agora vedes e ouvis.
text_el: τῇ δεξιᾷ οὖν τοῦ θεοῦ ὑψωθεὶς τήν τε ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἁγίου λαβὼν παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ἐξέχεεν τοῦτο ὃ ὑμεῖς καὶ βλέπετε καὶ ἀκούετε.

text_en: For David ascended not into heaven ; but he himself said: The Lord said to my Lord: Sit on my right hand,
text_la: Non enim David ascendit in cælum : dixit autem ipse : Dixit Dominus Domino meo : Sede a dextris meis,
text_pt: Porque Davi não subiu aos céus, mas ele próprio diz:Disse o Senhor ao meu Senhor:Assenta-te à minha direita,
text_el: οὐ γὰρ Δαυὶδ ἀνέβη εἰς τοὺς οὐρανούς, λέγει δὲ αὐτός, εἶπεν κύριος τῷ κυρίῳ μου, κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου,

text_en: until I make your enemies your footstool.
text_la: donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum.
text_pt: Até que ponha os teus inimigos por escabelo de teus pés.
text_el: ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου.

text_en: Therefore let all the house of Israel know most certainly that God has made both Lord and Christ , this same Jesus , whom you have crucified.
text_la: Certissime sciat ergo omnis domus Israël, quia et Dominum eum et Christum fecit Deus hunc Jesum, quem vos crucifixistis.
text_pt: Saiba pois com certeza toda a casa de Israel que a esse Jesus, a quem vós crucificastes, Deus o fez Senhor e Cristo.
text_el: ἀσφαλῶς οὖν γινωσκέτω πᾶς οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ ὅτι καὶ κύριον αὐτὸν καὶ Χριστὸν ἐποίησεν ὁ θεός, τοῦτον τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὃν ὑμεῖς ἐσταυρώσατε.

text_en: Now when they had heard these things, they had compunction in their heart and said to Peter and to the rest of the apostles : What shall we do, men and brethren?
text_la: His autem auditis, compuncti sunt corde, et dixerunt ad Petrum et ad reliquos Apostolos : Quid faciemus, viri fratres?
text_pt: E, ouvindo eles isto, compungiram-se em seu coração, e perguntaram a Pedro e aos demais apóstolos: Que faremos, homens irmãos?
text_el: Ἀκούσαντες δὲ κατενύγησαν τὴν καρδίαν, εἶπόν τε πρὸς τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τοὺς λοιποὺς ἀποστόλους: τί ποιήσωμεν, ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί;

text_en: But Peter said to them: Do penance : and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ , for the remission of your sins . And you shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Petrus vero ad illos : Pœnitentiam, inquit, agite, et baptizetur unusquisque vestrum in nomine Jesu Christi in remissionem peccatorum vestrorum : et accipietis donum Spiritus Sancti.
text_pt: E disse-lhes Pedro: Arrependei-vos, e cada um de vós seja batizado em nome de Jesus Cristo, para perdão dos pecados; e recebereis o dom do Espírito Santo;
text_el: Πέτρος δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς, μετανοήσατε, καὶ βαπτισθήτω ἕκαστος ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς ἄφεσιν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ὑμῶν, καὶ λήμψεσθε τὴν δωρεὰν τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος:

text_en: For the promise is to you and to your children and to all that are far off, whomsoever the Lord our God shall call.
text_la: Vobis enim est repromissio, et filiis vestris, et omnibus qui longe sunt, quoscumque advocaverit Dominus Deus noster.
text_pt: Porque a promessa vos diz respeito a vós, a vossos filhos, e a todos os que estão longe, a tantos quantos Deus nosso Senhor chamar.
text_el: ὑμῖν γάρ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις ὑμῶν καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς εἰς μακρὰν ὅσους ἂν προσκαλέσηται κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν.

text_en: And with very many other words did he testify and exhort them, saying: Save yourselves from this perverse generation .
text_la: Aliis etiam verbis plurimis testificatus est, et exhortabatur eos, dicens : Salvamini a generatione ista prava.
text_pt: E com muitas outras palavras isto testificava, e os exortava, dizendo: Salvai-vos desta geração perversa.
text_el: ἑτέροις τε λόγοις πλείοσιν διεμαρτύρατο, καὶ παρεκάλει αὐτοὺς λέγων, σώθητε ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς τῆς σκολιᾶς ταύτης.

text_en: They therefore that received his word were baptized : and there were added in that day about three thousand souls .
text_la: Qui ergo receperunt sermonem ejus, baptizati sunt : et appositæ sunt in die illa animæ circiter tria millia.
text_pt: De sorte que foram batizados os que de bom grado receberam a sua palavra; e naquele dia agregaram-se quase três mil almas,
text_el: οἱ μὲν οὖν ἀποδεξάμενοι τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ἐβαπτίσθησαν, καὶ προσετέθησαν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ψυχαὶ ὡσεὶ τρισχίλιαι.

text_en: And they were persevering in the doctrine of the apostles and in the communication of the breaking of bread and in prayers .
text_la: Erant autem perseverantes in doctrina Apostolorum, et communicatione fractionis panis, et orationibus.
text_pt: E perseveravam na doutrina dos apóstolos, e na comunhão, e no partir do pão, e nas orações.
text_el: ἦσαν δὲ προσκαρτεροῦντες τῇ διδαχῇ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ τῇ κοινωνίᾳ, τῇ κλάσει τοῦ ἄρτου καὶ ταῖς προσευχαῖς.

text_en: And fear came upon every soul . Many wonders also and signs were done by the apostles in Jerusalem : and there was great fervor in all.
text_la: Fiebat autem omni animæ timor : multa quoque prodigia et signa per Apostolos in Jerusalem fiebant, et metus erat magnus in universis.
text_pt: E em toda a alma havia temor, e muitas maravilhas e sinais se faziam pelos apóstolos.
text_el: Ἐγίνετο δὲ πάσῃ ψυχῇ φόβος: πολλά δὲ τέρατα καὶ σημεῖα διὰ τῶν ἀποστόλων ἐγίνετο.

text_en: And all they that believed were together and had all things common.
text_la: Omnes etiam qui credebant, erant pariter, et habebant omnia communia.
text_pt: E todos os que criam estavam juntos, e tinham tudo em comum.
text_el: πάντες δὲ οἱ πιστεύσαντες ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ εἶχον ἅπαντα κοινά,

text_en: Their possessions and goods they sold and divided them to all, according as every one had need.
text_la: Possessiones et substantias vendebant, et dividebant illa omnibus, prout cuique opus erat.
text_pt: E vendiam suas propriedades e bens, e repartiam com todos, segundo cada um havia de mister.
text_el: καὶ τὰ κτήματα καὶ τὰς ὑπάρξεις ἐπίπρασκον καὶ διεμέριζον αὐτὰ πᾶσιν καθότι ἄν τις χρείαν εἶχεν:

text_en: And continuing daily with one accord in the temple and breaking bread from house to house, they took their meat with gladness and simplicity of heart:
text_la: Quotidie quoque perdurantes unanimiter in templo, et frangentes circa domos panem, sumebant cibum cum exsultatione et simplicitate cordis,
text_pt: E, perseverando unânimes todos os dias no templo, e partindo o pão em casa, comiam juntos com alegria e singeleza de coração,
text_el: καθ' ἡμέραν τε προσκαρτεροῦντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, κλῶντές τε κατ' οἶκον ἄρτον, μετελάμβανον τροφῆς ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει καὶ ἀφελότητι καρδίας,

text_en: Praising God and having favour with all the people. And the Lord increased daily together such as should be saved .
text_la: collaudantes Deum et habentes gratiam ad omnem plebem. Dominus autem augebat qui salvi fierent quotidie in idipsum.
text_pt: Louvando a Deus, e caindo na graça de todo o povo. E todos os dias acrescentava o Senhor à igreja aqueles que se haviam de salvar.
text_el: αἰνοῦντες τὸν θεὸν καὶ ἔχοντες χάριν πρὸς ὅλον τὸν λαόν. ὁ δὲ κύριος προσετίθει τοὺς σῳζομένους καθ' ἡμέραν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό.

text_en: Now Peter and John went up into the temple at the ninth hour of prayer .
text_la: Petrus autem et Joannes ascendebant in templum ad horam orationis nonam.
text_pt: E Pedro e João subiam juntos ao templo à hora da oração, a nona.
text_el: Πέτρος δὲ καὶ Ἰωάννης ἀνέβαινον εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἐπὶ τὴν ὥραν τῆς προσευχῆς τὴν ἐνάτην.

text_en: And a certain man who was lame from his mother's womb was carried: whom they laid every day at the gate of the temple , which is called Beautiful, that he might ask alms of them that went into the temple .
text_la: Et quidam vir, qui erat claudus ex utero matris suæ, bajulabatur : quem ponebant quotidie ad portam templi, quæ dicitur Speciosa, ut peteret eleemosynam ab introëuntibus in templum.
text_pt: E era trazido um homem que desde o ventre de sua mãe era coxo, o qual todos os dias punham à porta do templo, chamada Formosa, para pedir esmola aos que entravam.
text_el: καί τις ἀνὴρ χωλὸς ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτοῦ ὑπάρχων ἐβαστάζετο, ὃν ἐτίθουν καθ' ἡμέραν πρὸς τὴν θύραν τοῦ ἱεροῦ τὴν λεγομένην ὡραίαν τοῦ αἰτεῖν ἐλεημοσύνην παρὰ τῶν εἰσπορευομένων εἰς τὸ ἱερόν:

text_en: He, when he had seen Peter and John , about to go into the temple , asked to receive an alms .
text_la: Is cum vidisset Petrum et Joannem incipientes introire in templum, rogabat ut eleemosynam acciperet.
text_pt: O qual, vendo a Pedro e a João que iam entrando no templo, pediu que lhe dessem uma esmola.
text_el: ὃς ἰδὼν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην μέλλοντας εἰσιέναι εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἠρώτα ἐλεημοσύνην λαβεῖν.

text_en: But Peter with John , fastening his eyes upon him, said: Look upon us.
text_la: Intuens autem in eum Petrus cum Joanne, dixit : Respice in nos.
text_pt: E Pedro, com João, fitando os olhos nele, disse: Olha para nós.
text_el: ἀτενίσας δὲ Πέτρος εἰς αὐτὸν σὺν τῷ Ἰωάννῃ εἶπεν: βλέψον εἰς ἡμᾶς.

text_en: But he looked earnestly upon them, hoping that he should receive something of them.
text_la: At ille intendebat in eos, sperans se aliquid accepturum ab eis.
text_pt: E olhou para eles, esperando receber deles alguma coisa.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐπεῖχεν αὐτοῖς προσδοκῶν τι παρ' αὐτῶν λαβεῖν.

text_en: But Peter said: Silver and gold I have none; but what I have, I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth , arise and walk.
text_la: Petrus autem dixit : Argentum et aurum non est mihi : quod autem habeo, hoc tibi do : in nomine Jesu Christi Nazareni surge, et ambula.
text_pt: E disse Pedro: Não tenho prata nem ouro; mas o que tenho isso te dou. Em nome de Jesus Cristo, o Nazareno, levanta-te e anda.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Πέτρος: ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον οὐχ ὑπάρχει μοι: ὃ δὲ ἔχω τοῦτό σοι δίδωμι: ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου περιπάτει.

text_en: And taking him by the right hand, he lifted him up: and forthwith his feet and soles received strength.
text_la: Et apprehensa manu ejus dextera, allevavit eum, et protinus consolidatæ sunt bases ejus et plantæ.
text_pt: E, tomando-o pela mão direita, o levantou, e logo os seus pés e artelhos se firmaram.
text_el: καὶ πιάσας αὐτὸν τῆς δεξιᾶς χειρὸς ἤγειρεν αὐτόν: παραχρῆμα δὲ ἐστερεώθησαν αἱ βάσεις αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ σφυδρά,

text_en: And he leaping up, stood and walked and went in with them into the temple , walking and leaping and praising God .
text_la: Et exiliens stetit, et ambulabat : et intravit cum illis in templum ambulans, et exiliens, et laudans Deum.
text_pt: E, saltando ele, pôs-se em pé, e andou, e entrou com eles no templo, andando, e saltando, e louvando a Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαλλόμενος ἔστη καὶ περιεπάτει, καὶ εἰσῆλθεν σὺν αὐτοῖς εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν περιπατῶν καὶ ἁλλόμενος καὶ αἰνῶν τὸν θεόν.

text_en: And all the people saw him walking and praising God .
text_la: Et vidit omnis populus eum ambulantem et laudantem Deum.
text_pt: E todo o povo o viu andar e louvar a Deus;
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτὸν περιπατοῦντα καὶ αἰνοῦντα τὸν θεόν,

text_en: And they knew him, that it was he who sat begging alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple : and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened to him.
text_la: Cognoscebant autem illum, quod ipse erat qui ad eleemosynam sedebat ad Speciosam portam templi : et impleti sunt stupore et extasi in eo quod contigerat illi.
text_pt: E conheciam-no, pois era ele o que se assentava a pedir esmola à porta Formosa do templo; e ficaram cheios de pasmo e assombro, pelo que lhe acontecera.
text_el: ἐπεγίνωσκον δὲ αὐτὸν ὅτι οὗτος ἦν ὁ πρὸς τὴν ἐλεημοσύνην καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῇ ὡραίᾳ πύλῃ τοῦ ἱεροῦ, καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν θάμβους καὶ ἐκστάσεως ἐπὶ τῷ συμβεβηκότι αὐτῷ.

text_en: And as he held Peter and John , all the people ran to them, to the porch which is called Solomon's , greatly wondering.
text_la: Cum teneret autem Petrum et Joannem, cucurrit omnis populus ad eos ad porticum quæ appellatur Salomonis, stupentes.
text_pt: E, apegando-se o coxo, que fora curado, a Pedro e João, todo o povo correu atônito para junto deles, ao alpendre chamado de Salomão.
text_el: Κρατοῦντος δὲ αὐτοῦ τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τὸν Ἰωάννην συνέδραμεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τῇ στοᾷ τῇ καλουμένῃ Σολομῶντος ἔκθαμβοι.

text_en: But Peter seeing, made answer to the people: You men of Israel , why wonder you at this? Or why look you upon us, as if by our strength or power we had made this man to walk?
text_la: Videns autem Petrus, respondit ad populum : Viri Israëlitæ, quid miramini in hoc, aut nos quid intuemini, quasi nostra virtute aut potestate fecerimus hunc ambulare?
text_pt: E quando Pedro viu isto, disse ao povo: Homens israelitas, por que vos maravilhais disto? Ou, por que olhais tanto para nós, como se por nossa própria virtude ou santidade fizéssemos andar este homem?
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος ἀπεκρίνατο πρὸς τὸν λαόν, ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται, τί θαυμάζετε ἐπὶ τούτῳ, ἢ ἡμῖν τί ἀτενίζετε ὡς ἰδίᾳ δυνάμει ἢ εὐσεβείᾳ πεποιηκόσιν τοῦ περιπατεῖν αὐτόν;

text_en: The God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob , the God of our fathers, has glorified his Son Jesus , whom you indeed delivered up and denied before the face of Pilate , when he judged he should be released.
text_la: Deus Abraham, et Deus Isaac, et Deus Jacob, Deus patrum nostrorum glorificavit filium suum Jesum, quem vos quidem tradidistis, et negastis ante faciem Pilati, judicante illo dimitti.
text_pt: O Deus de Abraão, de Isaque e de Jacó, o Deus de nossos pais, glorificou a seu filho Jesus, a quem vós entregastes e perante a face de Pilatos negastes, tendo ele determinado que fosse solto.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακώβ, ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν, ἐδόξασεν τὸν παῖδα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν, ὃν ὑμεῖς μὲν παρεδώκατε καὶ ἠρνήσασθε κατὰ πρόσωπον Πιλάτου, κρίναντος ἐκείνου ἀπολύειν:

text_en: But you denied the Holy One and the Just : and desired a murderer to be granted unto you.
text_la: Vos autem sanctum et justum negastis, et petistis virum homicidam donari vobis:
text_pt: Mas vós negastes o Santo e o Justo, e pedistes que se vos desse um homem homicida.
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ τὸν ἅγιον καὶ δίκαιον ἠρνήσασθε, καὶ ᾐτήσασθε ἄνδρα φονέα χαρισθῆναι ὑμῖν,

text_en: But the author of life you killed , whom God has raised from the dead : of which we are witnesses .
text_la: auctorem vero vitæ interfecistis, quem Deus suscitavit a mortuis, cujus nos testes sumus.
text_pt: E matastes o Príncipe da vida, ao qual Deus ressuscitou dentre os mortos, do que nós somos testemunhas.
text_el: τὸν δὲ ἀρχηγὸν τῆς ζωῆς ἀπεκτείνατε, ὃν ὁ θεὸς ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν, οὗ ἡμεῖς μάρτυρές ἐσμεν.

text_en: And in the faith of his name , this man , whom you have seen and known , has his name strengthened. And the faith which is by him has given this perfect soundness in the sight of you all.
text_la: Et in fide nominis ejus, hunc quem vos vidistis et nostis, confirmavit nomen ejus : et fides, quæ per eum est, dedit integram sanitatem istam in conspectu omnium vestrum.
text_pt: E pela fé no seu nome fez o seu nome fortalecer a este que vedes e conheceis; sim, a fé que vem por ele, deu a este, na presença de todos vós, esta perfeita saúde.
text_el: καὶ τῇ πίστει τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ τοῦτον ὃν θεωρεῖτε καὶ οἴδατε ἐστερέωσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἡ πίστις ἡ δι' αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τὴν ὁλοκληρίαν ταύτην ἀπέναντι πάντων ὑμῶν.

text_en: And now, brethren, I know that you did it through ignorance : as did also your rulers.
text_la: Et nunc, fratres, scio quia per ignorantiam fecistis, sicut et principes vestri.
text_pt: E agora, irmãos, eu sei que o fizestes por ignorância, como também os vossos príncipes.
text_el: καὶ νῦν, ἀδελφοί, οἶδα ὅτι κατὰ ἄγνοιαν ἐπράξατε, ὥσπερ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ὑμῶν:

text_en: But those things which God before had showed by the mouth of all the prophets , that his Christ should suffer, he has so fulfilled.
text_la: Deus autem, quæ prænuntiavit per os omnium prophetarum, pati Christum suum, sic implevit.
text_pt: Mas Deus assim cumpriu o que já dantes pela boca de todos os seus profetas havia anunciado; que o Cristo havia de padecer.
text_el: ὁ δὲ θεὸς ἃ προκατήγγειλεν διὰ στόματος πάντων τῶν προφητῶν παθεῖν τὸν Χριστὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπλήρωσεν οὕτως.

text_en: Be penitent , therefore, and be converted , that your sins may be blotted out.
text_la: Pœnitemini igitur et convertimini, ut deleantur peccata vestra:
text_pt: Arrependei-vos, pois, e convertei-vos, para que sejam apagados os vossos pecados, e venham assim os tempos do refrigério pela presença do Senhor,
text_el: μετανοήσατε οὖν καὶ ἐπιστρέψατε πρὸς τὸ ἐξαλειφθῆναι ὑμῶν τὰς ἁμαρτίας,

text_en: That when the times of refreshment shall come from the presence of the Lord , and he shall send him who has been preached unto you, Jesus Christ .
text_la: ut cum venerint tempora refrigerii a conspectu Domini, et miserit eum qui prædicatus est vobis, Jesum Christum,
text_pt: E envie ele a Jesus Cristo, que já dantes vos foi pregado.
text_el: ὅπως ἂν ἔλθωσιν καιροὶ ἀναψύξεως ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἀποστείλῃ τὸν προκεχειρισμένον ὑμῖν Χριστόν, Ἰησοῦν,

text_en: Whom heaven indeed must receive, until the times of the restitution of all things, which God has spoken by the mouth of his holy prophets , from the beginning of the world.
text_la: quem oportet quidem cælum suscipere usque in tempora restitutionis omnium quæ locutus est Deus per os sanctorum suorum a sæculo prophetarum.
text_pt: O qual convém que o céu contenha até aos tempos da restauração de tudo, dos quais Deus falou pela boca de todos os seus santos profetas, desde o princípio.
text_el: ὃν δεῖ οὐρανὸν μὲν δέξασθαι ἄχρι χρόνων ἀποκαταστάσεως πάντων ὧν ἐλάλησεν ὁ θεὸς διὰ στόματος τῶν ἁγίων ἀπ' αἰῶνος αὐτοῦ προφητῶν.

text_en: For Moses said: A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me: him you shall hear according to all things whatsoever he shall speak to you.
text_la: Moyses quidem dixit : Quoniam prophetam suscitabit vobis Dominus Deus vester de fratribus vestris, tamquam me : ipsum audietis juxta omnia quæcumque locutus fuerit vobis.
text_pt: Porque Moisés disse aos pais: O Senhor vosso Deus levantará de entre vossos irmãos um profeta semelhante a mim; a ele ouvireis em tudo quanto vos disser.
text_el: Μωϋσῆς μὲν εἶπεν ὅτι προφήτην ὑμῖν ἀναστήσει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν ὡς ἐμέ: αὐτοῦ ἀκούσεσθε κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἂν λαλήσῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

text_en: And it shall be, that every soul which will not hear that prophet shall be destroyed from among the people.
text_la: Erit autem : omnis anima quæ non audierit prophetam illum, exterminabitur de plebe.
text_pt: E acontecerá que toda a alma que não escutar esse profeta será exterminada dentre o povo.
text_el: ἔσται δὲ πᾶσα ψυχὴ ἥτις ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσῃ τοῦ προφήτου ἐκείνου ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ.

text_en: And all the prophets , from Samuel and afterwards, who have spoken, have told of these days.
text_la: Et omnes prophetæ, a Samuel et deinceps, qui locuti sunt, annuntiaverunt dies istos.
text_pt: Sim, e todos os profetas, desde Samuel, todos quantos depois falaram, também predisseram estes dias.
text_el: καὶ πάντες δὲ οἱ προφῆται ἀπὸ Σαμουὴλ καὶ τῶν καθεξῆς ὅσοι ἐλάλησαν καὶ κατήγγειλαν τὰς ἡμέρας ταύτας.

text_en: You are the children of the prophets and of the testament which God made to our fathers, saying to Abraham : And in your seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed .
text_la: Vos estis filii prophetarum, et testamenti quod disposuit Deus ad patres nostros, dicens ad Abraham : Et in semine tuo benedicentur omnes familiæ terræ.
text_pt: Vós sois os filhos dos profetas e da aliança que Deus fez com nossos pais, dizendo a Abraão: Na tua descendência serão benditas todas as famílias da terra.
text_el: ὑμεῖς ἐστε οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῆς διαθήκης ἧς ὁ θεὸς διέθετο πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ὑμῶν, λέγων πρὸς Ἀβραάμ, καὶ ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου εὐλογηθήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ πατριαὶ τῆς γῆς.

text_en: To you first, God , raising up his Son , has sent him to bless you: that every one may convert himself from his wickedness .
text_la: Vobis primum Deus suscitans filium suum, misit eum benedicentem vobis : ut convertat se unusquisque a nequitia sua.
text_pt: Ressuscitando Deus a seu Filho Jesus, primeiro o enviou a vós, para que nisso vos abençoasse, no apartar, a cada um de vós, das vossas maldades.
text_el: ὑμῖν πρῶτον ἀναστήσας ὁ θεὸς τὸν παῖδα αὐτοῦ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν εὐλογοῦντα ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἀποστρέφειν ἕκαστον ἀπὸ τῶν πονηριῶν [ὑμῶν].

text_en: And as they were speaking to the people the priests and the officer of the temple and the Sadducees came upon them,
text_la: Loquentibus autem illis ad populum, supervenerunt sacerdotes, et magistratus templi, et sadducæi,
text_pt: E, estando eles falando ao povo, sobrevieram os sacerdotes, e o capitão do templo, e os saduceus,
text_el: Λαλούντων δὲ αὐτῶν πρὸς τὸν λαὸν ἐπέστησαν αὐτοῖς οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ ὁ στρατηγὸς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ οἱ Σαδδουκαῖοι,

text_en: being grieved that they taught the people and preached in Jesus the resurrection from the dead :
text_la: dolentes quod docerent populum, et annuntiarent in Jesu resurrectionem ex mortuis:
text_pt: Doendo-se muito de que ensinassem o povo, e anunciassem em Jesus a ressurreição dentre os mortos.
text_el: διαπονούμενοι διὰ τὸ διδάσκειν αὐτοὺς τὸν λαὸν καὶ καταγγέλλειν ἐν τῷ Ἰησοῦ τὴν ἀνάστασιν τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν,

text_en: And they laid hands upon them and put them in hold till the next day: for it was now evening.
text_la: et injecerunt in eos manus, et posuerunt eos in custodiam in crastinum : erat enim jam vespera.
text_pt: E lançaram mão deles, e os encerraram na prisão até ao dia seguinte, pois já era tarde.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέβαλον αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ ἔθεντο εἰς τήρησιν εἰς τὴν αὔριον: ἦν γὰρ ἑσπέρα ἤδη.

text_en: But many of them who had heard the word believed : and the number of the men was made five thousand.
text_la: Multi autem eorum qui audierant verbum, crediderunt : et factus est numerus virorum quinque millia.
text_pt: Muitos, porém, dos que ouviram a palavra creram, e chegou o número desses homens a quase cinco mil.
text_el: πολλοὶ δὲ τῶν ἀκουσάντων τὸν λόγον ἐπίστευσαν, καὶ ἐγενήθη [ὁ] ἀριθμὸς ἀνδρῶν ὡς χιλιάδες πέντε.

text_en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their princes and ancients and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem .
text_la: Factum est autem in crastinum, ut congregarentur principes eorum, et seniores, et scribæ, in Jerusalem:
text_pt: E aconteceu, no dia seguinte, reunirem-se em Jerusalém os seus principais, os anciãos, os escribas,
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐπὶ τὴν αὔριον συναχθῆναι αὐτῶν τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους καὶ τοὺς γραμματεῖς ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ

text_en: And Annas the high priest and Caiphas and John and Alexander : and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest .
text_la: et Annas princeps sacerdotum, et Caiphas, et Joannes, et Alexander, et quotquot erant de genere sacerdotali.
text_pt: E Anás, o sumo sacerdote, e Caifás, e João, e Alexandre, e todos quantos havia da linhagem do sumo sacerdote.
text_el: καὶ Ἅννας ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ Καϊάφας καὶ Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἀλέξανδρος καὶ ὅσοι ἦσαν ἐκ γένους ἀρχιερατικοῦ

text_en: And setting them in the midst, they asked: By what power or by what name , have you done this?
text_la: Et statuentes eos in medio, interrogabant : In qua virtute, aut in quo nomine fecistis hoc vos?
text_pt: E, pondo-os no meio, perguntaram: Com que poder ou em nome de quem fizestes isto?
text_el: καὶ στήσαντες αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ μέσῳ ἐπυνθάνοντο, ἐν ποίᾳ δυνάμει ἢ ἐν ποίῳ ὀνόματι ἐποιήσατε τοῦτο ὑμεῖς;

text_en: Then Peter , filled with the Holy Ghost , said to them: You princes of the people and ancients, hear.
text_la: Tunc repletus Spiritu Sancto Petrus, dixit ad eos : Principes populi, et seniores, audite:
text_pt: Então Pedro, cheio do Espírito Santo, lhes disse: Principais do povo, e vós, anciãos de Israel,
text_el: τότε Πέτρος πλησθεὶς πνεύματος ἁγίου εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς, ἄρχοντες τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ πρεσβύτεροι,

text_en: If we this day are examined concerning the good deed done to the infirm man , by what means he has been made whole:
text_la: si nos hodie dijudicamur in benefacto hominis infirmi, in quo iste salvus factus est,
text_pt: Visto que hoje somos interrogados acerca do benefício feito a um homem enfermo, e do modo como foi curado,
text_el: εἰ ἡμεῖς σήμερον ἀνακρινόμεθα ἐπὶ εὐεργεσίᾳ ἀνθρώπου ἀσθενοῦς, ἐν τίνι οὗτος σέσωσται,

text_en: Be it known to you all and to all the people of Israel , that by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ of Nazareth , whom you crucified, whom God has raised from the dead , even by him, this man stands here before you, whole.
text_la: notum sit omnibus vobis, et omni plebi Israël, quia in nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi Nazareni, quem vos crucifixistis, quem Deus suscitavit a mortuis, in hoc iste astat coram vobis sanus.
text_pt: Seja conhecido de vós todos, e de todo o povo de Israel, que em nome de Jesus Cristo, o Nazareno, aquele a quem vós crucificastes e a quem Deus ressuscitou dentre os mortos, em nome desse é que este está são diante de vós.
text_el: γνωστὸν ἔστω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν καὶ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ Ἰσραὴλ ὅτι ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου, ὃν ὑμεῖς ἐσταυρώσατε, ὃν ὁ θεὸς ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐν τούτῳ οὗτος παρέστηκεν ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν ὑγιής.

text_en: This is the stone which was rejected by you the builders, which has become the head of the corner .
text_la: Hic est lapis qui reprobatus est a vobis ædificantibus, qui factus est in caput anguli:
text_pt: Ele é a pedra que foi rejeitada por vós, os edificadores, a qual foi posta por cabeça de esquina.
text_el: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ λίθος ὁ ἐξουθενηθεὶς ὑφ' ὑμῶν τῶν οἰκοδόμων, ὁ γενόμενος εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας.

text_en: Neither is there salvation in any other. For there is no other name under heaven given to men , whereby we must be saved .
text_la: et non est in alio aliquo salus. Nec enim aliud nomen est sub cælo datum hominibus, in quo oporteat nos salvos fieri.
text_pt: E em nenhum outro há salvação, porque também debaixo do céu nenhum outro nome há, dado entre os homens, pelo qual devamos ser salvos.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἄλλῳ οὐδενὶ ἡ σωτηρία, οὐδὲ γὰρ ὄνομά ἐστιν ἕτερον ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανὸν τὸ δεδομένον ἐν ἀνθρώποις ἐν ᾧ δεῖ σωθῆναι ἡμᾶς.

text_en: Now seeing the constancy of Peter and of John , understanding that they were illiterate and ignorant men , they wondered: and they knew them that they had been with Jesus .
text_la: Videntes autem Petri constantiam, et Joannis, comperto quod homines essent sine litteris, et idiotæ, admirabantur, et cognoscebant eos quoniam cum Jesu fuerant:
text_pt: Então eles, vendo a ousadia de Pedro e João, e informados de que eram homens sem letras e indoutos, maravilharam-se e reconheceram que eles haviam estado com Jesus.
text_el: Θεωροῦντες δὲ τὴν τοῦ Πέτρου παρρησίαν καὶ Ἰωάννου, καὶ καταλαβόμενοι ὅτι ἄνθρωποι ἀγράμματοί εἰσιν καὶ ἰδιῶται, ἐθαύμαζον ἐπεγίνωσκόν τε αὐτοὺς ὅτι σὺν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἦσαν:

text_en: Seeing the man also who had been healed, standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
text_la: hominem quoque videntes stantem cum eis, qui curatus fuerat, nihil poterant contradicere.
text_pt: E, vendo estar com eles o homem que fora curado, nada tinham que dizer em contrário.
text_el: τόν τε ἄνθρωπον βλέποντες σὺν αὐτοῖς ἑστῶτα τὸν τεθεραπευμένον οὐδὲν εἶχον ἀντειπεῖν.

text_en: But they commanded them to go aside out of the council : and they conferred among themselves,
text_la: Jusserunt autem eos foras extra concilium secedere : et conferebant ad invicem,
text_pt: Todavia, mandando-os sair fora do conselho, conferenciaram entre si,
text_el: κελεύσαντες δὲ αὐτοὺς ἔξω τοῦ συνεδρίου ἀπελθεῖν συνέβαλλον πρὸς ἀλλήλους

text_en: saying: What shall we do to these men ? For indeed a miracle has been done by them, known to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem . It is manifest: and we cannot deny it.
text_la: dicentes : Quid faciemus hominibus istis? quoniam quidem notum signum factum est per eos omnibus habitantibus Jerusalem : manifestum est, et non possumus negare.
text_pt: Dizendo: Que havemos de fazer a estes homens? porque a todos os que habitam em Jerusalém é manifesto que por eles foi feito um sinal notório, e não o podemos negar;
text_el: λέγοντες, τί ποιήσωμεν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τούτοις; ὅτι μὲν γὰρ γνωστὸν σημεῖον γέγονεν δι' αὐτῶν πᾶσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ἰερουσαλὴμ φανερόν, καὶ οὐ δυνάμεθα ἀρνεῖσθαι:

text_en: But that it may be no farther spread among the people, let us threaten them that they speak no more in this name to any man .
text_la: Sed ne amplius divulgetur in populum, comminemur eis ne ultra loquantur in nomine hoc ulli hominum.
text_pt: Mas, para que não se divulgue mais entre o povo, ameacemo-los para que não falem mais nesse nome a homem algum.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἵνα μὴ ἐπὶ πλεῖον διανεμηθῇ εἰς τὸν λαόν, ἀπειλησώμεθα αὐτοῖς μηκέτι λαλεῖν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ μηδενὶ ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: And calling them, they charged them not to speak at all, nor teach in the name of Jesus .
text_la: Et vocantes eos, denuntiaverunt ne omnino loquerentur neque docerent in nomine Jesu.
text_pt: E, chamando-os, disseram-lhes que absolutamente não falassem, nem ensinassem, no nome de Jesus.
text_el: καὶ καλέσαντες αὐτοὺς παρήγγειλαν καθόλου μὴ φθέγγεσθαι μηδὲ διδάσκειν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι [τοῦ] Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: But Peter and John answering, said to them: If it be just , in the sight of God , to hear you rather than God , judge.
text_la: Petrus vero et Joannes respondentes, dixerunt ad eos : Si justum est in conspectu Dei vos potius audire quam Deum, judicate.
text_pt: Respondendo, porém, Pedro e João, lhes disseram: Julgai vós se é justo, diante de Deus, ouvir-vos antes a vós do que a Deus;
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος καὶ Ἰωάννης ἀποκριθέντες εἶπον πρὸς αὐτούς: εἰ δίκαιόν ἐστιν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν ἀκούειν μᾶλλον ἢ τοῦ θεοῦ, κρίνατε:

text_en: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
text_la: Non enim possumus quæ vidimus et audivimus non loqui.
text_pt: Porque não podemos deixar de falar do que temos visto e ouvido.
text_el: οὐ δυνάμεθα γὰρ ἡμεῖς ἃ εἴδαμεν καὶ ἠκούσαμεν μὴ λαλεῖν.

text_en: But they, threatening, sent them away, not finding how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified what had been done, in that which had come to pass.
text_la: At illi comminantes dimiserunt eos, non invenientes quomodo punirent eos propter populum : quia omnes clarificabant id quod factum fuerat in eo quod acciderat.
text_pt: Mas eles ainda os ameaçaram mais e, não achando motivo para os castigar, deixaram-nos ir, por causa do povo; porque todos glorificavam a Deus pelo que acontecera;
text_el: οἱ δὲ προσαπειλησάμενοι ἀπέλυσαν αὐτούς, μηδὲν εὑρίσκοντες τὸ πῶς κολάσωνται αὐτούς, διὰ τὸν λαόν, ὅτι πάντες ἐδόξαζον τὸν θεὸν ἐπὶ τῷ γεγονότι:

text_en: For the man was above forty years old, in whom that miraculous cure had been wrought.
text_la: Annorum enim erat amplius quadraginta homo, in quo factum fuerat signum istud sanitatis.
text_pt: Pois tinha mais de quarenta anos o homem em quem se operara aquele milagre de saúde.
text_el: ἐτῶν γὰρ ἦν πλειόνων τεσσεράκοντα ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐφ' ὃν γεγόνει τὸ σημεῖον τοῦτο τῆς ἰάσεως.

text_en: And being let go, they came to their own company and related all that the chief priests and ancients had said to them.
text_la: Dimissi autem venerunt ad suos, et annuntiaverunt eis quanta ad eos principes sacerdotum et seniores dixissent.
text_pt: E, soltos eles, foram para os seus, e contaram tudo o que lhes disseram os principais dos sacerdotes e os anciãos.
text_el: Ἀπολυθέντες δὲ ἦλθον πρὸς τοὺς ἰδίους καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν ὅσα πρὸς αὐτοὺς οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι εἶπαν.

text_en: Who having heard it, with one accord lifted up their voice to God and said: Lord, you are he that made heaven and earth, the sea and all things that are in them.
text_la: Qui cum audissent, unanimiter levaverunt vocem ad Deum, et dixerunt : Domine, tu es qui fecisti cælum et terram, mare et omnia quæ in eis sunt:
text_pt: E, ouvindo eles isto, unânimes levantaram a voz a Deus, e disseram: Senhor, tu és o Deus que fizeste o céu, e a terra, e o mar e tudo o que neles há;
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἦραν φωνὴν πρὸς τὸν θεὸν καὶ εἶπαν, δέσποτα, σὺ ὁ ποιήσας τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς,

text_en: Who, by the Holy Ghost , by the mouth of our father David , your servant, have said: Why did the Gentiles rage: and the people meditate vain things?
text_la: qui Spiritu Sancto per os patris nostri David pueri tui dixisti : Quare fremuerunt gentes, et populi meditati sunt inania?
text_pt: Que disseste pela boca de Davi, teu servo: Por que bramaram os gentios, e os povos pensaram coisas vãs?
text_el: ὁ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν διὰ πνεύματος ἁγίου στόματος Δαυὶδ παιδός σου εἰπών, ἱνατί ἐφρύαξαν ἔθνη καὶ λαοὶ ἐμελέτησαν κενά;

text_en: The kings of the earth stood up: and the princes assembled together against the Lord and his Christ .
text_la: Astiterunt reges terræ, et principes convenerunt in unum adversus Dominum, et adversus Christum ejus.
text_pt: Levantaram-se os reis da terra,E os príncipes se ajuntaram à uma,Contra o Senhor e contra o seu Ungido.
text_el: παρέστησαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες συνήχθησαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ κατὰ τοῦ κυρίου καὶ κατὰ τοῦ Χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: For of a truth there assembled together in this city against your holy child Jesus , whom you have anointed, Herod , and Pontius Pilate , with the Gentiles and the people of Israel ,
text_la: Convenerunt enim vere in civitate ista adversus sanctum puerum tuum Jesum, quem unxisti, Herodes et Pontius Pilatus, cum gentibus et populis Israël,
text_pt: Porque verdadeiramente contra o teu santo Filho Jesus, que tu ungiste, se ajuntaram, não só Herodes, mas Pôncio Pilatos, com os gentios e os povos de Israel;
text_el: συνήχθησαν γὰρ ἐπ' ἀληθείας ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ ἐπὶ τὸν ἅγιον παῖδά σου Ἰησοῦν, ὃν ἔχρισας, Ἡρῴδης τε καὶ Πόντιος Πιλᾶτος σὺν ἔθνεσιν καὶ λαοῖς Ἰσραήλ,

text_en: to do what your hand and your counsel decreed to be done.
text_la: facere quæ manus tua et consilium tuum decreverunt fieri.
text_pt: Para fazerem tudo o que a tua mão e o teu conselho tinham anteriormente determinado que se havia de fazer.
text_el: ποιῆσαι ὅσα ἡ χείρ σου καὶ ἡ βουλή προώρισεν γενέσθαι.

text_en: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto your servants that with all confidence they may speak your word,
text_la: Et nunc, Domine, respice in minas eorum, et da servis tuis cum omni fiducia loqui verbum tuum,
text_pt: Agora, pois, ó Senhor, olha para as suas ameaças, e concede aos teus servos que falem com toda a ousadia a tua palavra;
text_el: καὶ τὰ νῦν, κύριε, ἔπιδε ἐπὶ τὰς ἀπειλὰς αὐτῶν, καὶ δὸς τοῖς δούλοις σου μετὰ παρρησίας πάσης λαλεῖν τὸν λόγον σου,

text_en: by stretching forth your hand to cures and signs and wonders , to be done by the name of your holy Son , Jesus .
text_la: in eo quod manum tuam extendas ad sanitates, et signa, et prodigia fieri per nomen sancti filii tui Jesu.
text_pt: Enquanto estendes a tua mão para curar, e para que se façam sinais e prodígios pelo nome de teu santo Filho Jesus.
text_el: ἐν τῷ τὴν χεῖρά ἐκτείνειν σε εἰς ἴασιν καὶ σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα γίνεσθαι διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ ἁγίου παιδός σου Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: And when they had prayed , the place was moved wherein they were assembled: and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost : and they spoke the word of God with confidence.
text_la: Et cum orassent, motus est locus in quo erant congregati : et repleti sunt omnes Spiritu Sancto, et loquebantur verbum Dei cum fiducia.
text_pt: E, tendo orado, moveu-se o lugar em que estavam reunidos; e todos foram cheios do Espírito Santo, e anunciavam com ousadia a palavra de Deus.
text_el: καὶ δεηθέντων αὐτῶν ἐσαλεύθη ὁ τόπος ἐν ᾧ ἦσαν συνηγμένοι, καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν ἅπαντες τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος, καὶ ἐλάλουν τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ μετὰ παρρησίας.

text_en: And the multitude of believers had but one heart and one soul . Neither did any one say that aught of the things which he possessed was his own: but all things were common unto them.
text_la: Multitudinis autem credentium erat cor unum et anima una : nec quisquam eorum quæ possidebat, aliquid suum esse dicebat, sed erant illis omnia communia.
text_pt: E era um o coração e a alma da multidão dos que criam, e ninguém dizia que coisa alguma do que possuía era sua própria, mas todas as coisas lhes eram comuns.
text_el: Τοῦ δὲ πλήθους τῶν πιστευσάντων ἦν καρδία καὶ ψυχὴ μία, καὶ οὐδὲ εἷς τι τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐτῷ ἔλεγεν ἴδιον εἶναι, ἀλλ' ἦν αὐτοῖς πάντα κοινά.

text_en: And with great power did the Apostles give testimony of the resurrection of Jesus Christ our Lord : and great grace was in them all.
text_la: Et virtute magna reddebant Apostoli testimonium resurrectionis Jesu Christi Domini nostri : et gratia magna erat in omnibus illis.
text_pt: E os apóstolos davam, com grande poder, testemunho da ressurreição do Senhor Jesus, e em todos eles havia abundante graça.
text_el: καὶ δυνάμει μεγάλῃ ἀπεδίδουν τὸ μαρτύριον οἱ ἀπόστολοι τοῦ κυρίου, Ἰησοῦ τῆς ἀναστάσεως, χάρις τε μεγάλη ἦν ἐπὶ πάντας αὐτούς.

text_en: For neither was there any one needy among them. For as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them and brought the price of the things they sold,
text_la: Neque enim quisquam egens erat inter illos. Quotquot enim possessores agrorum aut domorum erant, vendentes afferebant pretia eorum quæ vendebant,
text_pt: Não havia, pois, entre eles necessitado algum; porque todos os que possuíam herdades ou casas, vendendo-as, traziam o preço do que fora vendido, e o depositavam aos pés dos apóstolos.
text_el: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἐνδεής τις ἦν ἐν αὐτοῖς: ὅσοι γὰρ κτήτορες χωρίων ἢ οἰκιῶν ὑπῆρχον, πωλοῦντες ἔφερον τὰς τιμὰς τῶν πιπρασκομένων

text_en: and laid it down before the feet of the apostles . And distribution was made to every one, according as he had need.
text_la: et ponebant ante pedes Apostolorum. Dividebatur autem singulis prout cuique opus erat.
text_pt: E repartia-se a cada um, segundo a necessidade que cada um tinha.
text_el: καὶ ἐτίθουν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἀποστόλων: διεδίδετο δὲ ἑκάστῳ καθότι ἄν τις χρείαν εἶχεν.

text_en: And Joseph, who, by the apostles , was surnamed Barnabas (which is, by interpretation, The son of consolation), a Levite , a Cyprian born,
text_la: Joseph autem, qui cognominatus est Barnabas ab Apostolis (quod est interpretatum, Filius consolationis), Levites, Cyprius genere,
text_pt: Então José, cognominado pelos apóstolos Barnabé(que, traduzido, é Filho da consolação), levita, natural de Chipre,
text_el: Ἰωσὴφ δὲ ὁ ἐπικληθεὶς Βαρναβᾶς ἀπὸ τῶν ἀποστόλων, ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον υἱὸς παρακλήσεως, Λευίτης, Κύπριος τῷ γένει,

text_en: having land, sold it and brought the price and laid it at the feet of the Apostles .
text_la: cum haberet agrum, vendidit eum, et attulit pretium, et posuit ante pedes Apostolorum.
text_pt: Possuindo uma herdade, vendeu-a, e trouxe o preço, e o depositou aos pés dos apóstolos.
text_el: ὑπάρχοντος αὐτῷ ἀγροῦ πωλήσας ἤνεγκεν τὸ χρῆμα καὶ ἔθηκεν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἀποστόλων.

text_en: But a certain man named Ananias, with Saphira his wife, sold a piece of land,
text_la: Vir autem quidam nomine Ananias, cum Saphira uxore suo vendidit agrum,
text_pt: Mas um certo homem chamado Ananias, com Safira, sua mulher, vendeu uma propriedade,
text_el: Ἀνὴρ δέ τις Ἁνανίας ὀνόματι σὺν Σαπφίρῃ τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπώλησεν κτῆμα

text_en: and by fraud kept back part of the price of the land, his wife being privy thereunto: and bringing a certain part of it, laid it at the feet of the apostles .
text_la: et fraudavit de pretio agri, conscia uxore sua : et afferens partem quamdam, ad pedes Apostolorum posuit.
text_pt: E reteve parte do preço, sabendo-o também sua mulher; e, levando uma parte, a depositou aos pés dos apóstolos.
text_el: καὶ ἐνοσφίσατο ἀπὸ τῆς τιμῆς, συνειδυίης καὶ τῆς γυναικός, καὶ ἐνέγκας μέρος τι παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἀποστόλων ἔθηκεν.

text_en: But Peter said: Ananias, why has Satan tempted your heart, that you should lie to the Holy Ghost and by fraud keep part of the price of the land?
text_la: Dixit autem Petrus : Anania, cur tentavit Satanas cor tuum, mentiri te Spiritui Sancto, et fraudare de pretio agri?
text_pt: Disse então Pedro: Ananias, por que encheu Satanás o teu coração, para que mentisses ao Espírito Santo, e retivesses parte do preço da herdade?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος: Ἁνανία, διὰ τί ἐπλήρωσεν ὁ Σατανᾶς τὴν καρδίαν σου, ψεύσασθαί σε τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον καὶ νοσφίσασθαι ἀπὸ τῆς τιμῆς τοῦ χωρίου;

text_en: Whilst it remained, did it not remain to you? And after it was sold, was it not in your power? Why have you conceived this thing in your heart? You have not lied to men , but to God .
text_la: nonne manens tibi manebat, et venundatum in tua erat potestate? quare posuisti in corde tuo hanc rem? non es mentitus hominibus, sed Deo.
text_pt: Guardando-a não ficava para ti? E, vendida, não estava em teu poder? Por que formaste este desígnio em teu coração? Não mentiste aos homens, mas a Deus.
text_el: οὐχὶ μένον σοὶ ἔμενεν καὶ πραθὲν ἐν τῇ σῇ ἐξουσίᾳ ὑπῆρχεν; τί ὅτι ἔθου ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο; οὐκ ἐψεύσω ἀνθρώποις ἀλλὰ τῷ θεῷ.

text_en: And Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and gave up the ghost . And there came great fear upon all that heard it.
text_la: Audiens autem Ananias hæc verba, cecidit, et expiravit. Et factus est timor magnus super omnes qui audierunt.
text_pt: E Ananias, ouvindo estas palavras, caiu e expirou. E um grande temor veio sobre todos os que isto ouviram.
text_el: ἀκούων δὲ ὁ Ἁνανίας τοὺς λόγους τούτους πεσὼν ἐξέψυξεν: καὶ ἐγένετο φόβος μέγας ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀκούοντας.

text_en: And the young men rising up, removed him, and carrying him out, buried him.
text_la: Surgentes autem juvenes amoverunt eum, et efferentes sepelierunt.
text_pt: E, levantando-se os moços, cobriram o morto e, transportando-o para fora, o sepultaram.
text_el: ἀναστάντες δὲ οἱ νεώτεροι συνέστειλαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐξενέγκαντες ἔθαψαν.

text_en: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
text_la: Factum est autem quasi horarum trium spatium, et uxor ipsius, nesciens quod factum fuerat, introivit.
text_pt: E, passando um espaço quase de três horas, entrou também sua mulher, não sabendo o que havia acontecido.
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ ὡς ὡρῶν τριῶν διάστημα καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ μὴ εἰδυῖα τὸ γεγονὸς εἰσῆλθεν.

text_en: And Peter said to her: Tell me, woman , whether you sold the land for so much? And she said: Yea, for so much.
text_la: Dixit autem ei Petrus : Dic mihi mulier, si tanti agrum vendidistis? At illa dixit : Etiam tanti.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Pedro: Dize-me, vendestes por tanto aquela herdade? E ela disse: Sim, por tanto.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ πρὸς αὐτὴν Πέτρος, εἰπέ μοι, εἰ τοσούτου τὸ χωρίον ἀπέδοσθε; ἡ δὲ εἶπεν, ναί, τοσούτου.

text_en: And Peter said unto her: Why have you agreed together to tempt the spirit of the Lord ? Behold the feet of them who have buried your husband are at the door: and they shall carry you out,
text_la: Petrus autem ad eam : Quid utique convenit vobis tentare Spiritum Domini? Ecce pedes eorum qui sepelierunt virum tuum ad ostium, et efferent te.
text_pt: Então Pedro lhe disse: Por que é que entre vós vos concertastes para tentar o Espírito do Senhor? Eis aí à porta os pés dos que sepultaram o teu marido, e também te levarão a ti.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος πρὸς αὐτήν, τί ὅτι συνεφωνήθη ὑμῖν πειράσαι τὸ πνεῦμα κυρίου; ἰδοὺ οἱ πόδες τῶν θαψάντων τὸν ἄνδρα σου ἐπὶ τῇ θύρᾳ καὶ ἐξοίσουσίν σε.

text_en: immediately, she fell down before his feet and gave up the ghost . And the young men coming in found her dead: and carried her out and buried her by her husband.
text_la: Confestim cecidit ante pedes ejus, et expiravit. Intrantes autem juvenes invenerunt illam mortuam : et extulerunt, et sepelierunt ad virum suum.
text_pt: E logo caiu aos seus pés, e expirou. E, entrando os moços, acharam-na morta, e a sepultaram junto de seu marido.
text_el: ἔπεσεν δὲ παραχρῆμα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξέψυξεν: εἰσελθόντες δὲ οἱ νεανίσκοι εὗρον αὐτὴν νεκράν, καὶ ἐξενέγκαντες ἔθαψαν πρὸς τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς.

text_en: And there came great fear upon the whole church and upon all that heard these things.
text_la: Et factus est timor magnus in universa ecclesia, et in omnes qui audierunt hæc.
text_pt: E houve um grande temor em toda a igreja, e em todos os que ouviram estas coisas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο φόβος μέγας ἐφ' ὅλην τὴν ἐκκλησίαν καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀκούοντας ταῦτα.

text_en: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people. And they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.
text_la: Per manus autem Apostolorum fiebant signa et prodigia multa in plebe. Et erant unanimiter omnes in porticu Salomonis.
text_pt: E muitos sinais e prodígios eram feitos entre o povo pelas mãos dos apóstolos. E estavam todos unanimemente no alpendre de Salomão.
text_el: Διὰ δὲ τῶν χειρῶν τῶν ἀποστόλων ἐγίνετο σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα πολλὰ ἐν τῷ λαῷ: καὶ ἦσαν ὁμοθυμαδὸν πάντες ἐν τῇ Στοᾷ Σολομῶντος:

text_en: But of the rest no man dared join himself unto them: but the people magnified them.
text_la: Ceterorum autem nemo audebat se conjungere illis : sed magnificabat eos populus.
text_pt: Dos outros, porém, ninguém ousava ajuntar-se a eles; mas o povo tinha-os em grande estima.
text_el: τῶν δὲ λοιπῶν οὐδεὶς ἐτόλμα κολλᾶσθαι αὐτοῖς, ἀλλ' ἐμεγάλυνεν αὐτοὺς ὁ λαός:

text_en: And the multitude of men and women who believed in the Lord was more increased:
text_la: Magis autem augebatur credentium in Domino multitudo virorum ac mulierum,
text_pt: E a multidão dos que criam no Senhor, tanto homens como mulheres, crescia cada vez mais.
text_el: μᾶλλον δὲ προσετίθεντο πιστεύοντες τῷ κυρίῳ πλήθη ἀνδρῶν τε καὶ γυναικῶν,

text_en: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and couches, that, when Peter came, his shadow at the least might overshadow any of them and they might be delivered from their infirmities.
text_la: ita ut in plateas ejicerent infirmos, et ponerent in lectulis et grabatis, ut, veniente Petro, saltem umbra illius obumbraret quemquam illorum, et liberarentur ab infirmitatibus suis.
text_pt: De sorte que transportavam os enfermos para as ruas, e os punham em leitos e em camilhas para que ao menos a sombra de Pedro, quando este passasse, cobrisse alguns deles.
text_el: ὥστε καὶ εἰς τὰς πλατείας ἐκφέρειν τοὺς ἀσθενεῖς καὶ τιθέναι ἐπὶ κλιναρίων καὶ κραβάττων, ἵνα ἐρχομένου Πέτρου κἂν ἡ σκιὰ ἐπισκιάσει τινὶ αὐτῶν.

text_en: And there came also together to Jerusalem a multitude out of the neighbouring cities, bringing sick persons and such as were troubled with unclean spirits : who were all healed.
text_la: Concurrebat autem et multitudo vicinarum civitatum Jerusalem, afferentes ægros, et vexatos a spiritibus immundis : qui curabantur omnes.
text_pt: E até das cidades circunvizinhas concorria muita gente a Jerusalém, conduzindo enfermos e atormentados de espíritos imundos; os quais eram todos curados.
text_el: συνήρχετο δὲ καὶ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν πέριξ πόλεων Ἰερουσαλήμ, φέροντες ἀσθενεῖς καὶ ὀχλουμένους ὑπὸ πνευμάτων ἀκαθάρτων, οἵτινες ἐθεραπεύοντο ἅπαντες.

text_en: Then the high priest rising up, and all they that were with him (which is the heresy of the Sadducees ) were filled with envy .
text_la: Exsurgens autem princeps sacerdotum, et omnes qui cum illo erant (quæ est hæresis sadducæorum), repleti sunt zelo:
text_pt: E, levantando-se o sumo sacerdote, e todos os que estavam com ele (e eram eles da seita dos saduceus), encheram-se de inveja,
text_el: Ἀναστὰς δὲ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ πάντες οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ, ἡ οὖσα αἵρεσις τῶν Σαδδουκαίων, ἐπλήσθησαν ζήλου

text_en: And they laid hands on the apostles and put them in the common prison .
text_la: et injecerunt manus in Apostolos, et posuerunt eos in custodia publica.
text_pt: E lançaram mão dos apóstolos, e os puseram na prisão pública.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέβαλον τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀποστόλους καὶ ἔθεντο αὐτοὺς ἐν τηρήσει δημοσίᾳ.

text_en: But an angel of the Lord by night, opening the doors of the prison and leading them out, said:
text_la: Angelus autem Domini per noctem aperiens januas carceris, et educens eos, dixit:
text_pt: Mas de noite um anjo do Senhor abriu as portas da prisão e, tirando-os para fora, disse:
text_el: ἄγγελος δὲ κυρίου διὰ νυκτὸς ἤνοιξεν τὰς θύρας τῆς φυλακῆς ἐξαγαγών τε αὐτοὺς εἶπεν,

text_en: Go, and standing speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
text_la: Ite, et stantes loquimini in templo plebi omnia verba vitæ hujus.
text_pt: Ide e apresentai-vos no templo, e dizei ao povo todas as palavras desta vida.
text_el: πορεύεσθε καὶ σταθέντες λαλεῖτε ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ τῷ λαῷ πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τῆς ζωῆς ταύτης.

text_en: Who having heard this, early in the morning, entered into the temple and taught. And the high priest coming, and they that were with him, called together the council and all the ancients of the children of Israel : and they sent to the prison to have them brought.
text_la: Qui cum audissent, intraverunt diluculo in templum, et docebant. Adveniens autem princeps sacerdotum, et qui cum eo erant, convocaverunt concilium, et omnes seniores filiorum Israël : et miserunt ad carcerem ut adducerentur.
text_pt: E, ouvindo eles isto, entraram de manhã cedo no templo, e ensinavam. Chegando, porém, o sumo sacerdote e os que estavam com ele, convocaram o conselho, e a todos os anciãos dos filhos de Israel, e enviaram ao cárcere, para que de lá os trouxessem.
text_el: ἀκούσαντες δὲ εἰσῆλθον ὑπὸ τὸν ὄρθρον εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἐδίδασκον. παραγενόμενος δὲ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ συνεκάλεσαν τὸ συνέδριον καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γερουσίαν τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ, καὶ ἀπέστειλαν εἰς τὸ δεσμωτήριον ἀχθῆναι αὐτούς.

text_en: But when the ministers came and opening the prison found them not there, they returned and told,
text_la: Cum autem venissent ministri, et aperto carcere non invenissent illos, reversi nuntiaverunt,
text_pt: Mas, tendo lá ido os servidores, não os acharam na prisão e, voltando, lho anunciaram,
text_el: οἱ δὲ παραγενόμενοι ὑπηρέται οὐχ εὗρον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ, ἀναστρέψαντες δὲ ἀπήγγειλαν

text_en: saying: The prison indeed we found shut with all diligence, and the keepers standing before the door: but opening it, we found no man within.
