text_la: dicentes : Carcerem quidem invenimus clausum cum omni diligentia, et custodes stantes ante januas : aperientes autem neminem intus invenimus.
text_pt: Dizendo: Achamos realmente o cárcere fechado, com toda a segurança, e os guardas, que estavam fora, diante das portas; mas, quando abrimos, ninguém achamos dentro.
text_el: λέγοντες ὅτι τὸ δεσμωτήριον εὕρομεν κεκλεισμένον ἐν πάσῃ ἀσφαλείᾳ καὶ τοὺς φύλακας ἑστῶτας ἐπὶ τῶν θυρῶν, ἀνοίξαντες δὲ ἔσω, οὐδένα εὕρομεν.

text_en: Now when the officer of the temple and the chief priests heard these words, they were in doubt concerning them, what would come to pass.
text_la: Ut autem audierunt hos sermones magistratus templi et principes sacerdotum, ambigebant de illis quidnam fieret.
text_pt: Então o sumo sacerdote, o capitão do templo e os chefes dos sacerdotes, ouvindo estas palavras, estavam perplexos acerca deles e do que viria a ser aquilo.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἤκουσαν τοὺς λόγους τούτους ὅ τε στρατηγὸς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς, διηπόρουν περὶ αὐτῶν τί ἂν γένοιτο τοῦτο.

text_en: But one came and told them: Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple , standing and teaching the people.
text_la: Adveniens autem quidam, nuntiavit eis : Quia ecce viri quos posuistis in carcerem, sunt in templo, stantes et docentes populum.
text_pt: E, chegando um, anunciou-lhes, dizendo: Eis que os homens que encerrastes na prisão estão no templo e ensinam ao povo.
text_el: παραγενόμενος δέ τις ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἰδοὺ οἱ ἄνδρες οὓς ἔθεσθε ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ εἰσὶν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἑστῶτες καὶ διδάσκοντες τὸν λαόν.

text_en: Then went the officer with the ministers and brought them without violence : for they feared the people, lest they should be stoned .
text_la: Tunc abiit magistratus cum ministris, et adduxit illos sine vi : timebant enim populum ne lapidarentur.
text_pt: Então foi o capitão com os servidores, e os trouxe, não com violência (porque temiam ser apedrejados pelo povo).
text_el: Τότε ἀπελθὼν ὁ στρατηγὸς σὺν τοῖς ὑπηρέταις ἦγεν αὐτούς, οὐ μετὰ βίας, ἐφοβοῦντο γὰρ τὸν λαόν, μὴ λιθασθῶσιν:

text_en: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council . And the high priest asked them,
text_la: Et cum adduxissent illos, statuerunt in concilio : et interrogavit eos princeps sacerdotum,
text_pt: E, trazendo-os, os apresentaram ao conselho. E o sumo sacerdote os interrogou,
text_el: ἀγαγόντες δὲ αὐτοὺς ἔστησαν ἐν τῷ συνεδρίῳ. καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτοὺς ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς

text_en: saying: Commanding, we commanded you that you should not teach in this name . And behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine : and you have a mind to bring the blood of this man upon us.
text_la: dicens : Præcipiendo præcepimus vobis ne doceretis in nomine isto, et ecce replestis Jerusalem doctrina vestra : et vultis inducere super nos sanguinem hominis istius.
text_pt: Dizendo: Não vos admoestamos nós expressamente que não ensinásseis nesse nome? E eis que enchestes Jerusalém dessa vossa doutrina, e quereis lançar sobre nós o sangue desse homem.
text_el: λέγων, παραγγελίᾳ παρηγγείλαμεν ὑμῖν μὴ διδάσκειν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ; καὶ ἰδοὺ πεπληρώκατε τὴν Ἰερουσαλὴμ τῆς διδαχῆς ὑμῶν, καὶ βούλεσθε ἐπαγαγεῖν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς τὸ αἷμα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου.

text_en: But Peter and the apostles answering, said: We ought to obey God rather than men .
text_la: Respondens autem Petrus et Apostoli, dixerunt : Obedire oportet Deo magis quam hominibus.
text_pt: Porém, respondendo Pedro e os apóstolos, disseram: Mais importa obedecer a Deus do que aos homens.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Πέτρος καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι εἶπαν, πειθαρχεῖν δεῖ θεῷ μᾶλλον ἢ ἀνθρώποις.

text_en: The God of our fathers has raised up Jesus , whom you put to death , hanging him upon a tree.
text_la: Deus patrum nostrorum suscitavit Jesum, quem vos interemistis, suspendentes in ligno.
text_pt: O Deus de nossos pais ressuscitou a Jesus, ao qual vós matastes, suspendendo-o no madeiro.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἤγειρεν Ἰησοῦν, ὃν ὑμεῖς διεχειρίσασθε κρεμάσαντες ἐπὶ ξύλου:

text_en: Him has God exalted with his right hand, to be Prince and Saviour. to give repentance to Israel and remission of sins .
text_la: Hunc principem et salvatorem Deus exaltavit dextera sua ad dandam pœnitentiam Israëli, et remissionem peccatorum:
text_pt: Deus com a sua destra o elevou a Príncipe e Salvador, para dar a Israel o arrependimento e a remissão dos pecados.
text_el: τοῦτον ὁ θεὸς ἀρχηγὸν καὶ σωτῆρα ὕψωσεν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ, τοῦ δοῦναι μετάνοιαν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν.

text_en: And we are witnesses of these things: and the Holy Ghost , whom God has given to all that obey him.
text_la: et nos sumus testes horum verborum, et Spiritus Sanctus, quem dedit Deus omnibus obedientibus sibi.
text_pt: E nós somos testemunhas acerca destas palavras, nós e também o Espírito Santo, que Deus deu àqueles que lhe obedecem.
text_el: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν μάρτυρες τῶν ῥημάτων τούτων, καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ὃ ἔδωκεν ὁ θεὸς τοῖς πειθαρχοῦσιν αὐτῷ.

text_en: When they had heard these things, they were cut to the heart: and they thought to put them to death .
text_la: Hæc cum audissent, dissecabantur, et cogitabant interficere illos.
text_pt: E, ouvindo eles isto, se enfureciam, e deliberaram matá-los.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες διεπρίοντο καὶ ἐβούλοντο ἀνελεῖν αὐτούς.

text_en: But one in the council rising up, a Pharisee , named Gamaliel , a doctor of the law , respected by all the people, commanded the men to be put forth a little while.
text_la: Surgens autem quidam in concilio pharisæus, nomine Gamaliel, legis doctor, honorabilis universæ plebi, jussit foras ad breve homines fieri,
text_pt: Mas, levantando-se no conselho um certo fariseu, chamado Gamaliel, doutor da lei, venerado por todo o povo, mandou que por um pouco levassem para fora os apóstolos;
text_el: Ἀναστὰς δέ τις ἐν τῷ συνεδρίῳ Φαρισαῖος ὀνόματι Γαμαλιήλ, νομοδιδάσκαλος τίμιος παντὶ τῷ λαῷ, ἐκέλευσεν ἔξω βραχὺ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ποιῆσαι,

text_en: And he said to them: You men of Israel , take heed to yourselves what you intend to do, as touching these men .
text_la: dixitque ad illos : Viri Israëlitæ, attendite vobis super hominibus istis quid acturi sitis.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Homens israelitas, acautelai-vos a respeito do que haveis de fazer a estes homens,
text_el: εἶπέν τε πρὸς αὐτούς, ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται, προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τούτοις τί μέλλετε πράσσειν.

text_en: For before these days rose up Theodas, affirming himself to be somebody, to whom a number of men , about four hundred, joined themselves. Who was slain : and all that believed him were scattered and brought to nothing.
text_la: Ante hos enim dies extitit Theodas, dicens se esse aliquem, cui consensit numerus virorum circiter quadringentorum : qui occisus est, et omnes qui credebant ei, dissipati sunt, et redacti ad nihilum.
text_pt: Porque antes destes dias levantou-se Teudas, dizendo ser alguém; a este se ajuntou o número de uns quatrocentos homens; o qual foi morto, e todos os que lhe deram ouvidos foram dispersos e reduzidos a nada.
text_el: πρὸ γὰρ τούτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἀνέστη Θευδᾶς, λέγων εἶναί τινα ἑαυτόν, ᾧ προσεκλίθη ἀνδρῶν ἀριθμὸς ὡς τετρακοσίων: ὃς ἀνῃρέθη, καὶ πάντες ὅσοι ἐπείθοντο αὐτῷ διελύθησαν καὶ ἐγένοντο εἰς οὐδέν.

text_en: After this man , rose up Judas of Galilee, in the days of the enrolling, and drew away the people after him. He also perished: and all, even as many as consented to him, were dispersed.
text_la: Post hunc extitit Judas Galilæus in diebus professionis, et avertit populum post se : et ipse periit, et omnes quotquot consenserunt ei, dispersi sunt.
text_pt: Depois deste levantou-se Judas, o galileu, nos dias do alistamento, e levou muito povo após si; mas também este pereceu, e todos os que lhe deram ouvidos foram dispersos.
text_el: μετὰ τοῦτον ἀνέστη Ἰούδας ὁ Γαλιλαῖος ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς ἀπογραφῆς καὶ ἀπέστησεν λαὸν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ: κἀκεῖνος ἀπώλετο, καὶ πάντες ὅσοι ἐπείθοντο αὐτῷ διεσκορπίσθησαν.

text_en: And now, therefore, I say to you: Refrain from these men and let them alone. For if this council or this work be of men , it will come to nought:
text_la: Et nunc itaque dico vobis, discedite ab hominibus istis, et sinite illos : quoniam si est ex hominibus consilium hoc aut opus, dissolvetur:
text_pt: E agora digo-vos: Dai de mão a estes homens, e deixai-os, porque, se este conselho ou esta obra é de homens, se desfará,
text_el: καὶ [τὰ] νῦν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀπόστητε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων τούτων καὶ ἄφετε αὐτούς: ὅτι ἐὰν ᾖ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἡ βουλὴ αὕτη ἢ τὸ ἔργον τοῦτο, καταλυθήσεται:

text_en: But if it be of God , you cannot overthrow it, lest perhaps you be found even to fight against God . And they consented to him.
text_la: si vero ex Deo est, non poteritis dissolvere illud, ne forte et Deo repugnare inveniamini. Consenserunt autem illi.
text_pt: Mas, se é de Deus, não podereis desfazê-la; para que não aconteça serdes também achados combatendo contra Deus.
text_el: εἰ δὲ ἐκ θεοῦ ἐστιν, οὐ δυνήσεσθε καταλῦσαι αὐτούς, μήποτε καὶ θεομάχοι εὑρεθῆτε. ἐπείσθησαν δὲ αὐτῷ,

text_en: And calling in the apostles , after they had scourged them, they charged them that they should not speak at all in the name of Jesus . And they dismissed them.
text_la: Et convocantes Apostolos, cæsis denuntiaverunt ne omnino loquerentur in nomine Jesu, et dimiserunt eos.
text_pt: E concordaram com ele. E, chamando os apóstolos, e tendo-os açoitado, mandaram que não falassem no nome de Jesus, e os deixaram ir.
text_el: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενοι τοὺς ἀποστόλους δείραντες παρήγγειλαν μὴ λαλεῖν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἀπέλυσαν.

text_en: And they indeed went from the presence of the council , rejoicing that they were accounted worthy to suffer reproach for the name of Jesus .
text_la: Et illi quidem ibant gaudentes a conspectu concilii, quoniam digni habiti sunt pro nomine Jesu contumeliam pati.
text_pt: Retiraram-se, pois, da presença do conselho, regozijando-se de terem sido julgados dignos de padecer afronta pelo nome de Jesus.
text_el: Οἱ μὲν οὖν ἐπορεύοντο χαίροντες ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ συνεδρίου ὅτι κατηξιώθησαν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματος ἀτιμασθῆναι:

text_en: And every day they ceased not, in the temple and from house to house, to teach and preach Christ Jesus .
text_la: Omni autem die non cessabant in templo et circa domos, docentes et evangelizantes Christum Jesum.
text_pt: E todos os dias, no templo e nas casas, não cessavam de ensinar, e de anunciar a Jesus Cristo.
text_el: πᾶσάν τε ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ κατ' οἶκον οὐκ ἐπαύοντο διδάσκοντες καὶ εὐαγγελιζόμενοι τὸν Χριστόν, Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And in those days, the number of the disciples increasing, there arose a murmuring of the Greeks against the Hebrews , for that their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
text_la: In diebus illis, crescente numero discipulorum, factum est murmur Græcorum adversus Hebræos, eo quod despicerentur in ministerio quotidiano viduæ eorum.
text_pt: Ora, naqueles dias, crescendo o número dos discípulos, houve uma murmuração dos gregos contra os hebreus, porque as suas viúvas eram desprezadas no ministério cotidiano.
text_el: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις πληθυνόντων τῶν μαθητῶν ἐγένετο γογγυσμὸς τῶν Ἑλληνιστῶν πρὸς τοὺς Ἑβραίους, ὅτι παρεθεωροῦντο ἐν τῇ διακονίᾳ τῇ καθημερινῇ αἱ χῆραι αὐτῶν.

text_en: Then the twelve , calling together the multitude of the disciples , said: It is not reason that we should leave the word of God and serve tables.
text_la: Convocantes autem duodecim multitudinem discipulorum, dixerunt : Non est æquum nos derelinquere verbum Dei, et ministrare mensis.
text_pt: E os doze, convocando a multidão dos discípulos, disseram: Não é razoável que nós deixemos a palavra de Deus e sirvamos às mesas.
text_el: προσκαλεσάμενοι δὲ οἱ δώδεκα τὸ πλῆθος τῶν μαθητῶν εἶπαν, οὐκ ἀρεστόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς καταλείψαντας τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ διακονεῖν τραπέζαις:

text_en: Wherefore, brethren, look out among you seven men of good reputation , full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
text_la: Considerate ergo, fratres, viros ex vobis boni testimonii septem, plenos Spiritu Sancto et sapientia, quos constituamus super hoc opus.
text_pt: Escolhei, pois, irmãos, dentre vós, sete homens de boa reputação, cheios do Espírito Santo e de sabedoria, aos quais constituamos sobre este importante negócio.
text_el: ἐπισκέψασθε δέ, ἀδελφοί, ἄνδρας ἐξ ὑμῶν μαρτυρουμένους ἑπτὰ πλήρεις πνεύματος καὶ σοφίας, οὓς καταστήσομεν ἐπὶ τῆς χρείας ταύτης:

text_en: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer and to the ministry of the word.
text_la: Nos vero orationi et ministerio verbi instantes erimus.
text_pt: Mas nós perseveraremos na oração e no ministério da palavra.
text_el: ἡμεῖς δὲ τῇ προσευχῇ καὶ τῇ διακονίᾳ τοῦ λόγου προσκαρτερήσομεν.

text_en: And the saying was liked by all the multitude. And they chose Stephen , a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost , and Philip and Prochorus and Nicanor, and Timon and Parmenas and Nicolas, a proselyte of Antioch .
text_la: Et placuit sermo coram omni multitudine. Et elegerunt Stephanum, virum plenum fide et Spiritu Sancto, et Philippum, et Prochorum, et Nicanorem, et Timonem, et Parmenam, et Nicolaum advenam Antiochenum.
text_pt: E este parecer contentou a toda a multidão, e elegeram Estêvão, homem cheio de fé e do Espírito Santo, e Filipe, e Prócoro, e Nicanor, e Timão, e Parmenas e Nicolau, prosélito de Antioquia;
text_el: καὶ ἤρεσεν ὁ λόγος ἐνώπιον παντὸς τοῦ πλήθους, καὶ ἐξελέξαντο Στέφανον, ἄνδρα πλήρη πίστεως καὶ πνεύματος ἁγίου, καὶ Φίλιππον καὶ Πρόχορον καὶ Νικάνορα καὶ Τίμωνα καὶ Παρμενᾶν καὶ Νικόλαον προσήλυτον Ἀντιοχέα,

text_en: These they set before the apostles : and they praying , imposed hands upon them.
text_la: Hos statuerunt ante conspectum Apostolorum: et orantes imposuerunt eis manus.
text_pt: E os apresentaram ante os apóstolos, e estes, orando, lhes impuseram as mãos.
text_el: οὓς ἔστησαν ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀποστόλων, καὶ προσευξάμενοι ἐπέθηκαν αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας.

text_en: And the word of the Lord increased: and the number of the disciples was multiplied in Jerusalem exceedingly. A great multitude also of the priests obeyed the faith .
text_la: Et verbum Domini crescebat, et multiplicabatur numerus discipulorum in Jerusalem valde : multa etiam turba sacerdotum obediebat fidei.
text_pt: E crescia a palavra de Deus, e em Jerusalém se multiplicava muito o número dos discípulos, e grande parte dos sacerdotes obedecia à fé.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ ηὔξανεν, καὶ ἐπληθύνετο ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν μαθητῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ σφόδρα, πολύς τε ὄχλος τῶν ἱερέων ὑπήκουον τῇ πίστει.

text_en: And Stephen , full of grace and fortitude , did great wonders and signs among the people.
text_la: Stephanus autem plenus gratia et fortitudine, faciebat prodigia et signa magna in populo.
text_pt: E Estêvão, cheio de fé e de poder, fazia prodígios e grandes sinais entre o povo.
text_el: Στέφανος δὲ πλήρης χάριτος καὶ δυνάμεως ἐποίει τέρατα καὶ σημεῖα μεγάλα ἐν τῷ λαῷ.

text_en: Now there arose some, of that which is called the synagogue of the Libertines and of the Cyrenians and of the Alexandrians and of them that were of Cilicia and Asia , disputing with Stephen .
text_la: Surrexerunt autem quidam de synagoga quæ appellatur Libertinorum, et Cyrenensium, et Alexandrinorum, et eorum qui erant a Cilicia, et Asia, disputantes cum Stephano:
text_pt: E levantaram-se alguns que eram da sinagoga chamada dos libertinos, e dos cireneus e dos alexandrinos, e dos que eram da Cilícia e da Asia, e disputavam com Estêvão.
text_el: ἀνέστησαν δέ τινες τῶν ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς τῆς λεγομένης Λιβερτίνων καὶ Κυρηναίων καὶ Ἀλεξανδρέων καὶ τῶν ἀπὸ Κιλικίας καὶ Ἀσίας συζητοῦντες τῷ Στεφάνῳ,

text_en: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit that spoke.
text_la: et non poterant resistere sapientiæ, et Spiritui qui loquebatur.
text_pt: E não podiam resistir à sabedoria, e ao Espírito com que falava.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυον ἀντιστῆναι τῇ σοφίᾳ καὶ τῷ πνεύματι ᾧ ἐλάλει.

text_en: Then they suborned men to say they had heard him speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God .
text_la: Tunc summiserunt viros, qui dicerent se audivisse eum dicentem verba blasphemiæ in Moysen et in Deum.
text_pt: Então subornaram uns homens, para que dissessem: Ouvimos-lhe proferir palavras blasfemas contra Moisés e contra Deus.
text_el: τότε ὑπέβαλον ἄνδρας λέγοντας ὅτι ἀκηκόαμεν αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ῥήματα βλάσφημα εἰς Μωϋσῆν καὶ τὸν θεόν:

text_en: And they stirred up the people and the ancients and the scribes . And running together, they took him and brought him to the council .
text_la: Commoverunt itaque plebem, et seniores, et scribas : et concurrentes rapuerunt eum, et adduxerunt in concilium,
text_pt: E excitaram o povo, os anciãos e os escribas; e, investindo contra ele, o arrebataram e o levaram ao conselho.
text_el: συνεκίνησάν τε τὸν λαὸν καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους καὶ τοὺς γραμματεῖς, καὶ ἐπιστάντες συνήρπασαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἤγαγον εἰς τὸ συνέδριον,

text_en: And they set up false witnesses , who said: This man ceases not to speak words against the holy place and the law .
text_la: et statuerunt falsos testes, qui dicerent : Homo iste non cessat loqui verba adversus locum sanctum, et legem:
text_pt: E apresentaram falsas testemunhas, que diziam: Este homem não cessa de proferir palavras blasfemas contra este santo lugar e a lei;
text_el: ἔστησάν τε μάρτυρας ψευδεῖς λέγοντας, ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος οὐ παύεται λαλῶν ῥήματα κατὰ τοῦ τόπου τοῦ ἁγίου [τούτου] καὶ τοῦ νόμου:

text_en: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place and shall change the traditions which Moses delivered unto us.
text_la: audivimus enim eum dicentem quoniam Jesus Nazarenus hic destruet locum istum, et mutabit traditiones quas tradidit nobis Moyses.
text_pt: Porque nós lhe ouvimos dizer que esse Jesus Nazareno há de destruir este lugar e mudar os costumes que Moisés nos deu.
text_el: ἀκηκόαμεν γὰρ αὐτοῦ λέγοντος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζωραῖος οὗτος καταλύσει τὸν τόπον τοῦτον καὶ ἀλλάξει τὰ ἔθη ἃ παρέδωκεν ἡμῖν Μωϋσῆς.

text_en: And all that sat in the council , looking on him, saw his face as if it had been the face of an angel .
text_la: Et intuentes eum omnes qui sedebant in concilio, viderunt faciem ejus tamquam faciem angeli.
text_pt: Então todos os que estavam assentados no conselho, fixando os olhos nele, viram o seu rosto como o rosto de um anjo.
text_el: καὶ ἀτενίσαντες εἰς αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ καθεζόμενοι ἐν τῷ συνεδρίῳ εἶδον τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ πρόσωπον ἀγγέλου.

text_en: Then the high priest said: Are these things so?
text_la: Dixit autem princeps sacerdotum : Si hæc ita se habent?
text_pt: E disse o sumo sacerdote: Porventura é isto assim?
text_el: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ ἀρχιερεύς: εἰ ταῦτα οὕτως ἔχει;

text_en: Who said: You men , brethren and fathers, hear. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham , when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charan.
text_la: Qui ait : Viri fratres et patres, audite : Deus gloriæ apparuit patri nostro Abrahæ cum esset in Mesopotamia, priusquam moraretur in Charan,
text_pt: E ele disse: Homens, irmãos, e pais, ouvi. O Deus da glória apareceu a nosso pai Abraão, estando na mesopotâmia, antes de habitar em Harã,
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἔφη, ἄνδρες ἀδελφοὶ καὶ πατέρες, ἀκούσατε. ὁ θεὸς τῆς δόξης ὤφθη τῷ πατρὶ ἡμῶν Ἀβραὰμ ὄντι ἐν τῇ Μεσοποταμίᾳ πρὶν ἢ κατοικῆσαι αὐτὸν ἐν Χαρράν,

text_en: And said to him: Go forth out of your country and from your kindred: and come into the land which I shall show you.
text_la: et dixit ad illum : Exi de terra tua, et de cognatione tua, et veni in terram quam monstravero tibi.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Sai da tua terra e dentre a tua parentela, e dirige-te à terra que eu te mostrar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν, ἔξελθε ἐκ τῆς γῆς σου καὶ τῆς συγγενείας σου, καὶ δεῦρο εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἄν σοι δείξω.

text_en: Then he went out of the land of the Chaldeans and dwelt in Charan. And from thence, after his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein you now dwell.
text_la: Tunc exiit de terra Chaldæorum, et habitavit in Charan. Et inde, postquam mortuus est pater ejus, transtulit illum in terram istam, in qua nunc vos habitatis.
text_pt: Então saiu da terra dos caldeus, e habitou em Harã. E dali, depois que seu pai faleceu, Deus o trouxe para esta terra em que habitais agora.
text_el: τότε ἐξελθὼν ἐκ γῆς Χαλδαίων κατῴκησεν ἐν Χαρράν. κἀκεῖθεν μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ μετῴκισεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς νῦν κατοικεῖτε,

text_en: And he gave him no inheritance in it: no, not the pace of a foot. But he promised to give it him in possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
text_la: Et non dedit illi hæreditatem in ea, nec passum pedis : sed repromisit dare illi eam in possessionem, et semini ejus post ipsum, cum non haberet filium.
text_pt: E não lhe deu nela herança, nem ainda o espaço de um pé; mas prometeu que lhe daria a posse dela, e depois dele, à sua descendência, não tendo ele ainda filho.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ κληρονομίαν ἐν αὐτῇ οὐδὲ βῆμα ποδός, καὶ ἐπηγγείλατο δοῦναι αὐτῷ εἰς κατάσχεσιν αὐτὴν καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτόν, οὐκ ὄντος αὐτῷ τέκνου.

text_en: And God said to him: That his seed should sojourn in a strange country, and that they should bring them under bondage and treat them evil four hundred years.
text_la: Locutus est autem ei Deus : Quia erit semen ejus accola in terra aliena, et servituti eos subjicient, et male tractabunt eos annis quadringentis:
text_pt: E falou Deus assim: Que a sua descendência seria peregrina em terra alheia, e a sujeitariam à escravidão, e a maltratariam por quatrocentos anos.
text_el: ἐλάλησεν δὲ οὕτως ὁ θεὸς ὅτι ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ πάροικον ἐν γῇ ἀλλοτρίᾳ, καὶ δουλώσουσιν αὐτὸ καὶ κακώσουσιν ἔτη τετρακόσια:

text_en: And the nation which they shall serve will I judge (said the Lord ): and after these things they shall go out and shall serve me in this place.
text_la: et gentem cui servierint, judicabo ego, dixit Dominus : et post hæc exibunt, et servient mihi in loco isto.
text_pt: E eu julgarei a nação que os tiver escravizado, disse Deus. E depois disto sairão e me servirão neste lugar.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἔθνος ᾧ ἐὰν δουλεύσουσιν κρινῶ ἐγώ, ὁ θεὸς εἶπεν, καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐξελεύσονται καὶ λατρεύσουσίν μοι ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ.

text_en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision . And so he begot Isaac and circumcised him the eighth day: and Isaac begot Jacob : and Jacob , the twelve patriarchs .
text_la: Et dedit illi testamentum circumcisionis : et sic genuit Isaac, et circumcidit eum die octavo : et Isaac, Jacob : et Jacob, duodecim patriarchas.
text_pt: E deu-lhe a aliança da circuncisão; e assim gerou a Isaque, e o circuncidou ao oitavo dia; e Isaque a Jacó; e Jacó aos doze patriarcas.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ διαθήκην περιτομῆς: καὶ οὕτως ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰσαὰκ καὶ περιέτεμεν αὐτὸν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ, καὶ Ἰσαὰκ τὸν Ἰακώβ, καὶ Ἰακὼβ τοὺς δώδεκα πατριάρχας.

text_en: And the patriarchs , through envy , sold Joseph into Egypt . And God was with him,
text_la: Et patriarchæ æmulantes, Joseph vendiderunt in Ægyptum : et erat Deus cum eo,
text_pt: E os patriarcas, movidos de inveja, venderam José para o Egito; mas Deus era com ele.
text_el: Καὶ οἱ πατριάρχαι ζηλώσαντες τὸν Ἰωσὴφ ἀπέδοντο εἰς Αἴγυπτον: καὶ ἦν ὁ θεὸς μετ' αὐτοῦ,

text_en: and delivered him out of all his tribulations: and he gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharao , the king of Egypt . And he appointed him governor over Egypt and over all his house.
text_la: et eripuit eum ex omnibus tribulationibus ejus, et dedit ei gratiam et sapientiam in conspectu pharaonis regis Ægypti : et constituit eum præpositum super Ægyptum, et super omnem domum suam.
text_pt: E livrou-o de todas as suas tribulações, e lhe deu graça e sabedoria ante Faraó, rei do Egito, que o constituiu governador sobre o Egito e toda a sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐξείλατο αὐτὸν ἐκ πασῶν τῶν θλίψεων αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ χάριν καὶ σοφίαν ἐναντίον Φαραὼ βασιλέως Αἰγύπτου, καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτὸν ἡγούμενον ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον καὶ ὅλον τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Now there came a famine upon all Egypt and Chanaan , and great tribulation: and our fathers found no food.
text_la: Venit autem fames in universam Ægyptum et Chanaan, et tribulatio magna : et non inveniebant cibos patres nostri.
text_pt: Sobreveio então a todo o país do Egito e de Canaã fome e grande tribulação; e nossos pais não achavam alimentos.
text_el: ἦλθεν δὲ λιμὸς ἐφ' ὅλην τὴν Αἴγυπτον καὶ Χανάαν καὶ θλῖψις μεγάλη, καὶ οὐχ ηὕρισκον χορτάσματα οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν.

text_en: But when Jacob had heard that there was corn in Egypt , he sent our fathers first.
text_la: Cum audisset autem Jacob esse frumentum in Ægypto, misit patres nostros primum:
text_pt: Mas tendo ouvido Jacó que no Egito havia trigo, enviou ali nossos pais, a primeira vez.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ Ἰακὼβ ὄντα σιτία εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἐξαπέστειλεν τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν πρῶτον:

text_en: And at the second time, Joseph was known by his brethren: and his kindred was made known to Pharao .
text_la: et in secundo cognitus est Joseph a fratribus suis, et manifestatum est Pharaoni genus ejus.
text_pt: E na segunda vez foi José conhecido por seus irmãos, e a sua linhagem foi manifesta a Faraó.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ δευτέρῳ ἐγνωρίσθη Ἰωσὴφ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ, καὶ φανερὸν ἐγένετο τῷ Φαραὼ τὸ γένος Ἰωσήφ.

text_en: And Joseph sending, called thither Jacob , his father, and all his kindred, seventy-five souls .
text_la: Mittens autem Joseph, accersivit Jacob patrem suum et omnem cognationem suam, in animabus septuaginta quinque.
text_pt: E José mandou chamar a seu pai Jacó, e a toda a sua parentela, que era de setenta e cinco almas.
text_el: ἀποστείλας δὲ Ἰωσὴφ μετεκαλέσατο Ἰακὼβ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν συγγένειαν ἐν ψυχαῖς ἑβδομήκοντα πέντε,

text_en: So Jacob went down into Egypt . And he died, and our fathers.
text_la: Et descendit Jacob in Ægyptum : et defunctus est ipse, et patres nostri.
text_pt: E Jacó desceu ao Egito, e morreu, ele e nossos pais;
text_el: κατέβη δὲ Ἰακὼβ [εἰς Αἴγυπτον]. καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν,

text_en: And they were translated into Sichem and were laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Hemor, the son of Sichem .
text_la: Et translati sunt in Sichem, et positi sunt in sepulchro, quod emit Abraham pretio argenti a filiis Hemor filii Sichem.
text_pt: E foram transportados para Siquém, e depositados na sepultura que Abraão comprara por certa soma de dinheiro aos filhos de Emor, pai de Siquém.
text_el: καὶ μετετέθησαν εἰς Συχὲμ καὶ ἐτέθησαν ἐν τῷ μνήματι ᾧ ὠνήσατο Ἀβραὰμ τιμῆς ἀργυρίου παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ἑμμὼρ ἐν Συχέμ.

text_en: And when the time of the promise drew near, which God had promised to Abraham , the people increased and were multiplied in Egypt .
text_la: Cum autem appropinquaret tempus promissionis quam confessus erat Deus Abrahæ, crevit populus, et multiplicatus est in Ægypto,
text_pt: Aproximando-se, porém, o tempo da promessa que Deus tinha feito a Abraão, o povo cresceu e se multiplicou no Egito;
text_el: καθὼς δὲ ἤγγιζεν ὁ χρόνος τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἧς ὡμολόγησεν ὁ θεὸς τῷ Ἀβραάμ, ηὔξησεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ ἐπληθύνθη ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ,

text_en: Till another king arose in Egypt , who knew not Joseph .
text_la: quoadusque surrexit alius rex in Ægypto, qui non sciebat Joseph.
text_pt: Até que se levantou outro rei, que não conhecia a José.
text_el: ἄχρι οὗ ἀνέστη βασιλεὺς ἕτερος ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον ὃς οὐκ ᾔδει τὸν Ἰωσήφ.

text_en: This same, dealing craftily with our race, afflicted our fathers, that they should expose their children, to the end they might not be kept alive.
text_la: Hic circumveniens genus nostrum, afflixit patres nostros ut exponerent infantes suos, ne vivificarentur.
text_pt: Esse, usando de astúcia contra a nossa linhagem, maltratou nossos pais, ao ponto de os fazer enjeitar as suas crianças, para que não se multiplicassem.
text_el: οὗτος κατασοφισάμενος τὸ γένος ἡμῶν ἐκάκωσεν τοὺς πατέρας τοῦ ποιεῖν τὰ βρέφη ἔκθετα αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ μὴ ζῳογονεῖσθαι.

text_en: At the same time was Moses born: and he was acceptable to God . Who was nourished three months in his father's house.
text_la: Eodem tempore natus est Moyses, et fuit gratus Deo : qui nutritus est tribus mensibus in domo patris sui.
text_pt: Nesse tempo nasceu Moisés, e era mui formoso, e foi criado três meses em casa de seu pai.
text_el: ἐν ᾧ καιρῷ ἐγεννήθη Μωϋσῆς, καὶ ἦν ἀστεῖος τῷ θεῷ: ὃς ἀνετράφη μῆνας τρεῖς ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρός:

text_en: And when he was exposed, Pharao's daughter took him up and nourished him for her own son.
text_la: Exposito autem illo, sustulit eum filia Pharaonis, et nutrivit eum sibi in filium.
text_pt: E, sendo enjeitado, tomou-o a filha de Faraó, e o criou como seu filho.
text_el: ἐκτεθέντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀνείλατο αὐτὸν ἡ θυγάτηρ Φαραὼ καὶ ἀνεθρέψατο αὐτὸν ἑαυτῇ εἰς υἱόν.

text_en: And Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians : and he was mighty in his words and in his deeds .
text_la: Et eruditus est Moyses omni sapientia Ægyptiorum, et erat potens in verbis et in operibus suis.
text_pt: E Moisés foi instruído em toda a ciência dos egípcios; e era poderoso em suas palavras e obras.
text_el: καὶ ἐπαιδεύθη Μωϋσῆς πάσῃ σοφίᾳ Αἰγυπτίων, ἦν δὲ δυνατὸς ἐν λόγοις καὶ ἔργοις αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren, the children of Israel .
text_la: Cum autem impleretur ei quadraginta annorum tempus, ascendit in cor ejus ut visitaret fratres suos filios Israël.
text_pt: E, quando completou a idade de quarenta anos, veio-lhe ao coração ir visitar seus irmãos, os filhos de Israel.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐπληροῦτο αὐτῷ τεσσερακονταετὴς χρόνος, ἀνέβη ἐπὶ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ ἐπισκέψασθαι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: And when he had seen one of them suffer wrong, he defended him: and striking the Egyptian , he avenged him who suffered the injury.
text_la: Et cum vidisset quemdam injuriam patientem, vindicavit illum, et fecit ultionem ei qui injuriam sustinebat, percusso Ægyptio.
text_pt: E, vendo maltratado um deles, o defendeu, e vingou o ofendido, matando o egípcio.
text_el: καὶ ἰδών τινα ἀδικούμενον ἠμύνατο καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐκδίκησιν τῷ καταπονουμένῳ πατάξας τὸν Αἰγύπτιον.

text_en: And he thought that his brethren understood that God by his hand would save them. But they understood it not.
text_la: Existimabat autem intelligere fratres, quoniam Deus per manum ipsius daret salutem illis : at illi non intellexerunt.
text_pt: E ele cuidava que seus irmãos entenderiam que Deus lhes havia de dar a liberdade pela sua mão; mas eles não entenderam.
text_el: ἐνόμιζεν δὲ συνιέναι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὅτι ὁ θεὸς διὰ χειρὸς αὐτοῦ δίδωσιν σωτηρίαν αὐτοῖς, οἱ δὲ οὐ συνῆκαν.

text_en: And the day following, he showed himself to them when they were at strife and would have reconciled them in peace, saying: Men, you are brethren. Why hurt you one another?
text_la: Sequenti vero die apparuit illis litigantibus : et reconciliabat eos in pace, dicens : Viri, fratres estis : ut quid nocetis alterutrum?
text_pt: E no dia seguinte, pelejando eles, foi por eles visto, e quis levá-los à paz, dizendo: Homens, sois irmãos; por que vos agravais um ao outro?
text_el: τῇ τε ἐπιούσῃ ἡμέρᾳ ὤφθη αὐτοῖς μαχομένοις καὶ συνήλλασσεν αὐτοὺς εἰς εἰρήνην εἰπών, ἄνδρες, ἀδελφοί ἐστε: ἱνατί ἀδικεῖτε ἀλλήλους;

text_en: But he that did the injury to his neighbour thrust him away, saying: Who has appointed you prince and judge over us:
text_la: Qui autem injuriam faciebat proximo, repulit eum, dicens : Quis te constituit principem et judicem super nos?
text_pt: E o que ofendia o seu próximo o repeliu, dizendo: Quem te constituiu príncipe e juiz sobre nós?
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀδικῶν τὸν πλησίον ἀπώσατο αὐτὸν εἰπών, τίς σε κατέστησεν ἄρχοντα καὶ δικαστὴν ἐφ' ἡμῶν;

text_en: What! Will you kill me, as you yesterday killed the Egyptian ?
text_la: Numquid interficere me tu vis, quemadmodum interfecisti heri Ægyptium?
text_pt: Queres tu matar-me, como ontem mataste o egípcio?
text_el: μὴ ἀνελεῖν με σὺ θέλεις ὃν τρόπον ἀνεῖλες ἐχθὲς τὸν Αἰγύπτιον;

text_en: And Moses fled upon this word: and was a stranger in the land of Madian , where he begot two sons.
text_la: Fugit autem Moyses in verbo isto : et factus est advena in terra Madian, ubi generavit filios duos.
text_pt: E a esta palavra fugiu Moisés, e esteve como estrangeiro na terra de Midiã, onde gerou dois filhos.
text_el: ἔφυγεν δὲ Μωϋσῆς ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τούτῳ, καὶ ἐγένετο πάροικος ἐν γῇ Μαδιάμ, οὗ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς δύο.

text_en: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him, in the desert of mount Sina , an angel in a flame of fire in a bush.
text_la: Et expletis annis quadraginta, apparuit illi in deserto montis Sina angelus in igne flammæ rubi.
text_pt: E, completados quarenta anos, apareceu-lhe o anjo do Senhor no deserto do monte Sinai, numa chama de fogo no meio de uma sarça.
text_el: Καὶ πληρωθέντων ἐτῶν τεσσεράκοντα ὤφθη αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τοῦ ὄρους Σινᾶ ἄγγελος ἐν φλογὶ πυρὸς βάτου.

text_en: And Moses seeing it wondered at the sight. And as he drew near to view it, the voice of the Lord came unto him, saying:
text_la: Moyses autem videns, admiratus est visum. Et accedente illo ut consideraret, facta est ad eum vox Domini, dicens:
text_pt: Então Moisés, quando viu isto, se maravilhou da visão; e, aproximando-se para observar, foi-lhe dirigida a voz do Senhor,
text_el: ὁ δὲ Μωϋσῆς ἰδὼν ἐθαύμασεν τὸ ὅραμα: προσερχομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ κατανοῆσαι ἐγένετο φωνὴ κυρίου,

text_en: I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob . And Moses being terrified dared not behold.
text_la: Ego sum Deus patrum tuorum, Deus Abraham, Deus Isaac, et Deus Jacob. Tremefactus autem Moyses, non audebat considerare.
text_pt: Dizendo: Eu sou o Deus de teus pais, o Deus de Abraão, e o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó. E Moisés, todo trêmulo, não ousava olhar.
text_el: ἐγὼ ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων σου, ὁ θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακώβ. ἔντρομος δὲ γενόμενος Μωϋσῆς οὐκ ἐτόλμα κατανοῆσαι.

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Loose the shoes from your feet: for the place wherein you stand is holy ground.
text_la: Dixit autem illi Dominus : Solve calceamentum pedum tuorum : locus enim in quo stas, terra sancta est.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o Senhor: Tira as alparcas dos teus pés, porque o lugar em que estás é terra santa.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος, λῦσον τὸ ὑπόδημα τῶν ποδῶν σου, ὁ γὰρ τόπος ἐφ' ᾧ ἕστηκας γῆ ἁγία ἐστίν.

text_en: Seeing, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt : and I have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them. And now come: and I will send you into Egypt .
text_la: Videns vidi afflictionem populi mei qui est in Ægypto, et gemitum eorum audivi, et descendi liberare eos. Et nunc veni, et mittam te in Ægyptum.
text_pt: Tenho visto atentamente a aflição do meu povo que está no Egito, e ouvi os seus gemidos, e desci a livrá-los. Agora, pois, vem, e enviar-te-ei ao Egito.
text_el: ἰδὼν εἶδον τὴν κάκωσιν τοῦ λαοῦ μου τοῦ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ, καὶ τοῦ στεναγμοῦ αὐτοῦ ἤκουσα, καὶ κατέβην ἐξελέσθαι αὐτούς: καὶ νῦν δεῦρο ἀποστείλω σε εἰς Αἴγυπτον.

text_en: This Moses , whom they refused, saying: Who has appointed you prince and judge? Him God sent to be prince and redeemer, by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the burning bush.
text_la: Hunc Moysen, quem negaverunt, dicentes : Quis te constituit principem et judicem? hunc Deus principem et redemptorem misit, cum manu angeli qui apparuit illi in rubo.
text_pt: A este Moisés, ao qual haviam negado, dizendo: Quem te constituiu príncipe e juiz? a este enviou Deus como príncipe e libertador, pela mão do anjo que lhe aparecera na sarça.
text_el: Τοῦτον τὸν Μωϋσῆν, ὃν ἠρνήσαντο εἰπόντες, τίς σε κατέστησεν ἄρχοντα καὶ δικαστήν; τοῦτον ὁ θεὸς καὶ ἄρχοντα καὶ λυτρωτὴν ἀπέσταλκεν σὺν χειρὶ ἀγγέλου τοῦ ὀφθέντος αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ βάτῳ.

text_en: He brought them out, doing wonders and signs in the land of Egypt and in the Red Sea and in the desert , forty years.
text_la: Hic eduxit illos faciens prodigia et signa in terra Ægypti, et in rubro mari, et in deserto annis quadraginta.
text_pt: Foi este que os conduziu para fora, fazendo prodígios e sinais na terra do Egito, e no Mar Vermelho, e no deserto, por quarenta anos.
text_el: οὗτος ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ποιήσας τέρατα καὶ σημεῖα ἐν τῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἐν Ἐρυθρᾷ Θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἔτη τεσσεράκοντα.

text_en: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel : A prophet shall God raise up to you of your own brethren, as myself. Him shall you hear.
text_la: Hic est Moyses, qui dixit filiis Israël : Prophetam suscitabit vobis Deus de fratribus vestris, tamquam me : ipsum audietis.
text_pt: Este é aquele Moisés que disse aos filhos de Israel: O Senhor vosso Deus vos levantará dentre vossos irmãos um profeta como eu; a ele ouvireis.
text_el: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Μωϋσῆς ὁ εἴπας τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ, προφήτην ὑμῖν ἀναστήσει ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν ὡς ἐμέ.

text_en: This is he that was in the church in the wilderness , with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sina and with our fathers. Who received the words of life to give unto us.
text_la: Hic est qui fuit in ecclesia in solitudine cum angelo, qui loquebatur ei in monte Sina, et cum patribus nostris : qui accepit verba vitæ dare nobis.
text_pt: Este é o que esteve entre a congregação no deserto, com o anjo que lhe falava no monte Sinai, e com nossos pais, o qual recebeu as palavras de vida para no-las dar.
text_el: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ γενόμενος ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ μετὰ τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ λαλοῦντος αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σινᾶ καὶ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν, ὃς ἐδέξατο λόγια ζῶντα δοῦναι ὑμῖν,

text_en: Whom our fathers would not obey : but thrust him away and in their hearts turned back into Egypt ,
text_la: Cui noluerunt obedire patres nostri : sed repulerunt, et aversi sunt cordibus suis in Ægyptum,
text_pt: Ao qual nossos pais não quiseram obedecer, antes o rejeitaram e em seu coração se tornaram ao Egito,
text_el: ᾧ οὐκ ἠθέλησαν ὑπήκοοι γενέσθαι οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἀλλὰ ἀπώσαντο καὶ ἐστράφησαν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν εἰς Αἴγυπτον,

text_en: saying to Aaron : Make us gods to go before us. For as for this Moses , who brought us out of the land of Egypt , we know not what has become of him.
text_la: dicentes ad Aaron : Fac nobis deos qui præcedant nos : Moyses enim hic, qui eduxit nos de terra Ægypti, nescimus quid factum sit ei.
text_pt: Dizendo a Arão: Faze-nos deuses que vão adiante de nós; porque a esse Moisés, que nos tirou da terra do Egito, não sabemos o que lhe aconteceu.
text_el: εἰπόντες τῷ Ἀαρών: ποίησον ἡμῖν θεοὺς οἳ προπορεύσονται ἡμῶν: ὁ γὰρ Μωϋσῆς οὗτος, ὃς ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί ἐγένετο αὐτῷ.

text_en: And they made a calf in those days and offered sacrifices to the idol and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
text_la: Et vitulum fecerunt in diebus illis, et obtulerunt hostiam simulacro, et lætabantur in operibus manuum suarum.
text_pt: E naqueles dias fizeram o bezerro, e ofereceram sacrifícios ao ídolo, e se alegraram nas obras das suas mãos.
text_el: καὶ ἐμοσχοποίησαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις καὶ ἀνήγαγον θυσίαν τῷ εἰδώλῳ, καὶ εὐφραίνοντο ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν.

text_en: And God turned and gave them up to serve the host of heaven , as it is written in the books of the prophets : Did you offer victims and sacrifices to me for forty years, in the desert , O house of Israel ?
text_la: Convertit autem Deus, et tradidit eos servire militiæ cæli, sicut scriptum est in libro prophetarum : Numquid victimas et hostias obtulistis mihi annis quadraginta in deserto, domus Israël?
text_pt: Mas Deus se afastou, e os abandonou a que servissem ao exército do céu, como está escrito no livro dos profetas: Porventura me oferecestes vítimas e sacrifícios No deserto por quarenta anos, ó casa de Israel?
text_el: ἔστρεψεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς λατρεύειν τῇ στρατιᾷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν βίβλῳ τῶν προφητῶν, μὴ σφάγια καὶ θυσίας προσηνέγκατέ μοι ἔτη τεσσεράκοντα ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, οἶκος Ἰσραήλ;

text_en: And you took unto you the tabernacle of Moloch and the star of your god Rempham, figures which you made to adore them. And I will carry you away beyond Babylon .
text_la: Et suscepistis tabernaculum Moloch, et sidus dei vestri Rempham, figuras quas fecistis adorare eas : et transferam vos trans Babylonem.
text_pt: Antes tomastes o tabernáculo de Moloque,E a estrela do vosso deus Renfã, figuras que vós fizestes para as adorar.Transportar-vos-ei, pois, para além da Babilônia.
text_el: καὶ ἀνελάβετε τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ Μολὸχ καὶ τὸ ἄστρον τοῦ θεοῦ Ῥομφά, τοὺς τύπους οὓς ἐποιήσατε προσκυνεῖν αὐτοῖς; καὶ μετοικιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐπέκεινα Βαβυλῶνος.

text_en: The tabernacle of the testimony was with our fathers in the desert , as God ordained for them, speaking to Moses , that he should make it according to the form which he had seen.
text_la: Tabernaculum testimonii fuit cum patribus nostris in deserto, sicut disposuit illis Deus loquens ad Moysen, ut faceret illud secundum formam quam viderat.
text_pt: Estava entre nossos pais no deserto o tabernáculo do testemunho, como ordenara aquele que disse a Moisés que o fizesse segundo o modelo que tinha visto.
text_el: Ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἦν τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καθὼς διετάξατο ὁ λαλῶν τῷ Μωϋσῇ ποιῆσαι αὐτὴν κατὰ τὸν τύπον ὃν ἑωράκει,

text_en: Which also our fathers receiving, brought in with Jesus , into the possession of the Gentiles : whom God drove out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David ,
text_la: Quod et induxerunt, suscipientes patres nostri cum Jesu in possessionem gentium quas expulit Deus a facie patrum nostrorum, usque in diebus David,
text_pt: O qual, nossos pais, recebendo-o também, o levaram com Josué quando entraram na posse das nações que Deus lançou para fora da presença de nossos pais, até aos dias de Davi,
text_el: ἣν καὶ εἰσήγαγον διαδεξάμενοι οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν μετὰ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῇ κατασχέσει τῶν ἐθνῶν ὧν ἐξῶσεν ὁ θεὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἕως τῶν ἡμερῶν Δαυίδ,

text_en: who found grace before God and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob .
text_la: qui invenit gratiam ante Deum, et petiit ut inveniret tabernaculum Deo Jacob.
text_pt: Que achou graça diante de Deus, e pediu que pudesse achar tabernáculo para o Deus de Jacó.
text_el: ὃς εὗρεν χάριν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ᾐτήσατο εὑρεῖν σκήνωμα τῷ θεῷ Ἰακώβ.

text_en: But Solomon built him a house ,
text_la: Salomon autem ædificavit illi domum.
text_pt: E Salomão lhe edificou casa;
text_el: Σολομῶν δὲ οἰκοδόμησεν αὐτῷ οἶκον.

text_en: yet the most High dwells not in houses made by hands, as the prophet says:
text_la: Sed non Excelsus in manufactis habitat, sicut propheta dicit:
text_pt: Mas o Altíssimo não habita em templos feitos por mãos de homens, como diz o profeta:
text_el: ἀλλ' οὐχ ὁ ὕψιστος ἐν χειροποιήτοις κατοικεῖ: καθὼς ὁ προφήτης λέγει,

text_en: Heaven is my throne and the earth my footstool. What house will you build me (says the Lord )? Or what is the place of my resting?
text_la: Cælum mihi sedes est : terra autem scabellum pedum meorum. Quam domum ædificabitis mihi? dicit Dominus : aut quis locus requietionis meæ est?
text_pt: O céu é o meu trono,e a terra o estrado dos meus pés.Que casa me edificareis? diz o Senhor,Ou qual é o lugar do meu repouso?
text_el: ὁ οὐρανός μοι θρόνος, καὶ ἡ γῆ ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν μου: ποῖον οἶκον οἰκοδομήσετέ μοι, λέγει κύριος, ἢ τίς τόπος τῆς καταπαύσεώς μου;

text_en: Hath not my hand made all these things?
text_la: Nonne manus mea fecit hæc omnia?
text_pt: Porventura não fez a minha mão todas estas coisas?
text_el: οὐχὶ ἡ χείρ μου ἐποίησεν ταῦτα πάντα;

text_en: You stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Ghost . As your fathers did, so do you also.
text_la: Dura cervice, et incircumcisis cordibus et auribus, vos semper Spiritui Sancto resistitis : sicut patres vestri, ita et vos.
text_pt: Homens de dura cerviz, e incircuncisos de coração e ouvido, vós sempre resistis ao Espírito Santo; assim vós sois como vossos pais.
text_el: Σκληροτράχηλοι καὶ ἀπερίτμητοι καρδίαις καὶ τοῖς ὠσίν, ὑμεῖς ἀεὶ τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἁγίῳ ἀντιπίπτετε, ὡς οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν καὶ ὑμεῖς.

text_en: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted ? And they have slain them who foretold of the coming of the Just One : of whom you have been now the betrayers and murderers .
text_la: Quem prophetarum non sunt persecuti patres vestri? et occiderunt eos qui prænuntiabant de adventu Justi, cujus vos nunc proditores et homicidæ fuistis:
text_pt: A qual dos profetas não perseguiram vossos pais? Até mataram os que anteriormente anunciaram a vinda do Justo, do qual vós agora fostes traidores e homicidas;
text_el: τίνα τῶν προφητῶν οὐκ ἐδίωξαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν; καὶ ἀπέκτειναν τοὺς προκαταγγείλαντας περὶ τῆς ἐλεύσεως τοῦ δικαίου οὗ νῦν ὑμεῖς προδόται καὶ φονεῖς ἐγένεσθε,

text_en: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels and have not kept it.
text_la: qui accepistis legem in dispositione angelorum, et non custodistis.
text_pt: Vós, que recebestes a lei por ordenação dos anjos, e não a guardastes.
text_el: οἵτινες ἐλάβετε τὸν νόμον εἰς διαταγὰς ἀγγέλων, καὶ οὐκ ἐφυλάξατε.

text_en: Now hearing these things, they were cut to the heart: and they gnashed with their teeth at him.
text_la: Audientes autem hæc, dissecabantur cordibus suis, et stridebant dentibus in eum.
text_pt: E, ouvindo eles isto, enfureciam-se em seus corações, e rangiam os dentes contra ele.
text_el: Ἀκούοντες δὲ ταῦτα διεπρίοντο ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν καὶ ἔβρυχον τοὺς ὀδόντας ἐπ' αὐτόν.

text_en: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost , looking up steadfastly to heaven , saw the glory of God and Jesus standing on the right hand of God .
text_la: Cum autem esset plenus Spiritu Sancto, intendens in cælum, vidit gloriam Dei, et Jesum stantem a dextris Dei.
text_pt: Mas ele, estando cheio do Espírito Santo, fixando os olhos no céu, viu a glória de Deus, e Jesus, que estava à direita de Deus;
text_el: ὑπάρχων δὲ πλήρης πνεύματος ἁγίου ἀτενίσας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶδεν δόξαν θεοῦ καὶ Ἰησοῦν ἑστῶτα ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: And he said: Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God .
text_la: Et ait : Ecce video cælos apertos, et Filium hominis stantem a dextris Dei.
text_pt: E disse: Eis que vejo os céus abertos, e o Filho do homem, que está em pé à mão direita de Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ θεωρῶ τοὺς οὐρανοὺς διηνοιγμένους καὶ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ δεξιῶν ἑστῶτα τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And they, crying out with a loud voice, stopped their ears and with one accord ran violently upon him.
text_la: Exclamantes autem voce magna continuerunt aures suas, et impetum fecerunt unanimiter in eum.
text_pt: Mas eles gritaram com grande voz, taparam os seus ouvidos, e arremeteram unânimes contra ele.
text_el: κράξαντες δὲ φωνῇ μεγάλῃ συνέσχον τὰ ὦτα αὐτῶν, καὶ ὥρμησαν ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐπ' αὐτόν,

text_en: And casting him forth without the city, they stoned him. And the witnesses laid down their garments at the feet of a young man, whose name was Saul .
text_la: Et ejicientes eum extra civitatem, lapidabant : et testes deposuerunt vestimenta sua secus pedes adolescentis qui vocabatur Saulus.
text_pt: E, expulsando-o da cidade, o apedrejavam. E as testemunhas depuseram as suas capas aos pés de um jovem chamado Saulo.
text_el: καὶ ἐκβαλόντες ἔξω τῆς πόλεως ἐλιθοβόλουν. καὶ οἱ μάρτυρες ἀπέθεντο τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας νεανίου καλουμένου Σαύλου.

text_en: And they stoned Stephen , invoking and saying: Lord Jesus , receive my spirit .
text_la: Et lapidabant Stephanum invocantem, et dicentem : Domine Jesu, suscipe spiritum meum.
text_pt: E apedrejaram a Estêvão que em invocação dizia: Senhor Jesus, recebe o meu espírito.
text_el: καὶ ἐλιθοβόλουν τὸν Στέφανον ἐπικαλούμενον καὶ λέγοντα, κύριε Ἰησοῦ, δέξαι τὸ πνεῦμά μου.

text_en: And falling on his knees , he cried with a loud voice, saying: Lord, lay not this sin to their charge: And when he had said this, he fell asleep in the Lord . And Saul was consenting to his death.
text_la: Positis autem genibus, clamavit voce magna, dicens : Domine, ne statuas illis hoc peccatum. Et cum hoc dixisset, obdormivit in Domino. Saulus autem erat consentiens neci ejus.
text_pt: E, pondo-se de joelhos, clamou com grande voz: Senhor, não lhes imputes este pecado. E, tendo dito isto, adormeceu.
text_el: θεὶς δὲ τὰ γόνατα ἔκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ: κύριε, μὴ στήσῃς αὐτοῖς ταύτην τὴν ἁμαρτίαν. καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἐκοιμήθη.

text_en: And at that time, there was raised a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem . And they were all dispersed through the countries of Judea , and Samaria , except the apostles .
text_la: Facta est autem in illa die persecutio magna in ecclesia quæ erat Jerosolymis, et omnes dispersi sunt per regiones Judææ et Samariæ præter Apostolos.
text_pt: E também Saulo consentiu na morte dele. E fez-se naquele dia uma grande perseguição contra a igreja que estava em Jerusalém; e todos foram dispersos pelas terras da Judéia e de Samaria, exceto os apóstolos.
text_el: Σαῦλος δὲ ἦν συνευδοκῶν τῇ ἀναιρέσει αὐτοῦ. Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ διωγμὸς μέγας ἐπὶ τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τὴν ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις: πάντες [δὲ] διεσπάρησαν κατὰ τὰς χώρας τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ Σαμαρείας πλὴν τῶν ἀποστόλων.

text_en: And devout men took order for Stephen's funeral and made great mourning over him.
text_la: Curaverunt autem Stephanum viri timorati, et fecerunt planctum magnum super eum.
text_pt: E uns homens piedosos foram enterrar Estêvão, e fizeram sobre ele grande pranto.
text_el: συνεκόμισαν δὲ τὸν Στέφανον ἄνδρες εὐλαβεῖς καὶ ἐποίησαν κοπετὸν μέγαν ἐπ' αὐτῷ.

text_en: But Saul made havock of the church , entering in from house to house: and dragging away men and women , committed them to prison .
text_la: Saulus autem devastabat ecclesiam per domos intrans, et trahens viros ac mulieres, tradebat in custodiam.
text_pt: E Saulo assolava a igreja, entrando pelas casas; e, arrastando homens e mulheres, os encerrava na prisão.
text_el: Σαῦλος δὲ ἐλυμαίνετο τὴν ἐκκλησίαν κατὰ τοὺς οἴκους εἰσπορευόμενος, σύρων τε ἄνδρας καὶ γυναῖκας παρεδίδου εἰς φυλακήν.

text_en: They therefore that were dispersed went about preaching the word of God .
text_la: Igitur qui dispersi erant pertransibant, evangelizantes verbum Dei.
text_pt: Mas os que andavam dispersos iam por toda a parte, anunciando a palavra.
text_el: Οἱ μὲν οὖν διασπαρέντες διῆλθον εὐαγγελιζόμενοι τὸν λόγον.

text_en: And Philip , going down to the city of Samaria , preached Christ unto them.
text_la: Philippus autem descendens in civitatem Samariæ, prædicabant illis Christum.
text_pt: E, descendo Filipe à cidade de Samaria lhes pregava a Cristo.
text_el: Φίλιππος δὲ κατελθὼν εἰς τὴν πόλιν τῆς Σαμαρείας ἐκήρυσσεν αὐτοῖς τὸν Χριστόν.

text_en: And the people with one accord were attentive to those things which were said by Philip , hearing, and seeing the miracles which he did.
text_la: Intendebant autem turbæ his quæ a Philippo dicebantur, unanimiter audientes, et videntes signa quæ faciebat.
text_pt: E as multidões unanimemente prestavam atenção ao que Filipe dizia, porque ouviam e viam os sinais que ele fazia;
text_el: προσεῖχον δὲ οἱ ὄχλοι τοῖς λεγομένοις ὑπὸ τοῦ Φιλίππου ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐν τῷ ἀκούειν αὐτοὺς καὶ βλέπειν τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει:

text_en: For many of them who had unclean spirits , crying with a loud voice, went out.
text_la: Multi enim eorum qui habebant spiritus immundos, clamantes voce magna exibant. Multi autem paralytici et claudi curati sunt.
text_pt: Pois que os espíritos imundos saíam de muitos que os tinham, clamando em alta voz; e muitos paralíticos e coxos eram curados.
text_el: πολλοὶ γὰρ τῶν ἐχόντων πνεύματα ἀκάθαρτα βοῶντα φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἐξήρχοντο, πολλοὶ δὲ παραλελυμένοι καὶ χωλοὶ ἐθεραπεύθησαν:

text_en: And many, taken with the palsy, and that were lame, were healed.
text_la: Factum est ergo gaudium magnum in illa civitate.
text_pt: E havia grande alegria naquela cidade.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ πολλὴ χαρὰ ἐν τῇ πόλει ἐκείνῃ.

text_en: There was therefore great joy in that city. Now there was a certain man named Simon who before had been a magician in that city, seducing the people of Samaria , giving out that he was some great one:
text_la: Vir autem quidam nomine Simon, qui ante fuerat in civitate magus, seducens gentem Samariæ, dicens se esse aliquem magnum:
text_pt: E estava ali um certo homem, chamado Simão, que anteriormente exercera naquela cidade a arte mágica, e tinha iludido o povo de Samaria, dizendo que era uma grande personagem;
text_el: Ἀνὴρ δέ τις ὀνόματι Σίμων προϋπῆρχεν ἐν τῇ πόλει μαγεύων καὶ ἐξιστάνων τὸ ἔθνος τῆς Σαμαρείας, λέγων εἶναί τινα ἑαυτὸν μέγαν,

text_en: To whom they all gave ear, from the least to the greatest, saying: This man is the power of God , which is called great.
text_la: cui auscultabant omnes a minimo usque ad maximum, dicentes : Hic est virtus Dei, quæ vocatur magna.
text_pt: Ao qual todos atendiam, desde o menor até ao maior, dizendo: Este é a grande virtude de Deus.
text_el: ᾧ προσεῖχον πάντες ἀπὸ μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου λέγοντες, οὗτός ἐστιν ἡ δύναμις τοῦ θεοῦ ἡ καλουμένη μεγάλη.

text_en: And they were attentive to him, because, for a long time, he had bewitched them with his magical practices.
text_la: Attendebant autem eum: propter quod multo tempore magiis suis dementasset eos.
text_pt: E atendiam-no, porque já desde muito tempo os havia iludido com artes mágicas.
text_el: προσεῖχον δὲ αὐτῷ διὰ τὸ ἱκανῷ χρόνῳ ταῖς μαγείαις ἐξεστακέναι αὐτούς.

text_en: But when they had believed Philip preaching of the kingdom of God , in the name of Jesus Christ , they were baptized , both men and women .
text_la: Cum vero credidissent Philippo evangelizanti de regno Dei, in nomine Jesu Christi baptizabantur viri ac mulieres.
text_pt: Mas, como cressem em Filipe, que lhes pregava acerca do reino de Deus, e do nome de Jesus Cristo, se batizavam, tanto homens como mulheres.
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ἐπίστευσαν τῷ Φιλίππῳ εὐαγγελιζομένῳ περὶ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ ὀνόματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἐβαπτίζοντο ἄνδρες τε καὶ γυναῖκες.

text_en: Then Simon himself believed also and, being baptized , he adhered to Philip . And being astonished, wondered to see the signs and exceeding great miracles which were done.
text_la: Tunc Simon et ipse credidit : et cum baptizatus esset, adhærebat Philippo. Videns etiam signa et virtutes maximas fieri, stupens admirabatur.
text_pt: E creu até o próprio Simão; e, sendo batizado, ficou de contínuo com Filipe; e, vendo os sinais e as grandes maravilhas que se faziam, estava atônito.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Σίμων καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπίστευσεν, καὶ βαπτισθεὶς ἦν προσκαρτερῶν τῷ Φιλίππῳ, θεωρῶν τε σημεῖα καὶ δυνάμεις μεγάλας γινομένας ἐξίστατο.

text_en: Now, when the apostles , who were in Jerusalem , had heard that Samaria had received the word of God , they sent unto them Peter and John .
text_la: Cum autem audissent Apostoli qui erant Jerosolymis, quod recepisset Samaria verbum Dei, miserunt ad eos Petrum et Joannem.
text_pt: Os apóstolos, pois, que estavam em Jerusalém, ouvindo que Samaria recebera a palavra de Deus, enviaram para lá Pedro e João.
text_el: ἀκούσαντες δὲ οἱ ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἀπόστολοι ὅτι δέδεκται ἡ Σαμάρεια τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην,

text_en: Who, when they had come, prayed for them that they might receive the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Qui cum venissent, oraverunt pro ipsis ut acciperent Spiritum Sanctum:
text_pt: Os quais, tendo descido, oraram por eles para que recebessem o Espírito Santo
text_el: οἵτινες καταβάντες προσηύξαντο περὶ αὐτῶν ὅπως λάβωσιν πνεῦμα ἅγιον:

text_en: For he was not as yet come upon any of them: but they were only baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus .
text_la: nondum enim in quemquam illorum venerat, sed baptizati tantum erant in nomine Domini Jesu.
text_pt: (Porque sobre nenhum deles tinha ainda descido; mas somente eram batizados em nome do Senhor Jesus).
text_el: οὐδέπω γὰρ ἦν ἐπ' οὐδενὶ αὐτῶν ἐπιπεπτωκός, μόνον δὲ βεβαπτισμένοι ὑπῆρχον εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: Then they laid their hands upon them: and they received the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Tunc imponebant manus super illos, et accipiebant Spiritum Sanctum.
text_pt: Então lhes impuseram as mãos, e receberam o Espírito Santo.
text_el: τότε ἐπετίθεσαν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ' αὐτούς, καὶ ἐλάμβανον πνεῦμα ἅγιον.

text_en: And when Simon saw that, by the imposition of the hands of the apostles , the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money ,
text_la: Cum vidisset autem Simon quia per impositionem manus Apostolorum daretur Spiritus Sanctus, obtulit eis pecuniam,
text_pt: E Simão, vendo que pela imposição das mãos dos apóstolos era dado o Espírito Santo, lhes ofereceu dinheiro,
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Σίμων ὅτι διὰ τῆς ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν τῶν ἀποστόλων δίδοται τὸ πνεῦμα, προσήνεγκεν αὐτοῖς χρήματα

text_en: saying: Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I shall lay my hands , he may receive the Holy Ghost . But Peter said to him:
text_la: dicens : Date et mihi hanc potestatem, ut cuicumque imposuero manus, accipiat Spiritum Sanctum. Petrus autem dixit ad eum:
text_pt: Dizendo: Dai-me também a mim esse poder, para que aquele sobre quem eu puser as mãos receba o Espírito Santo.
text_el: λέγων, δότε κἀμοὶ τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην ἵνα ᾧ ἐὰν ἐπιθῶ τὰς χεῖρας λαμβάνῃ πνεῦμα ἅγιον.

text_en: Keep your money to yourself, to perish with you: because you have thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money .
text_la: Pecunia tua tecum sit in perditionem: quoniam donum Dei existimasti pecunia possideri.
text_pt: Mas disse-lhe Pedro: O teu dinheiro seja contigo para perdição, pois cuidaste que o dom de Deus se alcança por dinheiro.
text_el: Πέτρος δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν, τὸ ἀργύριόν σου σὺν σοὶ εἴη εἰς ἀπώλειαν, ὅτι τὴν δωρεὰν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐνόμισας διὰ χρημάτων κτᾶσθαι.

text_en: You have no part nor lot in this matter. For your heart is not right in the sight of God .
text_la: Non est tibi pars neque sors in sermone isto : cor enim tuum non est rectum coram Deo.
text_pt: Tu não tens parte nem sorte nesta palavra, porque o teu coração não é reto diante de Deus.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν σοι μερὶς οὐδὲ κλῆρος ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τούτῳ, ἡ γὰρ καρδία σου οὐκ ἔστιν εὐθεῖα ἔναντι τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Do penance therefore for this your wickedness : and pray to God , that perhaps this thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
text_la: Pœnitentiam itaque age ab hac nequitia tua : et roga Deum, si forte remittatur tibi hæc cogitatio cordis tui.
text_pt: Arrepende-te, pois, dessa tua iniqüidade, e ora a Deus, para que porventura te seja perdoado o pensamento do teu coração;
text_el: μετανόησον οὖν ἀπὸ τῆς κακίας σου ταύτης, καὶ δεήθητι τοῦ κυρίου εἰ ἄρα ἀφεθήσεταί σοι ἡ ἐπίνοια τῆς καρδίας σου:

text_en: For I see you are in the gall of bitterness and in the bonds of iniquity .
text_la: In felle enim amaritudinis, et obligatione iniquitatis, video te esse.
text_pt: Pois vejo que estás em fel de amargura, e em laço de iniqüidade.
text_el: εἰς γὰρ χολὴν πικρίας καὶ σύνδεσμον ἀδικίας ὁρῶ σε ὄντα.

text_en: Then Simon answering, said: Pray you for me to the Lord that none of these things which you have spoken may come upon me.
text_la: Respondens autem Simon, dixit : Precamini vos pro me ad Dominum, ut nihil veniat super me horum quæ dixistis.
text_pt: Respondendo, porém, Simão, disse: Orai vós por mim ao Senhor, para que nada do que dissestes venha sobre mim.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Σίμων εἶπεν, δεήθητε ὑμεῖς ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ πρὸς τὸν κύριον ὅπως μηδὲν ἐπέλθῃ ἐπ' ἐμὲ ὧν εἰρήκατε.

text_en: And they indeed, having testified and preached the word of the Lord , returned to Jerusalem : and preached the gospel to many countries of the Samaritans .
text_la: Et illi quidem testificati, et locuti verbum Domini, redibant Jerosolymam, et multis regionibus Samaritanorum evangelizabant.
text_pt: Tendo eles, pois, testificado e falado a palavra do Senhor, voltaram para Jerusalém e em muitas aldeias dos samaritanos anunciaram o evangelho.
text_el: Οἱ μὲν οὖν διαμαρτυράμενοι καὶ λαλήσαντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ κυρίου ὑπέστρεφον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, πολλάς τε κώμας τῶν Σαμαριτῶν εὐηγγελίζοντο.

text_en: Now an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip , saying: Arise, go towards the south, to the way that goes down from Jerusalem into Gaza : this is desert .
text_la: Angelus autem Domini locutus est ad Philippum, dicens : Surge, et vade contra meridianum, ad viam quæ descendit ab Jerusalem in Gazam : hæc est deserta.
text_pt: E o anjo do Senhor falou a Filipe, dizendo: Levanta-te, e vai para o lado do sul, ao caminho que desce de Jerusalém para Gaza, que está deserta.
text_el: Ἄγγελος δὲ κυρίου ἐλάλησεν πρὸς Φίλιππον λέγων: ἀνάστηθι καὶ πορεύου κατὰ μεσημβρίαν ἐπὶ τὴν ὁδὸν τὴν καταβαίνουσαν ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς Γάζαν: αὕτη ἐστὶν ἔρημος.

text_en: And rising up, he went. And behold, a man of Ethiopia , an eunuch, of great authority under Candace the queen of the Ethiopians , who had charge over all her treasures, had come to Jerusalem to adore .
text_la: Et surgens abiit. Et ecce vir Æthiops, eunuchus, potens Candacis reginæ Æthiopum, qui erat super omnes gazas ejus, venerat adorare in Jerusalem:
text_pt: E levantou-se, e foi; e eis que um homem etíope, eunuco, mordomo-mor de Candace, rainha dos etíopes, o qual era superintendente de todos os seus tesouros, e tinha ido a Jerusalém para adoração,
text_el: καὶ ἀναστὰς ἐπορεύθη: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ Αἰθίοψ εὐνοῦχος δυνάστης Κανδάκης βασιλίσσης Αἰθιόπων, ὃς ἦν ἐπὶ πάσης τῆς γάζης αὐτῆς, [ὃς] ἐληλύθει προσκυνήσων εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ,

text_en: And he was returning, sitting in his chariot and reading Isaiah the prophet .
text_la: et revertebatur sedens super currum suum, legensque Isaiam prophetam.
text_pt: Regressava e, assentado no seu carro, lia o profeta Isaías.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ὑποστρέφων καὶ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τοῦ ἅρματος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνεγίνωσκεν τὸν προφήτην Ἠσαΐαν.

text_en: And the Spirit said to Philip : Go near and join yourself to this chariot.
text_la: Dixit autem Spiritus Philippo : Accede, et adjunge te ad currum istum.
text_pt: E disse o Espírito a Filipe: Chega-te, e ajunta-te a esse carro.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ τὸ πνεῦμα τῷ Φιλίππῳ, πρόσελθε καὶ κολλήθητι τῷ ἅρματι τούτῳ.

text_en: And Philip running thither, heard him reading the prophet Isaias . And he said: Do you think that you understand what you read?
text_la: Accurrens autem Philippus, audivit eum legentem Isaiam prophetam, et dixit : Putasne intelligis quæ legis?
text_pt: E, correndo Filipe, ouviu que lia o profeta Isaías, e disse: Entendes tu o que lês?
text_el: προσδραμὼν δὲ ὁ Φίλιππος ἤκουσεν αὐτοῦ ἀναγινώσκοντος Ἠσαΐαν τὸν προφήτην, καὶ εἶπεν: Ἆρά γε γινώσκεις ἃ ἀναγινώσκεις;

text_en: Who said: And how can I, unless some man show me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
text_la: Qui ait : Et quomodo possum, si non aliquis ostenderit mihi? Rogavitque Philippum ut ascenderet, et sederet secum.
text_pt: E ele disse: Como poderei entender, se alguém não me ensinar? E rogou a Filipe que subisse e com ele se assentasse.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, πῶς γὰρ ἂν δυναίμην ἐὰν μή τις ὁδηγήσει με; παρεκάλεσέν τε τὸν Φίλιππον ἀναβάντα καθίσαι σὺν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And the place of the scripture which he was reading was this: He was led as a sheep to the slaughter: and like a lamb without voice before his shearer, so opens he not his mouth.
text_la: Locus autem Scripturæ quem legebat, erat hic : Tamquam ovis ad occisionem ductus est : et sicut agnus coram tondente se, sine voce, sic non aperuit os suum.
text_pt: E o lugar da Escritura que lia era este: Foi levado como a ovelha para o matadouro; e, como está mudo o cordeiro diante do que o tosquia, Assim não abriu a sua boca.
text_el: ἡ δὲ περιοχὴ τῆς γραφῆς ἣν ἀνεγίνωσκεν ἦν αὕτη: ὡς πρόβατον ἐπὶ σφαγὴν ἤχθη, καὶ ὡς ἀμνὸς ἐναντίον τοῦ κείροντος αὐτὸν ἄφωνος, οὕτως οὐκ ἀνοίγει τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ.

text_en: In humility his judgment was taken away. His generation who shall declare, for his life shall be taken from the earth?
text_la: In humilitate judicium ejus sublatum est. Generationem ejus quis enarrabit? quoniam tolletur de terra vita ejus.
text_pt: Na sua humilhação foi tirado o seu julgamento; E quem contará a sua geração? Porque a sua vida é tirada da terra.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ταπεινώσει ἡ κρίσις αὐτοῦ ἤρθη: τὴν γενεὰν αὐτοῦ τίς διηγήσεται; ὅτι αἴρεται ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἡ ζωὴ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the eunuch answering Philip , said: I beseech you, of whom does the prophet speak this? Of himself, or of some other man ?
text_la: Respondens autem eunuchus Philippo, dixit : Obsecro te, de quo propheta dicit hoc? de se, an de alio aliquo?
text_pt: E, respondendo o eunuco a Filipe, disse: Rogo-te, de quem diz isto o profeta? De si mesmo, ou de algum outro?
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ εὐνοῦχος τῷ Φιλίππῳ εἶπεν, δέομαί σου, περὶ τίνος ὁ προφήτης λέγει τοῦτο; περὶ ἑαυτοῦ ἢ περὶ ἑτέρου τινός;

text_en: Then Philip , opening his mouth and beginning at this scripture , preached unto him Jesus .
text_la: Aperiens autem Philippus os suum, et incipiens a Scriptura ista, evangelizavit illi Jesum.
text_pt: Então Filipe, abrindo a sua boca, e começando nesta Escritura, lhe anunciou a Jesus.
text_el: ἀνοίξας δὲ ὁ Φίλιππος τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῆς γραφῆς ταύτης εὐηγγελίσατο αὐτῷ τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And as they went on their way, they came to a certain water. And the eunuch said: See, here is water: What hinders me from being baptized ?
text_la: Et dum irent per viam, venerunt ad quamdam aquam : et ait eunuchus : Ecce aqua : quid prohibet me baptizari?
text_pt: E, indo eles caminhando, chegaram ao pé de alguma água, e disse o eunuco: Eis aqui água; que impede que eu seja batizado?
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐπορεύοντο κατὰ τὴν ὁδόν, ἦλθον ἐπί τι ὕδωρ, καί φησιν ὁ εὐνοῦχος: ἰδοὺ ὕδωρ: τί κωλύει με βαπτισθῆναι;

text_en: And Philip said: If you believe with all your heart, you may. And he answering, said: I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God .
text_la: Dixit autem Philippus : Si credis ex toto corde, licet. Et respondens ait : Credo Filium Dei esse Jesum Christum.
text_pt: E disse Filipe: É lícito, se crês de todo o coração. E, respondendo ele, disse: Creio que Jesus Cristo é o Filho de Deus.

text_en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still. And they went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch. And he baptized him.
text_la: Et jussit stare currum : et descenderunt uterque in aquam, Philippus et eunuchus, et baptizavit eum.
text_pt: E mandou parar o carro, e desceram ambos à água, tanto Filipe como o eunuco, e o batizou.
text_el: καὶ ἐκέλευσεν στῆναι τὸ ἅρμα, καὶ κατέβησαν ἀμφότεροι εἰς τὸ ὕδωρ ὅ τε Φίλιππος καὶ ὁ εὐνοῦχος, καὶ ἐβάπτισεν αὐτόν.

text_en: And when they had come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord took away Philip : and the eunuch saw him no more. And he went on his way rejoicing.
text_la: Cum autem ascendissent de aqua, Spiritus Domini rapuit Philippum, et amplius non vidit eum eunuchus. Ibat autem per viam suam gaudens.
text_pt: E, quando saíram da água, o Espírito do Senhor arrebatou a Filipe, e não o viu mais o eunuco; e, jubiloso, continuou o seu caminho.
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ἀνέβησαν ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος, πνεῦμα κυρίου ἥρπασεν τὸν Φίλιππον, καὶ οὐκ εἶδεν αὐτὸν οὐκέτι ὁ εὐνοῦχος: ἐπορεύετο γὰρ τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ χαίρων.

text_en: But Philip was found in Azotus : and passing through, he preached the gospel to all the cities, till he came to Caesarea .
text_la: Philippus autem inventus est in Azoto, et pertransiens evangelizabat civitatibus cunctis, donec veniret Cæsaream.
text_pt: E Filipe se achou em Azoto e, indo passando, anunciava o evangelho em todas as cidades, até que chegou a Cesaréia.
text_el: Φίλιππος δὲ εὑρέθη εἰς Ἄζωτον, καὶ διερχόμενος εὐηγγελίζετο τὰς πόλεις πάσας ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς Καισάρειαν.

text_en: And Saul , as yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord , went to the high priest
text_la: Saulus autem adhuc spirans minarum et cædis in discipulos Domini, accessit ad principem sacerdotum,
text_pt: E Saulo, respirando ainda ameaças e mortes contra os discípulos do Senhor, dirigiu-se ao sumo sacerdote.
text_el: Ὁ δὲ Σαῦλος, ἔτι ἐμπνέων ἀπειλῆς καὶ φόνου εἰς τοὺς μαθητὰς τοῦ κυρίου, προσελθὼν τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ

text_en: and asked of him letters to Damascus , to the synagogues : that if he found any men and women of this way, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem .
text_la: et petiit ab eo epistolas in Damascum ad synagogas : ut si quos invenisset hujus viæ viros ac mulieres, vinctos perduceret in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E pediu-lhe cartas para Damasco, para as sinagogas, a fim de que, se encontrasse alguns deste Caminho, quer homens quer mulheres, os conduzisse presos a Jerusalém.
text_el: ᾐτήσατο παρ' αὐτοῦ ἐπιστολὰς εἰς Δαμασκὸν πρὸς τὰς συναγωγάς, ὅπως ἐάν τινας εὕρῃ τῆς ὁδοῦ ὄντας, ἄνδρας τε καὶ γυναῖκας, δεδεμένους ἀγάγῃ εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ.

text_en: And as he went on his journey, it came to pass that he drew near to Damascus . And suddenly a light from heaven shined round about him.
text_la: Et cum iter faceret, contigit ut appropinquaret Damasco : et subito circumfulsit eum lux de cælo.
text_pt: E, indo no caminho, aconteceu que, chegando perto de Damasco, subitamente o cercou um resplendor de luz do céu.
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ πορεύεσθαι ἐγένετο αὐτὸν ἐγγίζειν τῇ Δαμασκῷ, ἐξαίφνης τε αὐτὸν περιήστραψεν φῶς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ,

text_en: And falling on the ground, he heard a voice saying to him: Saul , Saul , why do you persecute me?
text_la: Et cadens in terram audivit vocem dicentem sibi : Saule, Saule, quid me persequeris?
text_pt: E, caindo em terra, ouviu uma voz que lhe dizia: Saulo, Saulo, por que me persegues?
text_el: καὶ πεσὼν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἤκουσεν φωνὴν λέγουσαν αὐτῷ, Σαοὺλ Σαούλ, τί με διώκεις;

text_en: Who said: Who are you, Lord? And he: I am Jesus whom you persecute . It is hard for you to kick against the goad.
text_la: Qui dixit : Quis es, domine? Et ille : Ego sum Jesus, quem tu persequeris : durum est tibi contra stimulum calcitrare.
text_pt: E ele disse: Quem és, Senhor? E disse o Senhor: Eu sou Jesus, a quem tu persegues. Duro é para ti recalcitrar contra os aguilhões.
text_el: εἶπεν δέ: τίς εἶ, κύριε; ὁ δέ: ἐγώ εἰμι Ἰησοῦς ὃν σὺ διώκεις:

text_en: And he, trembling and astonished, said: Lord, what will you have me to do?
text_la: Et tremens ac stupens dixit : Domine, quid me vis facere?
text_pt: E ele, tremendo e atônito, disse: Senhor, que queres que eu faça? E disse-lhe o Senhor: Levanta-te, e entra na cidade, e lá te será dito o que te convém fazer.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἀνάστηθι καὶ εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν πόλιν, καὶ λαληθήσεταί σοι ὅ τί σε δεῖ ποιεῖν.

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Arise and go into the city; and there it shall be told you what you must do. Now the men who went in company with him stood amazed, hearing indeed a voice but seeing no man .
text_la: Et Dominus ad eum : Surge, et ingredere civitatem, et ibi dicetur tibi quid te oporteat facere. Viri autem illi qui comitabantur cum eo, stabant stupefacti, audientes quidem vocem, neminem autem videntes.
text_pt: E os homens, que iam com ele, pararam espantados, ouvindo a voz, mas não vendo ninguém.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἄνδρες οἱ συνοδεύοντες αὐτῷ εἱστήκεισαν ἐνεοί, ἀκούοντες μὲν τῆς φωνῆς μηδένα δὲ θεωροῦντες.

text_en: And Saul arose from the ground: and when his eyes were opened, he saw nothing. But they, leading him by the hands, brought him to Damascus .
text_la: Surrexit autem Saulus de terra, apertisque oculis nihil videbat. Ad manus autem illum trahentes, introduxerunt Damascum.
text_pt: E Saulo levantou-se da terra, e, abrindo os olhos, não via a ninguém. E, guiando-o pela mão, o conduziram a Damasco.
text_el: ἠγέρθη δὲ Σαῦλος ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς, ἀνεῳγμένων δὲ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ οὐδὲν ἔβλεπεν: χειραγωγοῦντες δὲ αὐτὸν εἰσήγαγον εἰς Δαμασκόν.

text_en: And he was there three days without sight: and he did neither eat nor drink.
text_la: Et erat ibi tribus diebus non videns, et non manducavit, neque bibit.
text_pt: E esteve três dias sem ver, e não comeu nem bebeu.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ἡμέρας τρεῖς μὴ βλέπων, καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγεν οὐδὲ ἔπιεν.

text_en: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus , named Ananias. And the Lord said to him in a vision : Ananias, And he said: Behold I am here, Lord .
text_la: Erat autem quidam discipulus Damasci, nomine Ananias : et dixit ad illum in visu Dominus : Anania. At ille ait : Ecce ego, Domine.
text_pt: E havia em Damasco um certo discípulo chamado Ananias; e disse-lhe o Senhor em visão: Ananias! E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui, Senhor.
text_el: Ἦν δέ τις μαθητὴς ἐν Δαμασκῷ ὀνόματι Ἁνανίας, καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν ὁράματι ὁ κύριος: Ἁνανία. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ ἐγώ, κύριε.

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Arise and go into the street that is called Strait and seek in the house of Judas, one named Saul of Tarsus . For behold he prays .
text_la: Et Dominus ad eum : Surge, et vade in vicum qui vocatur Rectus : et quære in domo Judæ Saulum nomine Tarsensem : ecce enim orat.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o Senhor: Levanta-te, e vai à rua chamada Direita, e pergunta em casa de Judas por um homem de Tarso chamado Saulo; pois eis que ele está orando;
text_el: ὁ δὲ κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν, ἀνάστα πορεύθητι ἐπὶ τὴν ῥύμην τὴν καλουμένην εὐθεῖαν καὶ ζήτησον ἐν οἰκίᾳ Ἰούδα Σαῦλον ὀνόματι Ταρσέα: ἰδοὺ γὰρ προσεύχεται,

text_en: (And he saw a man named Ananias coming in and putting his hands upon him , that he might receive his sight.)
text_la: (Et vidit virum Ananiam nomine, introëuntem, et imponentem sibi manus ut visum recipiat.)
text_pt: E numa visão ele viu que entrava um homem chamado Ananias, e punha sobre ele a mão, para que tornasse a ver.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ἄνδρα [ἐν ὁράματι] Ἁνανίαν ὀνόματι εἰσελθόντα καὶ ἐπιθέντα αὐτῷ [τὰς] χεῖρας, ὅπως ἀναβλέψῃ.

text_en: But Ananias answered: Lord , I have heard by many of this man , how much evil he has done to your saints in Jerusalem .
text_la: Respondit autem Ananias : Domine, audivi a multis de viro hoc, quanta mala fecerit sanctis tuis in Jerusalem:
text_pt: E respondeu Ananias: Senhor, a muitos ouvi acerca deste homem, quantos males tem feito aos teus santos em Jerusalém;
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ Ἁνανίας: κύριε, ἤκουσα ἀπὸ πολλῶν περὶ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς τούτου, ὅσα κακὰ τοῖς ἁγίοις σου ἐποίησεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ:

text_en: And here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all that invoke your name .
text_la: et hic habet potestatem a principibus sacerdotum alligandi omnes qui invocant nomen tuum.
text_pt: E aqui tem poder dos principais dos sacerdotes para prender a todos os que invocam o teu nome.
text_el: καὶ ὧδε ἔχει ἐξουσίαν παρὰ τῶν ἀρχιερέων δῆσαι πάντας τοὺς ἐπικαλουμένους τὸ ὄνομά σου.

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Go your way: for this man is to me a vessel of election, to carry my name before the Gentiles and kings and the children of Israel .
text_la: Dixit autem ad eum Dominus : Vade, quoniam vas electionis est mihi iste, ut portet nomen meum coram gentibus, et regibus, et filiis Israël.
text_pt: Disse-lhe, porém, o Senhor: Vai, porque este é para mim um vaso escolhido, para levar o meu nome diante dos gentios, e dos reis e dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ κύριος, πορεύου, ὅτι σκεῦος ἐκλογῆς ἐστίν μοι οὗτος τοῦ βαστάσαι τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐνώπιον [τῶν] ἐθνῶν τε καὶ βασιλέων υἱῶν τε Ἰσραήλ:

text_en: For I will show him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.
text_la: Ego enim ostendam illi quanta oporteat eum pro nomine meo pati.
text_pt: E eu lhe mostrarei quanto deve padecer pelo meu nome.
text_el: ἐγὼ γὰρ ὑποδείξω αὐτῷ ὅσα δεῖ αὐτὸν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματός μου παθεῖν.

text_en: And Ananias went his way and entered into the house. And laying his hands upon him, he said: Brother Saul , the Lord Jesus has sent me, he that appeared to you in the way as you came, that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Et abiit Ananias, et introivit in domum : et imponens ei manus, dixit : Saule frater, Dominus misit me Jesus, qui apparuit tibi in via qua veniebas, ut videas, et implearis Spiritu Sancto.
text_pt: E Ananias foi, e entrou na casa e, impondo-lhe as mãos, disse: Irmão Saulo, o Senhor Jesus, que te apareceu no caminho por onde vinhas, me enviou, para que tornes a ver e sejas cheio do Espírito Santo.
text_el: Ἀπῆλθεν δὲ Ἁνανίας καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν, καὶ ἐπιθεὶς ἐπ' αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας εἶπεν: Σαοὺλ ἀδελφέ, ὁ κύριος ἀπέσταλκέν με, Ἰησοῦς ὁ ὀφθείς σοι ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ᾗ ἤρχου, ὅπως ἀναβλέψῃς καὶ πλησθῇς πνεύματος ἁγίου.

text_en: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it were scales: and he received his sight. And rising up, he was baptized .
text_la: Et confestim ceciderunt ab oculis ejus tamquam squamæ, et visum recepit : et surgens baptizatus est.
text_pt: E logo lhe caíram dos olhos como que umas escamas, e recuperou a vista; e, levantando-se, foi batizado.
text_el: καὶ εὐθέως ἀπέπεσαν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ὡς λεπίδες, ἀνέβλεψέν τε, καὶ ἀναστὰς ἐβαπτίσθη,

text_en: And when he had taken meat, he was strengthened. And he was with the disciples that were at Damascus , for some days.
text_la: Et cum accepisset cibum, confortatus est. Fuit autem cum discipulis qui erant Damasci per dies aliquot.
text_pt: E, tendo comido, ficou confortado. E esteve Saulo alguns dias com os discípulos que estavam em Damasco.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν τροφὴν ἐνισξύθη. Ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τῶν ἐν Δαμασκῷ μαθητῶν ἡμέρας τινάς,

text_en: And immediately he preached Jesus in the synagogues , that he is the son of God .
text_la: Et continuo in synagogis prædicabat Jesum, quoniam hic est Filius Dei.
text_pt: E logo nas sinagogas pregava a Cristo, que este é o Filho de Deus.
text_el: καὶ εὐθέως ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς ἐκήρυσσεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And all that heard him were astonished and said: Is not this he who persecuted in Jerusalem those that called upon this name and came hither for that intent, that he might carry them bound to the chief priests ?
text_la: Stupebant autem omnes qui audiebant, et dicebant : Nonne hic est qui expugnabat in Jerusalem eos qui invocabant nomen istud : et huc ad hoc venit, ut vinctos illos duceret ad principes sacerdotum?
text_pt: E todos os que o ouviam estavam atônitos, e diziam: Não é este o que em Jerusalém perseguia os que invocavam este nome, e para isso veio aqui, para os levar presos aos principais dos sacerdotes?
text_el: ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες οἱ ἀκούοντες καὶ ἔλεγον, οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ πορθήσας ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ τοὺς ἐπικαλουμένους τὸ ὄνομα τοῦτο, καὶ ὧδε εἰς τοῦτο ἐληλύθει ἵνα δεδεμένους αὐτοὺς ἀγάγῃ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς;

text_en: But Saul increased much more in strength and confounded the Jews who dwelt at Damascus , affirming that this is the Christ .
text_la: Saulus autem multo magis convalescebat, et confundebat Judæos qui habitabant Damasci, affirmans quoniam hic est Christus.
text_pt: Saulo, porém, se esforçava muito mais, e confundia os judeus que habitavam em Damasco, provando que aquele era o Cristo.
text_el: Σαῦλος δὲ μᾶλλον ἐνεδυναμοῦτο καὶ συνέχυννεν Ἰουδαίους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Δαμασκῷ, συμβιβάζων ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός.

text_en: And when many days were passed, the Jews consulted together to kill him.
text_la: Cum autem implerentur dies multi, consilium fecerunt in unum Judæi ut eum interficerent.
text_pt: E, tendo passado muitos dias, os judeus tomaram conselho entre si para o matar.
text_el: Ὡς δὲ ἐπληροῦντο ἡμέραι ἱκαναί, συνεβουλεύσαντο οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀνελεῖν αὐτόν:

text_en: But their lying in wait was made known to Saul . And they watched the gates also day and night, that they might kill him.
text_la: Notæ autem factæ sunt Saulo insidiæ eorum. Custodiebant autem et portas die ac nocte, ut eum interficerent.
text_pt: Mas as suas ciladas vieram ao conhecimento de Saulo; e como eles guardavam as portas, tanto de dia como de noite, para poderem tirar-lhe a vida,
text_el: ἐγνώσθη δὲ τῷ Σαύλῳ ἡ ἐπιβουλὴ αὐτῶν. παρετηροῦντο δὲ καὶ τὰς πύλας ἡμέρας τε καὶ νυκτὸς ὅπως αὐτὸν ἀνέλωσιν:
