text_en: But the disciples , taking him in the night, conveyed him away by the wall, letting him down in a basket.
text_la: Accipientes autem eum discipuli nocte, per murum dimiserunt eum, submittentes in sporta.
text_pt: Tomando-o de noite os discípulos o desceram, dentro de um cesto, pelo muro.
text_el: λαβόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς διὰ τοῦ τείχους καθῆκαν αὐτὸν χαλάσαντες ἐν σπυρίδι.

text_en: And when he had come into Jerusalem , he essayed to join himself to the disciples : and they all were afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple .
text_la: Cum autem venisset in Jerusalem, tentabat se jungere discipulis, et omnes timebant eum, non credentes quod esset discipulus.
text_pt: E, quando Saulo chegou a Jerusalém, procurava ajuntar-se aos discípulos, mas todos o temiam, não crendo que fosse discípulo.
text_el: Παραγενόμενος δὲ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐπείραζεν κολλᾶσθαι τοῖς μαθηταῖς: καὶ πάντες ἐφοβοῦντο αὐτόν, μὴ πιστεύοντες ὅτι ἐστὶν μαθητής.

text_en: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles and told them how he had seen the Lord , and that he had spoken to him: and how in Damascus he had dealt confidently in the name of Jesus .
text_la: Barnabas autem apprehensum illum duxit ad Apostolos : et narravit illis quomodo in via vidisset Dominum, et quia locutus est ei, et quomodo in Damasco fiducialiter egerit in nomine Jesu.
text_pt: Então Barnabé, tomando-o consigo, o trouxe aos apóstolos, e lhes contou como no caminho ele vira ao Senhor e lhe falara, e como em Damasco falara ousadamente no nome de Jesus.
text_el: Βαρναβᾶς δὲ ἐπιλαβόμενος αὐτὸν ἤγαγεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστόλους, καὶ διηγήσατο αὐτοῖς πῶς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ εἶδεν τὸν κύριον καὶ ὅτι ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ, καὶ πῶς ἐν Δαμασκῷ ἐπαρρησιάσατο ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: And he was with them, coming in and going out in Jerusalem and dealing confidently in the name of the Lord .
text_la: Et erat cum illis intrans et exiens in Jerusalem, et fiducialiter agens in nomine Domini.
text_pt: E andava com eles em Jerusalém, entrando e saindo,
text_el: καὶ ἦν μετ' αὐτῶν εἰσπορευόμενος καὶ ἐκπορευόμενος εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, παρρησιαζόμενος ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου,

text_en: He spoke also to the Gentiles and disputed with the Greeks. But they sought to kill him.
text_la: Loquebatur quoque gentibus, et disputabat cum Græcis : illi autem quærebant occidere eum.
text_pt: E falava ousadamente no nome do Senhor Jesus. Falava e disputava também contra os gregos, mas eles procuravam matá-lo.
text_el: ἐλάλει τε καὶ συνεζήτει πρὸς τοὺς Ἑλληνιστάς: οἱ δὲ ἐπεχείρουν ἀνελεῖν αὐτόν.

text_en: Which when the brethren had known , they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him away to Tarsus .
text_la: Quod cum cognovissent fratres, deduxerunt eum Cæsaream, et dimiserunt Tarsum.
text_pt: Sabendo-o, porém, os irmãos, o acompanharam até Cesaréia, e o enviaram a Tarso.
text_el: ἐπιγνόντες δὲ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ κατήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς Καισάρειαν καὶ ἐξαπέστειλαν αὐτὸν εἰς Ταρσόν.

text_en: Now, the church had peace throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria : and was edified, walking in the fear of the Lord : and was filled with the consolation of the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Ecclesia quidem per totam Judæam, et Galilæam, et Samariam habebat pacem, et ædificabatur ambulans in timore Domini, et consolatione Sancti Spiritus replebatur.
text_pt: Assim, pois, as igrejas em toda a Judéia, e Galiléia e Samaria tinham paz, e eram edificadas; e se multiplicavam, andando no temor do Senhor e consolação do Espírito Santo.
text_el: Ἡ μὲν οὖν ἐκκλησία καθ' ὅλης τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ Γαλιλαίας καὶ Σαμαρείας εἶχεν εἰρήνην, οἰκοδομουμένη καὶ πορευομένη τῷ φόβῳ τοῦ κυρίου, καὶ τῇ παρακλήσει τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος ἐπληθύνετο.

text_en: And it came to pass that Peter , as he passed through, visiting all, came to the saints who dwelt at Lydda .
text_la: Factum est autem, ut Petrus dum pertransiret universos, deveniret ad sanctos qui habitabant Lyddæ.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, passando Pedro por toda a parte, veio também aos santos que habitavam em Lida.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ Πέτρον διερχόμενον διὰ πάντων κατελθεῖν καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἁγίους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Λύδδα.

text_en: And he found there a certain man named Eneas, who had kept his bed for eight years, who was ill of the palsy.
text_la: Invenit autem ibi hominem quemdam, nomine Æneam, ab annis octo jacentem in grabato, qui erat paralyticus.
text_pt: E achou ali certo homem, chamado Enéias, jazendo numa cama havia oito anos, o qual era paralítico.
text_el: εὗρεν δὲ ἐκεῖ ἄνθρωπόν τινα ὀνόματι Αἰνέαν ἐξ ἐτῶν ὀκτὼ κατακείμενον ἐπὶ κραβάττου, ὃς ἦν παραλελυμένος.

text_en: And Peter said to him: Eneas, the Lord Jesus Christ heals you. Arise and make your bed. And immediately he arose.
text_la: Et ait illi Petrus : Ænea, sanat te Dominus Jesus Christus : surge, et sterne tibi. Et continuo surrexit.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Pedro: Enéias, Jesus Cristo te dá saúde; levanta-te e faze a tua cama. E logo se levantou.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος, Αἰνέα, ἰᾶταί σε Ἰησοῦς Χριστός: ἀνάστηθι καὶ στρῶσον σεαυτῷ. καὶ εὐθέως ἀνέστη.

text_en: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him: who were converted to the Lord .
text_la: Et viderunt eum omnes qui habitabant Lyddæ et Saronæ : qui conversi sunt ad Dominum.
text_pt: E viram-no todos os que habitavam em Lida e Sarona, os quais se converteram ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶδαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες Λύδδα καὶ τὸν Σαρῶνα, οἵτινες ἐπέστρεψαν ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον.

text_en: And in Joppe there was a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas . This woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
text_la: In Joppe autem fuit quædam discipula, nomine Tabitha, quæ interpretata dicitur Dorcas. Hæc erat plena operibus bonis et eleemosynis quas faciebat.
text_pt: E havia em Jope uma discípula chamada Tabita, que traduzido se diz Dorcas. Esta estava cheia de boas obras e esmolas que fazia.
text_el: ἐν Ἰόππῃ δέ τις ἦν μαθήτρια ὀνόματι Ταβιθά, ἣ διερμηνευομένη λέγεται Δορκάς: αὕτη ἦν πλήρης ἔργων ἀγαθῶν καὶ ἐλεημοσυνῶν ὧν ἐποίει.

text_en: And it came to pass in those days that she was sick and died. Whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
text_la: Factum est autem in diebus illis ut infirmata moreretur. Quam cum lavissent, posuerunt eam in cœnaculo.
text_pt: E aconteceu naqueles dias que, enfermando ela, morreu; e, tendo-a lavado, a depositaram num quarto alto.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἀσθενήσασαν αὐτὴν ἀποθανεῖν: λούσαντες δὲ ἔθηκαν ἐν ὑπερῴῳ.

text_en: And forasmuch as Lydda was near to Joppe , the disciples , hearing that Peter was there, sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not be slack to come unto them.
text_la: Cum autem prope esset Lydda ad Joppen, discipuli, audientes quia Petrus esset in ea, miserunt duos viros ad eum, rogantes : Ne pigriteris venire ad nos.
text_pt: E, como Lida era perto de Jope, ouvindo os discípulos que Pedro estava ali, lhe mandaram dois homens, rogando-lhe que não se demorasse em vir ter com eles.
text_el: ἐγγὺς δὲ οὔσης Λύδδας τῇ Ἰόππῃ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀκούσαντες ὅτι Πέτρος ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτῇ ἀπέστειλαν δύο ἄνδρας πρὸς αὐτὸν παρακαλοῦντες, μὴ ὀκνήσῃς διελθεῖν ἕως ἡμῶν.

text_en: And Peter rising up went with them. And when he had come, they brought him into the upper chamber. And all the widows stood about him, weeping and showing him the coats and garments which Dorcas made them.
text_la: Exsurgens autem Petrus, venit cum illis. Et cum advenisset, duxerunt illum in cœnaculum : et circumsteterunt illum omnes viduæ flentes, et ostendentes ei tunicas et vestes quas faciebat illis Dorcas.
text_pt: E, levantando-se Pedro, foi com eles; e quando chegou o levaram ao quarto alto, e todas as viúvas o rodearam, chorando e mostrando as túnicas e roupas que Dorcas fizera quando estava com elas.
text_el: ἀναστὰς δὲ Πέτρος συνῆλθεν αὐτοῖς: ὃν παραγενόμενον ἀνήγαγον εἰς τὸ ὑπερῷον, καὶ παρέστησαν αὐτῷ πᾶσαι αἱ χῆραι κλαίουσαι καὶ ἐπιδεικνύμεναι χιτῶνας καὶ ἱμάτια ὅσα ἐποίει μετ' αὐτῶν οὖσα ἡ Δορκάς.

text_en: And they all being put forth, Peter , kneeling down, prayed . And turning to the body, he said: Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes and, seeing Peter , sat up.
text_la: Ejectis autem omnibus foras, Petrus ponens genua oravit : et conversus ad corpus, dixit : Tabitha, surge. At illa aperuit oculos suos : et viso Petro, resedit.
text_pt: Mas Pedro, fazendo sair a todos, pôs-se de joelhos e orou: e, voltando-se para o corpo, disse: Tabita, levanta-te. E ela abriu os olhos, e, vendo a Pedro, assentou-se.
text_el: ἐκβαλὼν δὲ ἔξω πάντας ὁ Πέτρος καὶ θεὶς τὰ γόνατα προσηύξατο, καὶ ἐπιστρέψας πρὸς τὸ σῶμα εἶπεν, Ταβιθά, ἀνάστηθι. ἡ δὲ ἤνοιξεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῆς, καὶ ἰδοῦσα τὸν Πέτρον ἀνεκάθισεν.

text_en: And giving her his hand, he lifted her up. And when he had called the saints and the widows , he presented her alive.
text_la: Dans autem illi manum, erexit eam. Et cum vocasset sanctos et viduas, assignavit eam vivam.
text_pt: E ele, dando-lhe a mão, a levantou e, chamando os santos e as viúvas, apresentou-lha viva.
text_el: δοὺς δὲ αὐτῇ χεῖρα ἀνέστησεν αὐτήν, φωνήσας δὲ τοὺς ἁγίους καὶ τὰς χήρας παρέστησεν αὐτὴν ζῶσαν.

text_en: And it was made known throughout all Joppe . And many believed in the Lord .
text_la: Notum autem factum est per universam Joppen : et crediderunt multi in Domino.
text_pt: E foi isto notório por toda a Jope, e muitos creram no Senhor.
text_el: γνωστὸν δὲ ἐγένετο καθ' ὅλης Ἰόππης, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν πολλοὶ ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον.

text_en: And it came to pass that he abode many days in Joppe , with one Simon a tanner.
text_la: Factum est autem ut dies multos moraretur in Joppe, apud Simonem quemdam coriarium.
text_pt: E ficou muitos dias em Jope, com um certo Simão curtidor.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡμέρας ἱκανὰς μεῖναι ἐν Ἰόππῃ παρά τινι Σίμωνι βυρσεῖ.

text_en: And there was a certain man in Caesarea , named Cornelius , a centurion of that which is called the Italian band:
text_la: Vir autem quidam erat in Cæsarea, nomine Cornelius, centurio cohortis quæ dicitur Italica,
text_pt: E havia em Cesaréia um homem por nome Cornélio, centurião da coorte chamada italiana,
text_el: Ἀνὴρ δέ τις ἐν Καισαρείᾳ ὀνόματι Κορνήλιος, ἑκατοντάρχης ἐκ σπείρης τῆς καλουμένης Ἰταλικῆς,

text_en: A religious man , and fearing God with all his house , giving much alms to the people and always praying to God .
text_la: religiosus, ac timens Deum cum omni domo sua, faciens eleemosynas multas plebi, et deprecans Deum semper.
text_pt: Piedoso e temente a Deus, com toda a sua casa, o qual fazia muitas esmolas ao povo, e de contínuo orava a Deus.
text_el: εὐσεβὴς καὶ φοβούμενος τὸν θεὸν σὺν παντὶ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ, ποιῶν ἐλεημοσύνας πολλὰς τῷ λαῷ καὶ δεόμενος τοῦ θεοῦ διὰ παντός,

text_en: This man saw in a vision manifestly, about the ninth hour of the day, an angel of God coming in unto him and saying to him: Cornelius .
text_la: Is vidit in visu manifeste, quasi hora diei nona, angelum Dei introëuntem ad se, et dicentem sibi : Corneli.
text_pt: Este, quase à hora nona do dia, viu claramente numa visão um anjo de Deus, que se dirigia para ele e dizia: Cornélio.
text_el: εἶδεν ἐν ὁράματι φανερῶς ὡσεὶ περὶ ὥραν ἐνάτην τῆς ἡμέρας ἄγγελον τοῦ θεοῦ εἰσελθόντα πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἰπόντα αὐτῷ, Κορνήλιε.

text_en: And he, beholding him, being seized with fear, said: What is it, Lord? And he said to him: Your prayers and your alms are ascended for a memorial in the sight of God .
text_la: At ille intuens eum, timore correptus, dixit : Quid est, domine? Dixit autem illi : Orationes tuæ et eleemosynæ tuæ ascenderunt in memoriam in conspectu Dei.
text_pt: O qual, fixando os olhos nele, e muito atemorizado, disse: Que é, Senhor? E disse-lhe: As tuas orações e as tuas esmolas têm subido para memória diante de Deus;
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀτενίσας αὐτῷ καὶ ἔμφοβος γενόμενος εἶπεν, τί ἐστιν, κύριε; εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ, αἱ προσευχαί σου καὶ αἱ ἐλεημοσύναι σου ἀνέβησαν εἰς μνημόσυνον ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And now send men to Joppe : and call hither one Simon, who is surnamed Peter .
text_la: Et nunc mitte viros in Joppen, et accersi Simonem quemdam, qui cognominatur Petrus:
text_pt: Agora, pois, envia homens a Jope, e manda chamar a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro.
text_el: καὶ νῦν πέμψον ἄνδρας εἰς Ἰόππην καὶ μετάπεμψαι Σίμωνά τινα ὃς ἐπικαλεῖται Πέτρος:

text_en: He lodges with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side. He will tell you what you must do.
text_la: hic hospitatur apud Simonem quemdam coriarium, cujus est domus juxta mare : hic dicet tibi quid te oporteat facere.
text_pt: Este está hospedado com um certo Simão curtidor, que tem a sua casa junto do mar. Ele te dirá o que deves fazer.
text_el: οὗτος ξενίζεται παρά τινι Σίμωνι βυρσεῖ, ᾧ ἐστιν οἰκία παρὰ θάλασσαν.

text_en: And when the angel who spoke to him was departed, he called two of his household servants and a soldier who feared the Lord , of them that were under him.
text_la: Et cum discessisset angelus qui loquebatur illi, vocavit duos domesticos suos, et militem metuentem Dominum ex his qui illi parebant.
text_pt: E, retirando-se o anjo que lhe falava, chamou dois dos seus criados, e a um piedoso soldado dos que estavam ao seu serviço.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἀπῆλθεν ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ λαλῶν αὐτῷ, φωνήσας δύο τῶν οἰκετῶν καὶ στρατιώτην εὐσεβῆ τῶν προσκαρτερούντων αὐτῷ,

text_en: To whom when he had related all, he sent them to Joppe .
text_la: Quibus cum narrasset omnia, misit illos in Joppen.
text_pt: E, havendo-lhes contado tudo, os enviou a Jope.
text_el: καὶ ἐξηγησάμενος ἅπαντα αὐτοῖς ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν Ἰόππην.

text_en: And on the next day, whilst they were going on their journey and drawing near to the city, Peter went up to the higher parts of the house to pray , about the sixth hour .
text_la: Postera autem die, iter illis facientibus, et appropinquantibus civitati, ascendit Petrus in superiora ut oraret circa horam sextam.
text_pt: E no dia seguinte, indo eles seu caminho, e estando já perto da cidade, subiu Pedro ao terraço para orar, quase à hora sexta.
text_el: Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον ὁδοιπορούντων ἐκείνων καὶ τῇ πόλει ἐγγιζόντων ἀνέβη Πέτρος ἐπὶ τὸ δῶμα προσεύξασθαι περὶ ὥραν ἕκτην.

text_en: And being hungry, he was desirous to taste somewhat. And as they were preparing, there came upon him an ecstasy of mind .
text_la: Et cum esuriret, voluit gustare. Parantibus autem illis, cecidit super eum mentis excessus:
text_pt: E tendo fome, quis comer; e, enquanto lho preparavam, sobreveio-lhe um arrebatamento de sentidos,
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ πρόσπεινος καὶ ἤθελεν γεύσασθαι: παρασκευαζόντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἐγένετο ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἔκστασις,

text_en: And he saw the heaven opened and a certain vessel descending, as it were a great linen sheet let down by the four corners from heaven to the earth:
text_la: et vidit cælum apertum, et descendens vas quoddam, velut linteum magnum, quatuor initiis submitti de cælo in terram,
text_pt: E viu o céu aberto, e que descia um vaso, como se fosse um grande lençol atado pelas quatro pontas, e vindo para a terra.
text_el: καὶ θεωρεῖ τὸν οὐρανὸν ἀνεῳγμένον καὶ καταβαῖνον σκεῦός τι ὡς ὀθόνην μεγάλην τέσσαρσιν ἀρχαῖς καθιέμενον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς,

text_en: Wherein were all manner of four-footed beasts and creeping things of the earth and fowls of the air.
text_la: in quo erant omnia quadrupedia, et serpentia terræ, et volatilia cæli.
text_pt: No qual havia de todos os animais quadrúpedes e feras e répteis da terra, e aves do céu.
text_el: ἐν ᾧ ὑπῆρχεν πάντα τὰ τετράποδα καὶ ἑρπετὰ τῆς γῆς καὶ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.

text_en: And there came a voice to him: Arise, Peter . Kill and eat.
text_la: Et facta est vox ad eum : Surge, Petre : occide, et manduca.
text_pt: E foi-lhe dirigida uma voz: Levanta-te, Pedro, mata e come.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο φωνὴ πρὸς αὐτόν, ἀναστάς, Πέτρε, θῦσον καὶ φάγε.

text_en: But Peter said: Far be it from me. For I never ate anything that is common and unclean .
text_la: Ait autem Petrus : Absit Domine, quia numquam manducavi omne commune et immundum.
text_pt: Mas Pedro disse: De modo nenhum, Senhor, porque nunca comi coisa alguma comum e imunda.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος εἶπεν, μηδαμῶς, κύριε, ὅτι οὐδέποτε ἔφαγον πᾶν κοινὸν καὶ ἀκάθαρτον.

text_en: And the voice spoke to him again the second time: That which God has cleansed, do not call common.
text_la: Et vox iterum secundo ad eum : Quod Deus purificavit, tu commune ne dixeris.
text_pt: E segunda vez lhe disse a voz: Não faças tu comum ao que Deus purificou.
text_el: καὶ φωνὴ πάλιν ἐκ δευτέρου πρὸς αὐτόν, ἃ ὁ θεὸς ἐκαθάρισεν σὺ μὴ κοίνου.

text_en: And this was done thrice. And presently the vessel was taken up into heaven.
text_la: Hoc autem factum est per ter : et statim receptum est vas in cælum.
text_pt: E aconteceu isto por três vezes; e o vaso tornou a recolher-se ao céu.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τρίς, καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνελήμφθη τὸ σκεῦος εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν.

text_en: Now, whilst Peter was doubting within himself what the vision that he had seen should mean, behold the men who were sent from Cornelius , inquiring for Simon's house, stood at the gate.
text_la: Et dum intra se hæsitaret Petrus quidnam esset visio quam vidisset, ecce viri qui missi erant a Cornelio, inquirentes domum Simonis astiterunt ad januam.
text_pt: E estando Pedro duvidando entre si acerca do que seria aquela visão que tinha visto, eis que os homens que foram enviados por Cornélio pararam à porta, perguntando pela casa de Simão.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐν ἑαυτῷ διηπόρει ὁ Πέτρος τί ἂν εἴη τὸ ὅραμα ὃ εἶδεν, ἰδοὺ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ ἀπεσταλμένοι ὑπὸ τοῦ Κορνηλίου διερωτήσαντες τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ Σίμωνος ἐπέστησαν ἐπὶ τὸν πυλῶνα,

text_en: And when they had called, they asked if Simon, who is surnamed Peter , were lodged there.
text_la: Et cum vocassent, interrogabant, si Simon qui cognominatur Petrus illic haberet hospitium.
text_pt: E, chamando, perguntaram se Simão, que tinha por sobrenome Pedro, morava ali.
text_el: καὶ φωνήσαντες ἐπύθοντο εἰ Σίμων ὁ ἐπικαλούμενος Πέτρος ἐνθάδε ξενίζεται.

text_en: And as Peter was thinking of the vision , the Spirit said to him: Behold three men seek you.
text_la: Petro autem cogitante de visione, dixit Spiritus ei : Ecce viri tres quærunt te.
text_pt: E, pensando Pedro naquela visão, disse-lhe o Espírito: Eis que três homens te buscam.
text_el: τοῦ δὲ Πέτρου διενθυμουμένου περὶ τοῦ ὁράματος εἶπεν τὸ πνεῦμα ἰδοὺ, ἄνδρες δύο ζητοῦντές σε:

text_en: Arise, therefore: get you down and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
text_la: Surge itaque, descende, et vade cum eis nihil dubitans : quia ego misi illos.
text_pt: Levanta-te pois, desce, e vai com eles, não duvidando; porque eu os enviei.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἀναστὰς κατάβηθι καὶ πορεύου σὺν αὐτοῖς μηδὲν διακρινόμενος, ὅτι ἐγὼ ἀπέσταλκα αὐτούς.

text_en: Then Peter , going down to the men , said: Behold, I am he whom you seek. What is the cause for which you have come?
text_la: Descendens autem Petrus ad viros, dixit : Ecce ego sum, quem quæritis : quæ causa est, propter quam venistis?
text_pt: E, descendo Pedro para junto dos homens que lhe foram enviados por Cornélio, disse: Eis que sou eu a quem procurais; qual é a causa por que estais aqui?
text_el: καταβὰς δὲ Πέτρος πρὸς τοὺς ἄνδρας εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ ἐγώ εἰμι ὃν ζητεῖτε: τίς ἡ αἰτία δι' ἣν πάρεστε;

text_en: Who said: Cornelius , a centurion , a just man and one that fears God , and having good testimony from all the nation of the Jews , received an answer of an holy angel , to send for you into his house And to hear words of you.
text_la: Qui dixerunt : Cornelius centurio, vir justus et timens Deum, et testimonium habens ab universa gente Judæorum, responsum accepit ab angelo sancto accersire te in domum suam, et audire verba abs te.
text_pt: E eles disseram: Cornélio, o centurião, homem justo e temente a Deus, e que tem bom testemunho de toda a nação dos judeus, foi avisado por um santo anjo para que te chamasse a sua casa, e ouvisse as tuas palavras.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν, Κορνήλιος ἑκατοντάρχης, ἀνὴρ δίκαιος καὶ φοβούμενος τὸν θεὸν μαρτυρούμενός τε ὑπὸ ὅλου τοῦ ἔθνους τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ἐχρηματίσθη ὑπὸ ἀγγέλου ἁγίου μεταπέμψασθαί σε εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκοῦσαι ῥήματα παρὰ σοῦ.

text_en: Then bringing them in, he lodged them. And the day following, he arose and went with them: and some of the brethren from Joppe accompanied him.
text_la: Introducens ergo eos, recepit hospitio. Sequenti autem die, surgens profectus est cum illis, et quidam ex fratribus ab Joppe comitati sunt eum.
text_pt: Então, chamando-os para dentro, os recebeu em casa. E no dia seguinte foi Pedro com eles, e foram com ele alguns irmãos de Jope.
text_el: εἰσκαλεσάμενος οὖν αὐτοὺς ἐξένισεν. Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον ἀναστὰς ἐξῆλθεν σὺν αὐτοῖς, καί τινες τῶν ἀδελφῶν τῶν ἀπὸ Ἰόππης συνῆλθον αὐτῷ.

text_en: And the morrow after, he entered into Caesarea . And Cornelius waited for them, having called together his kinsmen and special friends.
text_la: Altera autem die introivit Cæsaream. Cornelius vero exspectabat illos, convocatis cognatis suis et necessariis amicis.
text_pt: E no dia imediato chegaram a Cesaréia. E Cornélio os estava esperando, tendo já convidado os seus parentes e amigos mais íntimos.
text_el: τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν Καισάρειαν: ὁ δὲ Κορνήλιος ἦν προσδοκῶν αὐτούς, συγκαλεσάμενος τοὺς συγγενεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἀναγκαίους φίλους.

text_en: And it came to pass that when Peter had come in, Cornelius came to meet him and falling at his feet adored .
text_la: Et factum est cum introisset Petrus, obvius venit ei Cornelius, et procidens ad pedes ejus adoravit.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, entrando Pedro, saiu Cornélio a recebê-lo, e, prostrando-se a seus pés o adorou.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐγένετο τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν τὸν Πέτρον, συναντήσας αὐτῷ ὁ Κορνήλιος πεσὼν ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας προσεκύνησεν.

text_en: But Peter lifted him up, saying: Arise: I myself also am a man .
text_la: Petrus vero elevavit eum, dicens : Surge : et ego ipse homo sum.
text_pt: Mas Pedro o levantou, dizendo: Levanta-te, que eu também sou homem.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν λέγων, ἀνάστηθι: καὶ ἐγὼ αὐτὸς ἄνθρωπός εἰμι.

text_en: And talking with him, he went in and found many that had come together.
text_la: Et loquens cum illo intravit, et invenit multos qui convenerant:
text_pt: E, falando com ele, entrou, e achou muitos que ali se haviam ajuntado.
text_el: καὶ συνομιλῶν αὐτῷ εἰσῆλθεν, καὶ εὑρίσκει συνεληλυθότας πολλούς,

text_en: And he said to them: You know how abominable it is for a man that is a Jew to keep company or to come unto one of another nation: but God has showed to me, to call no man common or unclean .
text_la: dixitque ad illos : Vos scitis quomodo abominatum sit viro Judæo conjungi aut accedere ad alienigenam : sed mihi ostendit Deus neminem communem aut immundum dicere hominem.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Vós bem sabeis que não é lícito a um homem judeu ajuntar-se ou chegar-se a estrangeiros; mas Deus mostrou-me que a nenhum homem chame comum ou imundo.
text_el: ἔφη τε πρὸς αὐτούς, ὑμεῖς ἐπίστασθε ὡς ἀθέμιτόν ἐστιν ἀνδρὶ Ἰουδαίῳ κολλᾶσθαι ἢ προσέρχεσθαι ἀλλοφύλῳ: κἀμοὶ ὁ θεὸς ἔδειξεν μηδένα κοινὸν ἢ ἀκάθαρτον λέγειν ἄνθρωπον:

text_en: For which cause, making no doubt , I came when I was sent for. I ask, therefore, for what cause you have sent for me?
text_la: Propter quod sine dubitatione veni accersitus. Interrogo ergo, quam ob causam accersistis me?
text_pt: Por isso, sendo chamado, vim sem contradizer. Pergunto, pois, por que razão mandastes chamar-me?
text_el: διὸ καὶ ἀναντιρρήτως ἦλθον μεταπεμφθείς. πυνθάνομαι οὖν τίνι λόγῳ μετεπέμψασθέ με;

text_en: And Cornelius said: Four days ago, unto this hour, I was praying in my house, at the ninth hour and behold a man stood before me in white apparel and said:
text_la: Et Cornelius ait : A nudiusquarta die usque ad hanc horam, orans eram hora nona in domo mea, et ecce vir stetit ante me in veste candida, et ait:
text_pt: E disse Cornélio: Há quatro dias estava eu em jejum até esta hora, orando em minha casa à hora nona.
text_el: καὶ ὁ Κορνήλιος ἔφη, ἀπὸ τετάρτης ἡμέρας μέχρι ταύτης τῆς ὥρας ἤμην τὴν ἐνάτην προσευχόμενος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ἔστη ἐνώπιόν μου ἐν ἐσθῆτι λαμπρᾷ

text_en: Cornelius , your prayer is heard and your alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God .
text_la: Corneli, exaudita est oratio tua, et eleemosynæ tuæ commemoratæ sunt in conspectu Dei.
text_pt: E eis que diante de mim se apresentou um homem com vestes resplandecentes, e disse: Cornélio, a tua oração foi ouvida, e as tuas esmolas estão em memória diante de Deus.
text_el: καὶ φησίν, Κορνήλιε, εἰσηκούσθη σου ἡ προσευχὴ καὶ αἱ ἐλεημοσύναι σου ἐμνήσθησαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Send therefore to Joppe : and call hither Simon, who is surnamed Peter . He lodges in the house of Simon a tanner, by the sea side.
text_la: Mitte ergo in Joppen, et accersi Simonem qui cognominatur Petrus : hic hospitatur in domo Simonis coriarii juxta mare.
text_pt: Envia, pois, a Jope, e manda chamar Simão, o que tem por sobrenome Pedro; este está hospedado em casa de Simão o curtidor, junto do mar, e ele, vindo, te falará.
text_el: πέμψον οὖν εἰς Ἰόππην καὶ μετακάλεσαι Σίμωνα ὃς ἐπικαλεῖται Πέτρος: οὗτος ξενίζεται ἐν οἰκίᾳ Σίμωνος βυρσέως παρὰ θάλασσαν.

text_en: Immediately therefore I sent to you: and you have done well in coming. Now, therefore, all we are present in your sight to hear all things whatsoever are commanded you by the Lord .
text_la: Confestim ergo misi ad te : et tu benefecisti veniendo. Nunc ergo omnes nos in conspectu tuo adsumus audire omnia quæcumque tibi præcepta sunt a Domino.
text_pt: E logo mandei chamar-te, e bem fizeste em vir. Agora, pois, estamos todos presentes diante de Deus, para ouvir tudo quanto por Deus te é mandado.
text_el: ἐξαυτῆς οὖν ἔπεμψα πρὸς σέ, σύ τε καλῶς ἐποίησας παραγενόμενος. νῦν οὖν πάντες ἡμεῖς ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ πάρεσμεν ἀκοῦσαι πάντα τὰ προστεταγμένα σοι ὑπὸ τοῦ κυρίου.

text_en: And Peter opening his mouth, said: In very deed I perceive that God is not a respecter of persons .
text_la: Aperiens autem Petrus os suum, dixit : In veritate comperi quia non est personarum acceptor Deus;
text_pt: E, abrindo Pedro a boca, disse: Reconheço por verdade que Deus não faz acepção de pessoas;
text_el: Ἀνοίξας δὲ Πέτρος τὸ στόμα εἶπεν: ἐπ' ἀληθείας καταλαμβάνομαι ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν προσωπολήμπτης ὁ θεός,

text_en: But in every nation, he that fears him and works justice is acceptable to him.
text_la: sed in omni gente qui timet eum, et operatur justitiam, acceptus est illi.
text_pt: Mas que lhe é agradável aquele que, em qualquer nação, o teme e faz o que é justo.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἐν παντὶ ἔθνει ὁ φοβούμενος αὐτὸν καὶ ἐργαζόμενος δικαιοσύνην δεκτὸς αὐτῷ ἐστιν.

text_en: God sent the word to the children of Israel , preaching peace by Jesus Christ (He is Lord of all).
text_la: Verbum misit Deus filiis Israël, annuntians pacem per Jesum Christum (hic est omnium Dominus).
text_pt: A palavra que ele enviou aos filhos de Israel, anunciando a paz por Jesus Cristo (este é o Senhor de todos);
text_el: τὸν λόγον ἀπέστειλεν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ εὐαγγελιζόμενος εἰρήνην διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ: οὗτός ἐστιν πάντων κύριος:

text_en: You know the word which has been published through all Judea : for it began from Galilee , after the baptism which John preached.
text_la: Vos scitis quod factum est verbum per universam Judæam: incipiens enim a Galilæa post baptismum quod prædicavit Joannes,
text_pt: Esta palavra, vós bem sabeis, veio por toda a Judéia, começando pela Galiléia, depois do batismo que João pregou;
text_el: ὑμεῖς οἴδατε, τὸ γενόμενον ῥῆμα καθ' ὅλης τῆς Ἰουδαίας, ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας μετὰ τὸ βάπτισμα ὃ ἐκήρυξεν Ἰωάννης,

text_en: Jesus of Nazareth : how God anointed him with the Holy Ghost and with power, who went about doing good and healing all that were oppressed by the devil , for God was with him.
text_la: Jesum a Nazareth : quomodo unxit eum Deus Spiritu Sancto, et virtute, qui pertransiit benefaciendo, et sanando omnes oppressos a diabolo, quoniam Deus erat cum illo.
text_pt: Como Deus ungiu a Jesus de Nazaré com o Espírito Santo e com virtude; o qual andou fazendo bem, e curando a todos os oprimidos do diabo, porque Deus era com ele.
text_el: Ἰησοῦν τὸν ἀπὸ Ναζαρέθ, ὡς ἔχρισεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεὸς πνεύματι ἁγίῳ καὶ δυνάμει, ὃς διῆλθεν εὐεργετῶν καὶ ἰώμενος πάντας τοὺς καταδυναστευομένους ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἦν μετ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And we are witnesses of all things that he did in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem : whom they killed, hanging him upon a tree .
text_la: Et nos testes sumus omnium quæ fecit in regione Judæorum, et Jerusalem, quem occiderunt suspendentes in ligno.
text_pt: E nós somos testemunhas de todas as coisas que fez, tanto na terra da Judéia como em Jerusalém; ao qual mataram, pendurando-o num madeiro.
text_el: καὶ ἡμεῖς μάρτυρες πάντων ὧν ἐποίησεν ἔν τε τῇ χώρᾳ τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ Ἰερουσαλήμ, ὃν καὶ ἀνεῖλαν κρεμάσαντες ἐπὶ ξύλου.

text_en: Him God raised up the third day and gave him to be made manifest,
text_la: Hunc Deus suscitavit tertia die, et dedit eum manifestum fieri,
text_pt: A este ressuscitou Deus ao terceiro dia, e fez que se manifestasse,
text_el: τοῦτον ὁ θεὸς ἤγειρεν τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸν ἐμφανῆ γενέσθαι,

text_en: not to all the people, but to witnesses preordained by God , even to us, who ate and drank with him, after he arose again from the dead .
text_la: non omni populo, sed testibus præordinatis a Deo : nobis, qui manducavimus et bibimus cum illo postquam resurrexit a mortuis.
text_pt: Não a todo o povo, mas às testemunhas que Deus antes ordenara; a nós, que comemos e bebemos juntamente com ele, depois que ressuscitou dentre os mortos.
text_el: οὐ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ ἀλλὰ μάρτυσιν τοῖς προκεχειροτονημένοις ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἡμῖν, οἵτινες συνεφάγομεν καὶ συνεπίομεν αὐτῷ μετὰ τὸ ἀναστῆναι αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν:

text_en: And he commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that it is he who was appointed by God to be judge of the living and of the dead.
text_la: Et præcepit nobis prædicare populo, et testificari, quia ipse est qui constitutus est a Deo judex vivorum et mortuorum.
text_pt: E nos mandou pregar ao povo, e testificar que ele é o que por Deus foi constituído juiz dos vivos e dos mortos.
text_el: καὶ παρήγγειλεν ἡμῖν κηρύξαι τῷ λαῷ καὶ διαμαρτύρασθαι ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ὡρισμένος ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ κριτὴς ζώντων καὶ νεκρῶν.

text_en: To him all the prophets give testimony, that by his name all receive remission of sins , who believe in him.
text_la: Huic omnes prophetæ testimonium perhibent remissionem peccatorum accipere per nomen ejus omnes qui credunt in eum.
text_pt: A este dão testemunho todos os profetas, de que todos os que nele crêem receberão o perdão dos pecados pelo seu nome.
text_el: τούτῳ πάντες οἱ προφῆται μαρτυροῦσιν, ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν λαβεῖν διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ πάντα τὸν πιστεύοντα εἰς αὐτόν.

text_en: While Peter was yet speaking these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them that heard the word.
text_la: Adhuc loquente Petro verba hæc, cecidit Spiritus Sanctus super omnes qui audiebant verbum.
text_pt: E, dizendo Pedro ainda estas palavras, caiu o Espírito Santo sobre todos os que ouviam a palavra.
text_el: ἔτι λαλοῦντος τοῦ Πέτρου τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἐπέπεσεν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀκούοντας τὸν λόγον.

text_en: And the faithful of the circumcision , who came with Peter , were astonished for that the grace of the Holy Ghost was poured out upon the Gentiles also.
text_la: Et obstupuerunt ex circumcisione fideles qui venerant cum Petro, quia et in nationes gratia Spiritus Sancti effusa est.
text_pt: E os fiéis que eram da circuncisão, todos quantos tinham vindo com Pedro, maravilharam-se de que o dom do Espírito Santo se derramasse também sobre os gentios.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέστησαν οἱ ἐκ περιτομῆς πιστοὶ οἳ συνῆλθαν τῷ Πέτρῳ, ὅτι καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἔθνη ἡ δωρεὰ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἁγίου ἐκκέχυται:

text_en: For they heard them speaking with tongues and magnifying God .
text_la: Audiebant enim illos loquentes linguis, et magnificantes Deum.
text_pt: Porque os ouviam falar línguas, e magnificar a Deus.
text_el: ἤκουον γὰρ αὐτῶν λαλούντων γλώσσαις καὶ μεγαλυνόντων τὸν θεόν. τότε ἀπεκρίθη Πέτρος,

text_en: Then Peter answered: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized , who have received the Holy Ghost , as well as we?
text_la: Tunc respondit Petrus: Numquid aquam quis prohibere potest ut non baptizentur hi qui Spiritum Sanctum acceperunt sicut et nos?
text_pt: Respondeu, então, Pedro: Pode alguém porventura recusar a água, para que não sejam batizados estes, que também receberam como nós o Espírito Santo?
text_el: μήτι τὸ ὕδωρ δύναται κωλῦσαί τις τοῦ μὴ βαπτισθῆναι τούτους οἵτινες τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ἔλαβον ὡς καὶ ἡμεῖς;

text_en: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ . Then they desired him to tarry with them some days.
text_la: Et jussit eos baptizari in nomine Domini Jesu Christi. Tunc rogaverunt eum ut maneret apud eos aliquot diebus.
text_pt: E mandou que fossem batizados em nome do Senhor. Então rogaram-lhe que ficasse com eles por alguns dias.
text_el: προσέταξεν δὲ αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ βαπτισθῆναι. τότε ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν ἐπιμεῖναι ἡμέρας τινάς.

text_en: And the apostles and brethren, who were in Judea , heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God .
text_la: Audierunt autem Apostoli et fratres qui erant in Judæa, quoniam et gentes receperunt verbum Dei.
text_pt: E ouviram os apóstolos, e os irmãos que estavam na Judéia, que também os gentios tinham recebido a palavra de Deus.
text_el: Ἤκουσαν δὲ οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ οἱ ὄντες κατὰ τὴν Ἰουδαίαν ὅτι καὶ τὰ ἔθνη ἐδέξαντο τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And when Peter had come up to Jerusalem , they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
text_la: Cum autem ascendisset Petrus Jerosolymam, disceptabant adversus illum qui erant ex circumcisione,
text_pt: E, subindo Pedro a Jerusalém, disputavam com ele os que eram da circuncisão,
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ἀνέβη Πέτρος εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, διεκρίνοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἐκ περιτομῆς

text_en: saying: Why did you go in to men uncircumcised and eat with them?
text_la: dicentes : Quare introisti ad viros præputium habentes, et manducasti cum illis?
text_pt: Dizendo: Entraste em casa de homens incircuncisos, e comeste com eles.
text_el: λέγοντες ὅτι εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς ἄνδρας ἀκροβυστίαν ἔχοντας καὶ συνέφαγεν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: But Peter began and declared to them the matter in order, saying:
text_la: Incipiens autem Petrus exponebat illis ordinem, dicens:
text_pt: Mas Pedro começou a fazer-lhes uma exposição por ordem, dizendo:
text_el: ἀρξάμενος δὲ Πέτρος ἐξετίθετο αὐτοῖς καθεξῆς λέγων,

text_en: I was in the city of Joppe praying : and I saw in an ecstasy of mind a vision , a certain vessel descending, as it were a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. And it came even unto me.
text_la: Ego eram in civitate Joppe orans, et vidi in excessu mentis visionem, descendens vas quoddam velut linteum magnum quatuor initiis summitti de cælo, et venit usque ad me.
text_pt: Estando eu orando na cidade de Jope, tive, num arrebatamento dos sentidos, uma visão; via um vaso, como um grande lençol que descia do céu e vinha até junto de mim.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἤμην ἐν πόλει Ἰόππῃ προσευχόμενος καὶ εἶδον ἐν ἐκστάσει ὅραμα, καταβαῖνον σκεῦός τι ὡς ὀθόνην μεγάλην τέσσαρσιν ἀρχαῖς καθιεμένην ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἦλθεν ἄχρι ἐμοῦ:

text_en: Into which looking, I considered and saw fourfooted creatures of the earth and beasts and creeping things and fowls of the air.
text_la: In quod intuens considerabam, et vidi quadrupedia terræ, et bestias, et reptilia, et volatilia cæli.
text_pt: E, pondo nele os olhos, considerei, e vi animais da terra, quadrúpedes, e feras, e répteis e aves do céu.
text_el: εἰς ἣν ἀτενίσας κατενόουν καὶ εἶδον τὰ τετράποδα τῆς γῆς καὶ τὰ θηρία καὶ τὰ ἑρπετὰ καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.

text_en: And I heard also a voice saying to me: Arise, Peter . Kill and eat.
text_la: Audivi autem et vocem dicentem mihi : Surge, Petre : occide, et manduca.
text_pt: E ouvi uma voz que me dizia: Levanta-te, Pedro; mata e come.
text_el: ἤκουσα δὲ καὶ φωνῆς λεγούσης μοι, ἀναστάς, Πέτρε, θῦσον καὶ φάγε.

text_en: And I said: Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.
text_la: Dixi autem : Nequaquam Domine : quia commune aut immundum numquam introivit in os meum.
text_pt: Mas eu disse: De maneira nenhuma, Senhor; pois, nunca em minha boca entrou coisa alguma comum ou imunda.
text_el: εἶπον δέ, μηδαμῶς, κύριε, ὅτι κοινὸν ἢ ἀκάθαρτον οὐδέποτε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ στόμα μου.

text_en: And the voice answered again from heaven : What God has made clean, do not call common.
text_la: Respondit autem vox secundo de cælo : Quæ Deus mundavit, tu ne commune dixeris.
text_pt: Mas a voz respondeu-me do céu segunda vez: Não chames tu comum ao que Deus purificou.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ ἐκ δευτέρου φωνὴ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, ἃ ὁ θεὸς ἐκαθάρισεν σὺ μὴ κοίνου.

text_en: And this was done three times. And all were taken up again into heaven .
text_la: Hoc autem factum est per ter : et recepta sunt omnia rursum in cælum.
text_pt: E sucedeu isto por três vezes; e tudo tornou a recolher-se ao céu.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τρίς, καὶ ἀνεσπάσθη πάλιν ἅπαντα εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν.

text_en: And behold, immediately there were three men come to the house wherein I was, sent to me from Caesarea .
text_la: Et ecce viri tres confestim astiterunt in domo in qua eram, missi a Cæsarea ad me.
text_pt: E eis que, na mesma hora, pararam, junto da casa em que eu estava, três homens que me foram enviados de Cesaréia.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐξαυτῆς τρεῖς ἄνδρες ἐπέστησαν ἐπὶ τὴν οἰκίαν ἐν ᾗ ἦμεν, ἀπεσταλμένοι ἀπὸ Καισαρείας πρός με.

text_en: And the Spirit said to me that I should go with them, nothing doubting. And these six brethren went with me also: and we entered into the man's house.
text_la: Dixit autem Spiritus mihi ut irem cum illis, nihil hæsitans. Venerunt autem mecum et sex fratres isti, et ingressi sumus in domum viri.
text_pt: E disse-me o Espírito que fosse com eles, nada duvidando; e também estes seis irmãos foram comigo, e entramos em casa daquele homem;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ τὸ πνεῦμά μοι συνελθεῖν αὐτοῖς μηδὲν διακρίναντα. ἦλθον δὲ σὺν ἐμοὶ καὶ οἱ ἓξ ἀδελφοὶ οὗτοι, καὶ εἰσήλθομεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ ἀνδρός:

text_en: And he told us how he had seen an angel in his house, standing and saying to him: Send to Joppe and call hither Simon, who is surnamed Peter ,
text_la: Narravit autem nobis quomodo vidisset angelum in domo sua, stantem et dicentem sibi : Mitte in Joppen, et accersi Simonem qui cognominatur Petrus,
text_pt: E contou-nos como vira em pé um anjo em sua casa, e lhe dissera: Envia homens a Jope, e manda chamar a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro,
text_el: ἀπήγγειλεν δὲ ἡμῖν πῶς εἶδεν τὸν ἄγγελον ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ σταθέντα καὶ εἰπόντα, ἀπόστειλον εἰς Ἰόππην καὶ μετάπεμψαι Σίμωνα τὸν ἐπικαλούμενον Πέτρον,

text_en: who shall speak to you words whereby you shall be saved , and all your house .
text_la: qui loquetur tibi verba in quibus salvus eris tu, et universa domus tua.
text_pt: O qual te dirá palavras com que te salves, tu e toda a tua casa.
text_el: ὃς λαλήσει ῥήματα πρὸς σὲ ἐν οἷς σωθήσῃ σὺ καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκός σου.

text_en: And when I had begun to speak, the Holy Ghost fell upon them, as upon us also in the beginning.
text_la: Cum autem cœpissem loqui, cecidit Spiritus Sanctus super eos, sicut et in nos in initio.
text_pt: E, quando comecei a falar, caiu sobre eles o Espírito Santo, como também sobre nós ao princípio.
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ ἄρξασθαί με λαλεῖν ἐπέπεσεν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ὥσπερ καὶ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἐν ἀρχῇ.

text_en: And I remembered the word of the Lord , how that he said: John indeed baptized with water but you shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Recordatus sum autem verbi Domini, sicut dicebat : Joannes quidem baptizavit aqua, vos autem baptizabimini Spiritu Sancto.
text_pt: E lembrei-me do dito do Senhor, quando disse: João certamente batizou com água; mas vós sereis batizados com o Espírito Santo.
text_el: ἐμνήσθην δὲ τοῦ ῥήματος τοῦ κυρίου ὡς ἔλεγεν, Ἰωάννης μὲν ἐβάπτισεν ὕδατι, ὑμεῖς δὲ βαπτισθήσεσθε ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.

text_en: If then God gave them the same grace as to us also who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ : who was I, that could withstand God ?
text_la: Si ergo eamdem gratiam dedit illis Deus, sicut et nobis qui credidimus in Dominum Jesum Christum : ego quis eram, qui possem prohibere Deum?
text_pt: Portanto, se Deus lhes deu o mesmo dom que a nós, quando havemos crido no Senhor Jesus Cristo, quem era então eu, para que pudesse resistir a Deus?
text_el: εἰ οὖν τὴν ἴσην δωρεὰν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς ὡς καὶ ἡμῖν πιστεύσασιν ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν, ἐγὼ τίς ἤμην δυνατὸς κωλῦσαι τὸν θεόν;

text_en: Having heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God , saying: God then has also to the Gentiles given repentance, unto life.
text_la: His auditis, tacuerunt : et glorificaverunt Deum, dicentes : Ergo et gentibus pœnitentiam dedit Deus ad vitam.
text_pt: E, ouvindo estas coisas, apaziguaram-se, e glorificaram a Deus, dizendo: Na verdade até aos gentios deu Deus o arrependimento para a vida.
text_el: ἀκούσαντες δὲ ταῦτα ἡσύχασαν καὶ ἐδόξασαν τὸν θεὸν λέγοντες, ἄρα καὶ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὁ θεὸς τὴν μετάνοιαν εἰς ζωὴν ἔδωκεν.

text_en: Now they who had been dispersed by the persecution that arose on occasion of Stephen went about as far as Phenice and Cyprus and Antioch , speaking the word to none, but to the Jews only.
text_la: Et illi quidem qui dispersi fuerant a tribulatione quæ facta fuerat sub Stephano, perambulaverunt usque Phœnicen, et Cyprum, et Antiochiam, nemini loquentes verbum, nisi solis Judæis.
text_pt: E os que foram dispersos pela perseguição que sucedeu por causa de Estêvão caminharam até à Fenícia, Chipre e Antioquia, não anunciando a ninguém a palavra, senão somente aos judeus.
text_el: Οἱ μὲν οὖν διασπαρέντες ἀπὸ τῆς θλίψεως τῆς γενομένης ἐπὶ Στεφάνῳ διῆλθον ἕως Φοινίκης καὶ Κύπρου καὶ Ἀντιοχείας, μηδενὶ λαλοῦντες τὸν λόγον εἰ μὴ μόνον Ἰουδαίοις.

text_en: But some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene , who, when they were entered into Antioch , spoke also to the Greeks, preaching the Lord Jesus .
text_la: Erant autem quidam ex eis viri Cyprii et Cyrenæi, qui cum introissent Antiochiam, loquebantur et ad Græcos, annuntiantes Dominum Jesum.
text_pt: E havia entre eles alguns homens chíprios e cirenenses, os quais entrando em Antioquia falaram aos gregos, anunciando o Senhor Jesus.
text_el: ἦσαν δέ τινες ἐξ αὐτῶν ἄνδρες Κύπριοι καὶ Κυρηναῖοι, οἵτινες ἐλθόντες εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν ἐλάλουν καὶ πρὸς τοὺς Ἑλληνιστάς, εὐαγγελιζόμενοι τὸν κύριον Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believing , were converted to the Lord .
text_la: Et erat manus Domini cum eis: multusque numerus credentium conversus est ad Dominum.
text_pt: E a mão do Senhor era com eles; e grande número creu e se converteu ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἦν χεὶρ κυρίου μετ' αὐτῶν, πολύς τε ἀριθμὸς ὁ πιστεύσας ἐπέστρεψεν ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον.

text_en: And the tidings came to the ears of the church that was at Jerusalem , touching these things: and they sent Barnabas as far as Antioch .
text_la: Pervenit autem sermo ad aures ecclesiæ quæ erat Jerosolymis super istis: et miserunt Barnabam usque ad Antiochiam.
text_pt: E chegou a fama destas coisas aos ouvidos da igreja que estava em Jerusalém; e enviaram Barnabé a Antioquia.
text_el: Ἠκούσθη δὲ ὁ λόγος εἰς τὰ ὦτα τῆς ἐκκλησίας τῆς οὔσης ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ περὶ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐξαπέστειλαν Βαρναβᾶν ἕως Ἀντιοχείας:

text_en: Who, when he had come and had seen the grace of God , rejoiced. And he exhorted them all with purpose of heart to continue in the Lord .
text_la: Qui cum pervenisset, et vidisset gratiam Dei, gavisus est : et hortabatur omnes in proposito cordis permanere in Domino:
text_pt: O qual, quando chegou, e viu a graça de Deus, se alegrou, e exortou a todos a que permanecessem no Senhor, com propósito de coração;
text_el: ὃς παραγενόμενος καὶ ἰδὼν τὴν χάριν τὴν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐχάρη καὶ παρεκάλει πάντας τῇ προθέσει τῆς καρδίας προσμένειν [ἐν] τῷ κυρίῳ,

text_en: For he was a good man and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith . And a great multitude was added to the Lord .
text_la: quia erat vir bonus, et plenus Spiritu Sancto, et fide. Et apposita est multa turba Domino.
text_pt: Porque era homem de bem e cheio do Espírito Santo e de fé. E muita gente se uniu ao Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι ἦν ἀνὴρ ἀγαθὸς καὶ πλήρης πνεύματος ἁγίου καὶ πίστεως. καὶ προσετέθη ὄχλος ἱκανὸς τῷ κυρίῳ.

text_en: And Barnabas went to Tarsus to seek Saul : whom, when he had found, he brought to Antioch .
text_la: Profectus est autem Barnabas Tarsum, ut quæreret Saulum : quem cum invenisset, perduxit Antiochiam.
text_pt: E partiu Barnabé para Tarso, a buscar Saulo; e, achando-o, o conduziu para Antioquia.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ εἰς Ταρσὸν ἀναζητῆσαι Σαῦλον,

text_en: And they conversed there in the church a whole year: and they taught a great multitude, so that at Antioch the disciples were first named Christians .
text_la: Et annum totum conversati sunt ibi in ecclesia : et docuerunt turbam multam, ita ut cognominarentur primum Antiochiæ discipuli, christiani.
text_pt: E sucedeu que todo um ano se reuniram naquela igreja, e ensinaram muita gente; e em Antioquia foram os discípulos, pela primeira vez, chamados cristãos.
text_el: καὶ εὑρὼν ἤγαγεν εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν. ἐγένετο δὲ αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐνιαυτὸν ὅλον συναχθῆναι ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ διδάξαι ὄχλον ἱκανόν, χρηματίσαι τε πρώτως ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ τοὺς μαθητὰς Χριστιανούς.

text_en: And in these days there came prophets from Jerusalem to Antioch .
text_la: In his autem diebus supervenerunt ab Jerosolymis prophetæ Antiochiam:
text_pt: E naqueles dias desceram profetas de Jerusalém para Antioquia.
text_el: Ἐν ταύταις δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις κατῆλθον ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων προφῆται εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν:

text_en: And one of them named Agabus , rising up, signified by the Spirit that there should be a great famine over the whole world, which came to pass under Claudius.
text_la: et surgens unus ex eis nomine Agabus, significabat per spiritum famem magnam futuram in universo orbe terrarum, quæ facta est sub Claudio.
text_pt: E, levantando-se um deles, por nome Ágabo, dava a entender pelo Espírito, que haveria uma grande fome em todo o mundo, e isso aconteceu no tempo de Cláudio César.
text_el: ἀναστὰς δὲ εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν ὀνόματι Ἇγαβος ἐσήμαινεν διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος λιμὸν μεγάλην μέλλειν ἔσεσθαι ἐφ' ὅλην τὴν οἰκουμένην: ἥτις ἐγένετο ἐπὶ Κλαυδίου.

text_en: And the disciples , every man according to his ability, purposed to send relief to the brethren who dwelt in Judea .
text_la: Discipuli autem, prout quis habebat, proposuerunt singuli in ministerium mittere habitantibus in Judæa fratribus:
text_pt: E os discípulos determinaram mandar, cada um conforme o que pudesse, socorro aos irmãos que habitavam na Judéia.
text_el: τῶν δὲ μαθητῶν καθὼς εὐπορεῖτό τις ὥρισαν ἕκαστος αὐτῶν εἰς διακονίαν πέμψαι τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ ἀδελφοῖς:

text_en: Which also they did, sending it to the ancients, by the hands of Barnabas and Saul .
text_la: quod et fecerunt, mittentes ad seniores per manus Barnabæ et Sauli.
text_pt: O que eles com efeito fizeram, enviando-o aos anciãos por mão de Barnabé e de Saulo.
text_el: ὃ καὶ ἐποίησαν ἀποστείλαντες πρὸς τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους διὰ χειρὸς Βαρναβᾶ καὶ Σαύλου.

text_en: And at the same time, Herod the king stretched forth his hands, to afflict some of the church .
text_la: Eodem autem tempore misit Herodes rex manus, ut affligeret quosdam de ecclesia.
text_pt: E por aquele mesmo tempo o rei Herodes estendeu as mãos sobre alguns da igreja, para os maltratar;
text_el: κατ' ἐκεῖνον δὲ τὸν καιρὸν ἐπέβαλεν Ἡρῴδης ὁ βασιλεὺς τὰς χεῖρας κακῶσαί τινας τῶν ἀπὸ τῆς ἐκκλησίας.

text_en: And he killed James , the brother of John , with the sword.
text_la: Occidit autem Jacobum fratrem Joannis gladio.
text_pt: E matou à espada Tiago, irmão de João.
text_el: ἀνεῖλεν δὲ Ἰάκωβον τὸν ἀδελφὸν Ἰωάννου μαχαίρῃ.

text_en: And seeing that it pleased the Jews , he proceeded to take up Peter also. Now it was in the days of the Azymes .
text_la: Videns autem quia placeret Judæis, apposuit ut apprehenderet et Petrum. Erant autem dies Azymorum.
text_pt: E, vendo que isso agradara aos judeus, continuou, mandando prender também a Pedro. E eram os dias dos ázimos.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ ὅτι ἀρεστόν ἐστιν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις προσέθετο συλλαβεῖν καὶ Πέτρον- ἦσαν δὲ ἡμέραι τῶν ἀζύμων-

text_en: And when he had apprehended him, he cast him into prison , delivering him to four files of soldiers, to be kept, intending, after the pasch , to bring him forth to the people.
text_la: Quem cum apprehendisset, misit in carcerem, tradens quatuor quaternionibus militum custodiendum, volens post Pascha producere eum populo.
text_pt: E, havendo-o prendido, o encerrou na prisão, entregando-o a quatro quaternos de soldados, para que o guardassem, querendo apresentá-lo ao povo depois da páscoa.
text_el: ὃν καὶ πιάσας ἔθετο εἰς φυλακήν, παραδοὺς τέσσαρσιν τετραδίοις στρατιωτῶν φυλάσσειν αὐτόν, βουλόμενος μετὰ τὸ πάσχα ἀναγαγεῖν αὐτὸν τῷ λαῷ.

text_en: Peter therefore was kept in prison . But prayer was made without ceasing by the church unto God for him.
text_la: Et Petrus quidem servabatur in carcere. Oratio autem fiebant sine intermissione ab ecclesia ad Deum pro eo.
text_pt: Pedro, pois, era guardado na prisão; mas a igreja fazia contínua oração por ele a Deus.
text_el: ὁ μὲν οὖν Πέτρος ἐτηρεῖτο ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ: προσευχὴ δὲ ἦν ἐκτενῶς γινομένη ὑπὸ τῆς ἐκκλησίας πρὸς τὸν θεὸν περὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison .
text_la: Cum autem producturus eum esset Herodes, in ipsa nocte erat Petrus dormiens inter duos milites, vinctus catenis duabus : et custodes ante ostium custodiebant carcerem.
text_pt: E quando Herodes estava para o fazer comparecer, nessa mesma noite estava Pedro dormindo entre dois soldados, ligado com duas cadeias, e os guardas diante da porta guardavam a prisão.
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ἤμελλεν προσαγαγεῖν αὐτὸν ὁ Ἡρῴδης, τῇ νυκτὶ ἐκείνῃ ἦν ὁ Πέτρος κοιμώμενος μεταξὺ δύο στρατιωτῶν δεδεμένος ἁλύσεσιν δυσίν, φύλακές τε πρὸ τῆς θύρας ἐτήρουν τὴν φυλακήν.

text_en: And behold an angel of the Lord stood by him and a light shined in the room. And he, striking Peter on the side, raised him up, saying: Arise quickly. And the chains fell off from his hands.
text_la: Et ecce angelus Domini astitit, et lumen refulsit in habitaculo : percussoque latere Petri, excitavit eum, dicens : Surge velociter. Et ceciderunt catenæ de manibus ejus.
text_pt: E eis que sobreveio o anjo do Senhor, e resplandeceu uma luz na prisão; e, tocando a Pedro na ilharga, o despertou, dizendo: Levanta-te depressa. E caíram-lhe das mãos as cadeias.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐπέστη, καὶ φῶς ἔλαμψεν ἐν τῷ οἰκήματι: πατάξας δὲ τὴν πλευρὰν τοῦ Πέτρου ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν λέγων, ἀνάστα ἐν τάχει. καὶ ἐξέπεσαν αὐτοῦ αἱ ἁλύσεις ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν.

text_en: And the angel said to him: Gird yourself and put on your sandals. And he did so. And he said to him: Cast your garment about you and follow me,
text_la: Dixit autem angelus ad eum : Præcingere, et calcea te caligas tuas. Et fecit sic. Et dixit illi : Circumda tibi vestimentum tuum, et sequere me.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o anjo: Cinge-te, e ata as tuas alparcas. E ele assim o fez. Disse-lhe mais: Lança às costas a tua capa, e segue-me.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ ἄγγελος πρὸς αὐτόν, ζῶσαι καὶ ὑπόδησαι τὰ σανδάλιά σου. ἐποίησεν δὲ οὕτως. καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ, περιβαλοῦ τὸ ἱμάτιόν σου καὶ ἀκολούθει μοι.

text_en: and going out, he followed him. And he knew not that it was true which was done by the angel : but thought he saw a vision .
text_la: Et exiens sequebatur eum, et nesciebat quia verum est, quod fiebat per angelum : existimabat autem se visum videre.
text_pt: E, saindo, o seguia. E não sabia que era real o que estava sendo feito pelo anjo, mas cuidava que via alguma visão.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἠκολούθει, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει ὅτι ἀληθές ἐστιν τὸ γινόμενον διὰ τοῦ ἀγγέλου, ἐδόκει δὲ ὅραμα βλέπειν.

text_en: And passing through the first and the second ward, they came to the iron gate that leads to the city which of itself opened to them. And going out, they passed on through one street. And immediately the angel departed from him.
text_la: Transeuntes autem primam et secundam custodiam, venerunt ad portam ferream, quæ ducit ad civitatem : quæ ultro aperta est eis. Et exeuntes processerunt vicum unum : et continuo discessit angelus ab eo.
text_pt: E, quando passaram a primeira e segunda guarda, chegaram à porta de ferro, que dá para a cidade, a qual se lhes abriu por si mesma; e, tendo saído, percorreram uma rua, e logo o anjo se apartou dele.
text_el: διελθόντες δὲ πρώτην φυλακὴν καὶ δευτέραν ἦλθαν ἐπὶ τὴν πύλην τὴν σιδηρᾶν τὴν φέρουσαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν, ἥτις αὐτομάτη ἠνοίγη αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐξελθόντες προῆλθον ῥύμην μίαν, καὶ εὐθέως ἀπέστη ὁ ἄγγελος ἀπ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And Peter coming to himself, said: Now I know in very deed that the Lord has sent his angel and has delivered me out of the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews .
text_la: Et Petrus ad se reversus, dixit : Nunc scio vere quia misit Dominus angelum suum, et eripuit me de manu Herodis, et de omni exspectatione plebis Judæorum.
text_pt: E Pedro, tornando a si, disse: Agora sei verdadeiramente que o Senhor enviou o seu anjo, e me livrou da mão de Herodes, e de tudo o que o povo dos judeus esperava.
text_el: καὶ ὁ Πέτρος ἐν ἑαυτῷ γενόμενος εἶπεν, νῦν οἶδα ἀληθῶς ὅτι ἐξαπέστειλεν ὁ κύριος τὸν ἄγγελον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξείλατό με ἐκ χειρὸς Ἡρῴδου καὶ πάσης τῆς προσδοκίας τοῦ λαοῦ τῶν Ἰουδαίων.

text_en: And considering, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, who was surnamed Mark , where many were gathered together and praying .
text_la: Consideransque venit ad domum Mariæ matris Joannis, qui cognominatus est Marcus, ubi erant multi congregati, et orantes.
text_pt: E, considerando ele nisto, foi à casa de Maria, mãe de João, que tinha por sobrenome Marcos, onde muitos estavam reunidos e oravam.
text_el: συνιδών τε ἦλθεν ἐπὶ τὴν οἰκίαν τῆς Μαρίας τῆς μητρὸς Ἰωάννου τοῦ ἐπικαλουμένου Μάρκου, οὗ ἦσαν ἱκανοὶ συνηθροισμένοι καὶ προσευχόμενοι.

text_en: And when he knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken whose name was Rhode.
text_la: Pulsante autem eo ostium januæ, processit puella ad audiendum, nomine Rhode.
text_pt: E, batendo Pedro à porta do pátio, uma menina chamada Rode saiu a escutar;
text_el: κρούσαντος δὲ αὐτοῦ τὴν θύραν τοῦ πυλῶνος προσῆλθεν παιδίσκη ὑπακοῦσαι ὀνόματι Ῥόδη:

text_en: And as soon as she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for joy : but running in she told that Peter stood before the gate.
text_la: Et ut cognovit vocem Petri, præ gaudio non aperuit januam, sed intro currens nuntiavit stare Petrum ante januam.
text_pt: E, conhecendo a voz de Pedro, de gozo não abriu a porta, mas, correndo para dentro, anunciou que Pedro estava à porta.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιγνοῦσα τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ Πέτρου ἀπὸ τῆς χαρᾶς οὐκ ἤνοιξεν τὸν πυλῶνα, εἰσδραμοῦσα δὲ ἀπήγγειλεν ἑστάναι τὸν Πέτρον πρὸ τοῦ πυλῶνος.

text_en: But they said to her: You are mad . But she affirmed that it was so. Then said they: It is his angel .
text_la: At illi dixerunt ad eam : Insanis. Illa autem affirmabat sic se habere. Illi autem dicebant : Angelus ejus est.
text_pt: E disseram-lhe: Estás fora de ti. Mas ela afirmava que assim era. E diziam: É o seu anjo.
text_el: οἱ δὲ πρὸς αὐτὴν εἶπαν, μαίνῃ. ἡ δὲ διϊσχυρίζετο οὕτως ἔχειν. οἱ δὲ ἔλεγον, ὁ ἄγγελός ἐστιν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: But Peter continued knocking. And when they had opened, they saw him and were astonished.
text_la: Petrus autem perseverabat pulsans. Cum autem aperuissent, viderunt eum, et obstupuerunt.
text_pt: Mas Pedro perseverava em bater e, quando abriram, viram-no, e se espantaram.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἐπέμενεν κρούων: ἀνοίξαντες δὲ εἶδαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐξέστησαν.

text_en: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to hold their peace, told how the Lord had brought him out of prison . And he said: Tell these things to James and to the brethren. And going out, he went into another place.
text_la: Annuens autem eis manu ut tacerent, narravit quomodo Dominus eduxisset eum de carcere, dixitque : Nuntiate Jacobo et fratribus hæc. Et egressus abiit in alium locum.
text_pt: E acenando-lhes ele com a mão para que se calassem, contou-lhes como o Senhor o tirara da prisão, e disse: Anunciai isto a Tiago e aos irmãos. E, saindo, partiu para outro lugar.
text_el: κατασείσας δὲ αὐτοῖς τῇ χειρὶ σιγᾶν διηγήσατο αὐτοῖς πῶς ὁ κύριος αὐτὸν ἐξήγαγεν ἐκ τῆς φυλακῆς, εἶπέν τε, ἀπαγγείλατε Ἰακώβῳ καὶ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ταῦτα. καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐπορεύθη εἰς ἕτερον τόπον.

text_en: Now when day had come, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what had become of Peter .
text_la: Facta autem die, erat non parva turbatio inter milites, quidnam factum esset de Petro.
text_pt: E, sendo já dia, houve não pouco alvoroço entre os soldados sobre o que seria feito de Pedro.
text_el: γενομένης δὲ ἡμέρας ἦν τάραχος οὐκ ὀλίγος ἐν τοῖς στρατιώταις, τί ἄρα ὁ Πέτρος ἐγένετο.

text_en: And when Herod had sought for him and found him not, having examined the keepers, he commanded they should be put to death . And going down from Judea to Caesarea , he abode there.
text_la: Herodes autem cum requisisset eum et non invenisset, inquisitione facta de custodibus, jussit eos duci : descendensque a Judæa in Cæsaream, ibi commoratus est.
text_pt: E, quando Herodes o procurou e o não achou, feita inquirição aos guardas, mandou-os justiçar. E, partindo da Judéia para Cesaréia, ficou ali.
text_el: Ἡρῴδης δὲ ἐπιζητήσας αὐτὸν καὶ μὴ εὑρὼν, ἀνακρίνας τοὺς φύλακας ἐκέλευσεν ἀπαχθῆναι, καὶ κατελθὼν ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰουδαίας εἰς Καισάρειαν διέτριβεν.

text_en: And he was angry with the Tyrians and the Sidonians . But they with one accord came to him: and, having gained Blastus who was the king's chamberlain, they desired peace, because their countries were nourished by him.
text_la: Erat autem iratus Tyriis et Sidoniis. At illi unanimes venerunt ad eum, et persuaso Blasto, qui erat super cubiculum regis, postulabant pacem, eo quod alerentur regiones eorum ab illo.
text_pt: E ele estava irritado com os de Tiro e de Sidom; mas estes, vindo de comum acordo ter com ele, e obtendo a amizade de Blasto, que era o camarista do rei, pediam paz; porquanto o seu país se abastecia do país do rei.
text_el: ἦν δὲ θυμομαχῶν Τυρίοις καὶ Σιδωνίοις: ὁμοθυμαδὸν δὲ παρῆσαν πρὸς αὐτόν, καὶ πείσαντες Βλάστον τὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ κοιτῶνος τοῦ βασιλέως ᾐτοῦντο εἰρήνην, διὰ τὸ τρέφεσθαι αὐτῶν τὴν χώραν ἀπὸ τῆς βασιλικῆς.

text_en: And upon a day appointed, Herod being arrayed in kingly apparel, sat in the judgment seat and made an oration to them.
text_la: Statuto autem die Herodes vestitus veste regia sedit pro tribunali, et concionabatur ad eos.
text_pt: E num dia designado, vestindo Herodes as vestes reais, estava assentado no tribunal e lhes fez uma prática.
text_el: τακτῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ [ὁ] Ἡρῴδης ἐνδυσάμενος ἐσθῆτα βασιλικὴν καθίσας ἐπὶ τοῦ βήματος ἐδημηγόρει πρὸς αὐτούς:

text_en: And the people made acclamation, saying: It is the voice of a god, and not of a man .
text_la: Populus autem acclamabat : Dei voces, et non hominis.
text_pt: E o povo exclamava: Voz de Deus, e não de homem.
text_el: ὁ δὲ δῆμος ἐπεφώνει, θεοῦ φωνὴ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώπου.

text_en: And forthwith an angel of the Lord struck him, because he had not given the honour to God : and, being eaten up by worms, he gave up the ghost .
text_la: Confestim autem percussit eum angelus Domini, eo quod non dedisset honorem Deo : et consumptus a vermibus, expiravit.
text_pt: E no mesmo instante feriu-o o anjo do Senhor, porque não deu glória a Deus e, comido de bichos, expirou.
text_el: παραχρῆμα δὲ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν ἄγγελος κυρίου ἀνθ' ὧν οὐκ ἔδωκεν τὴν δόξαν τῷ θεῷ, καὶ γενόμενος σκωληκόβρωτος ἐξέψυξεν.

text_en: But the word of the Lord increased and multiplied.
text_la: Verbum autem Domini crescebat, et multiplicabatur.
text_pt: E a palavra de Deus crescia e se multiplicava.
text_el: ὁ δὲ λόγος τοῦ κυρίου ηὔξανεν καὶ ἐπληθύνετο.

text_en: And Barnabas and Saul , returned from Jerusalem , having fulfilled their ministry , taking with them John who was surnamed Mark .
text_la: Barnabas autem et Saulus reversi sunt ab Jerosolymis expleto ministerio assumpto Joanne, qui cognominatus est Marcus.
text_pt: E Barnabé e Saulo, havendo terminado aquele serviço, voltaram de Jerusalém, levando também consigo a João, que tinha por sobrenome Marcos.
text_el: Βαρναβᾶς δὲ καὶ Σαῦλος ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ πληρώσαντες τὴν διακονίαν, συμπαραλαβόντες Ἰωάννην τὸν ἐπικληθέντα Μᾶρκον.

text_en: Now there were in the church which was at Antioch prophets and doctors , among whom was Barnabas and Simon who was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene and Manahen who was the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch , and Saul .
text_la: Erant autem in ecclesia quæ erat Antiochiæ, prophetæ et doctores, in quibus Barnabas, et Simon qui vocabatur Niger, et Lucius Cyrenensis, et Manahen, qui erat Herodis Tetrarchæ collactaneus, et Saulus.
text_pt: E na igreja que estava em Antioquia havia alguns profetas e doutores, a saber: Barnabé e Simeão chamado Níger, e Lúcio, cireneu, e Manaém, que fora criado com Herodes o tetrarca, e Saulo.
text_el: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ κατὰ τὴν οὖσαν ἐκκλησίαν προφῆται καὶ διδάσκαλοι ὅ τε Βαρναβᾶς καὶ Συμεὼν ὁ καλούμενος Νίγερ, καὶ Λούκιος ὁ Κυρηναῖος, Μαναήν τε Ἡρῴδου τοῦ τετραάρχου σύντροφος καὶ Σαῦλος.

text_en: And as they were ministering to the Lord and fasting , the Holy Ghost said to them: Separate me Saul and Barnabas , for the work whereunto I have taken them.
text_la: Ministrantibus autem illis Domino, et jejunantibus, dixit illis Spiritus Sanctus : Segregate mihi Saulum et Barnabam in opus ad quod assumpsi eos.
text_pt: E, servindo eles ao Senhor, e jejuando, disse o Espírito Santo: Apartai-me a Barnabé e a Saulo para a obra a que os tenho chamado.
text_el: λειτουργούντων δὲ αὐτῶν τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ νηστευόντων εἶπεν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, ἀφορίσατε δή μοι τὸν Βαρναβᾶν καὶ Σαῦλον εἰς τὸ ἔργον ὃ προσκέκλημαι αὐτούς.

text_en: Then they fasting and praying and imposing their hands upon them, sent them away.
text_la: Tunc jejunantes et orantes, imponentesque eis manus, dimiserunt illos.
text_pt: Então, jejuando e orando, e pondo sobre eles as mãos, os despediram.
text_el: τότε νηστεύσαντες καὶ προσευξάμενοι καὶ ἐπιθέντες τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῖς ἀπέλυσαν.

text_en: So they, being sent by the Holy Ghost , went to Seleucia: and from thence they sailed to Cyprus .
text_la: Et ipsi quidem missi a Spiritu Sancto abierunt Seleuciam: et inde navigaverunt Cyprum.
text_pt: E assim estes, enviados pelo Espírito Santo, desceram a Selêucia e dali navegaram para Chipre.
text_el: αὐτοὶ μὲν οὖν ἐκπεμφθέντες ὑπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος κατῆλθον εἰς Σελεύκειαν, ἐκεῖθέν τε ἀπέπλευσαν εἰς Κύπρον,

text_en: And when they had come to Salamina, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews . And they had John also in the ministry .
text_la: Et cum venissent Salaminam, prædicabant verbum Dei in synagogis Judæorum. Habebant autem et Joannem in ministerio.
text_pt: E, chegados a Salamina, anunciavam a palavra de Deus nas sinagogas dos judeus; e tinham também a João como cooperador.
text_el: καὶ γενόμενοι ἐν Σαλαμῖνι κατήγγελλον τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς τῶν Ἰουδαίων: εἶχον δὲ καὶ Ἰωάννην ὑπηρέτην.

text_en: And when they had gone through the whole island, as far as Paphos , they found a certain man , a magician, a false prophet , a Jew , whose name was Bar-Jesu :
text_la: Et cum perambulassent universam insulam usque Paphum, invenerunt quemdam virum magum pseudoprophetam, Judæum, cui nomen erat Barjesu,
text_pt: E, havendo atravessado a ilha até Pafos, acharam um certo judeu mágico, falso profeta, chamado Barjesus,
text_el: διελθόντες δὲ ὅλην τὴν νῆσον ἄχρι Πάφου εὗρον ἄνδρα τινὰ μάγον ψευδοπροφήτην Ἰουδαῖον ᾧ ὄνομα Βαριησοῦς,

text_en: Who was with the proconsul Sergius Paulus, a prudent man . He, sending for Barnabas and Saul , desired to hear the word of God .
text_la: qui erat cum proconsule Sergio Paulo viro prudente. Hic, accersitis Barnaba et Saulo, desiderabat audire verbum Dei.
text_pt: O qual estava com o procônsul Sérgio Paulo, homem prudente. Este, chamando a si Barnabé e Saulo, procurava muito ouvir a palavra de Deus.
text_el: ὃς ἦν σὺν τῷ ἀνθυπάτῳ Σεργίῳ Παύλῳ, ἀνδρὶ συνετῷ. οὗτος προσκαλεσάμενος Βαρναβᾶν καὶ Σαῦλον ἐπεζήτησεν ἀκοῦσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ:

text_en: But Elymas the magician (for so his name is interpreted) withstood them, seeking to turn away the proconsul from the faith .
text_la: Resistebat autem illis Elymas magus (sic enim interpretatur nomen ejus), quærens avertere proconsulem a fide.
text_pt: Mas resistia-lhes Elimas, o encantador (porque assim se interpreta o seu nome), procurando apartar da fé o procônsul.
text_el: ἀνθίστατο δὲ αὐτοῖς Ἐλύμας ὁ μάγος, οὕτως γὰρ μεθερμηνεύεται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, ζητῶν διαστρέψαι τὸν ἀνθύπατον ἀπὸ τῆς πίστεως.

text_en: Then Saul, otherwise Paul , filled with the Holy Ghost , looking upon him,
text_la: Saulus autem, qui et Paulus, repletus Spiritu Sancto, intuens in eum,
text_pt: Todavia Saulo, que também se chama Paulo, cheio do Espírito Santo, e fixando os olhos nele,
text_el: Σαῦλος δέ, ὁ καὶ Παῦλος, πλησθεὶς πνεύματος ἁγίου ἀτενίσας εἰς αὐτὸν

text_en: said: O full of all guile and of all deceit , child of the devil , enemy of all justice , you cease not to pervert the right ways of the Lord .
text_la: dixit : O plene omni dolo et omni fallacia, fili diaboli, inimice omnis justitiæ, non desinis subvertere vias Domini rectas.
text_pt: Disse: Ó filho do diabo, cheio de todo o engano e de toda a malícia, inimigo de toda a justiça, não cessarás de perturbar os retos caminhos do Senhor?
text_el: εἶπεν, ὦ πλήρης παντὸς δόλου καὶ πάσης ῥᾳδιουργίας, υἱὲ διαβόλου, ἐχθρὲ πάσης δικαιοσύνης, οὐ παύσῃ διαστρέφων τὰς ὁδοὺς τοῦ κυρίου τὰς εὐθείας;

text_en: And now behold, the hand of the Lord is upon you: and you shall be blind, not seeing the sun for a time. And immediately there fell a mist and darkness upon him: and going about, he sought some one to lead him by the hand.
text_la: Et nunc ecce manus Domini super te, et eris cæcus, non videns solem usque ad tempus. Et confestim cecidit in eum caligo et tenebræ : et circuiens quærebat qui ei manum daret.
text_pt: Eis aí, pois, agora contra ti a mão do Senhor, e ficarás cego, sem ver o sol por algum tempo. E no mesmo instante a escuridão e as trevas caíram sobre ele e, andando à roda, buscava a quem o guiasse pela mão.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ χεὶρ κυρίου ἐπὶ σέ, καὶ ἔσῃ τυφλὸς μὴ βλέπων τὸν ἥλιον ἄχρι καιροῦ. παραχρῆμά δὲ ἔπεσεν ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἀχλὺς καὶ σκότος, καὶ περιάγων ἐζήτει χειραγωγούς.

text_en: Then the proconsul, when he had seen what was done, believed , admiring at the doctrine of the Lord .
text_la: Tunc proconsul cum vidisset factum, credidit admirans super doctrina Domini.
text_pt: Então o procônsul, vendo o que havia acontecido, creu, maravilhado da doutrina do Senhor.
text_el: τότε ἰδὼν ὁ ἀνθύπατος τὸ γεγονὸς ἐπίστευσεν ἐκπλησσόμενος ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ τοῦ κυρίου.

text_en: Now when Paul and they that were with him had sailed from Paphos , they came to Perge in Pamphylia. And John departing from them, returned to Jerusalem .
text_la: Et cum a Papho navigassent Paulus et qui cum eo erant, venerunt Pergen Pamphyliæ. Joannes autem discedens ab eis, reversus est Jerosolymam.
text_pt: E, partindo de Pafos, Paulo e os que estavam com ele chegaram a Perge, da Panfília. Mas João, apartando-se deles, voltou para Jerusalém.
text_el: Ἀναχθέντες δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς Πάφου οἱ περὶ Παῦλον ἦλθον εἰς Πέργην τῆς Παμφυλίας: Ἰωάννης δὲ ἀποχωρήσας ἀπ' αὐτῶν ὑπέστρεψεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

text_en: But they, passing through Perge , came to Antioch in Pisidia : and, entering into the Synagogue on the sabbath day , they sat down.
text_la: Illi vero pertranseuntes Pergen, venerunt Antiochiam Pisidiæ : et ingressi synagogam die sabbatorum, sederunt.
text_pt: E eles, saindo de Perge, chegaram a Antioquia, da Pisídia, e, entrando na sinagoga, num dia de sábado, assentaram-se;
text_el: αὐτοὶ δὲ διελθόντες ἀπὸ τῆς Πέργης παρεγένοντο εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν τὴν Πισιδίαν, καὶ ἐλθόντες εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων ἐκάθισαν.

text_en: And after the reading of the law and the prophets , the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying: You men , brethren, if you have any word of exhortation to make to the people, speak.
text_la: Post lectionem autem legis et prophetarum, miserunt principes synagogæ ad eos, dicentes : Viri fratres, si quis est in vobis sermo exhortationis ad plebem, dicite.
text_pt: E, depois da lição da lei e dos profetas, lhes mandaram dizer os principais da sinagoga: Homens irmãos, se tendes alguma palavra de consolação para o povo, falai.
text_el: μετὰ δὲ τὴν ἀνάγνωσιν τοῦ νόμου καὶ τῶν προφητῶν ἀπέστειλαν οἱ ἀρχισυνάγωγοι πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγοντες, ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, εἴ τίς ἐστιν ἐν ὑμῖν λόγος παρακλήσεως πρὸς τὸν λαόν, λέγετε.

text_en: Then Paul rising up and with his hand bespeaking silence, said: You men of Israel and you that fear God , give ear.
text_la: Surgens autem Paulus, et manu silentium indicens, ait : Viri Israëlitæ, et qui timetis Deum, audite:
text_pt: E, levantando-se Paulo, e pedindo silêncio com a mão, disse: Homens israelitas, e os que temeis a Deus, ouvi:
text_el: ἀναστὰς δὲ Παῦλος καὶ κατασείσας τῇ χειρὶ εἶπεν: ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται καὶ οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν θεόν, ἀκούσατε.

text_en: The God of the people of Israel chose our fathers and exalted the people when they were sojourners in the land of Egypt : And with an high arm brought them out from thence:
text_la: Deus plebis Israël elegit patres nostros, et plebem exaltavit cum essent incolæ in terra Ægypti, et in brachio excelso eduxit eos ex ea,
text_pt: O Deus deste povo de Israel escolheu a nossos pais, e exaltou o povo, sendo eles estrangeiros na terra do Egito; e com braço poderoso os tirou dela;
text_el: ὁ θεὸς τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου Ἰσραὴλ ἐξελέξατο τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν, καὶ τὸν λαὸν ὕψωσεν ἐν τῇ παροικίᾳ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου, καὶ μετὰ βραχίονος ὑψηλοῦ ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἐξ αὐτῆς,

text_en: And for the space of forty years endured their manners in the desert :
text_la: et per quadraginta annorum tempus mores eorum sustinuit in deserto.
text_pt: E suportou os seus costumes no deserto por espaço de quase quarenta anos.
text_el: καὶ ὡς τεσσερακονταετῆ χρόνον ἐτροποφόρησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ,

text_en: And, destroying seven nations in the land of Chanaan , divided their land among them by lot .
text_la: Et destruens gentes septem in terra Chanaan, sorte distribuit eis terram eorum,
text_pt: E, destruindo a sete nações na terra de Canaã, deu-lhes por sorte a terra deles.
text_el: καθελὼν ἔθνη ἑπτὰ ἐν γῇ Χανάαν κατεκληρονόμησεν τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν

text_en: As it were, after four hundred and fifty years. And after these things, he gave unto them judges, until Samuel the prophet .
text_la: quasi post quadringentos et quinquaginta annos : et post hæc dedit judices, usque ad Samuel prophetam.
text_pt: E, depois disto, por quase quatrocentos e cinqüenta anos, lhes deu juízes, até ao profeta Samuel.
text_el: ὡς ἔτεσιν τετρακοσίοις καὶ πεντήκοντα. καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἔδωκεν κριτὰς ἕως Σαμουὴλ προφήτου.

text_en: And after that they desired a king: and God gave them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin , forty years.
text_la: Et exinde postulaverunt regem : et dedit illis Deus Saul filium Cis, virum de tribu Benjamin, annis quadraginta:
text_pt: E depois pediram um rei, e Deus lhes deu por quarenta anos, a Saul filho de Cis, homem da tribo de Benjamim.
text_el: κἀκεῖθεν ᾐτήσαντο βασιλέα, καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς τὸν Σαοὺλ υἱὸν Κίς, ἄνδρα ἐκ φυλῆς Βενιαμίν, ἔτη τεσσεράκοντα.

text_en: And when he had removed him, he raised them up David to be king: to whom giving testimony, he said: I have found David , the son of Jesse, a man according to my own heart, who shall do all my wills.
text_la: et amoto illo, suscitavit illis David regem : cui testimonium perhibens, dixit : Inveni David filium Jesse, virum secundum cor meum, qui faciet omnes voluntates meas.
text_pt: E, quando este foi retirado, levantou-lhes como rei a Davi, ao qual também deu testemunho, e disse: Achei a Davi, filho de Jessé, homem conforme o meu coração, que executará toda a minha vontade.
text_el: καὶ μεταστήσας αὐτὸν ἤγειρεν τὸν Δαυὶδ αὐτοῖς εἰς βασιλέα, ᾧ καὶ εἶπεν μαρτυρήσας, εὗρον Δαυὶδ τὸν τοῦ Ἰεσσαί, [ἄνδρα] κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν μου, ὃς ποιήσει πάντα τὰ θελήματά μου.

text_en: Of this man's seed, God , according to his promise , has raised up to Israel a Saviour Jesus :
text_la: Hujus Deus ex semine secundum promissionem eduxit Israël salvatorem Jesum,
text_pt: Da descendência deste, conforme a promessa, levantou Deus a Jesus para Salvador de Israel;
text_el: τούτου ὁ θεὸς ἀπὸ τοῦ σπέρματος κατ' ἐπαγγελίαν ἤγαγεν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ σωτῆρα Ἰησοῦν,

text_en: John first preaching, before his coming, the baptism of penance to all the people of Israel .
text_la: prædicante Joanne ante faciem adventus ejus baptismum pœnitentiæ omni populo Israël.
text_pt: Tendo primeiramente João, antes da vinda dele, pregado a todo o povo de Israel o batismo de arrependimento.
text_el: προκηρύξαντος Ἰωάννου πρὸ προσώπου τῆς εἰσόδου αὐτοῦ βάπτισμα μετανοίας παντὶ τῷ λαῷ Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: And when John was fulfilling his course, he said: I am not he whom you think me to be. But behold, there comes one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
text_la: Cum impleret autem Joannes cursum suum, dicebat : Quem me arbitramini esse, non sum ego : sed ecce venit post me, cujus non sum dignus calceamenta pedum solvere.
text_pt: Mas João, quando completava a carreira, disse: Quem pensais vós que eu sou? Eu não sou o Cristo; mas eis que após mim vem aquele a quem não sou digno de desatar as alparcas dos pés.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐπλήρου Ἰωάννης τὸν δρόμον, ἔλεγεν: τί ἐμὲ ὑπονοεῖτε εἶναι, οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐγώ: ἀλλ' ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται μετ' ἐμὲ οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἄξιος τὸ ὑπόδημα τῶν ποδῶν λῦσαι.

text_en: Men, brethren, children of the stock of Abraham , and whosoever among you fear God : to you the word of this salvation is sent.
text_la: Viri fratres, filii generis Abraham, et qui in vobis timent Deum, vobis verbum salutis hujus missum est.
text_pt: Homens irmãos, filhos da geração de Abraão, e os que dentre vós temem a Deus, a vós vos é enviada a palavra desta salvação.
text_el: ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, υἱοὶ γένους Ἀβραὰμ καὶ οἱ ἐν ὑμῖν φοβούμενοι τὸν θεόν, ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος τῆς σωτηρίας ταύτης ἐξαπεστάλη.

text_en: For they that inhabited Jerusalem and the rulers thereof, not knowing him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath , judging him, have fulfilled them.
text_la: Qui enim habitabant Jerusalem, et principes ejus hunc ignorantes, et voces prophetarum quæ per omne sabbatum leguntur, judicantes impleverunt,
text_pt: Por não terem conhecido a este, os que habitavam em Jerusalém, e os seus príncipes, condenaram-no, cumprindo assim as vozes dos profetas que se lêem todos os sábados.
text_el: οἱ γὰρ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῶν τοῦτον ἀγνοήσαντες καὶ τὰς φωνὰς τῶν προφητῶν τὰς κατὰ πᾶν σάββατον ἀναγινωσκομένας κρίναντες ἐπλήρωσαν,

text_en: And finding no cause of death in him, they desired of Pilate that they might kill him.
text_la: et nullam causam mortis invenientes in eo, petierunt a Pilato ut interficerent eum.
text_pt: E, embora não achassem alguma causa de morte, pediram a Pilatos que ele fosse morto.
text_el: καὶ μηδεμίαν αἰτίαν θανάτου εὑρόντες ᾐτήσαντο Πιλᾶτον ἀναιρεθῆναι αὐτόν:

text_en: And when they had fulfilled all things that were written of him, taking him down from the tree , they laid him in a sepulchre .
text_la: Cumque consummassent omnia quæ de eo scripta erant, deponentes eum de ligno, posuerunt eum in monumento.
text_pt: E, havendo eles cumprido todas as coisas que dele estavam escritas, tirando-o do madeiro, o puseram na sepultura;
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐτέλεσαν πάντα τὰ περὶ αὐτοῦ γεγραμμένα, καθελόντες ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου ἔθηκαν εἰς μνημεῖον.

text_en: But God raised him up from the dead the third day.
text_la: Deus vero suscitavit eum a mortuis tertia die: qui visus est per dies multos his
text_pt: Mas Deus o ressuscitou dentre os mortos.
text_el: ὁ δὲ θεὸς ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν:

text_en: Who was seen for many days by them who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem , who to this present are his witnesses to the people.
text_la: qui simul ascenderant cum eo de Galilæa in Jerusalem : qui usque nunc sunt testes ejus ad plebem.
text_pt: E ele por muitos dias foi visto pelos que subiram com ele da Galiléia a Jerusalém, e são suas testemunhas para com o povo.
text_el: ὃς ὤφθη ἐπὶ ἡμέρας πλείους τοῖς συναναβᾶσιν αὐτῷ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, οἵτινες νῦν εἰσιν μάρτυρες αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν λαόν.

text_en: And we declare unto you that the promise which was made to our fathers,
text_la: Et nos vobis annuntiamus eam, quæ ad patres nostros repromissio facta est:
text_pt: E nós vos anunciamos que a promessa que foi feita aos pais, Deus a cumpriu a nós, seus filhos, ressuscitando a Jesus;
text_el: καὶ ἡμεῖς ὑμᾶς εὐαγγελιζόμεθα τὴν πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ἐπαγγελίαν γενομένην,

text_en: this same God has fulfilled to our children, raising up Jesus , as in the second psalm also is written: You are my Son : this day have I begotten you.
text_la: quoniam hanc Deus adimplevit filiis nostris resuscitans Jesum, sicut et in psalmo secundo scriptum est : Filius meus es tu, ego hodie genui te.
text_pt: Como também está escrito no salmo segundo: Meu filho és tu, hoje te gerei.
text_el: ὅτι ταύτην ὁ θεὸς ἐκπεπλήρωκεν τοῖς τέκνοις ἡμῶν ἀναστήσας Ἰησοῦν, ὡς καὶ ἐν τῷ ψαλμῷ γέγραπται τῷ δευτέρῳ: υἱός μου εἶ σύ, ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε.

text_en: And to show that he raised him up from the dead , not to return now any more to corruption, he said thus: I will give you the holy things of David , faithful.
text_la: Quod autem suscitavit eum a mortuis, amplius jam non reversurum in corruptionem, ita dixit : Quia dabo vobis sancta David fidelia.
text_pt: E que o ressuscitaria dentre os mortos, para nunca mais tornar à corrupção, disse-o assim: As santas e fiéis bênçãos de Davi vos darei.
text_el: ὅτι δὲ ἀνέστησεν αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν μηκέτι μέλλοντα ὑποστρέφειν εἰς διαφθοράν, οὕτως εἴρηκεν ὅτι δώσω ὑμῖν τὰ ὅσια Δαυὶδ τὰ πιστά.

text_en: And therefore, in another place also, he says: You shall not suffer your holy one to see corruption.
text_la: Ideoque et alias dicit: Non dabis sanctum tuum videre corruptionem.
text_pt: Por isso também em outro salmo diz: Não permitirás que o teu santo veja corrupção.
text_el: διότι καὶ ἐν ἑτέρῳ λέγει, οὐ δώσεις τὸν ὅσιόν σου ἰδεῖν διαφθοράν.

text_en: For David , when he had served in his generation , according to the will of God , slept: and was laid unto his fathers and saw corruption.
text_la: David enim in sua generatione cum administrasset, voluntati Dei dormivit : et appositus est ad patres suos, et vidit corruptionem.
text_pt: Porque, na verdade, tendo Davi no seu tempo servido conforme a vontade de Deus, dormiu, foi posto junto de seus pais e viu a corrupção.
text_el: Δαυὶδ μὲν γὰρ ἰδίᾳ γενεᾷ ὑπηρετήσας τῇ τοῦ θεοῦ βουλῇ ἐκοιμήθη καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶδεν διαφθοράν,

text_en: But he whom God has raised from the dead saw no corruption.
text_la: Quem vero Deus suscitavit a mortuis, non vidit corruptionem.
text_pt: Mas aquele a quem Deus ressuscitou nenhuma corrupção viu.
text_el: ὃν δὲ ὁ θεὸς ἤγειρεν οὐκ εἶδεν διαφθοράν.

text_en: Be it known therefore to you, men , brethren, that through him forgiveness of sins is preached to you: and from all the things from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses .
