text_la: Notum igitur sit vobis, viri fratres, quia per hunc vobis remissio peccatorum annuntiatur, et ab omnibus quibus non potuistis in lege Moysi justificari,
text_pt: Seja-vos, pois, notório, homens irmàos, que por este se vos anuncia a remissão dos pecados.
text_el: γνωστὸν οὖν ἔστω ὑμῖν, ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, ὅτι διὰ τούτου ὑμῖν ἄφεσις ἁμαρτιῶν καταγγέλλεται καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν οὐκ ἠδυνήθητε ἐν νόμῳ Μωϋσέως δικαιωθῆναι

text_en: In him every one that believes is justified .
text_la: in hoc omnis qui credit, justificatur.
text_pt: E de tudo o que, pela lei de Moisés, não pudestes ser justificados, por ele é justificado todo aquele que crê.
text_el: ἐν τούτῳ πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων δικαιοῦται.

text_en: Beware, therefore, lest that come upon you which is spoken in the prophets :
text_la: Videte ergo ne superveniat vobis quod dictum est in prophetis:
text_pt: Vede, pois, que não venha sobre vós o que está dito nos profetas:
text_el: βλέπετε οὖν μὴ ἐπέλθῃ τὸ εἰρημένον ἐν τοῖς προφήταις,

text_en: Behold, you despisers , and wonder and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which you will not believe , if any man shall tell it you.
text_la: Videte contemptores, et admiramini, et disperdimini : quia opus operor ego in diebus vestris, opus quod non credetis, si quis enarraverit vobis.
text_pt: Vede, ó desprezadores, e espantai-vos e desaparecei;porque opero uma obra em vossos dias,ora tal que não crereis, se alguém vo-la contar.
text_el: ἴδετε, οἱ καταφρονηταί, καὶ θαυμάσατε καὶ ἀφανίσθητε, ὅτι ἔργον ἐργάζομαι ἐγὼ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ὑμῶν, ἔργον ὃ οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε ἐάν τις ἐκδιηγῆται ὑμῖν.

text_en: And as they went out, they desired them that on the next sabbath they would speak unto them these words.
text_la: Exeuntibus autem illis rogabant ut sequenti sabbato loquerentur sibi verba hæc.
text_pt: E, saídos os judeus da sinagoga, os gentios rogaram que no sábado seguinte lhes fossem ditas as mesmas coisas.
text_el: Ἐξιόντων δὲ αὐτῶν παρεκάλουν εἰς τὸ μεταξὺ σάββατον λαληθῆναι αὐτοῖς τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα.

text_en: And when the synagogue was broken up, many of the Jews and of the strangers who served God followed Paul and Barnabas : who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God .
text_la: Cumque dimissa esset synagoga, secuti sunt multi Judæorum, et colentium advenarum, Paulum et Barnabam : qui loquentes suadebant eis ut permanerent in gratia Dei.
text_pt: E, despedida a sinagoga, muitos dos judeus e dos prosélitos religiosos seguiram Paulo e Barnabé; os quais, falando-lhes, os exortavam a que permanecessem na graça de Deus.
text_el: λυθείσης δὲ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἠκολούθησαν πολλοὶ τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ τῶν σεβομένων προσηλύτων τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ τῷ Βαρναβᾷ, οἵτινες προσλαλοῦντες αὐτοῖς ἔπειθον αὐτοὺς προσμένειν τῇ χάριτι τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: But the next sabbath day , the whole city almost came together, to hear the word of God .
text_la: Sequenti vero sabbato pene universa civitas convenit audire verbum Dei.
text_pt: E no sábado seguinte ajuntou-se quase toda a cidade para ouvir a palavra de Deus.
text_el: τῷ δὲ ἐρχομένῳ σαββάτῳ σχεδὸν πᾶσα ἡ πόλις συνήχθη ἀκοῦσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And the Jews , seeing the multitudes, were filled with envy and contradicted those things which were said by Paul , blaspheming .
text_la: Videntes autem turbas Judæi, repleti sunt zelo, et contradicebant his quæ a Paulo dicebantur, blasphemantes.
text_pt: Então os judeus, vendo a multidão, encheram-se de inveja e, blasfemando, contradiziam o que Paulo falava.
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τοὺς ὄχλους ἐπλήσθησαν ζήλου, καὶ ἀντέλεγον τοῖς ὑπὸ Παύλου λαλουμένοις βλασφημοῦντες.

text_en: Then Paul and Barnabas said boldly: To you it behoved us first to speak the word of God : but because you reject it and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold we turn to the Gentiles .
text_la: Tunc constanter Paulus et Barnabas dixerunt : Vobis oportebat primum loqui verbum Dei : sed quoniam repellitis illud, et indignos vos judicatis æternæ vitæ, ecce convertimur ad gentes.
text_pt: Mas Paulo e Barnabé, usando de ousadia, disseram: Era mister que a vós se vos pregasse primeiro a palavra de Deus; mas, visto que a rejeitais, e não vos julgais dignos da vida eterna, eis que nos voltamos para os gentios;
text_el: παρρησιασάμενοί τε ὁ Παῦλος καὶ ὁ Βαρναβᾶς εἶπαν: ὑμῖν ἦν ἀναγκαῖον πρῶτον λαληθῆναι τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ: ἐπειδὴ ἀπωθεῖσθε αὐτὸν καὶ οὐκ ἀξίους κρίνετε ἑαυτοὺς τῆς αἰωνίου ζωῆς, ἰδοὺ στρεφόμεθα εἰς τὰ ἔθνη.

text_en: For so the Lord has commanded us: I have set you to be the light of the Gentiles : that you may be for salvation unto the utmost part of the earth.
text_la: Sic enim præcepit nobis Dominus : Posui te in lucem gentium, ut sis in salutem usque ad extremum terræ.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor assim no-lo mandou:eu te pus para luz dos gentios,a fim de que sejas para salvação até os confins da terra.
text_el: οὕτως γὰρ ἐντέταλται ἡμῖν ὁ κύριος, τέθεικά σε εἰς φῶς ἐθνῶν τοῦ εἶναί σε εἰς σωτηρίαν ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς.

text_en: And the Gentiles hearing it were glad and glorified the word of the Lord : and as many as were ordained to life everlasting believed .
text_la: Audientes autem gentes, gavisæ sunt, et glorificabant verbum Domini : et crediderunt quotquot erant præordinati ad vitam æternam.
text_pt: E os gentios, ouvindo isto, alegraram-se, e glorificavam a palavra do Senhor; e creram todos quantos estavam ordenados para a vida eterna.
text_el: ἀκούοντα δὲ τὰ ἔθνη ἔχαιρον καὶ ἐδόξαζον τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅσοι ἦσαν τεταγμένοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον:

text_en: And the word of the Lord was published throughout the whole country.
text_la: Disseminabatur autem verbum Domini per universam regionem.
text_pt: E a palavra do Senhor se divulgava por toda aquela província.
text_el: διεφέρετο δὲ ὁ λόγος τοῦ κυρίου δι'' ὅλης τῆς χώρας.

text_en: But the Jews stirred up religious and honourable women and the chief men of the city: and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas : and cast them out of their coasts.
text_la: Judæi autem concitaverunt mulieres religiosas et honestas, et primos civitatis, et excitaverunt persecutionem in Paulum et Barnabam : et ejecerunt eos de finibus suis.
text_pt: Mas os judeus incitaram algumas mulheres religiosas e honestas, e os principais da cidade, e levantaram perseguição contra Paulo e Barnabé, e os lançaram fora dos seus termos.
text_el: οἱ δὲ Ἰουδαῖοι παρώτρυναν τὰς σεβομένας γυναῖκας τὰς εὐσχήμονας καὶ τοὺς πρώτους τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐπήγειραν διωγμὸν ἐπὶ τὸν Παῦλον καὶ Βαρναβᾶν, καὶ ἐξέβαλον αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν.

text_en: But they, shaking off the dust of their feet against them, came to Iconium .
text_la: At illi excusso pulvere pedum in eos, venerunt Iconium.
text_pt: Sacudindo, porém, contra eles o pó dos seus pés, partiram para Icônio.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐκτιναξάμενοι τὸν κονιορτὸν τῶν ποδῶν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἦλθον εἰς Ἰκόνιον,

text_en: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Discipuli quoque replebantur gaudio, et Spiritu Sancto.
text_pt: E os discípulos estavam cheios de alegria e do Espírito Santo.
text_el: οἵ τε μαθηταὶ ἐπληροῦντο χαρᾶς καὶ πνεύματος ἁγίου.

text_en: And it came to pass in Iconium that they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews and so spoke that a very great multitude both of the Jews and of the Greeks did believe .
text_la: Factum est autem Iconii, ut simul introirent in synagogam Judæorum, et loquerentur, ita ut crederet Judæorum et Græcorum copiosa multitudo.
text_pt: E aconteceu que em Icônio entraram juntos na sinagoga dos judeus, e falaram de tal modo que creu uma grande multidão, não só de judeus mas de gregos.
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν Ἰκονίῳ κατὰ τὸ αὐτὸ εἰσελθεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ λαλῆσαι οὕτως ὥστε πιστεῦσαι Ἰουδαίων τε καὶ Ἑλλήνων πολὺ πλῆθος.

text_en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up and incensed the minds of the Gentiles against the brethren.
text_la: Qui vero increduli fuerunt Judæi, suscitaverunt et ad iracundiam concitaverunt animas gentium adversus fratres.
text_pt: Mas os judeus incrédulos incitaram e irritaram, contra os irmãos, os ânimos dos gentios.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀπειθήσαντες Ἰουδαῖοι ἐπήγειραν καὶ ἐκάκωσαν τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν ἐθνῶν κατὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν.

text_en: A long time therefore they abode there, dealing confidently in the Lord , who gave testimony to the word of his grace , granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
text_la: Multo igitur tempore demorati sunt, fiducialiter agentes in Domino, testimonium perhibente verbo gratiæ suæ, dante signa et prodigia fieri per manus eorum.
text_pt: Detiveram-se, pois, muito tempo, falando ousadamente acerca do Senhor, o qual dava testemunho à palavra da sua graça, permitindo que por suas mãos se fizessem sinais e prodígios.
text_el: ἱκανὸν μὲν οὖν χρόνον διέτριψαν παρρησιαζόμενοι ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ τῷ μαρτυροῦντι τῷ λόγῳ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ, διδόντι σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα γίνεσθαι διὰ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν.

text_en: And the multitude of the city was divided. And some of them indeed held with the Jews , but some with the apostles .
text_la: Divisa est autem multitudo civitatis : et quidam quidem erant cum Judæis, quidam vero cum Apostolis.
text_pt: E dividiu-se a multidão da cidade; e uns eram pelos judeus, e outros pelos apóstolos.
text_el: ἐσχίσθη δὲ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς πόλεως, καὶ οἱ μὲν ἦσαν σὺν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις οἱ δὲ σὺν τοῖς ἀποστόλοις.

text_en: And when there was an assault made by the Gentiles and the Jews with their rulers, to use them contumeliously and to stone them:
text_la: Cum autem factus esset impetus gentilium et Judæorum cum principibus suis, ut contumeliis afficerent, et lapidarent eos,
text_pt: E havendo um motim, tanto dos judeus como dos gentios, com os seus principais, para os insultarem e apedrejarem,
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐγένετο ὁρμὴ τῶν ἐθνῶν τε καὶ Ἰουδαίων σὺν τοῖς ἄρχουσιν αὐτῶν ὑβρίσαι καὶ λιθοβολῆσαι αὐτούς,

text_en: They, understanding it, fled to Lystra and Derbe , cities of Lycaonia, and to the whole country round about: and were there preaching the gospel .
text_la: intelligentes confugerunt ad civitates Lycaoniæ Lystram et Derben, et universam in circuitu regionem, et ibi evangelizantes erant.
text_pt: Sabendo-o eles, fugiram para Listra e Derbe, cidades de Licaônia, e para a província circunvizinha;
text_el: συνιδόντες κατέφυγον εἰς τὰς πόλεις τῆς Λυκαονίας Λύστραν καὶ Δέρβην καὶ τὴν περίχωρον,

text_en: And there sat a certain man at Lystra , impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked.
text_la: Et quidam vir Lystris infirmus pedibus sedebat, claudus ex utero matris suæ, qui numquam ambulaverat.
text_pt: E ali pregavam o evangelho.
text_el: κἀκεῖ εὐαγγελιζόμενοι ἦσαν. Καί τις ἀνὴρ ἀδύνατος ἐν Λύστροις τοῖς ποσὶν ἐκάθητο, χωλὸς ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτοῦ, ὃς οὐδέποτε περιεπάτησεν.

text_en: This same heard Paul speaking. Who looking upon him and seeing that he had faith to be healed,
text_la: Hic audivit Paulum loquentem. Qui intuitus eum, et videns quia fidem haberet ut salvus fieret,
text_pt: E estava assentado em Listra certo homem leso dos pés, coxo desde o ventre de sua mãe, o qual nunca tinha andado.
text_el: οὗτος ἤκουεν τοῦ Παύλου λαλοῦντος, ὃς ἀτενίσας αὐτῷ καὶ ἰδὼν ὅτι ἔχει πίστιν τοῦ σωθῆναι,

text_en: said with a loud voice: Stand upright on your feet. And he leaped up and walked.
text_la: dixit magna voce : Surge super pedes tuos rectus. Et exilivit, et ambulabat.
text_pt: Este ouviu falar Paulo, que, fixando nele os olhos, e vendo que tinha fé para ser curado,
text_el: εἶπεν μεγάλῃ φωνῇ: ἀνάστηθι ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας σου ὀρθός. καὶ ἥλατο καὶ περιεπάτει.

text_en: And when the multitudes had seen what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice in the Lycaonian tongue, saying: The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men .
text_la: Turbæ autem cum vidissent quod fecerat Paulus, levaverunt vocem suam lycaonice, dicentes : Dii similes facti hominibus descenderunt ad nos.
text_pt: Disse em voz alta: Levanta-te direito sobre teus pés. E ele saltou e andou.
text_el: οἵ τε ὄχλοι ἰδόντες ὃ ἐποίησεν Παῦλος ἐπῆραν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτῶν Λυκαονιστὶ λέγοντες, οἱ θεοὶ ὁμοιωθέντες ἀνθρώποις κατέβησαν πρὸς ἡμᾶς:

text_en: And they called Barnabas , Jupiter: but Paul , Mercury: because he was chief speaker.
text_la: Et vocabant Barnabam Jovem, Paulum vero Mercurium : quoniam ipse erat dux verbi.
text_pt: E as multidões, vendo o que Paulo fizera, levantaram a sua voz, dizendo em língua licaônica: Fizeram-se os deuses semelhantes aos homens, e desceram até nós.
text_el: ἐκάλουν τε τὸν Βαρναβᾶν Δία, τὸν δὲ Παῦλον Ἑρμῆν, ἐπειδὴ αὐτὸς ἦν ὁ ἡγούμενος τοῦ λόγου.

text_en: The priest also of Jupiter that was before the city, bringing oxen and garlands before the gate, would have offered sacrifice with the people.
text_la: Sacerdos quoque Jovis, qui erat ante civitatem, tauros et coronas ante januas afferens, cum populis volebat sacrificare.
text_pt: E chamavam Júpiter a Barnabé, e Mercúrio a Paulo; porque este era o que falava.
text_el: ὅ τε ἱερεὺς τοῦ Διὸς τοῦ ὄντος πρὸ τῆς πόλεως ταύρους καὶ στέμματα ἐπὶ τοὺς πυλῶνας ἐνέγκας σὺν τοῖς ὄχλοις ἤθελεν θύειν.

text_en: Which, when the apostles Barnabas and Paul had heard, rending their clothes, they leaped out among the people, crying,
text_la: Quod ubi audierunt Apostoli, Barnabas et Paulus, conscissis tunicis suis exilierunt in turbas, clamantes
text_pt: E o sacerdote de Júpiter, cujo templo estava em frente da cidade, trazendo para a entrada da porta touros e grinaldas, queria com a multidão sacrificar-lhes.
text_el: ἀκούσαντες δὲ οἱ ἀπόστολοι Βαρναβᾶς καὶ Παῦλος, διαρρήξαντες τὰ ἱμάτια ἑαυτῶν ἐξεπήδησαν εἰς τὸν ὄχλον, κράζοντες

text_en: and saying: You men , why do you do these things? We also are mortals, men like unto you, preaching to you to be converted from these vain things to the living God , who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and all things that are in them:
text_la: et dicentes : Viri, quid hæc facitis? et nos mortales sumus, similes vobis homines, annuntiantes vobis ab his vanis converti ad Deum vivum, qui fecit cælum, et terram, et mare, et omnia quæ in eis sunt:
text_pt: Ouvindo, porém, isto os apóstolos Barnabé e Paulo, rasgaram as suas vestes, e saltaram para o meio da multidão, clamando,
text_el: καὶ λέγοντες, ἄνδρες, τί ταῦτα ποιεῖτε; καὶ ἡμεῖς ὁμοιοπαθεῖς ἐσμεν ὑμῖν ἄνθρωποι, εὐαγγελιζόμενοι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τούτων τῶν ματαίων ἐπιστρέφειν ἐπὶ θεὸν ζῶντα ὃς ἐποίησεν τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς:

text_en: Who in times past, suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
text_la: qui in præteritis generationibus dimisit omnes gentes ingredi vias suas.
text_pt: E dizendo: Senhores, por que fazeis essas coisas? Nós também somos homens como vós, sujeitos às mesmas paixões, e vos anunciamos que vos convertais dessas vaidades ao Deus vivo, que fez o céu, e a terra, o mar, e tudo quanto há neles;
text_el: ὃς ἐν ταῖς παρῳχημέναις γενεαῖς εἴασεν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη πορεύεσθαι ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν:

text_en: Nevertheless he left not himself without testimony, doing good from heaven , giving rains and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
text_la: Et quidem non sine testimonio semetipsum reliquit benefaciens de cælo, dans pluvias et tempora fructifera, implens cibo et lætitia corda nostra.
text_pt: O qual nos tempos passados deixou andar todas as nações em seus próprios caminhos.
text_el: καίτοι οὐκ ἀμάρτυρον αὐτὸν ἀφῆκεν ἀγαθουργῶν, οὐρανόθεν ὑμῖν ὑετοὺς διδοὺς καὶ καιροὺς καρποφόρους, ἐμπιπλῶν τροφῆς καὶ εὐφροσύνης τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν.

text_en: And speaking these things, they scarce restrained the people from sacrificing to them.
text_la: Et hæc dicentes, vix sedaverunt turbas ne sibi immolarent.
text_pt: E contudo, não se deixou a si mesmo sem testemunho, beneficiando-vos lá do céu, dando-vos chuvas e tempos frutíferos, enchendo de mantimento e de alegria os vossos corações.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα λέγοντες μόλις κατέπαυσαν τοὺς ὄχλους τοῦ μὴ θύειν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: Now there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium : and, persuading the multitude and stoning Paul , drew him out of the city, thinking him to be dead.
text_la: Supervenerunt autem quidam ab Antiochia et Iconio Judæi : et persuasis turbis, lapidantesque Paulum, traxerunt extra civitatem, existimantes eum mortuum esse.
text_pt: E, dizendo isto, com dificuldade impediram que as multidões lhes sacrificassem.
text_el: Ἐπῆλθαν δὲ ἀπὸ Ἀντιοχείας καὶ Ἰκονίου Ἰουδαῖοι, καὶ πείσαντες τοὺς ὄχλους καὶ λιθάσαντες τὸν Παῦλον ἔσυρον ἔξω τῆς πόλεως, νομίζοντες αὐτὸν τεθνηκέναι.

text_en: But as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up and entered into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe .
text_la: Circumdantibus autem eum discipulis, surgens intravit civitatem, et postera die profectus est cum Barnaba in Derben.
text_pt: Sobrevieram, porém, uns judeus de Antioquia e de Icônio que, tendo convencido a multidão, apedrejaram a Paulo e o arrastaram para fora da cidade, cuidando que estava morto.
text_el: κυκλωσάντων δὲ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτὸν ἀναστὰς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν πόλιν. καὶ τῇ ἐπαύριον ἐξῆλθεν σὺν τῷ Βαρναβᾷ εἰς Δέρβην.

text_en: And when they had preached the gospel to that city and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra and to Iconium and to Antioch :
text_la: Cumque evangelizassent civitati illi, et docuissent multos, reversi sunt Lystram, et Iconium, et Antiochiam,
text_pt: Mas, rodeando-o os discípulos, levantou-se, e entrou na cidade, e no dia seguinte saiu com Barnabé para Derbe.
text_el: εὐαγγελισάμενοί τε τὴν πόλιν ἐκείνην καὶ μαθητεύσαντες ἱκανοὺς ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς τὴν Λύστραν καὶ εἰς Ἰκόνιον καὶ [εἰς] Ἀντιόχειαν,

text_en: Confirming the souls of the disciples and exhorting them to continue in the faith : and that through many tribulations we must enter into the kingdom of God .
text_la: confirmantes animas discipulorum, exhortantesque ut permanerent in fide : et quoniam per multas tribulationes oportet nos intrare in regnum Dei.
text_pt: E, tendo anunciado o evangelho naquela cidade e feito muitos discípulos, voltaram para Listra, e Icônio e Antioquia,
text_el: ἐπιστηρίζοντες τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν μαθητῶν, παρακαλοῦντες ἐμμένειν τῇ πίστει, καὶ ὅτι διὰ πολλῶν θλίψεων δεῖ ἡμᾶς εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And when they had ordained to them priests in every church and had prayed with fasting , they commended them to the Lord , in whom they believed .
text_la: Et cum constituissent illis per singulas ecclesias presbyteros, et orassent cum jejunationibus, commendaverunt eos Domino, in quem crediderunt.
text_pt: Confirmando os ânimos dos discípulos, exortando-os a permanecer na fé, pois que por muitas tribulações nos importa entrar no reino de Deus.
text_el: χειροτονήσαντες δὲ αὐτοῖς κατ' ἐκκλησίαν πρεσβυτέρους προσευξάμενοι μετὰ νηστειῶν παρέθεντο αὐτοὺς τῷ κυρίῳ εἰς ὃν πεπιστεύκεισαν.

text_en: And passing through Pisidia , they came into Pamphylia.
text_la: Transeuntesque Pisidiam, venerunt in Pamphyliam,
text_pt: E, havendo-lhes, por comum consentimento, eleito anciãos em cada igreja, orando com jejuns, os encomendaram ao Senhor em quem haviam crido.
text_el: καὶ διελθόντες τὴν Πισιδίαν ἦλθον εἰς τὴν Παμφυλίαν,

text_en: And having spoken the word of the Lord in Perge , they went down into Attalia .
text_la: et loquentes verbum Domini in Perge, descenderunt in Attaliam:
text_pt: Passando depois por Pisídia, dirigiram-se a Panfília.
text_el: καὶ λαλήσαντες ἐν Πέργῃ τὸν λόγον κατέβησαν εἰς Ἀττάλειαν.

text_en: And thence they sailed to Antioch , from whence they had been delivered to the grace of God , unto the work which they accomplished.
text_la: et inde navigaverunt Antiochiam, unde erant traditi gratiæ Dei in opus quod compleverunt.
text_pt: E, tendo anunciado a palavra em Perge, desceram a Atália.
text_el: κἀκεῖθεν ἀπέπλευσαν εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν, ὅθεν ἦσαν παραδεδομένοι τῇ χάριτι τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς τὸ ἔργον ὃ ἐπλήρωσαν.

text_en: And when they had come and had assembled the church , they related what great things God had done with them and how he had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles .
text_la: Cum autem venissent, et congregassent ecclesiam, retulerunt quanta fecisset Deus cum illis, et quia aperuisset gentibus ostium fidei.
text_pt: E dali navegaram para Antioquia, de onde tinham sido encomendados à graça de Deus para a obra que já haviam cumprido.
text_el: παραγενόμενοι δὲ καὶ συναγαγόντες τὴν ἐκκλησίαν ἀνήγγελλον ὅσα ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς μετ' αὐτῶν καὶ ὅτι ἤνοιξεν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν θύραν πίστεως.

text_en: And they abode no small time with the disciples .
text_la: Morati sunt autem tempus non modicum cum discipulis.
text_pt: E, quando chegaram e reuniram a igreja, relataram quão grandes coisas Deus fizera por eles, e como abrira aos gentios a porta da fé.
text_el: διέτριβον δὲ χρόνον οὐκ ὀλίγον σὺν τοῖς μαθηταῖς.

text_en: And some , coming down from Judea , taught the brethren: That, except you be circumcised after the manner of Moses , you cannot be saved .
text_la: Et quidam descendentes de Judæa docebant fratres : Quia nisi circumcidamini secundum morem Moysi, non potestis salvari.
text_pt: Então alguns que tinham descido da Judéia ensinavam assim os irmãos: Se não vos circuncidardes conforme o uso de Moisés, não podeis salvar-vos.
text_el: Καί τινες κατελθόντες ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἐδίδασκον τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ περιτμηθῆτε τῷ ἔθει τῷ Μωϋσέως, οὐ δύνασθε σωθῆναι.

text_en: And when Paul and Barnabas had no small contest with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas and certain others of the other side should go up to the apostles and priests to Jerusalem , about this question.
text_la: Facta ergo seditione non minima Paulo et Barnabæ adversus illos, statuerunt ut ascenderent Paulus et Barnabas, et quidam alii ex aliis ad Apostolos et presbyteros in Jerusalem super hac quæstione.
text_pt: Tendo tido Paulo e Barnabé não pequena discussão e contenda contra eles, resolveu-se que Paulo e Barnabé, e alguns dentre eles, subissem a Jerusalém, aos apóstolos e aos anciãos, sobre aquela questão.
text_el: γενομένης δὲ στάσεως καὶ ζητήσεως οὐκ ὀλίγης τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ τῷ Βαρναβᾷ πρὸς αὐτοὺς, ἔταξαν ἀναβαίνειν Παῦλον καὶ Βαρναβᾶν καί τινας ἄλλους ἐξ αὐτῶν πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστόλους καὶ πρεσβυτέρους εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ περὶ τοῦ ζητήματος τούτου.

text_en: They therefore, being brought on their way by the church , passed through Phenice and Samaria , relating the conversion of the Gentiles . And they caused great joy to all the brethren.
text_la: Illi ergo deducti ab ecclesia pertransibant Phœnicen et Samariam, narrantes conversionem gentium : et faciebant gaudium magnum omnibus fratribus.
text_pt: E eles, sendo acompanhados pela igreja, passavam pela Fenícia e por Samaria, contando a conversão dos gentios; e davam grande alegria a todos os irmãos.
text_el: οἱ μὲν οὖν προπεμφθέντες ὑπὸ τῆς ἐκκλησίας διήρχοντο τήν τε Φοινίκην καὶ Σαμάρειαν ἐκδιηγούμενοι τὴν ἐπιστροφὴν τῶν ἐθνῶν, καὶ ἐποίουν χαρὰν μεγάλην πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς.

text_en: And when they had come to Jerusalem , they were received by the church and by the apostles and ancients, declaring how great things God had done with them.
text_la: Cum autem venissent Jerosolymam, suscepti sunt ab ecclesia, et ab Apostolis et senioribus, annuntiantes quanta Deus fecisset cum illis.
text_pt: E, quando chegaram a Jerusalém, foram recebidos pela igreja e pelos apóstolos e anciãos, e lhes anunciaram quão grandes coisas Deus tinha feito com eles.
text_el: παραγενόμενοι δὲ εἰς Ἰεροσόλυμα παρεδέχθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς ἐκκλησίας καὶ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων, ἀνήγγειλάν τε ὅσα ὁ θεὸς ἐποίησεν μετ' αὐτῶν.

text_en: But there arose of the sect of the Pharisees some that believed , saying: They must be circumcised and be commanded to observe the law of Moses .
text_la: Surrexerunt autem quidam de hæresi pharisæorum, qui crediderunt, dicentes quia oportet circumcidi eos, præcipere quoque servare legem Moysi.
text_pt: Alguns, porém, da seita dos fariseus, que tinham crido, se levantaram, dizendo que era mister circuncidá-los e mandar-lhes que guardassem a lei de Moisés.
text_el: ἐξανέστησαν δέ τινες τῶν ἀπὸ τῆς αἱρέσεως τῶν Φαρισαίων πεπιστευκότες, λέγοντες ὅτι δεῖ περιτέμνειν αὐτοὺς παραγγέλλειν τε τηρεῖν τὸν νόμον Μωϋσέως.

text_en: And the apostles and ancients assembled to consider of this matter.
text_la: Conveneruntque Apostoli et seniores videre de verbo hoc.
text_pt: Congregaram-se, pois, os apóstolos e os anciãos para considerar este assunto.
text_el: Συνήχθησάν τε οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἰδεῖν περὶ τοῦ λόγου τούτου.

text_en: And when there had been much disputing, Peter , rising up, said to them: Men, brethren, you know that in former days God made choice among us, that by my mouth the Gentiles should hear the word of the gospel and believe .
text_la: Cum autem magna conquisitio fieret, surgens Petrus dixit ad eos : Viri fratres, vos scitis quoniam ab antiquis diebus Deus in nobis elegit, per os meum audire gentes verbum Evangelii et credere.
text_pt: E, havendo grande contenda, levantou-se Pedro e disse-lhes: Homens irmãos, bem sabeis que já há muito tempo Deus me elegeu dentre nós, para que os gentios ouvissem da minha boca a palavra do evangelho, e cressem.
text_el: πολλῆς δὲ ζητήσεως γενομένης ἀναστὰς Πέτρος εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς, ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, ὑμεῖς ἐπίστασθε ὅτι ἀφ' ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων ἐν ὑμῖν ἐξελέξατο ὁ θεὸς διὰ τοῦ στόματός μου ἀκοῦσαι τὰ ἔθνη τὸν λόγον τοῦ εὐαγγελίου καὶ πιστεῦσαι:

text_en: And God , who knows the hearts, gave testimony, giving unto them the Holy Ghost , as well as to us:
text_la: Et qui novit corda Deus, testimonium perhibuit, dans illis Spiritum Sanctum, sicut et nobis,
text_pt: E Deus, que conhece os corações, lhes deu testemunho, dando-lhes o Espírito Santo, assim como também a nós;
text_el: καὶ ὁ καρδιογνώστης θεὸς ἐμαρτύρησεν αὐτοῖς δοὺς τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον καθὼς καὶ ἡμῖν,

text_en: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith .
text_la: et nihil discrevit inter nos et illos, fide purificans corda eorum.
text_pt: E não fez diferença alguma entre eles e nós, purificando os seus corações pela fé.
text_el: καὶ οὐθὲν διέκρινεν μεταξὺ ἡμῶν τε καὶ αὐτῶν, τῇ πίστει καθαρίσας τὰς καρδίας αὐτῶν.

text_en: Now therefore, why tempt you God to put a yoke upon the necks of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we have been able to bear?
text_la: Nunc ergo quid tentatis Deum, imponere jugum super cervices discipulorum quod neque patres nostri, neque nos portare potuimus?
text_pt: Agora, pois, por que tentais a Deus, pondo sobre a cerviz dos discípulos um jugo que nem nossos pais nem nós pudemos suportar?
text_el: νῦν οὖν τί πειράζετε τὸν θεόν, ἐπιθεῖναι ζυγὸν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον τῶν μαθητῶν ὃν οὔτε οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν οὔτε ἡμεῖς ἰσχύσαμεν βαστάσαι;

text_en: But by the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ , we believe to be saved , in like manner as they also.
text_la: sed per gratiam Domini Jesu Christi credimus salvari, quemadmodum et illi.
text_pt: Mas cremos que seremos salvos pela graça do Senhor Jesus Cristo, como eles também.
text_el: ἀλλὰ διὰ τῆς χάριτος τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ πιστεύομεν σωθῆναι καθ' ὃν τρόπον κἀκεῖνοι.

text_en: And all the multitude held their peace: and they heard Barnabas and Paul telling what great signs and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
text_la: Tacuit autem omnis multitudo : et audiebant Barnabam et Paulum narrantes quanta Deus fecisset signa et prodigia in gentibus per eos.
text_pt: Então toda a multidão se calou e escutava a Barnabé e a Paulo, que contavam quão grandes sinais e prodígios Deus havia feito por meio deles entre os gentios.
text_el: ἐσίγησεν δὲ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος, καὶ ἤκουον Βαρναβᾶ καὶ Παύλου ἐξηγουμένων ὅσα ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν δι' αὐτῶν.

text_en: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying: Men, brethren, hear me.
text_la: Et postquam tacuerunt, respondit Jacobus, dicens : Viri fratres, audite me.
text_pt: E, havendo-se eles calado, tomou Tiago a palavra, dizendo: Homens irmãos, ouvi-me:
text_el: Μετὰ δὲ τὸ σιγῆσαι αὐτοὺς ἀπεκρίθη Ἰάκωβος λέγων, ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, ἀκούσατέ μου.

text_en: Simon has related how God first visited to take to the Gentiles , a people to his name .
text_la: Simon narravit quemadmodum primum Deus visitavit sumere ex gentibus populum nomini suo.
text_pt: Simão relatou como primeiramente Deus visitou os gentios, para tomar deles um povo para o seu nome.
text_el: Συμεὼν ἐξηγήσατο καθὼς πρῶτον ὁ θεὸς ἐπεσκέψατο λαβεῖν ἐξ ἐθνῶν λαὸν τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And to this agree the words of the prophets , as it is written:
text_la: Et huic concordant verba prophetarum : sicut scriptum est:
text_pt: E com isto concordam as palavras dos profetas; como está escrito:
text_el: καὶ τούτῳ συμφωνοῦσιν οἱ λόγοι τῶν προφητῶν, καθὼς γέγραπται,

text_en: After these things I will return and will rebuild the tabernacle of David , which is fallen down: and the ruins thereof I will rebuild. And I will set it up:
text_la: Post hæc revertar, et reædificabo tabernaculum David quod decidit : et diruta ejus reædificabo, et erigam illud :
text_pt: Depois disto voltarei,e reedificarei o tabernáculo de Davi, que está caído, levantá-lo-ei das suas ruínas, e tornarei a edificá-lo.
text_el: μετὰ ταῦτα ἀναστρέψω καὶ ἀνοικοδομήσω τὴν σκηνὴν Δαυὶδ τὴν πεπτωκυῖαν, καὶ τὰ κατεστραμμένα αὐτῆς ἀνοικοδομήσω καὶ ἀνορθώσω αὐτήν,

text_en: That the residue of men may seek after the Lord , and all nations upon whom my name is invoked, says the Lord , who does these things.
text_la: ut requirant ceteri hominum Dominum, et omnes gentes super quas invocatum est nomen meum, dicit Dominus faciens hæc.
text_pt: Para que o restante dos homens busque ao Senhor,e todos os gentios, sobre os quais o meu nome é invocado,diz o Senhor, que faz todas estas coisas,
text_el: ὅπως ἂν ἐκζητήσωσιν οἱ κατάλοιποι τῶν ἀνθρώπων τὸν κύριον, καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐφ' οὓς ἐπικέκληται τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπ' αὐτούς, λέγει κύριος ποιῶν ταῦτα

text_en: To the Lord was his own work known from the beginning of the world .
text_la: Notum a sæculo est Domino opus suum.
text_pt: Conhecidas sào a Deus, desde o princípio do mundo, todas as suas obras.
text_el: γνωστὰ ἀπ' αἰῶνος.

text_en: For which cause, judge that they who from among the Gentiles are converted to God are not to be disquieted:
text_la: Propter quod ego judico non inquietari eos qui ex gentibus convertuntur ad Deum,
text_pt: Por isso julgo que não se deve perturbar aqueles, dentre os gentios, que se convertem a Deus.
text_el: διὸ ἐγὼ κρίνω μὴ παρενοχλεῖν τοῖς ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐπιστρέφουσιν ἐπὶ τὸν θεόν,

text_en: But that we write unto them, that they refrain themselves from the pollutions of idols and from fornication and from things strangled and from blood.
text_la: sed scribere ad eos ut abstineant se a contaminationibus simulacrorum, et fornicatione, et suffocatis, et sanguine.
text_pt: Mas escrever-lhes que se abstenham das contaminações dos ídolos, da fornicação, do que é sufocado e do sangue.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἐπιστεῖλαι αὐτοῖς τοῦ ἀπέχεσθαι τῶν ἀλισγημάτων τῶν εἰδώλων καὶ τῆς πορνείας καὶ πνικτοῦ καὶ τοῦ αἵματος:

text_en: For Moses of old time has in every city them that preach him in the synagogues , where he is read every sabbath .
text_la: Moyses enim a temporibus antiquis habet in singulis civitatibus qui eum prædicent in synagogis, ubi per omne sabbatum legitur.
text_pt: Porque Moisés, desde os tempos antigos, tem em cada cidade quem o pregue, e cada sábado é lido nas sinagogas.
text_el: Μωϋσῆς γὰρ ἐκ γενεῶν ἀρχαίων κατὰ πόλιν τοὺς κηρύσσοντας αὐτὸν ἔχει ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς κατὰ πᾶν σάββατον ἀναγινωσκόμενος.

text_en: Then it pleased the apostles and ancients, with the whole church , to choose men of their own company and to send to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas , namely, Judas, who was surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren.
text_la: Tunc placuit Apostolis et senioribus cum omni ecclesia eligere viros ex eis, et mittere Antiochiam cum Paulo et Barnaba : Judam, qui cognominabatur Barsabas, et Silam, viros primos in fratribus:
text_pt: Então pareceu bem aos apóstolos e aos anciãos, com toda a igreja, eleger homens dentre eles e enviá-los com Paulo e Barnabé a Antioquia, a saber: Judas, chamado Barsabás, e Silas, homens distintos entre os irmãos.
text_el: Τότε ἔδοξε τοῖς ἀποστόλοις καὶ τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις σὺν ὅλῃ τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ἐκλεξαμένους ἄνδρας ἐξ αὐτῶν πέμψαι εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν σὺν τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ Βαρναβᾷ, Ἰούδαν τὸν καλούμενον Βαρσαββᾶν καὶ Σιλᾶν, ἄνδρας ἡγουμένους ἐν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς,

text_en: Writing by their hands: The apostles and ancients, brethren, to the brethren of the Gentiles that are at Antioch and in Syria and Cilicia, greeting.
text_la: scribentes per manus eorum : Apostoli et seniores fratres, his qui sunt Antiochiæ, et Syriæ, et Ciliciæ, fratribus ex gentibus, salutem.
text_pt: E por intermédio deles escreveram o seguinte: Os apóstolos, e os anciãos e os irmãos, aos irmãos dentre os gentios que estão em Antioquia, e Síria e Cilícia, saúde.
text_el: γράψαντες διὰ χειρὸς αὐτῶν, οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἀδελφοὶ τοῖς κατὰ τὴν Ἀντιόχειαν καὶ Συρίαν καὶ Κιλικίαν ἀδελφοῖς τοῖς ἐξ ἐθνῶν χαίρειν.

text_en: Forasmuch as we have heard that some going out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls , to whom we gave no commandment:
text_la: Quoniam audivimus quia quidam ex nobis exeuntes, turbaverunt vos verbis, evertentes animas vestras, quibus non mandavimus,
text_pt: Porquanto ouvimos que alguns que saíram dentre nós vos perturbaram com palavras, e transtornaram as vossas almas, dizendo que deveis circuncidar-vos e guardar a lei, não lhes tendo nós dado mandamento,
text_el: ἐπειδὴ ἠκούσαμεν ὅτι τινὲς ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐτάραξαν ὑμᾶς λόγοις ἀνασκευάζοντες τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν, οἷς οὐ διεστειλάμεθα,

text_en: It has seemed good to us, being assembled together, to choose out men and to send them unto you, with our well beloved Barnabas and Paul :
text_la: placuit nobis collectis in unum eligere viros, et mittere ad vos cum carissimis nostris Barnaba et Paulo,
text_pt: Pareceu-nos bem, reunidos concordemente, eleger alguns homens e enviá-los com os nossos amados Barnabé e Paulo,
text_el: ἔδοξεν ἡμῖν γενομένοις ὁμοθυμαδὸν, ἐκλεξαμένοις ἄνδρας πέμψαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς σὺν τοῖς ἀγαπητοῖς ἡμῶν Βαρναβᾷ καὶ Παύλῳ,

text_en: Men that have given their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ .
text_la: hominibus qui tradiderunt animas suas pro nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi.
text_pt: Homens que já expuseram as suas vidas pelo nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
text_el: ἀνθρώποις παραδεδωκόσι τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

text_en: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves also will, by word of mouth, tell you the same things.
text_la: Misimus ergo Judam et Silam, qui et ipsi vobis verbis referent eadem.
text_pt: Enviamos, portanto, Judas e Silas, os quais por palavra vos anunciarão também as mesmas coisas.
text_el: ἀπεστάλκαμεν οὖν Ἰούδαν καὶ Σιλᾶν, καὶ αὐτοὺς διὰ λόγου ἀπαγγέλλοντας τὰ αὐτά.

text_en: For it has seemed good to the Holy Ghost and to us to lay no further burden upon you than these necessary things:
text_la: Visum est enim Spiritui Sancto et nobis nihil ultra imponere vobis oneris quam hæc necessaria:
text_pt: Na verdade pareceu bem ao Espírito Santo e a nós, não vos impor mais encargo algum, senão estas coisas necessárias:
text_el: ἔδοξεν γὰρ τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἁγίῳ καὶ ἡμῖν μηδὲν πλέον ἐπιτίθεσθαι ὑμῖν βάρος πλὴν τούτων τῶν ἐπάναγκες,

text_en: That you abstain from things sacrificed to idols and from blood and from things strangled and from fornication: from which things keeping yourselves, you shall do well. Farewell.
text_la: ut abstineatis vos ab immolatis simulacrorum, et sanguine, et suffocato, et fornicatione : a quibus custodientes vos, bene agetis. Valete.
text_pt: Que vos abstenhais das coisas sacrificadas aos ídolos, e do sangue, e da carne sufocada, e da fornicação, das quais coisas bem fazeis se vos guardardes. Bem vos vá.
text_el: ἀπέχεσθαι εἰδωλοθύτων καὶ αἵματος καὶ πνικτῶν καὶ πορνείας: ἐξ ὧν διατηροῦντες ἑαυτοὺς εὖ πράξετε. ἔρρωσθε.

text_en: They therefore, being dismissed, went down to Antioch and, gathering together the multitude, delivered the epistle .
text_la: Illi ergo dimissi, descenderunt Antiochiam : et congregata multitudine tradiderunt epistolam.
text_pt: Tendo eles então se despedido, partiram para Antioquia e, ajuntando a multidão, entregaram a carta.
text_el: Οἱ μὲν οὖν ἀπολυθέντες κατῆλθον εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν, καὶ συναγαγόντες τὸ πλῆθος ἐπέδωκαν τὴν ἐπιστολήν:

text_en: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
text_la: Quam cum legissent, gavisi sunt super consolatione.
text_pt: E, quando a leram, alegraram-se pela exortação.
text_el: ἀναγνόντες δὲ ἐχάρησαν ἐπὶ τῇ παρακλήσει.

text_en: But Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, with many words comforted the brethren and confirmed them.
text_la: Judas autem et Silas, et ipsi cum essent prophetæ, verbo plurimo consolati sunt fratres, et confirmaverunt.
text_pt: Depois Judas e Silas, que também eram profetas, exortaram e confirmaram os irmãos com muitas palavras.
text_el: Ἰούδας τε καὶ Σιλᾶς, καὶ αὐτοὶ προφῆται ὄντες, διὰ λόγου πολλοῦ παρεκάλεσαν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ ἐπεστήριξαν:

text_en: And after they had spent some time there, they were let go with peace by the brethren unto them that had sent them.
text_la: Facto autem ibi aliquanto tempore, dimissi sunt cum pace a fratribus ad eos qui miserant illos.
text_pt: E, detendo-se ali algum tempo, os irmãos os deixaram voltar em paz para os apóstolos;
text_el: ποιήσαντες δὲ χρόνον ἀπελύθησαν μετ' εἰρήνης ἀπὸ τῶν ἀδελφῶν πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστείλαντας αὐτούς.

text_en: But it seemed good unto Silas to remain there: and Judas alone departed to Jerusalem .
text_la: Visum est autem Silæ ibi remanere : Judas autem solus abiit Jerusalem.
text_pt: Mas pareceu bem a Silas ficar ali.

text_en: And Paul and Barnabas continued at Antioch , teaching and preaching, with many others, the word of the Lord .
text_la: Paulus autem et Barnabas demorabantur Antiochiæ, docentes et evangelizantes cum aliis pluribus verbum Domini.
text_pt: E Paulo e Barnabé ficaram em Antioquia, ensinando e pregando, com muitos outros, a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: Παῦλος δὲ καὶ Βαρναβᾶς διέτριβον ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ διδάσκοντες καὶ εὐαγγελιζόμενοι μετὰ καὶ ἑτέρων πολλῶν τὸν λόγον τοῦ κυρίου.

text_en: And after some days, Paul said to Barnabas : Let us return and visit our brethren in all the cities wherein we have preached the word of the Lord , to see how they do.
text_la: Post aliquot autem dies, dixit ad Barnabam Paulus : Revertentes visitemus fratres per universas civitates in quibus prædicavimus verbum Domini, quomodo se habeant.
text_pt: E alguns dias depois, disse Paulo a Barnabé: Tornemos a visitar nossos irmãos por todas as cidades em que já anunciamos a palavra do Senhor, para ver como estão.
text_el: Μετὰ δέ τινας ἡμέρας εἶπεν πρὸς Βαρναβᾶν Παῦλος, ἐπιστρέψαντες δὴ ἐπισκεψώμεθα τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς κατὰ πόλιν πᾶσαν ἐν αἷς κατηγγείλαμεν τὸν λόγον τοῦ κυρίου, πῶς ἔχουσιν.

text_en: And Barnabas would have taken with them John also, that was surnamed Mark.
text_la: Barnabas autem volebat secum assumere et Joannem, qui cognominabatur Marcus.
text_pt: E Barnabé aconselhava que tomassem consigo a João, chamado Marcos.
text_el: Βαρναβᾶς δὲ ἐβούλετο συμπαραλαβεῖν καὶ τὸν Ἰωάννην τὸν καλούμενον Μᾶρκον:

text_en: But Paul desired that he (as having departed from them out of Pamphylia and not gone with them to the work) might not be received.
text_la: Paulus autem rogabat eum (ut qui discessisset ab eis de Pamphylia, et non isset cum eis in opus) non debere recipi.
text_pt: Mas a Paulo parecia razoável que não tomassem consigo aquele que desde a Panfília se tinha apartado deles e não os acompanhou naquela obra.
text_el: Παῦλος δὲ ἠξίου τὸν ἀποστάντα ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Παμφυλίας καὶ μὴ συνελθόντα αὐτοῖς εἰς τὸ ἔργον, μὴ συμπαραλαμβάνειν τοῦτον.

text_en: And there arose a dissension so that they departed one from another. And Barnabas indeed, taking Mark , sailed to Cyprus .
text_la: Facta est autem dissensio, ita ut discederent ab invicem, et Barnabas quidem, assumpto Marco, navigaret Cyprum.
text_pt: E tal contenda houve entre eles, que se apartaram um do outro. Barnabé, levando consigo a Marcos, navegou para Chipre.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ παροξυσμὸς ὥστε ἀποχωρισθῆναι αὐτοὺς ἀπ' ἀλλήλων, τόν τε Βαρναβᾶν παραλαβόντα τὸν Μᾶρκον ἐκπλεῦσαι εἰς Κύπρον.

text_en: But Paul , choosing Silas, departed, being delivered by the brethren to the grace of God .
text_la: Paulus vero, electo Sila, profectus est, traditus gratiæ Dei a fratribus.
text_pt: E Paulo, tendo escolhido a Silas, partiu, encomendado pelos irmãos à graça de Deus.
text_el: Παῦλος δὲ ἐπιλεξάμενος Σιλᾶν ἐξῆλθεν παραδοθεὶς τῇ χάριτι τοῦ κυρίου ὑπὸ τῶν ἀδελφῶν,

text_en: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches , commanding them to keep the precepts of the apostles and the ancients.
text_la: Perambulabat autem Syriam et Ciliciam, confirmans ecclesias : præcipiens custodire præcepta Apostolorum et seniorum.
text_pt: E passou pela Síria e Cilícia, confirmando as igrejas.
text_el: διήρχετο δὲ τὴν Συρίαν καὶ [τὴν] Κιλικίαν ἐπιστηρίζων τὰς ἐκκλησίας.

text_en: And he came to Derbe and Lystra . And behold, there was a certain disciple there named Timothy, the son of a Jewish woman that believed : but his father was a Gentile .
text_la: Pervenit autem Derben et Lystram. Et ecce discipulus quidam erat ibi nomine Timotheus, filius mulieris Judææ fidelis, patre gentili.
text_pt: E chegou a Derbe e Listra. E eis que estava ali um certo discípulo por nome Timóteo, filho de uma judia que era crente, mas de pai grego;
text_el: Κατήντησεν δὲ καὶ εἰς Δέρβην καὶ εἰς Λύστραν. καὶ ἰδοὺ μαθητής τις ἦν ἐκεῖ ὀνόματι Τιμόθεος, υἱὸς γυναικὸς Ἰουδαίας πιστῆς πατρὸς δὲ Ἕλληνος,

text_en: To this man the brethren that were in Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony.
text_la: Huic testimonium bonum reddebant qui in Lystris erant et Iconio fratres.
text_pt: Do qual davam bom testemunho os irmãos que estavam em Listra e em Icônio.
text_el: ὃς ἐμαρτυρεῖτο ὑπὸ τῶν ἐν Λύστροις καὶ Ἰκονίῳ ἀδελφῶν.

text_en: Him Paul would have to go along with him: and taking him, he circumcised him, because of the Jews who were in those places. For they all knew that his father was a Gentile .
text_la: Hunc voluit Paulus secum proficisci : et assumens circumcidit eum propter Judæos qui erant in illis locis. Sciebant enim omnes quod pater ejus erat gentilis.
text_pt: Paulo quis que este fosse com ele; e tomando-o, o circuncidou, por causa dos judeus que estavam naqueles lugares; porque todos sabiam que seu pai era grego.
text_el: τοῦτον ἠθέλησεν ὁ Παῦλος σὺν αὐτῷ ἐξελθεῖν, καὶ λαβὼν περιέτεμεν αὐτὸν διὰ τοὺς Ἰουδαίους τοὺς ὄντας ἐν τοῖς τόποις ἐκείνοις, ᾔδεισαν γὰρ ἅπαντες ὅτι Ἕλλην ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ὑπῆρχεν.

text_en: And as they passed through the cities, they delivered unto them the decrees for to keep, that were decreed by the apostles and ancients who were at Jerusalem .
text_la: Cum autem pertransirent civitates, tradebant eis custodiri dogmata quæ erant decreta ab Apostolis et senioribus qui erant Jerosolymis.
text_pt: E, quando iam passando pelas cidades, lhes entregavam, para serem observados, os decretos que haviam sido estabelecidos pelos apóstolos e anciãos em Jerusalém.
text_el: Ὡς δὲ διεπορεύοντο τὰς πόλεις, παρεδίδοσαν αὐτοῖς φυλάσσειν τὰ δόγματα τὰ κεκριμένα ὑπὸ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων τῶν ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις.

text_en: And the churches were confirmed in faith and increased in number daily.
text_la: Et ecclesiæ quidem confirmabantur fide, et abundabunt numero quotidie.
text_pt: De sorte que as igrejas eram confirmadas na fé, e cada dia cresciam em número.
text_el: Αἱ μὲν οὖν ἐκκλησίαι ἐστερεοῦντο τῇ πίστει καὶ ἐπερίσσευον τῷ ἀριθμῷ καθ' ἡμέραν.

text_en: And when they had passed through Phrygia and the country of Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia .
text_la: Transeuntes autem Phrygiam et Galatiæ regionem, vetati sunt a Spiritu Sancto loqui verbum Dei in Asia.
text_pt: E, passando pela Frígia e pela província da Galácia, foram impedidos pelo Espírito Santo de anunciar a palavra na Ásia.
text_el: διῆλθον δὲ τὴν Φρυγίαν καὶ Γαλατικὴν χώραν, κωλυθέντες ὑπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος λαλῆσαι τὸν λόγον ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ:

text_en: And when they had come into Mysia, they attempted to go into Bithynia: and the Spirit of Jesus suffered them not.
text_la: Cum venissent autem in Mysiam, tentabant ire in Bithyniam : et non permisit eos Spiritus Jesu.
text_pt: E, quando chegaram a Mísia, intentavam ir para Bitínia, mas o Espírito não lho permitiu.
text_el: ἐλθόντες δὲ κατὰ τὴν Μυσίαν ἐπείραζον εἰς τὴν Βιθυνίαν πορευθῆναι, καὶ οὐκ εἴασεν αὐτοὺς τὸ πνεῦμα Ἰησοῦ:

text_en: And when they had passed through Mysia, they went down to Troas .
text_la: Cum autem pertransissent Mysiam, descenderunt Troadem:
text_pt: E, tendo passado por Mísia, desceram a Trôade.
text_el: παρελθόντες δὲ τὴν Μυσίαν κατέβησαν εἰς Τρῳάδα.

text_en: And a vision was showed to Paul in the night, which was a man of Macedonia standing and beseeching him and saying: Pass over into Macedonia and help us.
text_la: et visio per noctem Paulo ostensa est : vir Macedo quidam erat stans et deprecans eum, et dicens : Transiens in Macedoniam, adjuva nos.
text_pt: E Paulo teve de noite uma visão, em que se apresentou um homem da Macedônia, e lhe rogou, dizendo: Passa à Macedônia, e ajuda-nos.
text_el: καὶ ὅραμα διὰ νυκτὸς τῷ Παύλῳ ὤφθη, ἀνὴρ Μακεδών τις ἦν ἑστὼς καὶ παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν καὶ λέγων, διαβὰς εἰς Μακεδονίαν βοήθησον ἡμῖν.

text_en: And as soon as he had seen the vision , immediately we sought to go into Macedonia: being assured that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.
text_la: Ut autem visum vidit, statim quæsivimus proficisci in Macedoniam, certi facti quod vocasset nos Deus evangelizare eis.
text_pt: E, logo depois desta visão, procuramos partir para a Macedônia, concluindo que o Senhor nos chamava para lhes anunciarmos o evangelho.
text_el: ὡς δὲ τὸ ὅραμα εἶδεν, εὐθέως ἐζητήσαμεν ἐξελθεῖν εἰς Μακεδονίαν, συμβιβάζοντες ὅτι προσκέκληται ἡμᾶς ὁ θεὸς εὐαγγελίσασθαι αὐτούς.

text_en: And sailing from Troas , we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the day following to Neapolis.
text_la: Navigantes autem a Troade, recto cursu venimus Samothraciam, et sequenti die Neapolim:
text_pt: E, navegando de Trôade, fomos correndo em caminho direito para a Samotrácia e, no dia seguinte, para Neápolis;
text_el: Ἀναχθέντες οὖν ἀπὸ Τρῳάδος εὐθυδρομήσαμεν εἰς Σαμοθρᾴκην, τῇ δὲ ἐπιούσῃ εἰς Νέαν Πόλιν,

text_en: And from thence to Philippi , which is the chief city of part of Macedonia, a colony. And we were in this city some days conferring together.
text_la: et inde Philippos, quæ est prima partis Macedoniæ civitas, colonia. Eramus autem in hac urbe diebus aliquot, conferentes.
text_pt: E dali para Filipos, que é a primeira cidade desta parte da Macedônia, e é uma colônia; e estivemos alguns dias nesta cidade.
text_el: κἀκεῖθεν εἰς Φιλίππους, ἥτις ἐστὶν πρώτη τῆς μερίδος Μακεδονίας πόλις, κολωνία. ἦμεν δὲ ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ πόλει διατρίβοντες ἡμέρας τινάς.

text_en: And upon the Sabbath day , we went forth without the gate by a river side, where it seemed that there was prayer : and sitting down, we spoke to the women that were assembled.
text_la: Die autem sabbatorum egressi sumus foras portam juxta flumen, ubi videbatur oratio esse : et sedentes loquebamur mulieribus quæ convenerant.
text_pt: E no dia de sábado saímos fora das portas, para a beira do rio, onde se costumava fazer oração; e, assentando-nos, falamos às mulheres que ali se ajuntaram.
text_el: τῇ τε ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων ἐξήλθομεν ἔξω τῆς πύλης παρὰ ποταμὸν οὗ ἐνομίζομεν προσευχὴν εἶναι, καὶ καθίσαντες ἐλαλοῦμεν ταῖς συνελθούσαις γυναιξίν.

text_en: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira , one that worshipped God , did hear: whose heart the Lord opened to attend to those things which were said by Paul .
text_la: Et quædam mulier nomine Lydia, purpuraria civitatis Thyatirenorum, colens Deum, audivit : cujus Dominus aperuit cor intendere his quæ dicebantur a Paulo.
text_pt: E uma certa mulher, chamada Lídia, vendedora de púrpura, da cidade de Tiatira, e que servia a Deus, nos ouvia, e o Senhor lhe abriu o coração para que estivesse atenta ao que Paulo dizia.
text_el: καί τις γυνὴ ὀνόματι Λυδία, πορφυρόπωλις πόλεως Θυατείρων σεβομένη τὸν θεόν, ἤκουεν, ἧς ὁ κύριος διήνοιξεν τὴν καρδίαν προσέχειν τοῖς λαλουμένοις ὑπὸ Παύλου.

text_en: And when she was baptized , and her household, she besought us, saying: If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord , come into my house and abide there. And she constrained us.
text_la: Cum autem baptizata esset, et domus ejus, deprecata est, dicens : Si judicastis me fidelem Domino esse, introite in domum meam, et manete. Et coëgit nos.
text_pt: E, depois que foi batizada, ela e a sua casa, nos rogou, dizendo: Se haveis julgado que eu seja fiel ao Senhor, entrai em minha casa, e ficai ali. E nos constrangeu a isso.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐβαπτίσθη καὶ ὁ οἶκος αὐτῆς, παρεκάλεσεν λέγουσα, εἰ κεκρίκατέ με πιστὴν τῷ κυρίῳ εἶναι, εἰσελθόντες εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου μένετε: καὶ παρεβιάσατο ἡμᾶς.

text_en: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer , a certain girl having a pythonical spirit met us, who brought to her masters much gain by divining .
text_la: Factum est autem euntibus nobis ad orationem, puellam quamdam habentem spiritum pythonem obviare nobis, quæ quæstum magnum præstabat dominis suis divinando.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, indo nós à oração, nos saiu ao encontro uma jovem, que tinha espírito de adivinhação, a qual, adivinhando, dava grande lucro aos seus senhores.
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ πορευομένων ἡμῶν εἰς τὴν προσευχὴν παιδίσκην τινὰ ἔχουσαν πνεῦμα πύθωνα ὑπαντῆσαι ἡμῖν, ἥτις ἐργασίαν πολλὴν παρεῖχεν τοῖς κυρίοις αὐτῆς μαντευομένη.

text_en: This same following Paul and us, cried out, saying: These men are the servants of the Most High God , who preach unto you the way of salvation .
text_la: Hæc subsecuta Paulum et nos, clamabat dicens : Isti homines servi Dei excelsi sunt, qui annuntiant vobis viam salutis.
text_pt: Esta, seguindo a Paulo e a nós, clamava, dizendo: Estes homens, que nos anunciam o caminho da salvação, são servos do Deus Altíssimo.
text_el: αὕτη κατακολουθοῦσα [τῷ] Παύλῳ καὶ ἡμῖν ἔκραζεν λέγουσα, οὗτοι οἱ ἄνθρωποι δοῦλοι τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ὑψίστου εἰσίν, οἵτινες καταγγέλλουσιν ὑμῖν ὁδὸν σωτηρίας.

text_en: And this she did many days. But Paul being grieved, turned and said to the spirit : I command you, in the name of Jesus Christ , to go from her . And he went out the same hour.
text_la: Hoc autem faciebat multis diebus. Dolens autem Paulus, et conversus, spiritui dixit : Præcipio tibi in nomine Jesu Christi exire ab ea. Et exiit eadem hora.
text_pt: E isto fez ela por muitos dias. Mas Paulo, perturbado, voltou-se e disse ao espírito: Em nome de Jesus Cristo, te mando que saias dela. E na mesma hora saiu.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ ἐποίει ἐπὶ πολλὰς ἡμέρας. διαπονηθεὶς δὲ Παῦλος καὶ ἐπιστρέψας τῷ πνεύματι εἶπεν: παραγγέλλω σοι ἐν ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐξελθεῖν ἀπ' αὐτῆς: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ.

text_en: But her masters, seeing that the hope of their gain was gone, apprehending Paul and Silas, brought them into the market place to the rulers.
text_la: Videntes autem domini ejus quia exivit spes quæstus eorum, apprehendentes Paulum et Silam, perduxerunt in forum ad principes:
text_pt: E, vendo seus senhores que a esperança do seu lucro estava perdida, prenderam Paulo e Silas, e os levaram à praça, à presença dos magistrados.
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ κύριοι αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐξῆλθεν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς ἐργασίας αὐτῶν ἐπιλαβόμενοι τὸν Παῦλον καὶ τὸν Σιλᾶν εἵλκυσαν εἰς τὴν ἀγορὰν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας,

text_en: And presenting them to the magistrates, they said: These men disturb our city, being Jews :
text_la: et offerentes eos magistratibus, dixerunt : Hi homines conturbant civitatem nostram, cum sint Judæi:
text_pt: E, apresentando-os aos magistrados, disseram: Estes homens, sendo judeus, perturbaram a nossa cidade,
text_el: καὶ προσαγαγόντες αὐτοὺς τοῖς στρατηγοῖς εἶπαν: οὗτοι οἱ ἄνθρωποι ἐκταράσσουσιν ἡμῶν τὴν πόλιν Ἰουδαῖοι ὑπάρχοντες,

text_en: And preach a fashion which it is not lawful for us to receive nor observe, being Romans.
text_la: et annuntiant morem quem non licet nobis suscipere neque facere, cum simus Romani.
text_pt: E nos expõem costumes que não nos é lícito receber nem praticar, visto que somos romanos.
text_el: καὶ καταγγέλλουσιν ἔθη ἃ οὐκ ἔξεστιν ἡμῖν παραδέχεσθαι οὐδὲ ποιεῖν Ῥωμαίοις οὖσιν.

text_en: And the people ran together against them: and the magistrates, rending off their clothes, commanded them to be beaten with rods.
text_la: Et cucurrit plebs adversus eos : et magistratus, scissis tunicis eorum, jusserunt eos virgis cædi.
text_pt: E a multidão se levantou unida contra eles, e os magistrados, rasgando-lhes as vestes, mandaram açoitá-los com varas.
text_el: καὶ συνεπέστη ὁ ὄχλος κατ' αὐτῶν, καὶ οἱ στρατηγοὶ περιρήξαντες αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια ἐκέλευον ῥαβδίζειν,

text_en: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison , charging the gaoler to keep them diligently.
text_la: Et cum multas plagas eis imposuissent, miserunt eos in carcerem, præcipientes custodi ut diligenter custodiret eos.
text_pt: E, havendo-lhes dado muitos açoites, os lançaram na prisão, mandando ao carcereiro que os guardasse com segurança.
text_el: πολλάς δὲ ἐπιθέντες αὐτοῖς πληγὰς ἔβαλον εἰς φυλακήν, παραγγείλαντες τῷ δεσμοφύλακι ἀσφαλῶς τηρεῖν αὐτούς:

text_en: Who having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison and made their feet fast in the stocks.
text_la: Qui cum tale præceptum accepisset, misit eos in interiorem carcerem, et pedes eorum strinxit ligno.
text_pt: O qual, tendo recebido tal ordem, os lançou no cárcere interior, e lhes segurou os pés no tronco.
text_el: ὃς παραγγελίαν τοιαύτην λαβὼν ἔβαλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν ἐσωτέραν φυλακὴν καὶ τοὺς πόδας ἠσφαλίσατο αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ ξύλον.

text_en: And at midnight, Paul and Silas, praying , praised God . And they that were in prison heard them.
text_la: Media autem nocte Paulus et Silas orantes, laudabant Deum : et audiebant eos qui in custodia erant.
text_pt: E, perto da meia-noite, Paulo e Silas oravam e cantavam hinos a Deus, e os outros presos os escutavam.
text_el: κατὰ δὲ τὸ μεσονύκτιον Παῦλος καὶ Σιλᾶς προσευχόμενοι ὕμνουν τὸν θεόν, ἐπηκροῶντο δὲ αὐτῶν οἱ δέσμιοι:

text_en: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken. And immediately all the doors were opened and the bands of all were loosed.
text_la: Subito vero terræmotus factus est magnus, ita ut moverentur fundamenta carceris. Et statim aperta sunt omnia ostia : et universorum vincula soluta sunt.
text_pt: E de repente sobreveio um tão grande terremoto, que os alicerces do cárcere se moveram, e logo se abriram todas as portas, e foram soltas as prisões de todos.
text_el: ἄφνω δὲ σεισμὸς ἐγένετο μέγας ὥστε σαλευθῆναι τὰ θεμέλια τοῦ δεσμωτηρίου, ἠνεῴχθησαν δὲ [παραχρῆμα] αἱ θύραι πᾶσαι, καὶ πάντων τὰ δεσμὰ ἀνέθη.

text_en: And the keeper of the prison , awakening out of his sleep and seeing the doors of the prison open, drawing his sword, would have killed himself , supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
text_la: Expergefactus autem custos carceris, et videns januas apertas carceris, evaginato gladio volebat se interficere, æstimans fugisse vinctos.
text_pt: E, acordando o carcereiro, e vendo abertas as portas da prisão, tirou a espada, e quis matar-se, cuidando que os presos já tinham fugido.
text_el: ἔξυπνος δὲ γενόμενος ὁ δεσμοφύλαξ καὶ ἰδὼν ἀνεῳγμένας τὰς θύρας τῆς φυλακῆς, σπασάμενος τὴν μάχαιραν ἤμελλεν ἑαυτὸν ἀναιρεῖν, νομίζων ἐκπεφευγέναι τοὺς δεσμίους.

text_en: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying: Do yourself no harm, for we all are here.
text_la: Clamavit autem Paulus voce magna, dicens : Nihil tibi mali feceris : universi enim hic sumus.
text_pt: Mas Paulo clamou com grande voz, dizendo: Não te faças nenhum mal, que todos aqui estamos.
text_el: ἐφώνησεν δὲ Παῦλος μεγάλῃ φωνῇ λέγων, μηδὲν πράξῃς σεαυτῷ κακόν, ἅπαντες γάρ ἐσμεν ἐνθάδε.

text_en: Then calling for a light, he went in: and trembling, fell down at the feet of Paul and Silas.
text_la: Petitoque lumine, introgressus est : et tremefactus procidit Paulo et Silæ ad pedes:
text_pt: E, pedindo luz, saltou dentro e, todo trêmulo, se prostrou ante Paulo e Silas.
text_el: αἰτήσας δὲ φῶτα εἰσεπήδησεν, καὶ ἔντρομος γενόμενος προσέπεσεν τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ Σιλᾷ,

text_en: And bringing them out, he said: Masters, what must I do, that I may be saved ?
text_la: et producens eos foras, ait : Domini, quid me oportet facere, ut salvus fiam?
text_pt: E, tirando-os para fora, disse: Senhores, que é necessário que eu faça para me salvar?
text_el: καὶ προαγαγὼν αὐτοὺς ἔξω ἔφη, κύριοι, τί με δεῖ ποιεῖν ἵνα σωθῶ;

text_en: But they said: believe in the Lord Jesus : and you shall be saved , and your house.
text_la: At illi dixerunt : Crede in Dominum Jesum, et salvus eris tu, et domus tua.
text_pt: E eles disseram: Crê no Senhor Jesus Cristo e serás salvo, tu e a tua casa.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: πίστευσον ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον Ἰησοῦν, καὶ σωθήσῃ σὺ καὶ ὁ οἶκός σου.

text_en: And they preached the word of the Lord to him and to all that were in his house.
text_la: Et locuti sunt ei verbum Domini cum omnibus qui erant in domo ejus.
text_pt: E lhe pregavam a palavra do Senhor, e a todos os que estavam em sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησαν αὐτῷ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he, taking them the same hour of the night, washed their stripes: and himself was baptized , and all his house immediately.
text_la: Et tollens eos in illa hora noctis, lavit plagas eorum : et baptizatus est ipse, et omnis domus ejus continuo.
text_pt: E, tomando-os ele consigo naquela mesma hora da noite, lavou-lhes os vergões; e logo foi batizado, ele e todos os seus.
text_el: καὶ παραλαβὼν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ τῆς νυκτὸς ἔλουσεν ἀπὸ τῶν πληγῶν, καὶ ἐβαπτίσθη αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ αὐτοῦ ἅπαντες παραχρῆμα,

text_en: And when he had brought them into his own house, he laid the table for them: and rejoiced with all his house, believing God .
text_la: Cumque perduxisset eos in domum suam, apposuit eis mensam, et lætatus est cum omni domo sua credens Deo.
text_pt: E, levando-os à sua casa, lhes pôs a mesa; e, na sua crença em Deus, alegrou-se com toda a sua casa.
text_el: ἀναγαγών τε αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν οἶκον παρέθηκεν τράπεζαν, καὶ ἠγαλλιάσατο πανοικεὶ πεπιστευκὼς τῷ θεῷ.

text_en: And when the day had come, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying: Let those men go.
text_la: Et cum dies factus esset, miserunt magistratus lictores, dicentes : Dimitte homines illos.
text_pt: E, sendo já dia, os magistrados mandaram quadrilheiros, dizendo: Soltai aqueles homens.
text_el: Ἡμέρας δὲ γενομένης ἀπέστειλαν οἱ στρατηγοὶ τοὺς ῥαβδούχους λέγοντες, ἀπόλυσον τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἐκείνους.

text_en: And the keeper of the prison told these words to Paul : The magistrates have sent to let you go. Now therefore depart. And go in peace.
text_la: Nuntiavit autem custos carceris verba hæc Paulo : Quia miserunt magistratus ut dimittamini : nunc igitur exeuntes, ite in pace.
text_pt: E o carcereiro anunciou a Paulo estas palavras, dizendo: Os magistrados mandaram que vos soltasse; agora, pois, saí e ide em paz.
text_el: ἀπήγγειλεν δὲ ὁ δεσμοφύλαξ τοὺς λόγους πρὸς τὸν Παῦλον, ὅτι ἀπέσταλκαν οἱ στρατηγοὶ ἵνα ἀπολυθῆτε: νῦν οὖν ἐξελθόντες πορεύεσθε ἐν εἰρήνῃ.

text_en: But Paul said to them: They have beaten us publicly, uncondemned, men that are Romans, and have cast us into prison . And now do they thrust us out privately? Not so: but let them come.
text_la: Paulus autem dixit eis : Cæsos nos publice, indemnatos homines Romanos, miserunt in carcerem : et nunc occulte nos ejiciunt? Non ita : sed veniant,
text_pt: Mas Paulo replicou: Açoitaram-nos publicamente e, sem sermos condenados, sendo homens romanos, nos lançaram na prisão, e agora encobertamente nos lançam fora? Não será assim; mas venham eles mesmos e tirem-nos para fora.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Παῦλος ἔφη πρὸς αὐτούς, δείραντες ἡμᾶς δημοσίᾳ ἀκατακρίτους, ἀνθρώπους Ῥωμαίους ὑπάρχοντας, ἔβαλαν εἰς φυλακήν: καὶ νῦν λάθρᾳ ἡμᾶς ἐκβάλλουσιν; οὐ γάρ, ἀλλὰ ἐλθόντες αὐτοὶ ἡμᾶς ἐξαγαγέτωσαν.

text_en: And let us out themselves. And the serjeants told these words to the magistrates. And they were afraid: hearing that they were Romans.
text_la: et ipsi nos ejiciant. Nuntiaverunt autem magistratibus lictores verba hæc. Timueruntque audito quod Romani essent:
text_pt: E os quadrilheiros foram dizer aos magistrados estas palavras; e eles temeram, ouvindo que eram romanos.
text_el: ἀπήγγειλαν δὲ τοῖς στρατηγοῖς οἱ ῥαβδοῦχοι τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα. ἐφοβήθησαν δὲ ἀκούσαντες ὅτι Ῥωμαῖοί εἰσιν,

text_en: And coming, they besought them: and bringing them out, they desired them to depart out of the city.
text_la: et venientes deprecati sunt eos, et educentes rogabant ut egrederentur de urbe.
text_pt: E, vindo, lhes dirigiram súplicas; e, tirando-os para fora, lhes pediram que saíssem da cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθόντες παρεκάλεσαν αὐτούς, καὶ ἐξαγαγόντες ἠρώτων ἀπελθεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς πόλεως.

text_en: And they went out of the prison and entered into the house of Lydia: and having seen the brethren, they comforted them and departed.
text_la: Exeuntes autem de carcere, introierunt ad Lydiam : et visis fratribus consolati sunt eos, et profecti sunt.
text_pt: E, saindo da prisão, entraram em casa de Lídia e, vendo os irmãos, os confortaram, e depois partiram.
text_el: ἐξελθόντες δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλακῆς εἰσῆλθον πρὸς τὴν Λυδίαν, καὶ ἰδόντες παρεκάλεσαν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ ἐξῆλθαν.

text_en: And when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica , where there was a synagogue of the Jews .
text_la: Cum autem perambulassent Amphipolim et Apolloniam, venerunt Thessalonicam, ubi erat synagoga Judæorum.
text_pt: E passando por Anfípolis e Apolônia, chegaram a Tessalônica, onde havia uma sinagoga de judeus.
text_el: Διοδεύσαντες δὲ τὴν Ἀμφίπολιν καὶ τὴν Ἀπολλωνίαν ἦλθον εἰς Θεσσαλονίκην, ὅπου ἦν συναγωγὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων.

text_en: And Paul , according to his custom, went in unto them. And for three sabbath days he reasoned with them out of the scriptures :
text_la: Secundum consuetudinem autem Paulus introivit ad eos, et per sabbata tria disserebat eis de Scripturis,
text_pt: E Paulo, como tinha por costume, foi ter com eles; e por três sábados disputou com eles sobre as Escrituras,
text_el: κατὰ δὲ τὸ εἰωθὸς τῷ Παύλῳ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐπὶ σάββατα τρία διελέξατο αὐτοῖς ἀπὸ τῶν γραφῶν,

text_en: Declaring and insinuating that the Christ was to suffer and to rise again from the dead ; and that this is Jesus Christ , whom I preach to you.
text_la: adaperiens et insinuans quia Christum oportuit pati, et resurgere a mortuis : et quia hic est Jesus Christus, quem ego annuntio vobis.
text_pt: Expondo e demonstrando que convinha que o Cristo padecesse e ressuscitasse dentre os mortos. E este Jesus, que vos anuncio, dizia ele, é o Cristo.
text_el: διανοίγων καὶ παρατιθέμενος ὅτι τὸν Χριστὸν ἔδει παθεῖν καὶ ἀναστῆναι ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν [ὁ] Χριστός, ὁ Ἰησοῦς, ὃν ἐγὼ καταγγέλλω ὑμῖν.

text_en: And some of them believed and were associated to Paul and Silas: and of those that served God and of the Gentiles a great multitude: and of noble women not a few.
text_la: Et quidam ex eis crediderunt et adjuncti sunt Paulo et Silæ : et de colentibus gentilibusque multitudo magna, et mulieres nobiles non paucæ.
text_pt: E alguns deles creram, e ajuntaram-se com Paulo e Silas; e também uma grande multidão de gregos religiosos, e não poucas mulheres principais.
text_el: καί τινες ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐπείσθησαν καὶ προσεκληρώθησαν τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ [τῷ] Σιλᾷ, τῶν τε σεβομένων Ἑλλήνων πλῆθος πολὺ γυναικῶν τε τῶν πρώτων οὐκ ὀλίγαι.

text_en: But the Jews , moved with envy and taking unto them some wicked men of the vulgar sort and making a tumult, set the city in an uproar: and besetting Jason's house, sought to bring them out unto the people.
text_la: Zelantes autem Judæi, assumentesque de vulgo viros quosdam malos, et turba facta, concitaverunt civitatem : et assistentes domui Jasonis quærebant eos producere in populum.
text_pt: Mas os judeus desobedientes, movidos de inveja, tomaram consigo alguns homens perversos, dentre os vadios e, ajuntando o povo, alvoroçaram a cidade, e assaltando a casa de Jasom, procuravam trazê-los para junto do povo.
text_el: ζηλώσαντες δὲ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ προσλαβόμενοι τῶν ἀγοραίων ἄνδρας τινὰς πονηροὺς καὶ ὀχλοποιήσαντες ἐθορύβουν τὴν πόλιν, καὶ ἐπιστάντες τῇ οἰκίᾳ Ἰάσονος ἐζήτουν αὐτοὺς προαγαγεῖν εἰς τὸν δῆμον.

text_en: And not finding them, they drew Jason and certain brethren to the rulers of the city, crying: They that set the city in an uproar have come hither also:
text_la: Et cum non invenissent eos, trahebant Jasonem et quosdam fratres ad principes civitatis, clamantes : Quoniam hi qui urbem concitant, et huc venerunt,
text_pt: E, não os achando, trouxeram Jasom e alguns irmãos à presença dos magistrados da cidade, clamando: Estes que têm alvoroçado o mundo, chegaram também aqui;
text_el: μὴ εὑρόντες δὲ αὐτοὺς ἔσυρον Ἰάσονα καί τινας ἀδελφοὺς ἐπὶ τοὺς πολιτάρχας, βοῶντες ὅτι οἱ τὴν οἰκουμένην ἀναστατώσαντες οὗτοι καὶ ἐνθάδε πάρεισιν,

text_en: Whom Jason has received. And these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar , saying that there is another king, Jesus .
text_la: quos suscepit Jason, et hi omnes contra decreta Cæsaris faciunt, regem alium dicentes esse, Jesum.
text_pt: Os quais Jasom recolheu; e todos estes procedem contra os decretos de César, dizendo que há outro rei, Jesus.
text_el: οὓς ὑποδέδεκται Ἰάσων: καὶ οὗτοι πάντες ἀπέναντι τῶν δογμάτων Καίσαρος πράσσουσι, βασιλέα ἕτερον λέγοντες εἶναι Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And they stirred up the people: and the rulers of the city, hearing these things,
text_la: Concitaverunt autem plebem et principes civitatis audientes hæc.
text_pt: E alvoroçaram a multidão e os principais da cidade, que ouviram estas coisas.
text_el: ἐτάραξαν δὲ τὸν ὄχλον καὶ τοὺς πολιτάρχας ἀκούοντας ταῦτα,

text_en: and having taken satisfaction of Jason and of the rest, they let them go.
text_la: Et accepta satisfactione a Jasone et a ceteris, dimiserunt eos.
text_pt: Tendo, porém, recebido satisfação de Jasom e dos demais, os soltaram.
text_el: καὶ λαβόντες τὸ ἱκανὸν παρὰ τοῦ Ἰάσονος καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν ἀπέλυσαν αὐτούς.

text_en: But the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea. Who, when they had come thither, went into the synagogue of the Jews .
text_la: Fratres vero confestim per noctem dimiserunt Paulum et Silam in Berœam. Qui cum venissent, in synagogam Judæorum introierunt.
text_pt: E logo os irmãos enviaram de noite Paulo e Silas a Beréia; e eles, chegando lá, foram à sinagoga dos judeus.
text_el: Οἱ δὲ ἀδελφοὶ εὐθέως διὰ νυκτὸς ἐξέπεμψαν τόν τε Παῦλον καὶ τὸν Σιλᾶν εἰς Βέροιαν, οἵτινες παραγενόμενοι εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἀπῄεσαν.

text_en: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica , who received the word with all eagerness, daily searching the scriptures , whether these things were so.
text_la: Hi autem erant nobiliores eorum qui sunt Thessalonicæ, qui susceperunt verbum cum omni aviditate, quotidie scrutantes Scripturas, si hæc ita se haberent.
text_pt: Ora, estes foram mais nobres do que os que estavam em Tessalônica, porque de bom grado receberam a palavra, examinando cada dia nas Escrituras se estas coisas eram assim.
text_el: οὗτοι δὲ ἦσαν εὐγενέστεροι τῶν ἐν Θεσσαλονίκῃ, οἵτινες ἐδέξαντο τὸν λόγον μετὰ πάσης προθυμίας, [τὸ] καθ' ἡμέραν ἀνακρίνοντες τὰς γραφὰς εἰ ἔχοι ταῦτα οὕτως.

text_en: And many indeed of them believed : and of honourable women that were Gentiles and of men , not a few.
text_la: Et multi quidem crediderunt ex eis, et mulierum gentilium honestarum, et viri non pauci.
text_pt: De sorte que creram muitos deles, e também mulheres gregas da classe nobre, e não poucos homens.
text_el: πολλοὶ μὲν οὖν ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐπίστευσαν, καὶ τῶν Ἑλληνίδων γυναικῶν τῶν εὐσχημόνων καὶ ἀνδρῶν οὐκ ὀλίγοι.

text_en: And when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was also preached by Paul at Berea, they came thither also, stirring up and troubling the multitude.
text_la: Cum autem cognovissent in Thessalonica Judæi quia et Berœæ prædicatum est a Paulo verbum Dei, venerunt et illuc commoventes, et turbantes multitudinem.
text_pt: Mas, logo que os judeus de Tessalônica souberam que a palavra de Deus também era anunciada por Paulo em Beréia, foram lá, e excitaram as multidões.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἔγνωσαν οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς Θεσσαλονίκης Ἰουδαῖοι ὅτι καὶ ἐν τῇ Βεροίᾳ κατηγγέλη ὑπὸ τοῦ Παύλου ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ, ἦλθον κἀκεῖ σαλεύοντες καὶ ταράσσοντες τοὺς ὄχλους.

text_en: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul , to go unto the sea: but Silas and Timothy remained there.
text_la: Statimque tunc Paulum dimiserunt fratres, ut iret usque ad mare : Silas autem et Timotheus remanserunt ibi.
text_pt: No mesmo instante os irmãos mandaram a Paulo que fosse até ao mar, mas Silas e Timóteo ficaram ali.
text_el: εὐθέως δὲ τότε τὸν Παῦλον ἐξαπέστειλαν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ πορεύεσθαι ἕως ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν: ὑπέμεινάν τε ὅ τε Σιλᾶς καὶ ὁ Τιμόθεος ἐκεῖ.

text_en: And they that conducted Paul brought him as far as Athens : and receiving a commandment from him to Silas and Timothy, that they should come to him with all speed, they departed.
text_la: Qui autem deducebant Paulum, perduxerunt eum usque Athenas, et accepto mandato ab eo ad Silam et Timotheum ut quam celeriter venirent ad illum, profecti sunt.
text_pt: E os que acompanhavam Paulo o levaram até Atenas, e, recebendo ordem para que Silas e Timóteo fossem ter com ele o mais depressa possível, partiram.
text_el: οἱ δὲ καθιστάνοντες τὸν Παῦλον ἤγαγον ἕως Ἀθηνῶν, καὶ λαβόντες ἐντολὴν πρὸς τὸν Σιλᾶν καὶ τὸν Τιμόθεον ἵνα ὡς τάχιστα ἔλθωσιν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐξῄεσαν.

text_en: Now whilst Paul waited for them at Athens , his spirit was stirred within him, seeing the city wholly given to idolatry .
text_la: Paulus autem cum Athenis eos exspectaret, incitabatur spiritus ejus in ipso, videns idololatriæ deditam civitatem.
text_pt: E, enquanto Paulo os esperava em Atenas, o seu espírito se comovia em si mesmo, vendo a cidade tão entregue à idolatria.
text_el: ἐν δὲ ταῖς Ἀθήναις ἐκδεχομένου αὐτοὺς τοῦ Παύλου, παρωξύνετο τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ θεωροῦντος κατείδωλον οὖσαν τὴν πόλιν.

text_en: He disputed, therefore, in the synagogue with the Jews and with them that served God : and in the market place, every day, with them that were there.
text_la: Disputabat igitur in synagoga cum Judæis et colentibus, et in foro, per omnes dies ad eos qui aderant.
text_pt: De sorte que disputava na sinagoga com os judeus e religiosos, e todos os dias na praça com os que se apresentavam.
text_el: διελέγετο μὲν οὖν ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις καὶ τοῖς σεβομένοις καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀγορᾷ κατὰ πᾶσαν ἡμέραν πρὸς τοὺς παρατυγχάνοντας.

text_en: And certain philosophers of the Epicureans and of the Stoics disputed with him. And some said: What is it that this word sower would say? But others: He seems to be a setter forth of new gods. Because he preached to them Jesus and the resurrection .
text_la: Quidam autem epicurei et stoici philosophi disserebant cum eo, et quidam dicebant : Quid vult seminiverbius hic dicere? Alii vero : Novorum dæmoniorum videtur annuntiator esse : quia Jesum et resurrectionem annuntiabat eis.
text_pt: E alguns dos filósofos epicureus e estóicos contendiam com ele; e uns diziam: Que quer dizer este paroleiro? E outros: Parece que é pregador de deuses estranhos; porque lhes anunciava a Jesus e a ressurreição.
text_el: τινὲς δὲ καὶ τῶν Ἐπικουρείων καὶ Στοϊκῶν φιλοσόφων συνέβαλλον αὐτῷ, καί τινες ἔλεγον: τί ἂν θέλοι ὁ σπερμολόγος οὗτος λέγειν; οἱ δέ, ξένων δαιμονίων δοκεῖ καταγγελεὺς εἶναι, ὅτι τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ τὴν ἀνάστασιν εὐηγγελίζετο.

text_en: And taking him, they brought him to the Areopagus, saying: May we know what this new doctrine is, which you speak of?
text_la: Et apprehensum eum ad Areopagum duxerunt, dicentes : Possumus scire quæ est hæc nova, quæ a te dicitur, doctrina?
text_pt: E tomando-o, o levaram ao Areópago, dizendo: Poderemos nós saber que nova doutrina é essa de que falas?
text_el: ἐπιλαβόμενοί δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἄρειον Πάγον ἤγαγον, λέγοντες: δυνάμεθα γνῶναι τίς ἡ καινὴ αὕτη [ἡ] ὑπὸ σοῦ λαλουμένη διδαχή;

text_en: For you bring in certain new things to our ears. We would know therefore what these things mean.
text_la: nova enim quædam infers auribus nostris : volumus ergo scire quidnam velint hæc esse.
text_pt: Pois coisas estranhas nos trazes aos ouvidos; queremos pois saber o que vem a ser isto
text_el: ξενίζοντα γάρ τινα εἰσφέρεις εἰς τὰς ἀκοὰς ἡμῶν: βουλόμεθα οὖν γνῶναι τίνα θέλει ταῦτα εἶναι.

text_en: (Now all the Athenians and strangers that were there employed themselves in nothing else, but either in telling or in hearing some new thing.)
text_la: (Athenienses autem omnes, et advenæ hospites, ad nihil aliud vacabant nisi aut dicere aut audire aliquid novi.)
text_pt: (Pois todos os atenienses e estrangeiros residentes, de nenhuma outra coisa se ocupavam, senão de dizer e ouvir alguma novidade).
text_el: Ἀθηναῖοι δὲ πάντες καὶ οἱ ἐπιδημοῦντες ξένοι εἰς οὐδὲν ἕτερον ηὐκαίρουν ἢ λέγειν τι ἢ ἀκούειν τι καινότερον.

text_en: But Paul , standing in the midst of the Areopagus, said: You men of Athens , I perceive that in all things you are too superstitious .
text_la: Stans autem Paulus in medio Areopagi, ait : Viri Athenienses, per omnia quasi superstitiosiores vos video.
text_pt: E, estando Paulo no meio do Areópago, disse: Homens atenienses, em tudo vos vejo um tanto supersticiosos;
text_el: Σταθεὶς δὲ Παῦλος ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ Ἀρείου Πάγου ἔφη: Ἄνδρες Ἀθηναῖοι, κατὰ πάντα ὡς δεισιδαιμονεστέρους ὑμᾶς θεωρῶ:

text_en: For passing by and seeing your idols , I found an altar also, on which was written: To the Unknown God . What therefore you worship without knowing it, that I preach to you:
text_la: Præteriens enim, et videns simulacra vestra, inveni et aram in qua scriptum erat : Ignoto Deo. Quod ergo ignorantes colitis, hoc ego annuntio vobis.
text_pt: Porque, passando eu e vendo os vossos santuários, achei também um altar em que estava escrito: AO DEUS DESCONHECIDO. Esse, pois, que vós honrais, não o conhecendo, é o que eu vos anuncio.
text_el: διερχόμενος γὰρ καὶ ἀναθεωρῶν τὰ σεβάσματα ὑμῶν εὗρον καὶ βωμὸν ἐν ᾧ ἐπεγέγραπτο, ἀγνώστῳ θεῷ. ὃ οὖν ἀγνοοῦντες εὐσεβεῖτε, τοῦτο ἐγὼ καταγγέλλω ὑμῖν.

text_en: God , who made the world and all things therein, he being Lord of heaven and earth, dwells not in temples made with hands.
text_la: Deus, qui fecit mundum, et omnia quæ in eo sunt, hic cæli et terræ cum sit Dominus, non in manufactis templis habitat,
text_pt: O Deus que fez o mundo e tudo que nele há, sendo Senhor do céu e da terra, não habita em templos feitos por mãos de homens;
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ὁ ποιήσας τὸν κόσμον καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτῷ, οὗτος οὐρανοῦ καὶ γῆς ὑπάρχων κύριος οὐκ ἐν χειροποιήτοις ναοῖς κατοικεῖ

text_en: Neither is he served with men's hands, as though he needed anything: seeing it is he who gives to all life and breath and all things:
text_la: nec manibus humanis colitur indigens aliquo, cum ipse det omnibus vitam, et inspirationem, et omnia:
text_pt: Nem tampouco é servido por mãos de homens, como que necessitando de alguma coisa; pois ele mesmo é quem dá a todos a vida, e a respiração, e todas as coisas;
text_el: οὐδὲ ὑπὸ χειρῶν ἀνθρωπίνων θεραπεύεται προσδεόμενός τινος, αὐτὸς διδοὺς πᾶσι ζωὴν καὶ πνοὴν καὶ τὰ πάντα:

text_en: And has made of one, all mankind , to dwell upon the whole face of the earth, determining appointed times and the limits of their habitation.
text_la: fecitque ex uno omne genus hominum inhabitare super universam faciem terræ, definiens statuta tempora, et terminos habitationis eorum,
text_pt: E de um só sangue fez toda a geração dos homens, para habitar sobre toda a face da terra, determinando os tempos já dantes ordenados, e os limites da sua habitação;
text_el: ἐποίησέν τε ἐξ ἑνὸς πᾶν ἔθνος ἀνθρώπων κατοικεῖν ἐπὶ παντὸς προσώπου τῆς γῆς, ὁρίσας προστεταγμένους καιροὺς καὶ τὰς ὁροθεσίας τῆς κατοικίας αὐτῶν,

text_en: That they should seek God , if haply they may feel after him or find him, although he be not far from every one of us.
text_la: quærere Deum si forte attrectent eum, aut inveniant, quamvis non longe sit ab unoquoque nostrum.
text_pt: Para que buscassem ao Senhor, se porventura, tateando, o pudessem achar; ainda que não está longe de cada um de nós;
text_el: ζητεῖν τὸν θεὸν εἰ ἄρα γε ψηλαφήσειαν αὐτὸν καὶ εὕροιεν, καί γε οὐ μακρὰν ἀπὸ ἑνὸς ἑκάστου ἡμῶν ὑπάρχοντα.

text_en: For in him we live and move and are: as some also of your own poets said: For we are also his offspring.
text_la: In ipso enim vivimus, et movemur, et sumus : sicut et quidam vestrorum poëtarum dixerunt : Ipsius enim et genus sumus.
text_pt: Porque nele vivemos, e nos movemos, e existimos; como também alguns dos vossos poetas disseram: Pois somos também sua geração.
text_el: ἐν αὐτῷ γὰρ ζῶμεν καὶ κινούμεθα καὶ ἐσμέν, ὡς καί τινες τῶν καθ' ὑμᾶς ποιητῶν εἰρήκασιν, τοῦ γὰρ καὶ γένος ἐσμέν.

text_en: Being therefore the offspring of God , we must not suppose the divinity to be like unto gold or silver or stone, the graving of art and device of man .
text_la: Genus ergo cum simus Dei, non debemus æstimare auro, aut argento, aut lapidi, sculpturæ artis, et cogitationis hominis, divinum esse simile.
text_pt: Sendo nós, pois, geração de Deus, não havemos de cuidar que a divindade seja semelhante ao ouro, ou à prata, ou à pedra esculpida por artifício e imaginação dos homens.
text_el: γένος οὖν ὑπάρχοντες τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ὀφείλομεν νομίζειν χρυσῷ ἢ ἀργύρῳ ἢ λίθῳ, χαράγματι τέχνης καὶ ἐνθυμήσεως ἀνθρώπου, τὸ θεῖον εἶναι ὅμοιον.

text_en: And God indeed having winked at the times of this ignorance , now declares unto men that all should every where do penance .
text_la: Et tempora quidem hujus ignorantiæ despiciens Deus, nunc annuntiat hominibus ut omnes ubique pœnitentiam agant,
text_pt: Mas Deus, não tendo em conta os tempos da ignorância, anuncia agora a todos os homens, e em todo o lugar, que se arrependam;
text_el: τοὺς μὲν οὖν χρόνους τῆς ἀγνοίας ὑπεριδὼν ὁ θεὸς τὰ νῦν ἀπαγγέλλει τοῖς ἀνθρώποις πάντας πανταχοῦ μετανοεῖν,

text_en: Because he has appointed a day wherein he will judge the world in equity, by the man whom he has appointed: giving faith to all, by raising him up from the dead .
text_la: eo quod statuit diem in quo judicaturus est orbem in æquitate, in viro in quo statuit, fidem præbens omnibus, suscitans eum a mortuis.
text_pt: Porquanto tem determinado um dia em que com justiça há de julgar o mundo, por meio do homem que destinou; e disso deu certeza a todos, ressuscitando-o dentre os mortos.
text_el: καθότι ἔστησεν ἡμέραν ἐν ᾗ μέλλει κρίνειν τὴν οἰκουμένην ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ἐν ἀνδρὶ ᾧ ὥρισεν, πίστιν παρασχὼν πᾶσιν ἀναστήσας αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν.

text_en: And when they had heard of the resurrection of the dead , some indeed mocked. But others said: We will hear you again concerning this matter.
text_la: Cum audissent autem resurrectionem mortuorum, quidam quidem irridebant, quidam vero dixerunt : Audiemus te de hoc iterum.
text_pt: E, como ouviram falar da ressurreição dos mortos, uns escarneciam, e outros diziam: Acerca disso te ouviremos outra vez.
text_el: ἀκούσαντες δὲ ἀνάστασιν νεκρῶν οἱ μὲν ἐχλεύαζον, οἱ δὲ εἶπαν, ἀκουσόμεθά σου περὶ τούτου καὶ πάλιν.

text_en: So Paul went out from among them.
text_la: Sic Paulus exivit de medio eorum.
text_pt: E assim Paulo saiu do meio deles.
text_el: οὕτως ὁ Παῦλος ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν.
