text_en: But certain men , adhering to him, did believe : among whom was also Dionysius the Areopagite and a woman named Damaris and others with them.
text_la: Quidam vero viri adhærentes ei, crediderunt : in quibus et Dionysius Areopagita, et mulier nomine Damaris, et alii cum eis.
text_pt: Todavia, chegando alguns homens a ele, creram; entre os quais foi Dionísio, areopagita, uma mulher por nome Dâmaris, e com eles outros.
text_el: τινὲς δὲ ἄνδρες κολληθέντες αὐτῷ ἐπίστευσαν, ἐν οἷς καὶ Διονύσιος [ὁ] Ἀρεοπαγίτης καὶ γυνὴ ὀνόματι Δάμαρις καὶ ἕτεροι σὺν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: After these things, departing from Athens , he came to Corinth .
text_la: Post hæc egressus ab Athenis, venit Corinthum:
text_pt: E depois disto partiu Paulo de Atenas, e chegou a Corinto.
text_el: Μετὰ ταῦτα χωρισθεὶς ἐκ τῶν Ἀθηνῶν ἦλθεν εἰς Κόρινθον.

text_en: And finding a certain Jew , named Aquila , born in Pontus , lately come from Italy , with Priscilla his wife (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome ), he came to them.
text_la: et inveniens quemdam Judæum nomine Aquilam, Ponticum genere, qui nuper venerat ab Italia, et Priscillam uxorem ejus (eo quod præcepisset Claudius discedere omnes Judæos a Roma), accessit ad eos.
text_pt: E, achando um certo judeu por nome Áqüila, natural do Ponto, que havia pouco tinha vindo da Itália, e Priscila, sua mulher (pois Cláudio tinha mandado que todos os judeus saíssem de Roma), ajuntou-se com eles,
text_el: καὶ εὑρών τινα Ἰουδαῖον ὀνόματι Ἀκύλαν, Ποντικὸν τῷ γένει, προσφάτως ἐληλυθότα ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰταλίας καὶ Πρίσκιλλαν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸ διατεταχέναι Κλαύδιον χωρίζεσθαι πάντας τοὺς Ἰουδαίους ἀπὸ τῆς Ῥώμης, προσῆλθεν αὐτοῖς,

text_en: And because he was of the same trade, he remained with them and wrought. (Now they were tentmakers by trade.)
text_la: Et quia ejusdem erat artis, manebat apud eos, et operabatur. (Erant autem scenofactoriæ artis.)
text_pt: E, como era do mesmo ofício, ficou com eles, e trabalhava; pois tinham por ofício fazer tendas.
text_el: καὶ διὰ τὸ ὁμότεχνον εἶναι ἔμενεν παρ' αὐτοῖς καὶ ἠργάζοντο, ἦσαν γὰρ σκηνοποιοὶ τῇ τέχνῃ.

text_en: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath , bringing in the name of the Lord Jesus . And he persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.
text_la: Et disputabat in synagoga per omne sabbatum, interponens nomen Domini Jesu : suadebatque Judæis et Græcis.
text_pt: E todos os sábados disputava na sinagoga, e convencia a judeus e gregos.
text_el: διελέγετο δὲ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ κατὰ πᾶν σάββατον, ἔπειθέν τε Ἰουδαίους καὶ Ἕλληνας.

text_en: And when Silas and Timothy had come from Macedonia, Paul was earnest in preaching, testifying to the Jews that Jesus is the Christ .
text_la: Cum venissent autem de Macedonia Silas et Timotheus, instabat verbo Paulus, testificans Judæis esse Christum Jesum.
text_pt: E, quando Silas e Timóteo desceram da Macedônia, foi Paulo impulsionado no espírito, testificando aos judeus que Jesus era o Cristo.
text_el: Ὡς δὲ κατῆλθον ἀπὸ τῆς Μακεδονίας ὅ τε Σιλᾶς καὶ ὁ Τιμόθεος, συνείχετο τῷ λόγῳ ὁ Παῦλος, διαμαρτυρόμενος τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις εἶναι τὸν Χριστόν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: But they gainsaying and blaspheming , he shook his garments and said to them: Your blood be upon your own heads: I am clean. From henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles .
text_la: Contradicentibus autem eis, et blasphemantibus, excutiens vestimenta sua, dixit ad eos : Sanguis vester super caput vestrum : mundus ego : ex hoc ad gentes vadam.
text_pt: Mas, resistindo e blasfemando eles, sacudiu as vestes, e disse-lhes: O vosso sangue seja sobre a vossa cabeça; eu estou limpo, e desde agora parto para os gentios.
text_el: ἀντιτασσομένων δὲ αὐτῶν καὶ βλασφημούντων ἐκτιναξάμενος τὰ ἱμάτια εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς, τὸ αἷμα ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν ὑμῶν: καθαρὸς ἐγώ: ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν εἰς τὰ ἔθνη πορεύσομαι.

text_en: And departing thence, he entered into the house of a certain man , named Titus Justus, one that worshipped God , whose house was adjoining to the synagogue .
text_la: Et migrans inde, intravit in domum cujusdam, nomine Titi Justi, colentis Deum, cujus domus erat conjuncta synagogæ.
text_pt: E, saindo dali, entrou em casa de um homem chamado chamado Justo, que servia a Deus, e cuja casa estava junto da sinagoga.
text_el: καὶ μεταβὰς ἐκεῖθεν ἦλθεν εἰς οἰκίαν τινὸς ὀνόματι Τιτίου Ἰούστου σεβομένου τὸν θεόν, οὗ ἡ οἰκία ἦν συνομοροῦσα τῇ συναγωγῇ.

text_en: And Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue , believed in the Lord , with all his house. And many of the Corinthians hearing, believed and were baptized .
text_la: Crispus autem archisynagogus credidit Domino cum omni domo sua : et multi Corinthiorum audientes credebant, et baptizabantur.
text_pt: E Crispo, principal da sinagoga, creu no Senhor com toda a sua casa; e muitos dos coríntios, ouvindo-o, creram e foram batizados.
text_el: Κρίσπος δὲ ὁ ἀρχισυνάγωγος ἐπίστευσεν τῷ κυρίῳ σὺν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ, καὶ πολλοὶ τῶν Κορινθίων ἀκούοντες ἐπίστευον καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο.

text_en: And the Lord said to Paul in the night, by a vision : Do not fear , but speak. And hold not your peace,
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus nocte per visionem Paulo : Noli timere, sed loquere, et ne taceas:
text_pt: E disse o Senhor em visão a Paulo: Não temas, mas fala, e não te cales;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ κύριος ἐν νυκτὶ δι' ὁράματος τῷ Παύλῳ, μὴ φοβοῦ, ἀλλὰ λάλει καὶ μὴ σιωπήσῃς,

text_en: because I am with you and no man shall set upon you, to hurt you. For I have much people in this city.
text_la: propter quod ego sum tecum, et nemo apponetur tibi ut noceat te : quoniam populus est mihi multus in hac civitate.
text_pt: Porque eu sou contigo, e ninguém lançará mão de ti para te fazer mal, pois tenho muito povo nesta cidade.
text_el: διότι ἐγώ εἰμι μετὰ σοῦ καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπιθήσεταί σοι τοῦ κακῶσαί σε, διότι λαός ἐστί μοι πολὺς ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ.

text_en: And he stayed there a year and six months, teaching among them the word of God .
text_la: Sedit autem ibi annum et sex menses, docens apud eos verbum Dei.
text_pt: E ficou ali um ano e seis meses, ensinando entre eles a palavra de Deus.
text_el: ἐκάθισεν δὲ ἐνιαυτὸν καὶ μῆνας ἓξ διδάσκων ἐν αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia , the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him to the judgment seat,
text_la: Gallione autem proconsule Achaiæ, insurrexerunt uno animo Judæi in Paulum, et adduxerunt eum ad tribunal,
text_pt: Mas, sendo Gálio procônsul da Acaia, levantaram-se os judeus concordemente contra Paulo, e o levaram ao tribunal,
text_el: Γαλλίωνος δὲ ἀνθυπάτου ὄντος τῆς Ἀχαΐας κατεπέστησαν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ὁμοθυμαδὸν τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ βῆμα,

text_en: saying: This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law .
text_la: dicentes : Quia contra legem hic persuadet hominibus colere Deum.
text_pt: Dizendo: Este persuade os homens a servir a Deus contra a lei.
text_el: λέγοντες ὅτι παρὰ τὸν νόμον ἀναπείθει οὗτος τοὺς ἀνθρώπους σέβεσθαι τὸν θεόν.

text_en: And when Paul was beginning to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews : If it were some matter of injustice or an heinous deed, O Jews , I should with reason bear with you.
text_la: Incipiente autem Paulo aperire os, dixit Gallio ad Judæos : Si quidem esset iniquum aliquid aut facinus pessimum, o viri Judæi, recte vos sustinerem.
text_pt: E, querendo Paulo abrir a boca, disse Gálio aos judeus: Se houvesse, ó judeus, algum agravo ou crime enorme, com razão vos sofreria,
text_el: μέλλοντος δὲ τοῦ Παύλου ἀνοίγειν τὸ στόμα εἶπεν ὁ Γαλλίων πρὸς τοὺς Ἰουδαίους, εἰ μὲν ἦν ἀδίκημά τι ἢ ῥᾳδιούργημα πονηρόν, ὦ Ἰουδαῖοι, κατὰ λόγον ἂν ἀνεσχόμην ὑμῶν:

text_en: But if they be questions of word and names and of your law , look you to it. I will not be judge of such things.
text_la: Si vero quæstiones sunt de verbo, et nominibus, et lege vestra, vos ipsi videritis : judex ego horum nolo esse.
text_pt: Mas, se a questão é de palavras, e de nomes, e da lei que entre vós há, vede-o vós mesmos; porque eu não quero ser juiz dessas coisas.
text_el: εἰ δὲ ζητήματά ἐστιν περὶ λόγου καὶ ὀνομάτων καὶ νόμου τοῦ καθ' ὑμᾶς, ὄψεσθε αὐτοί: κριτὴς ἐγὼ τούτων οὐ βούλομαι εἶναι.

text_en: And he drove them from the judgment seat.
text_la: Et minavit eos a tribunali.
text_pt: E expulsou-os do tribunal.
text_el: καὶ ἀπήλασεν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ βήματος.

text_en: And all laying hold on Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue , beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
text_la: Apprehendentes autem omnes Sosthenem principem synagogæ, percutiebant eum ante tribunal : et nihil eorum Gallioni curæ erat.
text_pt: Então todos os gregos agarraram Sóstenes, principal da sinagoga, e o feriram diante do tribunal; e a Gálio nada destas coisas o incomodava.
text_el: ἐπιλαβόμενοι δὲ πάντες Σωσθένην τὸν ἀρχισυνάγωγον ἔτυπτον ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ βήματος: καὶ οὐδὲν τούτων τῷ Γαλλίωνι ἔμελεν.

text_en: But Paul , when he had stayed yet many days, taking his leave of the brethren, sailed thence into Syria (and with him Priscilla and Aquila ), having shorn his head in Cenchrae. For he had a vow .
text_la: Paulus vero cum adhuc sustinuisset dies multos fratribus valefaciens, navigavit in Syriam (et cum eo Priscilla et Aquila), qui sibi totonderat in Cenchris caput : habebat enim votum.
text_pt: E Paulo, ficando ainda ali muitos dias, despediu-se dos irmãos, e dali navegou para a Síria, e com ele Priscila e Áqüila, tendo rapado a cabeça em Cencréia, porque tinha voto.
text_el: Ὁ δὲ Παῦλος ἔτι προσμείνας ἡμέρας ἱκανὰς τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ἀποταξάμενος ἐξέπλει εἰς τὴν Συρίαν, καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ Πρίσκιλλα καὶ Ἀκύλας, κειράμενος ἐν Κεγχρεαῖς τὴν κεφαλήν, εἶχεν γὰρ εὐχήν.

text_en: And he came to Ephesus and left them there. But he himself, entering into the synagogue , disputed with the Jews .
text_la: Devenitque Ephesum, et illos ibi reliquit. Ipse vero ingressus synagogam, disputabat cum Judæis.
text_pt: E chegou a Éfeso, e deixou-os ali; mas ele, entrando na sinagoga, disputava com os judeus.
text_el: κατήντησαν δὲ εἰς Ἔφεσον, κἀκείνους κατέλιπεν αὐτοῦ, αὐτὸς δὲ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν διελέξατο τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις.

text_en: And when they desired him that he would tarry a longer time, he consented not:
text_la: Rogantibus autem eis ut ampliori tempore maneret, non consensit,
text_pt: E, rogando-lhe eles que ficasse por mais algum tempo, não conveio nisso.
text_el: ἐρωτώντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἐπὶ πλείονα χρόνον μεῖναι οὐκ ἐπένευσεν,

text_en: But taking his leave and saying: I will return to you again, God willing, he departed from Ephesus .
text_la: sed valefaciens, et dicens : Iterum revertar ad vos, Deo volente : profectus est ab Epheso.
text_pt: Antes se despediu deles, dizendo: É-me de todo preciso celebrar a solenidade que vem em Jerusalém; mas querendo Deus, outra vez voltarei a vós. E partiu de Éfeso.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἀποταξάμενος καὶ εἰπών: πάλιν ἀνακάμψω πρὸς ὑμᾶς τοῦ θεοῦ θέλοντος, ἀνήχθη ἀπὸ τῆς Ἐφέσου:

text_en: And going down to Caesarea , he went up to Jerusalem and saluted the church : and so came down to Antioch .
text_la: Et descendens Cæsaream, ascendit, et salutavit ecclesiam, et descendit Antiochiam.
text_pt: E, chegando a Cesaréia, subiu a Jerusalém e, saudando a igreja, desceu a Antioquia.
text_el: καὶ κατελθὼν εἰς Καισάρειαν, ἀναβὰς καὶ ἀσπασάμενος τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, κατέβη εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν,

text_en: And after he had spent some time there, he departed and went through the country of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, confirming all the disciples .
text_la: Et facto ibi aliquanto tempore profectus est, perambulans ex ordine Galaticam regionem, et Phrygiam, confirmans omnes discipulos.
text_pt: E, estando ali algum tempo, partiu, passando sucessivamente pela província da Galácia e da Frígia, confirmando a todos os discípulos.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσας χρόνον τινὰ ἐξῆλθεν, διερχόμενος καθεξῆς τὴν Γαλατικὴν χώραν καὶ Φρυγίαν, στηρίζων πάντας τοὺς μαθητάς.

text_en: Now a certain Jew , named Apollo, born at Alexandria , an eloquent man , came to Ephesus , one mighty in the scriptures .
text_la: Judæus autem quidam, Apollo nomine, Alexandrinus genere, vir eloquens, devenit Ephesum, potens in scripturis.
text_pt: E chegou a Éfeso um certo judeu chamado Apolo, natural de Alexandria, homem eloqüente e poderoso nas Escrituras.
text_el: Ἰουδαῖος δέ τις Ἀπολλῶς ὀνόματι, Ἀλεξανδρεὺς τῷ γένει, ἀνὴρ λόγιος, κατήντησεν εἰς Ἔφεσον, δυνατὸς ὢν ἐν ταῖς γραφαῖς.

text_en: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord : and being fervent in spirit , spoke and taught diligently the things that are of Jesus , knowing only the baptism of John .
text_la: Hic erat edoctus viam Domini : et fervens spiritu loquebatur, et docebat diligenter ea quæ sunt Jesu, sciens tantum baptisma Joannis.
text_pt: Este era instruído no caminho do Senhor e, fervoroso de espírito, falava e ensinava diligentemente as coisas do Senhor, conhecendo somente o batismo de João.
text_el: οὗτος ἦν κατηχημένος τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ κυρίου, καὶ ζέων τῷ πνεύματι ἐλάλει καὶ ἐδίδασκεν ἀκριβῶς τὰ περὶ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ἐπιστάμενος μόνον τὸ βάπτισμα Ἰωάννου.

text_en: This man therefore began to speak boldly in the synagogue . Whom when Priscilla and Aquila had heard, they took him to them and expounded to him the way of the Lord more diligently.
text_la: Hic ergo cœpit fiducialiter agere in synagoga. Quem cum audissent Priscilla et Aquila, assumpserunt eum, et diligentius exposuerunt ei viam Domini.
text_pt: Ele começou a falar ousadamente na sinagoga; e, quando o ouviram Priscila e Aqüila, o levaram consigo e lhe declararam mais precisamente o caminho de Deus.
text_el: οὗτός τε ἤρξατο παρρησιάζεσθαι ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ: ἀκούσαντες δὲ αὐτοῦ Πρίσκιλλα καὶ Ἀκύλας προσελάβοντο αὐτὸν καὶ ἀκριβέστερον αὐτῷ ἐξέθεντο τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And whereas he was desirous to go to Achaia , the brethren exhorting wrote to the disciples to receive him. Who, when he had come, helped them much who had believed .
text_la: Cum autem vellet ire Achaiam, exhortati fratres, scripserunt discipulis ut susciperent eum. Qui cum venisset, contulit multum his qui crediderant.
text_pt: Querendo ele passar à Acaia, o animaram os irmãos, e escreveram aos discípulos que o recebessem; o qual, tendo chegado, aproveitou muito aos que pela graça criam.
text_el: βουλομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ διελθεῖν εἰς τὴν Ἀχαΐαν, προτρεψάμενοι οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἔγραψαν τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἀποδέξασθαι αὐτόν. ὃς παραγενόμενος συνεβάλετο πολὺ τοῖς πεπιστευκόσιν διὰ τῆς χάριτος.

text_en: For with much vigour he convinced the Jews openly, showing by the scriptures that Jesus is the Christ .
text_la: Vehementer enim Judæos revincebat publice, ostendens per Scripturas esse Christum Jesum.
text_pt: Porque com grande veemência, convencia publicamente os judeus, mostrando pelas Escrituras que Jesus era o Cristo.
text_el: εὐτόνως γὰρ τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις διακατηλέγχετο δημοσίᾳ ἐπιδεικνὺς διὰ τῶν γραφῶν εἶναι τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And it came to pass, while Apollo was at Corinth , that Paul , having passed through the upper coasts, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples .
text_la: Factum est autem cum Apollo esset Corinthi, ut Paulus peragratis superioribus partibus veniret Ephesum, et inveniret quosdam discipulos:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, enquanto Apolo estava em Corinto, Paulo, tendo passado por todas as regiões superiores, chegou a Éfeso; e achando ali alguns discípulos,
text_el: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ τὸν Ἀπολλῶ εἶναι ἐν Κορίνθῳ Παῦλον διελθόντα τὰ ἀνωτερικὰ μέρη ἐλθεῖν εἰς Ἔφεσον καὶ εὑρεῖν τινας μαθητάς,

text_en: And he said to them: Have you received the Holy Ghost since you believed ? But they said to him: We have not so much as heard whether there be a Holy Ghost .
text_la: dixitque ad eos : Si Spiritum Sanctum accepistis credentes? At illi dixerunt ad eum : Sed neque si Spiritus Sanctus est, audivimus.
text_pt: Disse-lhes: Recebestes vós já o Espírito Santo quando crestes? E eles disseram-lhe: Nós nem ainda ouvimos que haja Espírito Santo.
text_el: εἶπέν τε πρὸς αὐτούς, εἰ πνεῦμα ἅγιον ἐλάβετε πιστεύσαντες; οἱ δὲ πρὸς αὐτόν, ἀλλ' οὐδ' εἰ πνεῦμα ἅγιον ἔστιν ἠκούσαμεν.

text_en: And he said: In what then were you baptized ? Who said: In John's baptism .
text_la: Ille vero ait : In quo ergo baptizati estis? Qui dixerunt : In Joannis baptismate.
text_pt: Perguntou-lhes, então: Em que sois batizados então? E eles disseram: No batismo de João.
text_el: εἶπέν: τε, εἰς τί οὖν ἐβαπτίσθητε; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν, εἰς τὸ Ἰωάννου βάπτισμα.

text_en: Then Paul said: John baptized the people with the baptism of penance saying: That they should believe in him, who was to come after him, that is to say, in Jesus .
text_la: Dixit autem Paulus : Joannes baptizavit baptismo pœnitentiæ populum, dicens in eum qui venturus esset post ipsum ut crederent, hoc est, in Jesum.
text_pt: Mas Paulo disse: Certamente João batizou com o batismo de arrependimento, dizendo ao povo que cresse no que após ele havia de vir, isto é, em Jesus Cristo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Παῦλος: Ἰωάννης ἐβάπτισεν βάπτισμα μετανοίας, τῷ λαῷ λέγων εἰς τὸν ἐρχόμενον μετ' αὐτὸν ἵνα πιστεύσωσιν, τοῦτ' ἔστιν εἰς τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: Having heard these things, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus .
text_la: His auditis, baptizati sunt in nomine Domini Jesu.
text_pt: E os que ouviram foram batizados em nome do Senhor Jesus.
text_el: ἀκούσαντες δὲ ἐβαπτίσθησαν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: And when Paul had imposed his hands on them, the Holy Ghost came upon them : and they spoke with tongues and prophesied .
text_la: Et cum imposuisset illis manus Paulus, venit Spiritus Sanctus super eos, et loquebantur linguis, et prophetabant.
text_pt: E, impondo-lhes Paulo as mãos, veio sobre eles o Espírito Santo; e falavam línguas, e profetizavam.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθέντος αὐτοῖς τοῦ Παύλου χεῖρας ἦλθε τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ἐπ' αὐτούς, ἐλάλουν τε γλώσσαις καὶ ἐπροφήτευον.

text_en: And all the men were about twelve.
text_la: Erant autem omnes viri fere duodecim.
text_pt: E estes eram, ao todo, uns doze homens.
text_el: ἦσαν δὲ οἱ πάντες ἄνδρες ὡσεὶ δώδεκα.

text_en: And entering into the synagogue , he spoke boldly for the space of three months, disputing and exhorting concerning the kingdom of God .
text_la: Introgressus autem synagogam, cum fiducia loquebatur per tres menses, disputans et suadens de regno Dei.
text_pt: E, entrando na sinagoga, falou ousadamente por espaço de três meses, disputando e persuadindo-os acerca do reino de Deus.
text_el: Εἰσελθὼν δὲ εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν ἐπαρρησιάζετο ἐπὶ μῆνας τρεῖς διαλεγόμενος καὶ πείθων περὶ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: But when some were hardened and believed not, speaking evil of the way of the Lord before the multitude, departing from them, he separated the disciples , disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.
text_la: Cum autem quidam indurarentur, et non crederent, maledicentes viam Domini coram multitudine, discedens ab eis, segregavit discipulos, quotidie disputans in schola tyranni cujusdam.
text_pt: Mas, como alguns deles se endurecessem e não obedecessem, falando mal do Caminho perante a multidão, retirou-se deles, e separou os discípulos, disputando todos os dias na escola de um certo Tirano.
text_el: ὡς δέ τινες ἐσκληρύνοντο καὶ ἠπείθουν κακολογοῦντες τὴν ὁδὸν ἐνώπιον τοῦ πλήθους, ἀποστὰς ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἀφώρισεν τοὺς μαθητάς, καθ' ἡμέραν διαλεγόμενος ἐν τῇ σχολῇ Τυράννου.

text_en: And this continued for the space of two years, so that all who dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord , both Jews and Gentiles .
text_la: Hoc autem factum est per biennium, ita ut omnes qui habitabant in Asia audirent verbum Domini, Judæi atque gentiles.
text_pt: E durou isto por espaço de dois anos; de tal maneira que todos os que habitavam na Ásia ouviram a palavra do Senhor Jesus, assim judeus como gregos.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ ἔτη δύο, ὥστε πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν Ἀσίαν ἀκοῦσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ κυρίου, Ἰουδαίους τε καὶ Ἕλληνας.

text_en: And God wrought by the hand of Paul more than common miracles .
text_la: Virtutesque non quaslibet faciebat Deus per manum Pauli,
text_pt: E Deus pelas mãos de Paulo fazia maravilhas extraordinárias.
text_el: Δυνάμεις τε οὐ τὰς τυχούσας ὁ θεὸς ἐποίει διὰ τῶν χειρῶν Παύλου,

text_en: So that even there were brought from his body to the sick, handkerchiefs and aprons: and the diseases departed from them: and the wicked spirits went out of them.
text_la: ita ut etiam super languidos deferrentur a corpore ejus sudaria et semicinctia, et recedebant ab eis languores, et spiritus nequam egrediebantur.
text_pt: De sorte que até os lenços e aventais se levavam do seu corpo aos enfermos, e as enfermidades fugiam deles, e os espíritos malignos saíam.
text_el: ὥστε καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀσθενοῦντας ἀποφέρεσθαι ἀπὸ τοῦ χρωτὸς αὐτοῦ σουδάρια ἢ σιμικίνθια καὶ ἀπαλλάσσεσθαι ἀπ' αὐτῶν τὰς νόσους, τά τε πνεύματα τὰ πονηρὰ ἐκπορεύεσθαι.

text_en: Now some also of the Jewish exorcists , who went about, attempted to invoke over them that had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus , saying: I conjure you by Jesus , whom Paul preaches.
text_la: Tentaverunt autem quidam et de circumeuntibus Judæis exorcistis invocare super eos qui habebant spiritus malos nomen Domini Jesu, dicentes : Adjuro vos per Jesum, quem Paulus prædicat.
text_pt: E alguns dos exorcistas judeus ambulantes tentavam invocar o nome do Senhor Jesus sobre os que tinham espíritos malignos, dizendo: Esconjuro-vos por Jesus a quem Paulo prega.
text_el: ἐπεχείρησαν δέ τινες καὶ τῶν περιερχομένων Ἰουδαίων ἐξορκιστῶν ὀνομάζειν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἔχοντας τὰ πνεύματα τὰ πονηρὰ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες, ὁρκίζω ὑμᾶς τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὃν Παῦλος κηρύσσει.

text_en: And there were certain men , seven sons of Sceva, a Jew , a chief priest , that did this.
text_la: Erant autem quidam Judæi, Scevæ principis sacerdotum septem filii, qui hoc faciebant.
text_pt: E os que faziam isto eram sete filhos de Ceva, judeu, principal dos sacerdotes.
text_el: ἦσαν δέ τινος Σκευᾶ Ἰουδαίου ἀρχιερέως ἑπτὰ υἱοὶ τοῦτο ποιοῦντες.

text_en: But the wicked spirit , answering, said to them: Jesus I know : and Paul I know . But who are you?
text_la: Respondens autem spiritus nequam dixit eis : Jesum novi, et Paulum scio : vos autem qui estis?
text_pt: Respondendo, porém, o espírito maligno, disse: Conheço a Jesus, e bem sei quem é Paulo; mas vós quem sois?
text_el: ἀποκριθὲν δὲ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ πονηρὸν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, Τὸν [μὲν] Ἰησοῦν γινώσκω καὶ τὸν Παῦλον ἐπίσταμαι, ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνες ἐστέ;

text_en: And the man in whom the wicked spirit was, leaping upon them and mastering them both, prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
text_la: Et insiliens in eos homo, in quo erat dæmonium pessimum, et dominatus amborum, invaluit contra eos, ita ut nudi et vulnerati effugerent de domo illa.
text_pt: E, saltando neles o homem que tinha o espírito maligno, e assenhoreando-se de todos, pôde mais do que eles; de tal maneira que, nus e feridos, fugiram daquela casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐφαλόμενος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐν ᾧ ἦν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ πονηρὸν κατακυριεύσας ἀμφοτέρων ἴσχυσεν κατ' αὐτῶν, ὥστε γυμνοὺς καὶ τετραυματισμένους ἐκφυγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου ἐκείνου.

text_en: And this became known to all the Jews and the Gentiles that dwelt a Ephesus . And fear fell on them all: and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
text_la: Hoc autem notum factum est omnibus Judæis, atque gentilibus qui habitabant Ephesi : et cecidit timor super omnes illos, et magnificabatur nomen Domini Jesu.
text_pt: E foi isto notório a todos os que habitavam em Éfeso, tanto judeus como gregos; e caiu temor sobre todos eles, e o nome do Senhor Jesus era engrandecido.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο γνωστὸν πᾶσιν Ἰουδαίοις τε καὶ Ἕλλησιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν τὴν Ἔφεσον, καὶ ἐπέπεσεν φόβος ἐπὶ πάντας αὐτούς, καὶ ἐμεγαλύνετο τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: And many of them that believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds .
text_la: Multique credentium veniebant, confitentes et annuntiantes actus suos.
text_pt: E muitos dos que tinham crido vinham, confessando e publicando os seus feitos.
text_el: πολλοί τε τῶν πεπιστευκότων ἤρχοντο ἐξομολογούμενοι καὶ ἀναγγέλλοντες τὰς πράξεις αὐτῶν.

text_en: And many of them who had followed curious arts brought together their books and burnt them before all. And, counting the price of them, they found the money to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.
text_la: Multi autem ex eis, qui fuerant curiosa sectati, contulerunt libros, et combusserunt coram omnibus : et computatis pretiis illorum, invenerunt pecuniam denariorum quinquaginta millium.
text_pt: Também muitos dos que seguiam artes mágicas trouxeram os seus livros, e os queimaram na presença de todos e, feita a conta do seu preço, acharam que montava a cinqüenta mil peças de prata.
text_el: ἱκανοὶ δὲ τῶν τὰ περίεργα πραξάντων συνενέγκαντες τὰς βίβλους κατέκαιον ἐνώπιον πάντων: καὶ συνεψήφισαν τὰς τιμὰς αὐτῶν καὶ εὗρον ἀργυρίου μυριάδας πέντε.

text_en: So mightily grew the word of God and was confirmed.
text_la: Ita fortiter crescebat verbum Dei, et confirmabatur.
text_pt: Assim a palavra do Senhor crescia poderosamente e prevalecia.
text_el: Οὕτως κατὰ κράτος τοῦ κυρίου ὁ λόγος ηὔξανεν καὶ ἴσχυεν.

text_en: And when these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia , to go to Jerusalem , saying: After I have been there, I must see Rome also.
text_la: His autem expletis, proposuit Paulus in Spiritu, transita Macedonia et Achaia, ire Jerosolymam, dicens : Quoniam postquam fuero ibi, oportet me et Romam videre.
text_pt: E, cumpridas estas coisas, Paulo propôs, em espírito, ir a Jerusalém, passando pela Macedônia e pela Acaia, dizendo: Depois que houver estado ali, importa-me ver também Roma.
text_el: Ὡς δὲ ἐπληρώθη ταῦτα, ἔθετο ὁ Παῦλος ἐν τῷ πνεύματι διελθὼν τὴν Μακεδονίαν καὶ Ἀχαΐαν πορεύεσθαι εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, εἰπὼν ὅτι μετὰ τὸ γενέσθαι με ἐκεῖ δεῖ με καὶ Ῥώμην ἰδεῖν.

text_en: And sending into Macedonia two of them that ministered to him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself remained for a time in Asia .
text_la: Mittens autem in Macedoniam duos ex ministrantibus sibi, Timotheum et Erastum, ipse remansit ad tempus in Asia.
text_pt: E, enviando à Macedônia dois daqueles que o serviam, Timóteo e Erasto, ficou ele por algum tempo na Ásia.
text_el: ἀποστείλας δὲ εἰς τὴν Μακεδονίαν δύο τῶν διακονούντων αὐτῷ, Τιμόθεον καὶ Ἔραστον, αὐτὸς ἐπέσχεν χρόνον εἰς τὴν Ἀσίαν.

text_en: Now at that time there arose no small disturbance about the way of the Lord .
text_la: Facta est autem illo tempore turbatio non minima de via Domini.
text_pt: E, naquele mesmo tempo, houve um não pequeno alvoroço acerca do Caminho.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ κατὰ τὸν καιρὸν ἐκεῖνον τάραχος οὐκ ὀλίγος περὶ τῆς ὁδοῦ.

text_en: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver temples for Diana, brought no small gain to the craftsmen.
text_la: Demetrius enim quidam nomine, argentarius, faciens ædes argenteas Dianæ, præstabat artificibus non modicum quæstum:
text_pt: Porque um certo ourives da prata, por nome Demétrio, que fazia de prata nichos de Diana, dava não pouco lucro aos artífices,
text_el: Δημήτριος γάρ τις ὀνόματι, ἀργυροκόπος, ποιῶν ναοὺς [ἀργυροῦς] Ἀρτέμιδος παρείχετο τοῖς τεχνίταις οὐκ ὀλίγην ἐργασίαν,

text_en: Whom he calling together with the workmen of like occupation, said: Sirs, you know that our gain is by this trade.
text_la: quos convocans, et eos qui hujusmodi erant opifices, dixit : Viri, scitis quia de hoc artificio est nobis acquisitio:
text_pt: Aos quais, havendo-os ajuntado com os oficiais de obras semelhantes, disse: Senhores, vós bem sabeis que deste ofício temos a nossa prosperidade;
text_el: οὓς συναθροίσας καὶ τοὺς περὶ τὰ τοιαῦτα ἐργάτας εἶπεν, ἄνδρες, ἐπίστασθε ὅτι ἐκ ταύτης τῆς ἐργασίας ἡ εὐπορία ἡμῖν ἐστιν,

text_en: And you see and hear that this Paul , by persuasion has drawn away a great multitude, not only of Ephesus , but almost of all Asia , saying: they are not gods which are made by hands.
text_la: et videtis et auditis quia non solum Ephesi, sed pene totius Asiæ, Paulus hic suadens avertit multam turbam, dicens : Quoniam non sunt dii, qui manibus fiunt.
text_pt: E bem vedes e ouvis que não só em Éfeso, mas até quase em toda a Ásia, este Paulo tem convencido e afastado uma grande multidão, dizendo que não são deuses os que se fazem com as mãos.
text_el: καὶ θεωρεῖτε καὶ ἀκούετε ὅτι οὐ μόνον Ἐφέσου ἀλλὰ σχεδὸν πάσης τῆς Ἀσίας ὁ Παῦλος οὗτος πείσας μετέστησεν ἱκανὸν ὄχλον, λέγων ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν θεοὶ οἱ διὰ χειρῶν γινόμενοι.

text_en: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought, but also the temple of great Diana shall be reputed for nothing! Yea, and her majesty shall begin to be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.
text_la: Non solum autem hæc periclitabitur nobis pars in redargutionem venire, sed et magnæ Dianæ templum in nihilum reputabitur, sed et destrui incipiet majestas ejus, quam tota Asia et orbis colit.
text_pt: E não somente há o perigo de que a nossa profissão caia em descrédito, mas também de que o próprio templo da grande deusa Diana seja estimado em nada, vindo a ser destruída a majestade daquela que toda a Ásia e o mundo veneram.
text_el: οὐ μόνον δὲ τοῦτο κινδυνεύει ἡμῖν τὸ μέρος εἰς ἀπελεγμὸν ἐλθεῖν, ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸ τῆς μεγάλης θεᾶς Ἀρτέμιδος ἱερὸν εἰς οὐθὲν λογισθῆναι, μέλλειν τε καὶ καθαιρεῖσθαι τῆς μεγαλειότητος αὐτῆς, ἣν ὅλη [ἡ] Ἀσία καὶ [ἡ] οἰκουμένη σέβεται.

text_en: Having heard these things, they were full of anger and cried out, saying: Great is Diana of the Ephesians !
text_la: His auditis, repleti sunt ira, et exclamaverunt dicentes : Magna Diana Ephesiorum.
text_pt: E, ouvindo-o, encheram-se de ira, e clamaram, dizendo: Grande é a Diana dos efésios.
text_el: ἀκούσαντες δὲ καὶ γενόμενοι πλήρεις θυμοῦ ἔκραζον λέγοντες, μεγάλη ἡ Ἄρτεμις Ἐφεσίων.

text_en: And the whole city was filled with confusion. And having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
text_la: Et impleta est civitas confusione, et impetum fecerunt uno animo in theatrum, rapto Gajo et Aristarcho Macedonibus, comitibus Pauli.
text_pt: E encheu-se de confusão toda a cidade e, unânimes, correram ao teatro, arrebatando a Gaio e a Aristarco, macedônios, companheiros de Paulo na viagem.
text_el: καὶ ἐπλήσθη ἡ πόλις τῆς συγχύσεως, ὥρμησάν τε ὁμοθυμαδὸν εἰς τὸ θέατρον συναρπάσαντες Γάϊον καὶ Ἀρίσταρχον Μακεδόνας, συνεκδήμους Παύλου.

text_en: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples allowed him not.
text_la: Paulo autem volente intrare in populum, non permiserunt discipuli.
text_pt: E, querendo Paulo apresentar-se ao povo, não lho permitiram os discípulos.
text_el: Παύλου δὲ βουλομένου εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸν δῆμον οὐκ εἴων αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταί:

text_en: And some also of the rulers of Asia , who were his friends, sent unto him, desiring that he would not venture himself into the theatre.
text_la: Quidam autem et de Asiæ principibus, qui erant amici ejus, miserunt ad eum rogantes ne se daret in theatrum:
text_pt: E também alguns dos principais da Ásia, que eram seus amigos, lhe rogaram que não se apresentasse no teatro.
text_el: τινὲς δὲ καὶ τῶν Ἀσιαρχῶν, ὄντες αὐτῷ φίλοι, πέμψαντες πρὸς αὐτὸν παρεκάλουν μὴ δοῦναι ἑαυτὸν εἰς τὸ θέατρον.

text_en: Now some cried one thing, some another. For the assembly was confused: and the greater part knew not for what cause they had come together.
text_la: alii autem aliud clamabant. Erat enim ecclesia confusa : et plures nesciebant qua ex causa convenissent.
text_pt: Uns, pois, clamavam de uma maneira, outros de outra, porque o ajuntamento era confuso; e os mais deles não sabiam por que causa se tinham ajuntado.
text_el: ἄλλοι μὲν οὖν ἄλλο τι ἔκραζον, ἦν γὰρ ἡ ἐκκλησία συγκεχυμένη, καὶ οἱ πλείους οὐκ ᾔδεισαν τίνος ἕνεκα συνεληλύθεισαν.

text_en: And they drew forth Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews thrusting him forward. And Alexander , beckoning with his hand for silence, would have given the people satisfaction,
text_la: De turba autem detraxerunt Alexandrum, propellentibus eum Judæis. Alexander autem manu silentio postulato, volebat reddere rationem populo.
text_pt: Então tiraram Alexandre dentre a multidão, impelindo-o os judeus para diante; e Alexandre, acenando com a mão, queria dar razão disto ao povo.
text_el: ἐκ δὲ τοῦ ὄχλου συνεβίβασαν Ἀλέξανδρον, προβαλόντων αὐτὸν τῶν Ἰουδαίων: ὁ δὲ Ἀλέξανδρος κατασείσας τὴν χεῖρα ἤθελεν ἀπολογεῖσθαι τῷ δήμῳ.

text_en: but as soon as they perceived him to be a Jew , all with one voice, for the space of about two hours, cried out: Great is Diana of the Ephesians !
text_la: Quem ut cognoverunt Judæum esse, vox facta una est omnium, quasi per horas duas clamantium : Magna Diana Ephesiorum.
text_pt: Mas quando conheceram que era judeu, todos unanimemente levantaram a voz, clamando por espaço de quase duas horas: Grande é a Diana dos efésios.
text_el: ἐπιγνόντες δὲ ὅτι Ἰουδαῖός ἐστιν φωνὴ ἐγένετο μία ἐκ πάντων ὡσεὶ ἐπὶ ὥρας δύο κραζόντων: μεγάλη ἡ Ἄρτεμις Ἐφεσίων.

text_en: And when the town clerk had appeased the multitudes, he said: You men of Ephesus , what man is there that knows not that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great Diana and of Jupiter's offspring?
text_la: Et cum sedasset scriba turbas, dixit : Viri Ephesii, quis enim est hominum, qui nesciat Ephesiorum civitatem cultricem esse magnæ Dianæ, Jovisque prolis?
text_pt: Então o escrivão da cidade, tendo apaziguado a multidão, disse: Homens efésios, qual é o homem que não sabe que a cidade dos efésios é a guardadora do templo da grande deusa Diana, e da imagem que desceu de Júpiter?
text_el: καταστείλας δὲ τὸν ὄχλον ὁ γραμματεὺς φησίν, ἄνδρες Ἐφέσιοι, τίς γάρ ἐστιν ἀνθρώπων ὃς οὐ γινώσκει τὴν Ἐφεσίων πόλιν νεωκόρον οὖσαν τῆς μεγάλης Ἀρτέμιδος καὶ τοῦ διοπετοῦς;

text_en: For as much therefore as these things cannot be contradicted, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rashly.
text_la: Cum ergo his contradici non possit, oportet vos sedatos esse, et nihil temere agere.
text_pt: Ora, não podendo isto ser contraditado, convém que vos aplaqueis e nada façais temerariamente;
text_el: ἀναντιρρήτων οὖν ὄντων τούτων δέον ἐστὶν ὑμᾶς κατεσταλμένους ὑπάρχειν καὶ μηδὲν προπετὲς πράσσειν.

text_en: For you have brought hither these men , who are neither guilty of sacrilege nor of blasphemy against your goddess.
text_la: Adduxistis enim homines istos, neque sacrilegos, neque blasphemantes deam vestram.
text_pt: Porque estes homens que aqui trouxestes nem são sacrílegos nem blasfemam da vossa deusa.
text_el: ἠγάγετε γὰρ τοὺς ἄνδρας τούτους οὔτε ἱεροσύλους οὔτε βλασφημοῦντας τὴν θεὸν ἡμῶν.

text_en: But if Demetrius and the craftsmen that are with him have a matter against any man , the courts of justice are open: and there are proconsuls. Let them accuse one another.
text_la: Quod si Demetrius et qui cum eo sunt artifices, habent adversus aliquem causam, conventus forenses aguntur, et proconsules sunt : accusent invicem.
text_pt: Mas, se Demétrio e os artífices que estão com ele têm alguma coisa contra alguém, há audiências e há procônsules; que se acusem uns aos outros;
text_el: εἰ μὲν οὖν Δημήτριος καὶ οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ τεχνῖται ἔχουσι πρός τινα λόγον, ἀγοραῖοι ἄγονται καὶ ἀνθύπατοί εἰσιν: ἐγκαλείτωσαν ἀλλήλοις.

text_en: And if you inquire after any other matter, it may be decided in a lawful assembly.
text_la: Si quid autem alterius rei quæritis, in legitima ecclesia poterit absolvi.
text_pt: E, se alguma outra coisa demandais, averiguar-se-á em legítima assembléia.
text_el: εἰ δέ τι περαιτέρω ἐπιζητεῖτε, ἐν τῇ ἐννόμῳ ἐκκλησίᾳ ἐπιλυθήσεται.

text_en: For we are even in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no man guilty (of whom we may give account) of this concourse.
text_la: Nam et periclitamur argui seditionis hodiernæ, cum nullus obnoxius sit de quo possimus reddere rationem concursus istius.
text_pt: Na verdade até corremos perigo de que, por hoje, sejamos acusados de sedição, não havendo causa alguma com que possamos justificar este concurso.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ κινδυνεύομεν ἐγκαλεῖσθαι στάσεως περὶ τῆς σήμερον, μηδενὸς αἰτίου ὑπάρχοντος περὶ οὗ οὐ δυνησόμεθα ἀποδοῦναι λόγον περὶ τῆς συστροφῆς ταύτης.

text_en: And when he had said these things, he dismissed the assembly.
text_la: Et cum hæc dixisset, dimisit ecclesiam.
text_pt: E, tendo dito isto, despediu a assembléia.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα εἰπὼν ἀπέλυσεν τὴν ἐκκλησίαν.

text_en: And after the tumult was ceased, Paul calling to him the disciples and exhorting them, took his leave and set forward to go into Macedonia.
text_la: Postquam autem cessavit tumultus, vocatis Paulus discipulis, et exhortatus eos, valedixit, et profectus est ut iret in Macedoniam.
text_pt: E, depois que cessou o alvoroço, Paulo chamou a si os discípulos e, abraçando-os, saiu para a macedônia.
text_el: Μετὰ δὲ τὸ παύσασθαι τὸν θόρυβον μεταπεμψάμενος ὁ Παῦλος τοὺς μαθητὰς καὶ παρακαλέσας, ἀσπασάμενος ἐξῆλθεν πορεύεσθαι εἰς Μακεδονίαν.

text_en: And when he had gone over those parts and had exhorted them with many words, he came into Greece :
text_la: Cum autem perambulasset partes illas, et exhortatus eos fuisset multo sermone, venit ad Græciam:
text_pt: E, havendo andado por aquelas terras, exortando-os com muitas palavras, veio à Grécia.
text_el: διελθὼν δὲ τὰ μέρη ἐκεῖνα καὶ παρακαλέσας αὐτοὺς λόγῳ πολλῷ ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν Ἑλλάδα,

text_en: Where, when he had spent three months, the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria . So he took a resolution to return through Macedonia.
text_la: ubi cum fecisset menses tres, factæ sunt illi insidiæ a Judæis navigaturo in Syriam : habuitque consilium ut reverteretur per Macedoniam.
text_pt: E, passando ali três meses, e sendo-lhe pelos judeus postas ciladas, como tivesse de navegar para a Síria, determinou voltar pela macedônia.
text_el: ποιήσας τε μῆνας τρεῖς γενομένης ἐπιβουλῆς αὐτῷ ὑπὸ τῶν Ἰουδαίων μέλλοντι ἀνάγεσθαι εἰς τὴν Συρίαν ἐγένετο γνώμης τοῦ ὑποστρέφειν διὰ Μακεδονίας.

text_en: And there accompanied him Sopater, the son of Pyrrhus, of Berea: and of the Thessalonians , Aristarchus and Secundus: and Gaius of Derbe and Timothy: and of Asia , Tychicus and Trophimus.
text_la: Comitatus est autem eum Sopater Pyrrhi Berœensis, Thessalonicensium vero Aristarchus, et Secundus, et Gajus Derbeus, et Timotheus : Asiani vero Tychicus et Trophimus.
text_pt: E acompanhou-o, até à Ásia, Sópater, de Beréia, e, dos de Tessalônica, Aristarco, e Segundo, e Gaio de Derbe, e Timóteo, e, dos da Ásia, Tíquico e Trófimo.
text_el: συνείπετο δὲ αὐτῷ Σώπατρος Πύρρου Βεροιαῖος, Θεσσαλονικέων δὲ Ἀρίσταρχος καὶ Σεκοῦνδος, καὶ Γάϊος Δερβαῖος καὶ Τιμόθεος, Ἀσιανοὶ δὲ Τυχικὸς καὶ Τρόφιμος.

text_en: These, going before, stayed for us at Troas .
text_la: Hi cum præcessissent, sustinuerunt nos Troade:
text_pt: Estes, indo adiante, nos esperaram em Trôade.
text_el: οὗτοι δὲ προσελθόντες ἔμενον ἡμᾶς ἐν Τρῳάδι:

text_en: But we sailed from Philippi after the days of the azymes and came to them to Troas in five days, where we abode seven days.
text_la: nos vero navigavimus post dies azymorum a Philippis, et venimus ad eos Troadem in diebus quinque, ubi demorati sumus diebus septem.
text_pt: E, depois dos dias dos pães ázimos, navegamos de Filipos, e em cinco dias fomos ter com eles a Trôade, onde estivemos sete dias.
text_el: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἐξεπλεύσαμεν μετὰ τὰς ἡμέρας τῶν ἀζύμων ἀπὸ Φιλίππων, καὶ ἤλθομεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν Τρῳάδα ἄχρι ἡμερῶν πέντε, {O(=}υ διετρίψαμεν ἡμέρας ἑπτά.

text_en: And on the first day of the week , when we were assembled to break bread , Paul discoursed with them, being to depart on the morrow. And he continued his speech until midnight.
text_la: Una autem sabbati cum convenissemus ad frangendum panem, Paulus disputabat cum eis profecturus in crastinum, protraxitque sermonem usque in mediam noctem.
text_pt: E no primeiro dia da semana, ajuntando-se os discípulos para partir o pão, Paulo, que havia de partir no dia seguinte, falava com eles; e prolongou a prática até à meia-noite.
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῇ μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων συνηγμένων ἡμῶν κλάσαι ἄρτον ὁ Παῦλος διελέγετο αὐτοῖς, μέλλων ἐξιέναι τῇ ἐπαύριον, παρέτεινέν τε τὸν λόγον μέχρι μεσονυκτίου.

text_en: And there were a great number of lamps in the upper chamber where we were assembled .
text_la: Erant autem lampades copiosæ in cœnaculo, ubi eramus congregati.
text_pt: E havia muitas luzes no cenáculo onde estavam juntos.
text_el: ἦσαν δὲ λαμπάδες ἱκαναὶ ἐν τῷ ὑπερῴῳ οὗ ἦμεν συνηγμένοι:

text_en: And a certain young man named Eutychus, sitting on the window, being oppressed with a deep sleep (as Paul was long preaching), by occasion of his sleep fell from the third loft down and was taken up dead.
text_la: Sedens autem quidam adolescens nomine Eutychus super fenestram, cum mergeretur somno gravi, disputante diu Paulo, ductus somno cecidit de tertio cœnaculo deorsum, et sublatus est mortuus.
text_pt: E, estando um certo jovem, por nome Eutico, assentado numa janela, caiu do terceiro andar, tomado de um sono profundo que lhe sobreveio durante o extenso discurso de Paulo; e foi levantado morto.
text_el: καθεζόμενος δέ τις νεανίας ὀνόματι Εὔτυχος ἐπὶ τῆς θυρίδος, καταφερόμενος ὕπνῳ βαθεῖ διαλεγομένου τοῦ Παύλου ἐπὶ πλεῖον, κατενεχθεὶς ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕπνου ἔπεσεν ἀπὸ τοῦ τριστέγου κάτω καὶ ἤρθη νεκρός.

text_en: To whom, when Paul had gone down, he laid himself upon him and, embracing him, said: Be not troubled, for his soul is in him.
text_la: Ad quem cum descendisset Paulus, incubuit super eum : et complexus dixit : Nolite turbari, anima enim ipsius in ipso est.
text_pt: Paulo, porém, descendo, inclinou-se sobre ele e, abraçando-o, disse: Não vos perturbeis, que a sua alma nele está.
text_el: καταβὰς δὲ ὁ Παῦλος ἐπέπεσεν αὐτῷ καὶ συμπεριλαβὼν εἶπεν, μὴ θορυβεῖσθε, ἡ γὰρ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ ἐστιν.

text_en: Then going up and breaking bread and tasting and having talked a long time to them, until daylight, so he departed.
text_la: Ascendens autem, frangensque panem, et gustans, satisque allocutus usque in lucem, sic profectus est.
text_pt: E subindo, e partindo o pão, e comendo, ainda lhes falou largamente até à alvorada; e assim partiu.
text_el: ἀναβὰς δὲ [καὶ] κλάσας τὸν ἄρτον καὶ γευσάμενος ἐφ' ἱκανόν τε ὁμιλήσας ἄχρι αὐγῆς οὕτως ἐξῆλθεν.

text_en: And they brought the youth alive and were not a little comforted.
text_la: Adduxerunt autem puerum viventem, et consolati sunt non minime.
text_pt: E levaram vivo o jovem, e ficaram não pouco consolados.
text_el: ἤγαγον δὲ τὸν παῖδα ζῶντα, καὶ παρεκλήθησαν οὐ μετρίως.

text_en: But we going aboard the ship, sailed to Assos, being there to take in Paul . For so he had appointed, himself purposing to travel by land.
text_la: Nos autem ascendentes navem, navigavimus in Asson, inde suscepturi Paulum : sic enim disposuerat ipse per terram iter facturus.
text_pt: Nós, porém, subindo ao navio, navegamos até Assôs, onde devíamos receber a Paulo, porque assim o ordenara, indo ele por terra.
text_el: Ἡμεῖς δὲ προελθόντες ἐπὶ τὸ πλοῖον ἀνήχθημεν ἐπὶ τὴν Ἆσσον, ἐκεῖθεν μέλλοντες ἀναλαμβάνειν τὸν Παῦλον: οὕτως γὰρ διατεταγμένος ἦν μέλλων αὐτὸς πεζεύειν.

text_en: And when he had met with us at Assos, we took him in and came to Mitylene .
text_la: Cum autem convenisset nos in Asson, assumpto eo, venimus Mitylenen.
text_pt: E, logo que se ajuntou conosco em Assôs, o recebemos, e fomos a Mitilene.
text_el: ὡς δὲ συνέβαλλεν ἡμῖν εἰς τὴν Ἆσσον, ἀναλαβόντες αὐτὸν ἤλθομεν εἰς Μιτυλήνην.

text_en: And sailing thence, the day following we came over against Chios : and the next day we arrived at Samos : and the day following we came to Miletus .
text_la: Et inde navigantes, sequenti die venimus contra Chium, et alia applicuimus Samum, et sequenti die venimus Miletum.
text_pt: E, navegando dali, chegamos no dia seguinte defronte de Quios, e no outro aportamos a Samos e, ficando em Trogílio, chegamos no dia seguinte a Mileto.
text_el: κἀκεῖθεν ἀποπλεύσαντες τῇ ἐπιούσῃ κατηντήσαμεν ἄντικρυς Χίου, τῇ δὲ ἑτέρᾳ παρεβάλομεν εἰς Σάμον, τῇ δὲ ἐχομένῃ ἤλθομεν εἰς Μίλητον:

text_en: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus , lest he should be stayed any time in Asia . For he hasted, if it were possible for him, to keep the day of Pentecost at Jerusalem .
text_la: Proposuerat enim Paulus transnavigare Ephesum, ne qua mora illi fieret in Asia. Festinabat enim, si possibile sibi esset, ut diem Pentecostes faceret Jerosolymis.
text_pt: Porque já Paulo tinha determinado passar ao largo de Éfeso, para não gastar tempo na Ásia. Apressava-se, pois, para estar, se lhe fosse possível, em Jerusalém no dia de Pentecostes.
text_el: κεκρίκει γὰρ ὁ Παῦλος παραπλεῦσαι τὴν Ἔφεσον, ὅπως μὴ γένηται αὐτῷ χρονοτριβῆσαι ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ, ἔσπευδεν γὰρ εἰ δυνατὸν εἴη αὐτῷ τὴν ἡμέραν τῆς πεντηκοστῆς γενέσθαι εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

text_en: And sending from Miletus to Ephesus , he called the ancients of the church .
text_la: A Mileto autem mittens Ephesum, vocavit majores natu ecclesiæ.
text_pt: E de Mileto mandou a Éfeso, a chamar os anciãos da igreja.
text_el: Ἀπὸ δὲ τῆς Μιλήτου πέμψας εἰς Ἔφεσον μετεκαλέσατο τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους τῆς ἐκκλησίας.

text_en: And when they had come to him and were together, he said to them: You know from the first day that I came into Asia , in what manner I have been with you, for all the time.
text_la: Qui cum venissent ad eum, et simul essent, dixit eis : Vos scitis a prima die qua ingressus sum in Asiam, qualiter vobiscum per omne tempus fuerim,
text_pt: E, logo que chegaram junto dele, disse-lhes: Vós bem sabeis, desde o primeiro dia em que entrei na Ásia, como em todo esse tempo me portei no meio de vós,
text_el: ὡς δὲ παρεγένοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, ὑμεῖς ἐπίστασθε ἀπὸ πρώτης ἡμέρας ἀφ' ἧς ἐπέβην εἰς τὴν Ἀσίαν πῶς μεθ' ὑμῶν τὸν πάντα χρόνον ἐγενόμην,

text_en: Serving the Lord with all humility and with tears and temptations which befell me by the conspiracies of the Jews :
text_la: serviens Domino cum omni humilitate, et lacrimis, et tentationibus, quæ mihi acciderunt ex insidiis Judæorum:
text_pt: Servindo ao Senhor com toda a humildade, e com muitas lágrimas e tentações, que pelas ciladas dos judeus me sobrevieram;
text_el: δουλεύων τῷ κυρίῳ μετὰ πάσης ταπεινοφροσύνης καὶ δακρύων καὶ πειρασμῶν τῶν συμβάντων μοι ἐν ταῖς ἐπιβουλαῖς τῶν Ἰουδαίων:

text_en: How I have kept back nothing that was profitable to you, but have preached it to you, and taught you publicly, and from house to house,
text_la: quomodo nihil subtraxerim utilium, quominus annuntiarem vobis et docerem vos, publice et per domos,
text_pt: Como nada, que útil seja, deixei de vos anunciar, e ensinar publicamente e pelas casas,
text_el: ὡς οὐδὲν ὑπεστειλάμην τῶν συμφερόντων τοῦ μὴ ἀναγγεῖλαι ὑμῖν καὶ διδάξαι ὑμᾶς δημοσίᾳ καὶ κατ' οἴκους,

text_en: testifying both to Jews and Gentiles penance towards God and faith in our Lord Jesus Christ .
text_la: testificans Judæis atque gentilibus in Deum pœnitentiam, et fidem in Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum.
text_pt: Testificando, tanto aos judeus como aos gregos, a conversão a Deus, e a fé em nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
text_el: διαμαρτυρόμενος Ἰουδαίοις τε καὶ Ἕλλησιν τὴν εἰς θεὸν μετάνοιαν καὶ πίστιν εἰς τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And now, behold, being bound in the spirit , I go to Jerusalem : not knowing the things which shall befall me there:
text_la: Et nunc ecce alligatus ego spiritu, vado in Jerusalem : quæ in ea ventura sint mihi, ignorans:
text_pt: E agora, eis que, ligado eu pelo espírito, vou para Jerusalém, não sabendo o que lá me há de acontecer,
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ δεδεμένος ἐγὼ τῷ πνεύματι πορεύομαι εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ συναντήσοντά ἐμοὶ μὴ εἰδώς,

text_en: Save that the Holy Ghost in every city witnesses to me, saying: That bands and afflictions wait for me at Jerusalem .
text_la: nisi quod Spiritus Sanctus per omnes civitates mihi protestatur, dicens quoniam vincula et tribulationes Jerosolymis me manent.
text_pt: Senão o que o Espírito Santo de cidade em cidade me revela, dizendo que me esperam prisões e tribulações.
text_el: πλὴν ὅτι τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον κατὰ πόλιν διαμαρτύρεταί μοι λέγον ὅτι δεσμὰ καὶ θλίψεις με μένουσιν.

text_en: But I fear none of these things, neither do I count my life more precious than myself, so that I may consummate my course and the ministry of the word which I received from the Lord Jesus , to testify the gospel of the grace of God .
text_la: Sed nihil horum vereor : nec facio animam meam pretiosiorem quam me, dummodo consummem cursum meum, et ministerium verbi quod accepi a Domino Jesu, testificari Evangelium gratiæ Dei.
text_pt: Mas de nada faço questão, nem tenho a minha vida por preciosa, contanto que cumpra com alegria a minha carreira, e o ministério que recebi do Senhor Jesus, para dar testemunho do evangelho da graça de Deus.
text_el: ἀλλ' οὐδενὸς λόγου ποιοῦμαι τὴν ψυχὴν τιμίαν ἐμαυτῷ ὡς τελειώσω τὸν δρόμον μου καὶ τὴν διακονίαν ἣν ἔλαβον παρὰ τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ, διαμαρτύρασθαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And now behold, I know that all you, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God , shall see my face no more.
text_la: Et nunc ecce ego scio quia amplius non videbitis faciem meam vos omnes, per quos transivi prædicans regnum Dei.
text_pt: E agora, na verdade, sei que todos vós, por quem passei pregando o reino de Deus, não vereis mais o meu rosto.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ οἶδα ὅτι οὐκέτι ὄψεσθε τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ὑμεῖς πάντες ἐν οἷς διῆλθον κηρύσσων τὴν βασιλείαν:

text_en: Wherefore I take you to witness this day that I am clear from the blood of all men .
text_la: Quapropter contestor vos hodierna die, quia mundus sum a sanguine omnium.
text_pt: Portanto, no dia de hoje, vos protesto que estou limpo do sangue de todos.
text_el: διότι μαρτύρομαι ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ σήμερον ἡμέρᾳ ὅτι καθαρός εἰμι ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος πάντων,

text_en: For I have not spared to declare unto you all, the counsel of God .
text_la: Non enim subterfugi, quominus annuntiarem omne consilium Dei vobis.
text_pt: Porque nunca deixei de vos anunciar todo o conselho de Deus.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ὑπεστειλάμην τοῦ μὴ ἀναγγεῖλαι πᾶσαν τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῖν.

text_en: Take heed to yourselves and to the whole flock, wherein the Holy Ghost has placed you bishops , to rule the Church of God which he has purchased with his own blood.
text_la: Attendite vobis, et universo gregi, in quo vos Spiritus Sanctus posuit episcopos regere ecclesiam Dei, quam acquisivit sanguine suo.
text_pt: Olhai, pois, por vós, e por todo o rebanho sobre que o Espírito Santo vos constituiu bispos, para apascentardes a igreja de Deus, que ele resgatou com seu próprio sangue.
text_el: προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς καὶ παντὶ τῷ ποιμνίῳ, ἐν ᾧ ὑμᾶς τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ἔθετο ἐπισκόπους, ποιμαίνειν τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἣν περιεποιήσατο διὰ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ ἰδίου.

text_en: I know that after my departure ravening wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
text_la: Ego scio quoniam intrabunt post discessionem meam lupi rapaces in vos, non parcentes gregi.
text_pt: Porque eu sei isto que, depois da minha partida, entrarão no meio de vós lobos cruéis, que não pouparão ao rebanho;
text_el: ἐγὼ οἶδα ὅτι εἰσελεύσονται μετὰ τὴν ἄφιξίν μου λύκοι βαρεῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς μὴ φειδόμενοι τοῦ ποιμνίου,

text_en: And of your own selves shall arise men speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.
text_la: Et ex vobisipsis exsurgent viri loquentes perversa, ut abducant discipulos post se.
text_pt: E que de entre vós mesmos se levantarão homens que falarão coisas perversas, para atraírem os discípulos após si.
text_el: καὶ ἐξ ὑμῶν [αὐτῶν] ἀναστήσονται ἄνδρες λαλοῦντες διεστραμμένα τοῦ ἀποσπᾶν τοὺς μαθητὰς ὀπίσω ἑαυτῶν.

text_en: Therefore watch, keeping in memory that for three years I ceased not with tears to admonish every one of you, night and day.
text_la: Propter quod vigilate, memoria retinentes quoniam per triennium nocte et die non cessavi, cum lacrimis monens unumquemque vestrum.
text_pt: Portanto, vigiai, lembrando-vos de que durante três anos, não cessei, noite e dia, de admoestar com lágrimas a cada um de vós.
text_el: διὸ γρηγορεῖτε, μνημονεύοντες ὅτι τριετίαν νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν οὐκ ἐπαυσάμην μετὰ δακρύων νουθετῶν ἕνα ἕκαστον.

text_en: And now I commend you to God and to the word of his grace , who is able to build up and to give an inheritance among all the sanctified .
text_la: Et nunc commendo vos Deo, et verbo gratiæ ipsius, qui potens est ædificare, et dare hæreditatem in sanctificatis omnibus.
text_pt: Agora, pois, irmãos, encomendo-vos a Deus e à palavra da sua graça; a ele que é poderoso para vos edificar e dar herança entre todos os santificados.
text_el: καὶ τὰ νῦν παρατίθεμαι ὑμᾶς τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ τῷ λόγῳ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ τῷ δυναμένῳ οἰκοδομῆσαι καὶ δοῦναι τὴν κληρονομίαν ἐν τοῖς ἡγιασμένοις πᾶσιν.

text_en: I have not coveted any man's silver, gold or apparel, as
text_la: Argentum, et aurum, aut vestem nullius concupivi, sicut
text_pt: De ninguém cobicei a prata, nem o ouro, nem o vestuário.
text_el: ἀργυρίου ἢ χρυσίου ἢ ἱματισμοῦ οὐδενὸς ἐπεθύμησα:

text_en: you yourselves know . For such things as were needful for me and them that are with me, these hands have furnished.
text_la: ipsi scitis : quoniam ad ea quæ mihi opus erant, et his qui mecum sunt, ministraverunt manus istæ.
text_pt: Sim, vós mesmos sabeis que para o que me era necessário a mim, e aos que estão comigo, estas mãos me serviram.
text_el: αὐτοὶ γινώσκετε ὅτι ταῖς χρείαις μου καὶ τοῖς οὖσιν μετ' ἐμοῦ ὑπηρέτησαν αἱ χεῖρες αὗται.

text_en: I have showed you all things, how that so labouring you ought to support the weak and to remember the word of the Lord Jesus , how he said: It is a more blessed thing to give, rather than to receive.
text_la: Omnia ostendi vobis, quoniam sic laborantes, oportet suscipere infirmos ac meminisse verbi Domini Jesu : quoniam ipse dixit : Beatius est magis dare, quam accipere.
text_pt: Tenho-vos mostrado em tudo que, trabalhando assim, é necessário auxiliar os enfermos, e recordar as palavras do Senhor Jesus, que disse: Mais bem-aventurada coisa é dar do que receber.
text_el: πάντα ὑπέδειξα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὕτως κοπιῶντας δεῖ ἀντιλαμβάνεσθαι τῶν ἀσθενούντων, μνημονεύειν τε τῶν λόγων τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ, ὅτι αὐτὸς εἶπεν: μακάριόν ἐστιν μᾶλλον διδόναι ἢ λαμβάνειν.

text_en: And when he had said these things, kneeling down , he prayed with them all.
text_la: Et cum hæc dixisset, positis genibus suis oravit cum omnibus illis.
text_pt: E, havendo dito isto, pôs-se de joelhos, e orou com todos eles.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα εἰπὼν θεὶς τὰ γόνατα αὐτοῦ σὺν πᾶσιν αὐτοῖς προσηύξατο.

text_en: And there was much weeping among them all. And falling on the neck of Paul , they kissed him,
text_la: Magnus autem fletus factus est omnium : et procumbentes super collum Pauli, osculabantur eum,
text_pt: E levantou-se um grande pranto entre todos e, lançando-se ao pescoço de Paulo, o beijavam,
text_el: ἱκανὸς δὲ κλαυθμὸς ἐγένετο πάντων, καὶ ἐπιπεσόντες ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον τοῦ Παύλου κατεφίλουν αὐτόν,

text_en: being grieved most of all for the word which he had said, that they should see his face no more. And they brought him on his way to the ship.
text_la: dolentes maxime in verbo quod dixerat, quoniam amplius faciem ejus non essent visuri. Et deducebant eum ad navem.
text_pt: Entristecendo-se muito, principalmente pela palavra que dissera, que não veriam mais o seu rosto. E acompanharam-no até o navio.
text_el: ὀδυνώμενοι μάλιστα ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ ᾧ εἰρήκει ὅτι οὐκέτι μέλλουσιν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ θεωρεῖν. προέπεμπον δὲ αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον.

text_en: And when it came to pass that, being parted from them, we set sail, we came with a straight course to Coos, and the day following to Rhodes : and from thence to Patara .
text_la: Cum autem factum esset ut navigaremus abstracti ab eis, recto cursu venimus Coum, et sequenti die Rhodum, et inde Pataram.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, separando-nos deles, navegamos e fomos correndo caminho direito, e chegamos a Cós, e no dia seguinte a Rodes, de onde passamos a Pátara.
text_el: Ὡς δὲ ἐγένετο ἀναχθῆναι ἡμᾶς ἀποσπασθέντας ἀπ' αὐτῶν, εὐθυδρομήσαντες ἤλθομεν εἰς τὴν Κῶ, τῇ δὲ ἑξῆς εἰς τὴν Ῥόδον, κἀκεῖθεν εἰς Πάταρα:

text_en: And when we had found a ship sailing over to Phenice, we went aboard and set forth.
text_la: Et cum invenissemus navem transfretantem in Phœnicen, ascendentes navigavimus.
text_pt: E, achando um navio, que ia para a Fenícia, embarcamos nele, e partimos.
text_el: καὶ εὑρόντες πλοῖον διαπερῶν εἰς Φοινίκην ἐπιβάντες ἀνήχθημεν.

text_en: And when we had discovered Cyprus , leaving it on the left hand, we sailed into Syria , and came to Tyre : for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
text_la: Cum apparuissemus autem Cypro, relinquentes eam ad sinistram, navigavimus in Syriam, et venimus Tyrum : ibi enim navis expositura erat onus.
text_pt: E, indo já à vista de Chipre, deixando-a à esquerda, navegamos para a Síria e chegamos a Tiro; porque o navio havia de ser descarregado ali.
text_el: ἀναφάναντες δὲ τὴν Κύπρον καὶ καταλιπόντες αὐτὴν εὐώνυμον ἐπλέομεν εἰς Συρίαν, καὶ κατήλθομεν εἰς Τύρον: ἐκεῖσε γὰρ τὸ πλοῖον ἦν ἀποφορτιζόμενον τὸν γόμον.

text_en: And finding disciples , we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul , through the Spirit , that he should not go up to Jerusalem .
text_la: Inventis autem discipulis, mansimus ibi diebus septem : qui Paulo dicebant per Spiritum ne ascenderet Jerosolymam.
text_pt: E, achando discípulos, ficamos ali sete dias; e eles pelo Espírito diziam a Paulo que não subisse a Jerusalém.
text_el: ἀνευρόντες δὲ τοὺς μαθητὰς ἐπεμείναμεν αὐτοῦ ἡμέρας ἑπτά, οἵτινες τῷ Παύλῳ ἔλεγον διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος μὴ ἐπιβαίνειν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

text_en: And the days being expired, departing we went forward, they all bringing us on our way, with their wives and children, till we were out of the city. And we kneeled down on the shore: and we prayed .
text_la: Et expletis diebus, profecti ibamus, deducentibus nos omnibus cum uxoribus et filiis usque foras civitatem : et positis genibus in littore, oravimus.
text_pt: E, havendo passado ali aqueles dias, saímos, e seguimos nosso caminho, acompanhando-nos todos, com suas mulheres e filhos até fora da cidade; e, postos de joelhos na praia, oramos.
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ἐγένετο ἐξαρτίσαι ἡμᾶς τὰς ἡμέρας, ἐξελθόντες ἐπορευόμεθα προπεμπόντων ἡμᾶς πάντων σὺν γυναιξὶ καὶ τέκνοις ἕως ἔξω τῆς πόλεως, καὶ θέντες τὰ γόνατα ἐπὶ τὸν αἰγιαλὸν προσευξάμενοι

text_en: And when we had bid one another farewell, we took ship. And they returned home.
text_la: Et cum valefecissemus invicem, ascendimus navem : illi autem redierunt in sua.
text_pt: E, despedindo-nos uns dos outros, subimos ao navio; e eles voltaram para suas casas.
text_el: ἀπησπασάμεθα ἀλλήλους, καὶ ἐνέβημεν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, ἐκεῖνοι δὲ ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς τὰ ἴδια.

text_en: But we, having finished the voyage by sea, from Tyre came down to Ptolemais : and saluting the brethren, we abode one day with them.
text_la: Nos vero navigatione expleta a Tyro descendimus Ptolemaidam : et salutatis fratribus, mansimus die una apud illos.
text_pt: E nós, concluída a navegação de Tiro, viemos a Ptolemaida; e, havendo saudado os irmãos, ficamos com eles um dia.
text_el: Ἡμεῖς δὲ τὸν πλοῦν διανύσαντες ἀπὸ Τύρου κατηντήσαμεν εἰς Πτολεμαΐδα, καὶ ἀσπασάμενοι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἐμείναμεν ἡμέραν μίαν παρ' αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And the next day departing, we came to Caesarea . And entering into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, we abode with him.
text_la: Alia autem die profecti, venimus Cæsaream. Et intrantes domum Philippi evangelistæ, qui erat unus de septem, mansimus apud eum.
text_pt: E no dia seguinte, partindo dali Paulo, e nós que com ele estávamos, chegamos a Cesaréia; e, entrando em casa de Filipe, o evangelista, que era um dos sete, ficamos com ele.
text_el: τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον ἐξελθόντες ἤλθομεν εἰς Καισάρειαν, καὶ εἰσελθόντες εἰς τὸν οἶκον Φιλίππου τοῦ εὐαγγελιστοῦ ὄντος ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐμείναμεν παρ' αὐτῷ.

text_en: And he had four daughters, virgins , who did prophesy .
text_la: Huic autem erant quatuor filiæ virgines prophetantes.
text_pt: E tinha este quatro filhas virgens, que profetizavam.
text_el: τούτῳ δὲ ἦσαν θυγατέρες τέσσαρες παρθένοι προφητεύουσαι.

text_en: And as we tarried there for some days, there came from Judea a certain prophet , named Agabus .
text_la: Et cum moraremur per dies aliquot, supervenit quidam a Judæa propheta, nomine Agabus.
text_pt: E, demorando-nos ali por muitos dias, chegou da Judéia um profeta, por nome Ágabo;
text_el: ἐπιμενόντων δὲ ἡμέρας πλείους κατῆλθέν τις ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰουδαίας προφήτης ὀνόματι Ἇγαβος,

text_en: Who, when he had come to us, took Paul's girdle: and binding his own feet and hands, he said: Thus says the Holy Ghost : The man whose girdle this is, the Jews shall bind in this manner in Jerusalem and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles .
text_la: Is cum venisset ad nos, tulit zonam Pauli : et alligans sibi pedes et manus, dixit : Hæc dicit Spiritus Sanctus : Virum, cujus est zona hæc, sic alligabunt in Jerusalem Judæi, et tradent in manus gentium.
text_pt: E, vindo ter conosco, tomou a cinta de Paulo, e ligando-se os seus próprios pés e mãos, disse: Isto diz o Espírito Santo: Assim ligarão os judeus em Jerusalém o homem de quem é esta cinta, e o entregarão nas mãos dos gentios.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ἡμᾶς καὶ ἄρας τὴν ζώνην τοῦ Παύλου, δήσας ἑαυτοῦ τοὺς πόδας καὶ τὰς χεῖρας εἶπεν: τάδε λέγει τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον: τὸν ἄνδρα οὗ ἐστιν ἡ ζώνη αὕτη οὕτως δήσουσιν ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ παραδώσουσιν εἰς χεῖρας ἐθνῶν.

text_en: Which when we had heard, both we and they that were of that place desired him that he would not go up to Jerusalem .
text_la: Quod cum audissemus, rogabamus nos, et qui loci illius erant, ne ascenderet Jerosolymam.
text_pt: E, ouvindo nós isto, rogamos-lhe, tanto nós como os que eram daquele lugar, que não subisse a Jerusalém.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἠκούσαμεν ταῦτα, παρεκαλοῦμεν ἡμεῖς τε καὶ οἱ ἐντόπιοι τοῦ μὴ ἀναβαίνειν αὐτὸν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ.

text_en: Then Paul answered and said: What do you mean, weeping and afflicting my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but to die also in Jerusalem , for the name of the Lord Jesus .
text_la: Tunc respondit Paulus, et dixit : Quid facitis flentes, et affligentes cor meum? Ego enim non solum alligari, sed et mori in Jerusalem paratus sum propter nomen Domini Jesu.
text_pt: Mas Paulo respondeu: Que fazeis vós, chorando e magoando-me o coração? Porque eu estou pronto não só a ser ligado, mas ainda a morrer em Jerusalém pelo nome do Senhor Jesus.
text_el: τότε ἀπεκρίθη [ὁ] Παῦλος: Τί ποιεῖτε κλαίοντες καὶ συνθρύπτοντές μου τὴν καρδίαν; ἐγὼ γὰρ οὐ μόνον δεθῆναι ἀλλὰ καὶ ἀποθανεῖν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἑτοίμως ἔχω ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: And when we could not persuade him, we ceased, saying: The will of the Lord be done.
text_la: Et cum ei suadere non possemus, quievimus, dicentes : Domini voluntas fiat.
text_pt: E, como não podíamos convencê-lo, nos aquietamos, dizendo: Faça-se a vontade do Senhor.
text_el: μὴ πειθομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ ἡσυχάσαμεν εἰπόντες, τοῦ κυρίου τὸ θέλημα γινέσθω.

text_en: And after those days, being prepared, we went up to Jerusalem .
text_la: Post dies autem istos, præparati ascendebamus in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E depois daqueles dias, havendo feito os nossos preparativos, subimos a Jerusalém.
text_el: Μετὰ δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας ταύτας ἐπισκευασάμενοι ἀνεβαίνομεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα:

text_en: And there went also with us some of the disciples from Caesarea , bringing with them one Mnason a Cyprian , an old disciple , with whom we should lodge.
text_la: Venerunt autem et ex discipulis a Cæsarea nobiscum, adducentes secum apud quem hospitaremur Mnasonem quemdam Cyprium, antiquum discipulum.
text_pt: E foram também conosco alguns discípulos de Cesaréia, levando consigo um certo Mnasom, chíprio, discípulo antigo, com quem havíamos de hospedar-nos.
text_el: συνῆλθον δὲ καὶ τῶν μαθητῶν ἀπὸ Καισαρείας σὺν ἡμῖν, ἄγοντες παρ' ᾧ ξενισθῶμεν Μνάσωνί τινι Κυπρίῳ, ἀρχαίῳ μαθητῇ.

text_en: And when we had come to Jerusalem , the brethren received us gladly.
text_la: Et cum venissemus Jerosolymam, libenter exceperunt nos fratres.
text_pt: E, logo que chegamos a Jerusalém, os irmãos nos receberam de muito boa vontade.
text_el: Γενομένων δὲ ἡμῶν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἀσμένως ἀπεδέξαντο ἡμᾶς οἱ ἀδελφοί.

text_en: And the day following, Paul went in with us unto James : and all the ancients were assembled.
text_la: Sequenti autem die introibat Paulus nobiscum ad Jacobum, omnesque collecti sunt seniores.
text_pt: E no dia seguinte, Paulo entrou conosco em casa de Tiago, e todos os anciãos vieram ali.
text_el: τῇ δὲ ἐπιούσῃ εἰσῄει ὁ Παῦλος σὺν ἡμῖν πρὸς Ἰάκωβον, πάντες τε παρεγένοντο οἱ πρεσβύτεροι.

text_en: Whom when he had saluted, he related particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry .
text_la: Quos cum salutasset, narrabat per singula quæ Deus fecisset in gentibus per ministerium ipsius.
text_pt: E, havendo-os saudado, contou-lhes por miúdo o que por seu ministério Deus fizera entre os gentios.
text_el: καὶ ἀσπασάμενος αὐτοὺς ἐξηγεῖτο καθ' ἓν ἕκαστον ὧν ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν διὰ τῆς διακονίας αὐτοῦ.

text_en: But they hearing it, glorified God and said to him: You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews that have believed : and they are all zealous for the law .
text_la: At illi cum audissent, magnificabant Deum, dixeruntque ei : Vides, frater, quot millia sunt in Judæis qui crediderunt, et omnes æmulatores sunt legis.
text_pt: E, ouvindo-o eles, glorificaram ao Senhor, e disseram-lhe: Bem vês, irmão, quantos milhares de judeus há que crêem, e todos são zeladores da lei.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ἐδόξαζον τὸν θεόν, εἶπόν τε αὐτῷ, Θεωρεῖς, ἀδελφέ, πόσαι μυριάδες εἰσὶν [ἐν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις] τῶν πεπιστευκότων, καὶ πάντες ζηλωταὶ τοῦ νόμου ὑπάρχουσιν:

text_en: Now they have heard of you that you teach those Jews , who are among the Gentiles to depart from Moses : saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, nor walk according to the custom.
text_la: Audierunt autem de te quia discessionem doceas a Moyse eorum qui per gentes sunt Judæorum, dicens non debere eos circumcidere filios suos, neque secundum consuetudinem ingredi.
text_pt: E já acerca de ti foram informados de que ensinas todos os judeus que estão entre os gentios a apartarem-se de Moisés, dizendo que não devem circuncidar seus filhos, nem andar segundo o costume da lei.
text_el: κατηχήθησαν δὲ περὶ σοῦ ὅτι ἀποστασίαν διδάσκεις ἀπὸ Μωϋσέως τοὺς κατὰ τὰ ἔθνη πάντας Ἰουδαίους, λέγων μὴ περιτέμνειν αὐτοὺς τὰ τέκνα μηδὲ τοῖς ἔθεσιν περιπατεῖν.

text_en: What is it therefore? The multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that you have come.
text_la: Quid ergo est? utique oportet convenire multitudinem : audient enim te supervenisse.
text_pt: Que faremos pois? em todo o caso é necessário que a multidão se ajunte; porque terão ouvido que já és vindo.
text_el: τί οὖν ἐστιν; πάντως ἀκούσονται ὅτι ἐλήλυθας.

text_en: Do therefore this that we say to you. We have four men , who have a vow on them.
text_la: Hoc ergo fac quod tibi dicimus. Sunt nobis viri quatuor, votum habentes super se.
text_pt: Faze, pois, isto que te dizemos: Temos quatro homens que fizeram voto.
text_el: τοῦτο οὖν ποίησον ὅ σοι λέγομεν: εἰσὶν ἡμῖν ἄνδρες τέσσαρες εὐχὴν ἔχοντες ἀφ' ἑαυτῶν.

text_en: Take these and sanctify yourself with them: and bestow on them, that they may shave their heads. And all will know that the things which they have heard of these are false : but that you yourself also walk keeping the law .
text_la: His assumptis, sanctifica te cum illis, et impende in illis ut radant capita : et scient omnes quia quæ de te audierunt, falsa sunt, sed ambulas et ipse custodiens legem.
text_pt: Toma estes contigo, e santifica-te com eles, e faze por eles os gastos para que rapem a cabeça, e todos ficarão sabendo que nada há daquilo de que foram informados acerca de ti, mas que também tu mesmo andas guardando a lei.
text_el: τούτους παραλαβὼν ἁγνίσθητι σὺν αὐτοῖς καὶ δαπάνησον ἐπ' αὐτοῖς ἵνα ξυρήσονται τὴν κεφαλήν, καὶ γνώσονται πάντες ὅτι ὧν κατήχηνται περὶ σοῦ οὐδέν ἐστιν, ἀλλὰ στοιχεῖς καὶ αὐτὸς φυλάσσων τὸν νόμον.

text_en: But, as touching the Gentiles that believe , we have written, decreeing that they should only refrain themselves from that which has been offered to idols and from blood and from things strangled and from fornication.
text_la: De his autem qui crediderunt ex gentibus, nos scripsimus judicantes ut abstineant se ab idolis immolato, et sanguine, et suffocato, et fornicatione.
text_pt: Todavia, quanto aos que creem dos gentios, já nós havemos escrito, e achado por bem, que nada disto observem; mas que só se guardem do que se sacrifica aos ídolos, e do sangue, e do sufocado e da fornicação.
text_el: περὶ δὲ τῶν πεπιστευκότων ἐθνῶν ἡμεῖς ἀπεστείλαμεν κρίναντες φυλάσσεσθαι αὐτοὺς τό τε εἰδωλόθυτον καὶ αἷμα καὶ πνικτὸν καὶ πορνείαν.

text_en: Then Paul took the men and, the next day being purified with them, entered into the temple , giving notice of the accomplishment of the days of purification, until an oblation should be offered for every one of them.
text_la: Tunc Paulus, assumptis viris, postera die purificatus cum illis intravit in templum, annuntians expletionem dierum purificationis, donec offerretur pro unoquoque eorum oblatio.
text_pt: Então Paulo, tomando consigo aqueles homens, entrou no dia seguinte no templo, já santificado com eles, anunciando serem já cumpridos os dias da purificação; e ficou ali até se oferecer por cada um deles a oferta.
text_el: τότε ὁ Παῦλος παραλαβὼν τοὺς ἄνδρας, τῇ ἐχομένῃ ἡμέρᾳ σὺν αὐτοῖς ἁγνισθεὶς εἰσῄει εἰς τὸ ἱερόν, διαγγέλλων τὴν ἐκπλήρωσιν τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῦ ἁγνισμοῦ ἕως οὗ προσηνέχθη ὑπὲρ ἑνὸς ἑκάστου αὐτῶν ἡ προσφορά.

text_en: But when the seven days were drawing to an end, those Jews that were of Asia , when they saw him in the temple , stirred up all the people and laid hands upon him, crying out:
text_la: Dum autem septem dies consummarentur, hi qui de Asia erant Judæi, cum vidissent eum in templo, concitaverunt omnem populum, et injecerunt ei manus, clamantes:
text_pt: E quando os sete dias estavam quase a terminar, os judeus da Ásia, vendo-o no templo, alvoroçaram todo o povo e lançaram mão dele,
text_el: Ὡς δὲ ἔμελλον αἱ ἑπτὰ ἡμέραι συντελεῖσθαι, οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἀσίας Ἰουδαῖοι θεασάμενοι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ συνέχεον πάντα τὸν ὄχλον καὶ ἐπέβαλον ἐπ' αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας,

text_en: Men of Israel , help: This is the man that teaches all men everywhere against the people and the law and this place; and moreover has brought in Gentiles into the temple and has violated this holy place.
text_la: Viri Israëlitæ, adjuvate : hic est homo qui adversus populum, et legem, et locum hunc, omnes ubique docens, insuper et gentiles induxit in templum, et violavit sanctum locum istum.
text_pt: Clamando: Homens israelitas, acudi; este é o homem que por todas as partes ensina a todos contra o povo e contra a lei, e contra este lugar; e, demais disto, introduziu também no templo os gregos, e profanou este santo lugar.
text_el: κράζοντες, ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται, βοηθεῖτε: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ κατὰ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ τοῦ νόμου καὶ τοῦ τόπου τούτου πάντας πανταχῇ διδάσκων, ἔτι τε καὶ Ἕλληνας εἰσήγαγεν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ κεκοίνωκεν τὸν ἅγιον τόπον τοῦτον.

text_en: (For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian in the city with him, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple .)
text_la: Viderant enim Trophimum Ephesium in civitate cum ipso, quem æstimaverunt quoniam in templum introduxisset Paulus.
text_pt: Porque tinham visto com ele na cidade a Trófimo de Éfeso, o qual pensavam que Paulo introduzira no templo.
text_el: ἦσαν γὰρ προεωρακότες Τρόφιμον τὸν Ἐφέσιον ἐν τῇ πόλει σὺν αὐτῷ, ὃν ἐνόμιζον ὅτι εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν εἰσήγαγεν ὁ Παῦλος.

text_en: And the whole city was in an uproar: and the people ran together. And taking Paul , they drew him out of the temple : and immediately the doors were shut.
text_la: Commotaque est civitas tota, et facta est concursio populi. Et apprehendentes Paulum, trahebant eum extra templum : et statim clausæ sunt januæ.
text_pt: E alvoroçou-se toda a cidade, e houve grande concurso de povo; e, pegando Paulo, o arrastaram para fora do templo, e logo as portas se fecharam.
text_el: ἐκινήθη τε ἡ πόλις ὅλη καὶ ἐγένετο συνδρομὴ τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ ἐπιλαβόμενοι τοῦ Παύλου εἷλκον αὐτὸν ἔξω τοῦ ἱεροῦ, καὶ εὐθέως ἐκλείσθησαν αἱ θύραι.

text_en: And as they went about to kill him, it was told the tribune of the band that all Jerusalem was in confusion.
text_la: Quærentibus autem eum occidere, nuntiatum est tribuno cohortis quia tota confunditur Jerusalem.
text_pt: E, procurando eles matá-lo, chegou ao tribuno da coorte o aviso de que Jerusalém estava toda em confusão;
text_el: ζητούντων τε αὐτὸν ἀποκτεῖναι ἀνέβη φάσις τῷ χιλιάρχῳ τῆς σπείρης ὅτι ὅλη συγχύννεται Ἰερουσαλήμ,

text_en: Who, forthwith taking with him soldiers and centurions , ran down to them. And when they saw the tribune and the soldiers, they left off beating Paul .
text_la: Qui statim, assumptis militibus et centurionibus, decurrit ad illos. Qui cum vidissent tribunum et milites, cessaverunt percutere Paulum.
text_pt: O qual, tomando logo consigo soldados e centuriões, correu para eles. E, quando viram o tribuno e os soldados, cessaram de ferir a Paulo.
text_el: ὃς ἐξαυτῆς παραλαβὼν στρατιώτας καὶ ἑκατοντάρχας κατέδραμεν ἐπ' αὐτούς: οἱ δὲ ἰδόντες τὸν χιλίαρχον καὶ τοὺς στρατιώτας ἐπαύσαντο τύπτοντες τὸν Παῦλον.

text_en: Then the tribune, coming near, took him and commanded him to be bound with two chains: and demanded who he was and what he had done.
text_la: Tunc accedens tribunus apprehendit eum, et jussit eum alligari catenis duabus : et interrogabat quis esset, et quid fecisset.
text_pt: Então, aproximando-se o tribuno, o prendeu e o mandou atar com duas cadeias, e lhe perguntou quem era e o que tinha feito.
text_el: τότε ἐγγίσας ὁ χιλίαρχος ἐπελάβετο αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκέλευσεν δεθῆναι ἁλύσεσι δυσί, καὶ ἐπυνθάνετο τίς εἴη καὶ τί ἐστιν πεποιηκώς.

text_en: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude. And when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.
text_la: Alii autem aliud clamabant in turba. Et cum non posset certum cognoscere præ tumultu, jussit duci eum in castra.
text_pt: E na multidão uns clamavam de uma maneira, outros de outra; mas, como nada podia saber ao certo, por causa do alvoroço, mandou conduzi-lo para a fortaleza.
text_el: ἄλλοι δὲ ἄλλο τι ἐπεφώνουν ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ: μὴ δυναμένου δὲ αὐτοῦ γνῶναι τὸ ἀσφαλὲς διὰ τὸν θόρυβον ἐκέλευσεν ἄγεσθαι αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν.

text_en: And when he had come to the stairs, it fell out that he was carried by the soldiers, because of the violence of the people.
text_la: Et cum venisset ad gradus, contigit ut portaretur a militibus propter vim populi.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, chegando às escadas, os soldados tiveram de lhe pegar por causa da violência da multidão.
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀναβαθμούς, συνέβη βαστάζεσθαι αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τῶν στρατιωτῶν διὰ τὴν βίαν τοῦ ὄχλου,

text_en: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying: Away with him!
text_la: Sequebatur enim multitudo populi, clamans : Tolle eum.
text_pt: Porque a multidão do povo o seguia, clamando: Mata-o!
text_el: ἠκολούθει γὰρ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ λαοῦ κράζοντες, αἶρε αὐτόν.

text_en: And as Paul was about to be brought into the castle, he says to the tribune: May I speak something to you? Who said: Can you speak Greek?
text_la: Et cum cœpisset induci in castra Paulus, dicit tribuno : Si licet mihi loqui aliquid ad te? Qui dixit : Græce nosti?
text_pt: E, quando iam a introduzir Paulo na fortaleza, disse Paulo ao tribuno: É-me permitido dizer-te alguma coisa? E ele disse: Sabes o grego?
text_el: μέλλων τε εἰσάγεσθαι εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν ὁ Παῦλος λέγει τῷ χιλιάρχῳ: εἰ ἔξεστίν μοι εἰπεῖν τι πρὸς σέ; ὁ δὲ ἔφη: Ἑλληνιστὶ γινώσκεις;

text_en: Are you not that Egyptian who before these days raised a tumult and led forth into the desert four thousand men that were murderers ?
text_la: nonne tu es Ægyptius, qui ante hos dies tumultum concitasti, et eduxisti in desertum quatuor millia virorum sicariorum?
text_pt: Não és tu porventura aquele egípcio que antes destes dias fez uma sedição e levou ao deserto quatro mil salteadores?
text_el: οὐκ ἄρα σὺ εἶ ὁ Αἰγύπτιος ὁ πρὸ τούτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἀναστατώσας καὶ ἐξαγαγὼν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον τοὺς τετρακισχιλίους ἄνδρας τῶν σικαρίων;

text_en: But Paul said to him: I am a Jew of Tarsus in Cilicia , a citizen of no mean city. And I beseech you, suffer me to speak to the people.
text_la: Et dixit ad eum Paulus : Ego homo sum quidem Judæus a Tarso Ciliciæ, non ignotæ civitatis municeps. Rogo autem te, permitte mihi loqui ad populum.
text_pt: Mas Paulo lhe disse: Na verdade que sou um homem judeu, cidadão de Tarso, cidade não pouco célebre na Cilícia; rogo-te, porém, que me permitas falar ao povo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Παῦλος, ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπος μέν εἰμι Ἰουδαῖος, Ταρσεὺς, τῆς Κιλικίας, οὐκ ἀσήμου πόλεως πολίτης: δέομαι δέ σου, ἐπίτρεψόν μοι λαλῆσαι πρὸς τὸν λαόν.

text_en: And when he had given him leave, Paul standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. And a great silence being made, he spoke unto them in the Hebrew tongue , saying:
text_la: Et cum ille permisisset, Paulus stans in gradibus annuit manu ad plebem, et magno silentio facto, allocutus est lingua hebræa, dicens:
text_pt: E, havendo-lho permitido, Paulo, pondo-se em pé nas escadas, fez sinal com a mão ao povo; e, feito grande silêncio, falou-lhes em língua hebraica, dizendo:
text_el: ἐπιτρέψαντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ὁ Παῦλος ἑστὼς ἐπὶ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν κατέσεισεν τῇ χειρὶ τῷ λαῷ: πολλῆς δὲ σιγῆς γενομένης προσεφώνησεν τῇ Ἑβραΐδι διαλέκτῳ λέγων:

text_en: Men, brethren and fathers, hear the account which I now give unto you.
text_la: Viri fratres, et patres, audite quam ad vos nunc reddo rationem.
text_pt: Homens, irmàos e pais, ouvi agora a minha defesa perante vós

text_en: (And when they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew tongue , they kept the more silence.)
text_la: Cum audissent autem quia hebræa lingua loqueretur ad illos, magis præstiterunt silentium.
text_pt: (E, quando ouviram falar-lhes em língua hebraica, maior silêncio guardaram). E disse:

text_en: And he says: I am a Jew , born at Tarsus in Cilicia , but brought up in this city, at the feet of Gamaliel , taught according to the truth of the law of the fathers , zealous for the law , as also all you are this day:
text_la: Et dicit : Ego sum vir Judæus, natus in Tarso Ciliciæ, nutritus autem in ista civitate, secus pedes Gamaliel eruditus juxta veritatem paternæ legis, æmulator legis, sicut et vos omnes estis hodie:
text_pt: Quanto a mim, sou judeu, nascido em Tarso da Cilícia, e nesta cidade criado aos pés de Gamaliel, instruído conforme a verdade da lei de nossos pais, zelador de Deus, como todos vós hoje sois.

text_en: Who persecuted this way unto death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women ,
text_la: qui hanc viam persecutus sum usque ad mortem, alligans et tradens in custodias viros ac mulieres,
text_pt: E persegui este caminho até à morte, prendendo, e pondo em prisões, tanto homens como mulheres,

text_en: as the high priest does bear me witness and all the ancients. From whom also receiving letters to the brethren, I went to Damascus , that I might bring them bound from thence to Jerusalem to be punished.
text_la: sicut princeps sacerdotum mihi testimonium reddit, et omnes majores natu : a quibus et epistolas accipiens, ad fratres Damascum pergebam, ut adducerem inde vinctos in Jerusalem ut punirentur.
text_pt: Como também o sumo sacerdote me é testemunha, e todo o conselho dos anciãos. E, recebendo destes cartas para os irmãos, fui a Damasco, para trazer maniatados para Jerusalém aqueles que ali estivessem, a fim de que fossem castigados.
